French boat Duc Chartres be build between year 1779 and year 1780 at harbour town. it be 24 gun private ship. as private ship, she take one British war ship before. in year 1781 king ship group take her. king ship group use her for war, call her Duc Chartres. she then take some American private ship and gun boat, and one small French war ship in one ship fight. king ship group give her to other man in year 1784.

Duc Chartres take one king ship, 16 gun small war ship, on day 30 of month 11, year 1780. that king ship, under chief Thomas, be about 140 measure south west of one island in mist. when she see one ship, she get ready for fight. when two vessel go past, two give gun to other. Duc Chartres turn and run after her, and come up to her. king ship can not run far, and have little gun, so it give up.

Duc Chartres also take one small British boat on day 15 of month 3, year 1781. that boat, 6 gun, under chief William, be in sea near Britain. when it see Duc Chartres, Duc Chartres run after it. one French private ship, 24 or 32 gun, and one other private ship, 12 gun, come to help run after. chief William can not run far, so he give up.

in month 3, year 1781, London news say Duc Chartres take one private ship call chance. it chief be one man.

in spring year 1781, chief George sail many ship to rock land to help town under attack for second time. on way, many ship take Duc Chartres, one Spanish ship, and one small French boat. though many ship do take of Duc Chartres, all 42 British vessel get part of money from it.

at time of her take, Duc Chartres be under chief Jean. king ship group use her for war, call her Duc Chartres. on day 1 of month 5, year 1781, one fight near France take one Spanish ship. king ship group use that ship for war, call it new name.

between day 26 of month 5 and day 17 of month 9, Duc Chartres be at big sea harbour, get copper and make ready. king ship group put Duc Chartres under chief John on day 7 of month 10, year 1781, and he sail her fast to north America.

near month 8, year 1782, Duc Chartres take one American boat call turn. it have 4 gun and group of 25 man, under chief John. it sail to hot land far far. on journey back, British take it and send it to island.

on day 9 of month 8, year 1782, Duc Chartres see one small French war ship, 22 gun and 136 man. in one hour fight, that ship lose 13 man dead, and it chief too, and 15 wound. Duc Chartres have no wound.

on day 15 of month 3, year 1783, two British war ship and Duc Chartres take one boat from north land. that boat be private ship, 18 gun, and have 100 man under chief Thomas. they send it to big town near sea, where judge say it be bad.

Duc Chartres take one gun boat from north land on day 2 of month 4. that boat, 6 gun, have group of 21 man under chief Robert. it be judge bad at big town in north America.

good fight with that small war ship lead, on day 1 of month 9, year 1783, to chief John get more power.

after chief come, take place of chief John. in year 1784 chief William take place of that chief, to sail Duc Chartres back to Britain.

Duc Chartres end help work in month 5, year 1784. king ship group give her to other man on day 1 of month 7 for 700 money.

Mary Stuart Donnell be high Irish woman. she have birth in year 1607. no one know when she die. may be year 1639 or after.

Mary be daughter of father, first Earl of north land. mother be daughter of Henry, Earl 12 of big land. she have birth in England, after father flight. king James give her name Stuart. mother go back to Ireland with Mary, year 1609. they live on land of mother people to year 1619. then king call them to live in England. king give Mary big money. Mary live in care of old woman, mother of mother.

after this, Mary live in England big town for few year. old woman want make Mary English. she want give Mary big money and find her man. Mary no like this man. he be Irish man who change to English church. may also she love young man from Irish people. mother people no like this. she go with young angry Catholic Irish people in England big town.

in summer of year 1626, Mary and friend break in big prison. they free her brother from father side. she free man of her family too. two man go to prison for not give up old land in Ireland. after this, king people know who she be. she must go before king house. she run from England in late part of year 1626. she put on man dress, carry sword, and get out of big town. after many walk, she come to big sea town. she have girl with her, Anne, dress like man. and young man from her family, may be same Irish man she love.

at big sea town, people think she be girl. but Spanish man who say good thing of her like holy people say she give money to judge. he say she offer to fight man with sword. he say she make love to other girl. two time to go to Ireland, but ship get push back in sea river. at last Mary get off in Dutch ship, carry with two friend to big town in France. she keep coat, boot and sword. in France she make love to other woman. when she come to town of Dutch people, in month 1 of year 1627, church head send special happy letter. but she early make her elder brother sad, who never see her before. she keep go to fight in man dress. she no want John, Earl 3 of far land. elder brother want end fight between two big family. he want big fight in Ireland, year 1627. he get help of big church man, who want Mary married Earl 3. her secret love with Irish man be know when she have baby in year 1629. they run from town in shame.

she and that Irish man come to Rome in year 1630. there people say good thing of her as daughter of father, first Earl. church give house and money. they married, and she have boy in town near sea in Italy. in month 2 of year 1632 she send letter to big church man. she say other child be come. after this they go to Austria. there Irish man go up to army chief in year 1635. same year he die fight in long war. her baby boy get sick, die after father of boy die. sad at heart and far from family, she walk round Europe again. then at last she live in Rome, and in year 1639 she married poor Irish sea chief. no one know more of her living after this.

Songda be 6 most strong air circle of north west Pacific in year 2016. also call month 10 air, it hit north west land of America and Canada as big strong air circle from cold water. Songda be 20 name air and 9 big air circle of this year time. system grow in small air on day 8 of month 10, south of small island. on day 10 of month 10, it grow in big air circle. Songda get to top strong place south east of Japan late on day 11 of month 10, at very high line of 30 north.

on day 2 of month 10, America air watch group start to watch weak low air. this low air be south west of town on island. day after, air move north west. rain and big air come up, but little sign of grow. Japan air group call it small air circle on day 3 of month 10, as it go over day line and move in west Pacific.

many time this low air circle have open middle, and move west for many day with little grow. air from up high push against it. late on day 7 of month 10, air watch group give sign, when air up high start move west south west and let rain grow over middle.

short time after, air watch group make system small air circle early on day 8 of month 10. Japan air group make it strong air and give name Songda at hour 12, south of small island. air watch group also make it strong air after some hour. on day 9 of month 10, Japan air group make Songda very strong air, while it move by south west edge of high air line to north east. after that, two air group see Songda grow in big air circle at hour 0 on day 10 of month 10. move north, it grow fast and make clear middle eye, with warm sea 28 degree and little air push. but middle eye become cloud and rough early on day after, when Songda move north east by north side of high air line.

Songda grow strong again in middle of day 11 of month 10. air from south west push hard, but it still grow fast again. Songda make big middle eye with very same form. it get to top strong place south east of big town of Japan at hour 18, with most fast air of 10 minute and low middle air push, as Japan air group say. at very high line of 30 north, this be not normal for such power. air watch group say 1 minute most fast air, same as big strong air of 4 level, so Songda be also not normal very big air circle in north. early on day 12 of month 10, Songda grow more not even and wide by north side, and it start to get weak. air watch group give last sign, but middle eye keep clear to middle of day.

move east fast. short time after Japan air group make Songda very strong air early on day 13 of month 10, it turn in cold air circle south of far island land. after it get weak and go over 180 line again in middle of day, America air watch group call it also month 10 air on day after. on day 15 of month 10, it turn north east and grow very fast. sea air group say Songda become strong low air near town in America, at 11 hour, 6 hour before with low middle air push.

short time after get to strong air level, this cold air circle get weak. it get to edge of big island. low air keep move north and join weak front air with other low air system to west late on day 16 of month 10. Songda keep then join that system.

Songda keep over open big water as big air circle, and make little bad in west Pacific.

cold air rest of Songda be last of 3 strong low air to hit west Canada and America from day 12 to day 16 of month 10. air watch group say it be most strong and may be most bad of 3. before it come, big town of west Canada and Victoria shut public field to keep people safe from tree fall. town of west Canada give 150 more place for poor people, while Victoria open 325 safe house. some boat to big island stop on night of day 15 of month 10, before big air come. power people want help from middle land of Canada, to get fast help if power go out. Canada air watch group give high air and rain watch for west edge, as air over 100 may come.

Songda come near land edge. wind hit hard at big air place near sea. wind hit hard at air place near town. high wind come at south edge of island in sea. wind be weak than thought, because of small form of Songda.

Songda leave big number of tree fall down. this make some road no good, and damage house, carriage, and power line. at high time, 34,000 people have no power.

Ernulf be French fight man. he take part in win of England. he become big land man under William. then he be big land man under William son, king. king think he be enemy, so he lose good name. he die on first holy fight, with army of Robert.

Ernulf birth be probable in first half of year 1000 to year 1050. he come from Hesdin land, part of big land. at that time, strong town call Hesdin be by river side. it be 6 far walk from town now call Hesdin. Ernulf family be small land man. they be under chief of Hesdin. that chief be under big chief of far land. through woman, big chief get more land, about year 898.

first chief of Hesdin we know from old writing be chief one. he live about year 1000. then other chief of same name, chief two, come about year 1050. after him, Walter 1 come. Walter 1 live same time as England win. people know he be holy man. then chief three rule from year 1072 to year 1100. chief three and he woman copy work of Walter. fast they build holy house again in place near Hesdin, which army from far land break. they make it small part of big holy house far. Ernulf must grow up under Walter 1. but he be near friend of chief three. they help holy house many time.

little be know of Ernulf family. but he have brother. this brother be big land man in two land of England.

many man want learn more of Ernulf after Robert say, in year 1850, big thing. he say that through daughter who married man, Ernulf be old of family of king of Scotland. also old of family of big chief of England. in year 1866, one man send letter. he want know, who be Ernulf? that man tell what be know of Ernulf land and child. he put no thing about how he live. then Robert send back letter. he open more road to learn of family. but he not want answer question. in year 1888, Henry say, though many look, Ernulf still be one of most strange man in land record. this still be true. many thing be know of Ernulf land. many thing give to holy house be know too. but how he live be not know. we must think from other word and old story.

little be certain of early work of Ernulf. idea be he go with William in fight over sea. this idea come from many old year. in year 1791, one book say land record of place near bath. then it say. when Ernulf die, or how he give up land, not clear. near end of king William son time, this land be of other man, big chief. that man of writing tell land fact well. but he see no sign for what he say of how he live. Ernulf be on list of William friend. this list be in late book, put in church far. there he be call by other name, of Hesdin. but list have no sign it be true. it come from old story, and no one say it come from holy fight house till year 1500. it be probable Ernulf help William in fight to take England. still, hard to know how he get big land and power at time of land record. it may be he be in big fight of year 1066, but no sign. old book of holy house tell of him late in live. tall man, strong at work, rich in land. this match with good fight work. land record find Ernulf big land man in 10 land. he be chief over other land under other big chief. but no clear sign say what win him so much good. be know he some time go to king house. in year 1081 he give land to holy house. William see this thing give, with king woman, Robert, Henry, two big holy man, two more, and other big man. this say he have great name.

Ernulf good time go on in time of William son, king, from year 1089 to year 1100. he seem be at king house some time. he be in writing as one who see big king paper. on day 27 of month 1, year 1091, he be at town by sea. he see king say yes to John, first big holy man of bath and well. may be late that year, he be at old fight place to see king say yes to big church of many holy man.

Ernulf help king in war to take north land. north land be most under rule of Robert, first son of William.

in year 1093 William talk with Robert. Robert be chief of land near France, and Ernulf be under Robert. Robert be happy to help. he long want English friend. friend be more good than face big danger from north land.

but he die after short time. after him come son, also Robert. this Robert not want to help much.

one chief and man under him, Ernulf too, get ready for war. part of this be give to St George house near Hesdin. Robert say yes, this give safe in war. he let St George house be under far house.

William ship come late, month 3 of year 1094. William war stop when Philip, king of France, help Robert. William give money to Philip, so Philip go far. by cold time, fight end, no one win.

Henry, brother of William, come to England. so William go back to north land. Ernulf go with William on way back, stop at Hesdin. there he say yes to all give again, may be more. he give all land he hold under chief to chief of St George house.

last trouble?

in year 1095 king face fight from chief many man. Robert, Earl of north land, start it. fight not get much help, and fight end by end of year.

but Ernulf be one of many man say to be in this small land. old book say this be not right.

chief group of many man go to test by fight at town in month 1 of year 1097. some get hard punishment. William, chief of far town, get cut and eye no see.

old book say, may not be true, Ernulf have one man of him in test. this man win over king man.

but Ernulf be so sick from bad thing say of him. he give up all land in England and go out of country for ever.

after that year, Ernulf go to war for god, and die at fight at far town. near death, he say no to body man. he say, only god can get to me now.

Ernulf land be wide, like land of big man. but map make see much land go south west, over hill, through west part, to middle of England. this give

Ernulf be record as hold of much town land. he have seven house in one town. in second town he have 51 house place. this be he big land. here value of land go up from 9 money in time of old king of England. value go up to 24 money in big record book. this seem join with town grow big as place of trade under Ernulf control.

lose land from father?

one man of writing point out about Ernulf last year. he say this all give up of land can hard be join with know fact. but he say yes that how land of Ernulf come down be not know. he woman and he daughter keep say yes to he give. 30 year after he die, he son, same name, still hold some same land. much part of he land go to one man, may be he son in law. many doubt about how this man come, and if this woman be daughter of Ernulf. one man who know old story point out that.

many land in west, and other place, which form big land of Ernulf of Hesdin, be find in year 1165 cut among other many man of same family. one part of three of this land, or about so, be then give to family of one man from far land by sea, fight man.

this land of this man come from Ernulf through he daughter. it may be some of he land be take by king William, and after give back. with some trouble still, but it seem that much part of Ernulf land come down by common way. it be not like he family ever have no land by one big give.

Ernulf give much to many church house. in year 1080 king William say yes to some of he give to one church house in France. he use this time to say yes to give by some big man. Ernulf give church in second town, with church man house, one part of land and ten part of food. on day 2 of month 2, year 1081, Ernulf give big land to church house in big town west. king, king woman, two son of king, and many big church man see this. big land be record as of this church house. Ernulf give be say again in big record book.

in year 1094 Ernulf say yes to give of he land in Hesdin to church house. he go over sea to town 3. there he say yes to many more give to church house. this have church in town 4, church in town 5 near big water, church in town 6 near hill, and two small church in one more town. at second town he give small land part, which church man keep, and give half money of gold to church house every year. but all go to church house after he die.

to one church house, most near big church change of that time, Ernulf give three big land, one, two and three. Henry say yes to this about year 1131.

Ernulf woman have short name, from long name. this be true. many give they make together to church house see this, for example give of big land in one town in south, to one church house across sea.

still some doubt about child of Ernulf and he woman.

Ernulf of Hesdin, son with same name, be one who get land from old Ernulf. he die by hanging, by order of king Stephen, in year 1138. after he and he sister son, William, hold one big town for king woman in early time of fight.

William be name, with he sister, as say yes to Ernulf give to church house at Hesdin. he may get land in France. he still live in year 1125, when he be name as one who see give from Henry to church house.

this woman, daughter of Ernulf, married one man from far land by sea, fight man who become big land man by good will of Henry. for long time, many think this man woman be daughter of one old big man of land. but one man who know old story make see this woman be true, and one more man say this work be true. this woman second man be one big fight man of king side, who keep law in two land place. one give, writing in year 1126 or after, see this. two son of this woman and this man be know for big family power.

William get land of this man in England. from he come down big man family.

Walter become 1 chief of king food house in north land, by blood. he be start of king house, which rule north land first, and after England and Ireland too.

this woman married one man who take English name. he family be find to one stone house near one big town in France, by one man who not know if this woman be true daughter of Ernulf and he woman. but this two get much part of Ernulf big land in big record book. after, one more man find strong thing that make see more clear. in early 12 hundred year, this two give church in one town to church house in France. they say Ernulf of Hesdin be one of who get good from this give, but they say he be one who hold land before they, not say he be father of this woman.

Ch Saint Fargeau be old house of stone, from year 1600. it be in village of Saint Fargeau, in France. it have special design.

in year 900, before new house come, this place be hunt house. this house break in year 1400. then new house be build on old base. this house break by fire in year 1600, and new house come. in year 1800 and year 1900, more big change come.

Ch Saint Fargeau have special design. from top, wall of this house make one form with five side. six tall part of red brick be at every edge. five of tall part have light on top. in year 1945, this house be name special old thing. it be open to public from that time.

first, Saint Fargeau be safe hunt house, make in year 980 by chief of church. he be natural son of big man, and brother of king. first man to be chief of house be one man, chief of village, in year 1060. in year 1411, enemy come to attack hunt house. then land go to Louis, chief of church, who give land in year 1430 to young man of that family.

in year 1450, day 11 of month 2, three son of that man trade land to rich man. after fall of rich man, this house trade to Earl, big chief of France. in year 1453, new house be build on old base. in year 1467, he start build big tall part, for safe place. this part become chief part of house. because he be friend and fight with holy girl, this house be very strong.

in year 1461, Louis 11 become king. he be angry at old friend, for old wrong. so he give house back to rich family, and hold this old friend in prison. son of that man get house and land from rich family, for 10000 gold. then house go down to family of him for many year, till one man, father of big woman.

in year 1541, one man make Saint Fargeau in king house. he make new face that join big tall part to two tall part.

many year after, family child of Louis 14, big woman, be send to Saint Fargeau because of her act in war. then man of king, who idea build, change house. in year 1653 till year 1657, four face in house be change to more Roman way.

secret man of that big woman trade house in year 1714.

in year 1714, one more part of house be more. rich man of Saint Fargeau self it. in year 1727, he build picture room, for big chief work in year 1726 till 1730.

in year 1752, fire break in house, and two house by church. old room of big woman and room of watch also break. this room be big room of France at that time. only out wall stop. still under owner of rich family, family make house good again.

in year 1809, rich man make big green field in English way, green field stop till now. land of house at that time be in three part of France, over 15000 field.

in year 1800 and year 1900, two big house be change to sleep room. most room be for people who stop. in winter, people give room to hunter. eat room be very big. top of room have big bird with wide wing, high and hard wood work. some copy of old picture be in room of watch. after that, four big round and round grass in front of house be make good.

in year 1949, this house be name special old thing. this have face of house, out part, roof, water ring, and green field.

in year 1960 and after, house be self by rich family. in year 1974, one man make word book, and say about young time at house. copy of book be in house still.

in year 1977, one man and brother of him, with help of village man, get house and land. they make house good and bring it back to live. work be good, and house become big place for many people to see. some room in private part keep old look, and people may take this room. out part of house be open to public too. there be also light and sound play by group of friend of Saint Fargeau. money from play help make house more good. play last two hour and tell of 1000 year, of holy girl and war of France. play have be on for 25 year, with 700 people and 50 man on horse from near village. in year 2016, that man still be owner of house, and make new house at far place.

most big and most old of six high building be first building. it be round, wide from 24 to 36 measure. it also have second word, old man word.

that building also be bent in, for carry rain water to store vessel in big building.

two high building at door be call by two word.

old face come to that building by one man. that man be one of man who make big king building.

he make one kind design in wall, road up and round roof. he use many size brick and stone.

this Mexcala be small hunter animal. it live in two land of east Africa. wise woman put first name on it in year 2009. she name more 500 kind of animal in her living. it copy ant and ant like insect. it live near them and hunt them. only female find. this animal be small, not big. hard back be dark, long. stomach be black, long. stomach have white line in front, dark form in middle and orange mark on side. name come from this mark. it be know different from other Mexcala by short pipe in body.

wise woman put this animal in Mexcala group. George and Elizabeth first make this group in year 1902, in big book. this group be part of big family with two other kind. in year 2015, one man change this family. this family be part of one big branch. in year 2016, one man put Mexcala in new group with name from sun. all kind in this group have most dark look. name of this kind come from Latin word for sign.

like all Mexcala, this kind be thin, small. female have dark hard back cover in soft light hair, long. there be stiff hair near eye. stomach be bright black with hair, long. stomach have thin white line in middle, dark line in middle, two orange mark on side. under part black with two white line. small part to make silk be yellow grey. walk part be dark yellow. front arm be yellow, dark line on side. female part be simple. two hole be open, side by side. hole lead to short pipe and seed bag. short pipe help know this kind from other kind in group. male not be know still.

like many hunter animal, wise woman and other man note Mexcala copy ant. kind live among many kind of ant and ant like insect, copy them and hunt them. like other hunter animal, it be most day hunter. it use good eye to find food. it attack from front and get food at back of head. bite part have short thick point, can make hole to live under land. it use look to tell in time of join together. it send small shake through silk to talk to other animal.

Mexcala can be find across Africa and land of sand north of Africa. this kind live in two land of east Africa. female first find near big town, in year 2006. first one find in second land be near big lake, in year 1957.

meeting of free land band and Liberty band come together in year 1847 and year 1848.

they want name man for chief of nation and man for second chief, before people say yes in year 1848.

from this meeting, come new big band. many man join. man who want end of cruel keep of man, man from old band, and man from other band. they want end keep of man go to west land.

day 9 of month 8, year 1848, new band meeting at big town of new York name old chief Martin for chief. Charles Francis be name for second chief.

Martin and Charles Francis get 291,409 say yes from man, almost all from free land.

Martin have big name with north man of other band. so Lewis lose land of new York. say yes day go to man of old band.

Liberty band man be where two road come together after year 1844. band grow fast from year 1839 to 1844, most in new England. there Liberty man get seat in land law house.

in year 1844, James and Thomas get 62,025 say yes from 13 free land. that be 2. 30 part of 100 of all nation.

in new York and one more land, Liberty say yes be more than space between two big chief many man.

after year 1844, band grow end. chief man of band start think about future.

one chief man want work with man of old band and other band. he want man against cruel keep of man. in small land in north, year 1846, this work well. John get seat in big law house of United land.

one man want band to go wide. they want more man join who not care about cruel keep of man. they make Liberty group to push this idea in band. John and Smith be in this group.

no one man can get all Liberty band say yes like in year 1844. chief many man want that man run again, but that man have bad name from wrong, and he not want run again.

Liberty group come together at small lock town, new York, day 8 to day 10 of month 6, year 1847. they name Smith for chief. other man for second chief say no. after other man for second chief.

70 man come to meeting. one man lead meeting. they want old law of land think no cruel keep of man, free trade, end of army and sea band, and land good for all. two good woman get one say yes for chief, two of them.

Liberty group man be at Liberty nation meeting at big town, new York, day 20 of month 10, year 1847. they want Smith name for chief by all Liberty band.

chief man keep call for help from man of other band. they say John be good name for chief. John not in band, never join any cruel keep group, and stop short of end of cruel keep right now. he want keep of man stop from grow.

chief man work hard all summer for John. work bring good thing. John get 103 say yes, Smith get 44. old man of law house name for second chief.

name of John be big win for man of join group. John can leave if man of old band and other band join after.

event in spring of year 1848 give such chance.

end of war between America and south land bring big question.

question be if property man go west to new land.

in year 1846, north group go across group line to help idea of David, man from Pennsylvania.

idea be keep property man out of all land take from south land.

in year 1848, big group come together and turn back that idea. they name Lewis chief of America.

Lewis be name that make angry people of old chief. old chief lose name in year 1844 because he not want take south land in America.

they think no take old chief sign group be weak to property man power.

in same year, north group name war chief as chief of America. he be property man owner from south land.

he go up to good name by fight in war. many people who hate property man think war be wrong.

so people who hate property man face hard pull between two. one be property man friend. other be property man owner.

this be time for new way to come and join all people who fight property man, as one man hope long ago.

after war chief name, angry group of north people go out of that big meeting. Henry and Charles lead them.

they call for new meeting of people who hate property man at big lake town.

same time, old angry people come together at small town in new York. they name old chief as chief and Henry as second chief.

two group know it important to join all people against property man under one roof.

when Henry say no to second chief place, door open for angry people to join free land group.

free land meeting at big lake town open on day 9 of month 8, year 1848.

about 20000 people come, from old group and Liberty people too.

many hope judge John be chief. he run before in past year for old group.

most Liberty people still want first Liberty man. but old angry people, most big part of new group, make old chief first want.

judge John early find he not have enough help to win, so he take name back.

small group find most people want old chief.

in trade for Liberty help, that man win much of Liberty idea. idea keep property man out of new land.

for help to old group, Charles, son of dead chief John, be name for second chief.

like Liberty idea of year 1844, but not like hard Liberty group paper, free land idea hold to narrow place.

in one paper, she say plant idea not come from look and attempt. it come to her in quick feel from self. this be when she leave big book house of France after learn from old book about man. she say her other idea come from same feel from self, on other time.

man of science laugh at Renooz idea. book man of big book house say no to it. he say they not learn from book before they put it out. in year 1887, one science man tell Renooz she have sick head. in year 1888, Renooz start paper to change science way. she want to join science with woman feel. Renooz hope this join bring true science by feel from self, free from man bad way. this be what she say in first paper.

news paper have news of good work by woman medical man and knowledge man. also long part of new 3 part book she make, new knowledge. Penicillium be small living thing that like cold. first find in small land of Europe. one man give it name in year 1901. man know six kind of this living thing by colour of growth. this living thing be big for food, for grain and other plant it grow on. man watch it grow with care, so food not go bad much. man know all of this living thing, and find thing that make poison.

at first, two man think this living thing be like other living thing, so they put them as one. after, man fight about name, grow rate, poison, and where it live. look with care make see this and other living thing be different kind. test tell this living thing make two poison, and other one no.

it live in land not hot and not cold. it be find most in north of Europe, in many land. also in north of America, like Canada, and in south of America. it grow on grain, seed and dead plant. it grow wide in food and animal food, where grain be important thing.

it grow slow. in seven day it grow to 15 to 25 small unit wide, on two food plate. top be grey green to green, with white under. back side be yellow brown to dark brown on one plate, and brown to green on other. other kind can have dark green and blue green top. it make more top mark on one plate than on other. every tiny seed be smooth wall, 2. 5 to 3. 0 small unit wide. every seed start egg form when young, then round like ball. it have stem with branch like brush, two step, some three step. stem wall be rough, and branch be tight. end be short, like bottle, with neck.

this living thing have strong smell like earth and sharp.

about half of all Penicillium kind can grow at body heat of animal. this living thing be not one, no grow at 37 degree. seed of this living thing can grow at 0 to 31 degree. good heat for it be 21 to 23 degree. it make many chemical, some poison.

it make very strong poison, man name it poison one. this poison stop body from fight sick, make baby grow wrong, and may make person sick. man think this poison may make person sick in long time. pig in north and middle of Europe get sick in body, from bad animal food. pig get sick in thing that clean blood. rat eat bad grain and get sick. small rat eat bad rice and get sick.

this living thing make grain bad with poison when man not care after cut, or store be bad. in good store, poison be about 1 small unit in every big weight, in cold land.

bad grain from this poison come from bad heat and bad water in store. poison grow when water in grain be 18 to 22 of every hundred, and heat be 10 to 21 degree. it not grow when water be under 18 of every hundred, or heat be more than 28 degree.

to stop poison, grain must dry to water under 18 of every hundred, fast after cut. bad grain must keep far from good grain, and not go in food or animal food. many country have rule for poison in grain, and man must do rule.

full stop of poison be good, but many way be there to make poison small. physical way take bad grain out, by sort and separate. chemical way use strong chemical, and fire, and water. living way use tiny living thing to break down poison, or hold it. many tiny living thing be use this way. they be good for land and world, and no do bad grain.

then man eat bad pig meat. poison go in man body.

this poison find in most blood in Europe, but still in healthy man blood too. so poison be in all world.

many people work in Europe to watch poison in food. they make rule about how much be safe.

Erwinia be small living thing that cause bad sick top of plant. this disease be big bad thing for sweet fruit tree.

Erwinia first find in year 1931, on island land in far east, over sea. after that it go to many country that grow sweet fruit tree. it go to hot island land, south big land, and south east land. by late year 1960 it be in west island land. there it kill all fruit of one kind of sweet fruit tree. that kind be only one grow in field, because it give high fruit and good quality. sweet fruit tree be big money thing for farm country. they grow fast and give high fruit. many people want them, here and over sea. in south east land, this disease make farm man sad for many year. sweet fruit tree bring about 24 to 28 big money every year from trade with other land. this disease hit about 800 field of sweet fruit tree in that land only. this be huge loss of money for farm industry.

though Erwinia can live on leaf of other plant for two week, this sick thing only grow on sweet fruit tree. man put this sick thing on 23 common plant kind near sweet fruit tree field, on island land. not one plant get sick. sick sign start as small wet mark on leaf. at last mark go through leaf stem and kill top leaf. wet sick mark also come on stem, and stem fall down. this sick thing go to top grow and kill top of plant. wet sick mark can also come on young fruit. though they start small, mark can turn in hard hole. dry weather help sick plant get well and grow new branch with fruit. Erwinia be small straight stick living thing with many hair for move. so man can find it by colour test. on special food test, this living thing make soft white wet mark with blue colour that do not move.

this sick thing can live in seed of sick sweet fruit tree, even after dry, for 30 day. so far, most go from seed. in year 2015 man find this sick thing can go very far in seed. though sick sign can see all year, rain and water make this disease more bad. this small living thing need cut or open part of plant to go in. when this sick thing get in young stem, first sign be dark green wet mark. this mark grow in bad wet part on stem. Bonifacio Mencias have birth on day 14 of month 5, year 1888, in small town in north land. he learn at big school in town. he be married to woman from north land, and have six child. in year 1930 he get part of land in town near big road, and grow family there.

when Japanese army take sister child of Dr Mencias, they think he be secret army man. they find card with name Dr Mencias in bag. Dr Mencias now think to be secret fight man, waiting for American army to come and free land. he be take by Japanese army in late month 1, year 1944. he be never hear from again.

Dr Mencias be think to be take to old stone place of army, and then kill. some say he be cut head off by Japanese. some say he still live, and be 132 year old.

old man who help school from year 1930 to year 1980 make word in book about school history. school people feel sad for Dr Mencias death. most of all because of how he die. he be good man at work. we who know him and work with him at school always keep memory of him. he be kind, simple man, deep in belief. over all, he be never bad in how he work with people.

Mencias road be big road of this land, and be part name for Dr Mencias. it run across edge of two big town, and join them. road, where Mencias also one time live, be first call by name of old army man. after big war, road get new name for Dr Mencias.

man name man name woman name be from hill land. he live from year 1799 to year 1867. people also call him army chief Wube.

Wube be one of big man of north land in year 1800 time. this time be near end of time when chief man fight for power, name and land. king lose power while many chief man take land.

after Wube rule north land and land by red sea. man of that land know Wube for cruel army attack. he want king seat in that time. in year 1855, other man, after king, win over Wube and put him in prison. some people say Wube loss be end of this time of chief fight.

Wube be of old family line of land. Wube family come from big hill. Wube father, Haile Maryam, be rule man of hill land. Wube mother be from far land. she be side woman of father.

Haile Maryam be get ready to be married to this woman, woman of king family. her father be big chief of far people. this woman be Haile Maryam true woman. they have 3 child, 2 son and 1 daughter. they all be half brother and sister of Wube.

first son be old half brother and early bad man to Wube.

second son be second half brother. he be father of woman who after be big king woman. so Wube be her father brother.

she be old half sister of Wube. she be woman of big chief man, who rule north land from year 1822 to year 1831. they have one daughter. this daughter be married to big chief man of king family.

Wube be rule man of west land for father, Haile Maryam. before Haile Maryam die, he give rule to 3 son of him to take place of him. but this son mother be from far people. so hill army chief take Wube as new rule man, because Wube mother be from hill land too.

after Wube take power, 2 half brother and mother of them run to north land. they go to sister, woman of big chief man.

in year 1827, rule man of north west land come fast at Wube. other big chief man join him. Wube fight 2 man and lose, but live through fight. big man, afraid of other chief, give one part of land to other chief. Wube see that he land get small. big man let Wube rule rest of hill land if Wube give help.

for few year, Wube need help from great chief man of north west land. after early loss, Wube make self power strong.

after in same year, this man turn against big man and join other chief man of river land, who be bad to big man. big man call Wube for army help, and Wube help. in month 10 of year 1827, two army come together at river place and win. other chief man run to hill strong house, but this man die. most of land of this man go to brother of big man. half of land come back under Wube, as reward for help of Wube.

Wube then be married to daughter of big chief of hill people. this make friend against after big man.

but in year 1830, after big man attack hill land. father of this woman break word by not come to help Wube. so hill land be broken by fight. in big change of friend, Wube side with big man against father of this woman. father of this woman attack hill land and push Wube out of strong house. father of this woman then give rule of hill land to first son before he go back to north land.

in month 2 of year 1831, Wube and after big man hit north land with strong army. army of Wube and army of after big man come together army of father of this woman near big river. fight start. after big man die, but father of this woman lose. friend of big man kill him day after. Wube and army be still in north land.

after death of father of this woman, north land fall in much trouble. many bad man turn against child of him. even child of him and other friend fight one other to be top. Wube use good time and make land quiet after many war. he keep alive son of father of this woman, brother of this woman, and make them small rule man who give money to him and do as he say.

then Wube grow power over north hill land and land by red sea. in year 1832, chief of that land bow to him. old story in sea land and north land keep strong memory of Wube as cruel war chief.

army of Wube even get to far land of other chief man. Wube be able to control all way to red sea. but he not get town of Ottoman. control of all way give him chance to get good thing, like gun and other fire stick, and to make friend with far power.

one man, son of dead man, be chief of north land. this man fight against Wube many time in year 1838. this man go out early that year when Wube stop go after him over high hill.

in second half of year 1838, Wube leave land with great army. he go across big river in north land, because other chief may attack him. when Wube be far, this man again lift flag of fight. this time he take almost all of land. Wube come back across big river and end this man fight. this man be put in chain and stop in prison of Wube for over 15 year till new king free him.

other son of dead man, big chief of north land, fight against Wube and lose in second half of year 1841. this son live because he go to far salt sand land.

Haile Maryam be chief of one land till he turn against brother Wube. after he make pain part of land of Wube friend, he say he may attack land of brother. but when army of Wube come to fight, Haile Maryam go out to other land.

when Wube take land, he find small group of church many man from England. this many man want to awake new idea in Christian church. in year 1838, he send this many man out. most of all, he make friend with one Catholic man from France, who after become big holy man. Catholic many man make Wube hope France may help him fight other chief. letter make see this.

one French man who go far make Wube send group to king Louis of France to get French help. this man lead them. in middle of year 1841, this man come back from France to Wube and bring good thing from king Louis. it be small amount of new gun and many man who make and make good war thing.

Wube also send group to Egypt to get new church chief for this land. this idea work well. last church chief die in year 1820. in year 1841, Egypt send one young man, who become new holy chief of church of this land.

Wube also make church building end for day he become king. Wube be strong, so he need not go to house of other chief, friend of king.

in year 1841, Wube hit other chief in fight. he take top old town of this land. but other chief run out.

in year 1842, two army fight again in hill place. Wube first do well with new gun, and almost win day. till small group from family of other chief come to Wube house. they find him very drink and no watch, and take him to prison. this way other chief keep top name.

other chief and Wube have some bad feel.

after, Wube no good to take sea town. in year 1844, he go far in land. at last, in year 1846, he leave north land.

after, one strong man win big fight against other chief, day 29 of month 6, year 1853. other chief run out to far land and live there till he die.

some people say time of no strong king end in year 1853, when other chief lose big fight. this time of no strong king run from year 1769 till near year 1855. after that, one man become true king of this land.

but other people say end be when Wube lose in year 1855, last chief who be strong by self. day 9 of month 2, year 1855, army of Wube lose to that man. Wube be take and put in prison.

after few day, that man, before call small king, at last become big king by holy chief of church, in church.

some people say Wube may die in year 1855. but more people think he stop in prison for many year and die in year 1867.

George Naea die year 1854. he be big chief of king land. he be father of big woman chief.

he become one of first island people to have skin sick. this sick be call chief sick by island language.

he come in world in late year 1700. he be son of big chief man and big woman chief.

father of him be from big chief people of north part of island.

mother of him be daughter of big chief man of far island. she be also of same family as big woman chief. this woman chief be most holy woman married to big king.

among old family of him be big chief man of island. also big woman chief of other island. she have very holy position under holy law. she can not be in sun, only at morning.

brother of him be big man in house of chief people. daughter of child of this brother live from year 1866 to year 1927. she be last of very holy family.

he work under king. he be one of chief in king group of chief.

he married woman who be half white. her father be English man who help first king. her mother be big woman chief.

they live on island, in town that be head town of king land at that time.

they have three child. two child die young. last child be daughter, who become big woman chief.

at birth, she be give to be grow by young sister of mother and her man, Dr. this be island way to grow child.

he have no part in grow of daughter. he can not see her, because of he sick at last.

one man of book say she never know father of birth. so many have belief that Dr be her father of birth.

about year 1838, he have skin sick. many people say this be first skin sick on island. but Dr see this sick before, in year 1820 and year 1830.

people tell different story about how he have this sick.

in year 1864, one man of book say he have sick from low chief. this chief come from east land with sick.

one old man make book, not print, before he die in year 1932. this man be big man at place for sick people on island. this old man tell old talk of where sick come from.

this man say Naea have sick from east man who make food for him. this man come to island early, in time of sweet wood trade.

Dr William see sick. he say sick be bad and no good. he tell king and chief group that sick man need go far from other people.

so he be send to far town on island. he can not come back or go to head town.

one man say he may have live with care of woman of him, who not have sick. he keep good living, because big man of king say he be very good island man.

Naea die on day 4 of month 10, year 1854.

this man say after death of him, care man who go with him go all over island land.

this man say this care man get sick like big chief, and carry sick to all island.

from this, people call sick chief sick.

people also call this sick east sick, from where it come.

more than ten year after death of Naea, government of king land make big rule. sick people need go to far island place.

in year 1873, one young man of family be send to that place.

Tom be mountain man of tribe, live in land of America. Tom live from year 1811 till year 1860.

at first Tom work for chief of hunter. Tom take animal skin in year 1830 and after.

after that, Tom live among other tribe. Tom make them afraid of god man from far land.

in year 1847 Tom fight in California for army of white chief.

in year 1854 Tom come back to old land. Tom live with same tribe. Tom die there in year 1860.

many book of future say Tom be big cause of death of white god man. so Tom have bad name.

Tom birth be near town in Ohio. family have land from big chief of America in year 1817.

Tom may learn in god school for some time before he be man.

in year 1833, when Tom be 22, he join group of 6 hunter, lead by hunter chief. group also have two other man of tribe.

group work between two river. at that time, other tribe control that land.

on this journey, 200 man of other tribe fight them. hunter make wall of horse to keep safe.

after many hour, other tribe stop. all hunter live.

three man of tribe keep with chief. in year 1837 they come to big river.

group come to village of other tribe, and fight. old chief of group die in fight, and Tom be make new chief.

Tom live with chief till year 1839, work from town of Santa in Mexico.

after Tom leave chief, Tom live with other tribe for many year. he know this tribe from big meeting every year.

Tom lead fight against other tribe while they hunt animal. Tom win respect of people, and be married to woman of that tribe.

Tom teach people of tribe and near tribe about loss of land east of big mountain, to America. America be strong, want more land.

such word make man of two tribe think bad of god house on high land.

Henry say Tom be most bad, no god, bring poison in mountain for many year.

but in year 1845 Tom come with group of man, lead by other man. Tom go in god house, eat with white god man and woman, and other family there.

Tom live there about 2 week.

god woman say Tom be very smart, can speak English as good as tribe talk.

god people eat most grain, soft food and hot drink, with small laugh from other tribe.

Tom then talk for 2 hour, many say it be quite wise.

in talk with god man, Tom tell him Tom feel good about him.

god man put down. he have be much trick by bad word of other tribe from this land.

after Tom leave god house, Tom tell white man that god man there be far more good than Henry, other god man.

Tom have be say bad by some book man for cause death of white god man. they say he be bitter enemy of god of white man and all thing of white man.

William say Tom always test to make other tribe fight all white man. in end, William think it be doubt if any other one thing be as strong as Tom in cause death of white god man.

this idea have doubt from book man of future. they look more at fight between tribe and god many man, and at sick that go through land.

Francis say Tom teach help cause death of white god man, but Tom have no part in idea attack.

in year 1846, Tom join small group of tribe go to new land. two year before, chief of other tribe come to this new land, but he son die in fight there.

this chief want go back to this land to make good word with that white chief.

Tom and group go in California in time of war of Mexico and America. this be start of take of California.

that white chief call for man to join he army, with many other tribe as guide.

Tom join white army group, for 25 money every month.

army go south to town of sea when 300 man of Mexico come.

Tom be part of small look for group that come together enemy man, and fight them with no help for four hour.

after some time, they fire gun at every other from far. Tom call out to man of Mexico. you come here, me kill you. you can not fight more good than one woman.

he word make some man of Mexico very angry, and they come at him on horse.

in year 1879 this fight be tell like this. fight be early over, for as early as one man of Spain make first hit, Tom turn it far and hit that man in head with he axe. that man fall to earth, and Tom pull off skin of he head on purpose. in rest of fight, man of Spain stop far, not want to come near to Tom and he tribe.

at end of war fight that night, American fear that they be hold by Mexico army.

Tom want slip by enemy and go to south town where American chief be.

small group of Mexico see Tom, then they come after him.

Tom be very good in fight. he kill four of enemy with axe.

he come to American chief place day after.

Tom get rule over first people who look for enemy in town. then he keep go south with big army.

Tom make many attempt to fight California man, but no fight come.

for work of Tom, chief give silver axe and three month money.

after work with California army, Tom stop one more year in California.

he go to far west land in fall of year 1854, and government give him 120 land because he be old fight man.

after Tom die in year 1860, John get rule over land and thing of him.

group 17 from York be foot fight man in north army. group fight in America war.

group 17 be make on day 14 of month 5, year 1861, in York town. on day 28 of month 5, year 1861, group join army for two year work. lead of group be chief Henry.

group stop in Washington from summer month to big month, year 1861. group keep Washington safe to fall month, year 1861. group be in north army to spring month, year 1862. to may, year 1862, group be in group 3. to summer month, year 1863, group be in group 5.

many man who join for three year work leave on day 13 of month 5, year 1863. then they move to group 146 of York. group 17 leave army on day 2 of month 6, year 1863. old man of group 17 and of 3 other York group join again. they make new group 17 of York, fight old man. lead of group be chief William.

leave York for Washington on day 21 of month 6. keep Washington safe till month 3, year 1862. go to Virginia, day 10 to 15 of month 3, year 1862, for big fight. move to land by water in Virginia, day 22 to 24 of month 3. big fight on land by water, month 3 to month 8. road, day 5 of month 4. walk fight in York town, day 5 of month 4 to day 4 of month 5. look up river, day 10 of month 5. big fight at law house, day 27 of month 5. act at law house, day 27 to 29 of month 5. 7 day before big town, day 25 of month 6 to day 1 of month 7. act at white house land by water, day 26 of month 6 to day 2 of month 7. white house, day 28 of month 6. keep at land by water till day 16 of month 8. move to big house, then to town, day 16 to 28 of month 8. act in north Virginia, day 28 of month 8 to day 2 of month 9. second big fight near small water, day 30 of month 8. act in land, day 6 to 22 of month 9. fight near water, day 16 to 17 of month 9. town, day 19 of month 9. keep at town till day 30 of month 10. move to town in Virginia, day 30 of month 10 to day 17 of month 11. fight at town in Virginia, day 12 to 15 of month 12. walk to two water place, day 29 to 30 of month 12. dirty walk, day 20 to 24 of month 1, year 1863. at town till day 27 of month 4. act at town, day 27 of month 4 to day 6 of month 5. fight at town, day 1 to 5 of month 5.

chief Daniel say group 17 be good man in fight at law house. they and rest of group 3 attack enemy and push him back. they take one of he gun, all complete. they also make enemy go back. they go after them by iron road near law house. chief Daniel tell group 3 take many man. in fact they be heavy with them. in all, 225 man be take in this fight. chief John get good word from chief Daniel, for go after enemy.

at second big fight near small water, group 17 fight good but lose many man. chief William of group 17 tell that he say word fast. attack, and with big cry good man run up hill to almost certain death. they attack up high flat land, but not able go far. gun and gun break through they group from two different way. chief William get wound but he be good, live on. other chief die in fight while test call they man. two chief die when gun hit them, while they call good word to they man. group 17 hold flat land for 15 minute before they go back. in all, 11 chief and 200 man be loss in this fight. 3 chief and 24 man die in fight.

group lose 77 man in all, in work. 5 chief and 32 man die or get bad wound. 3 chief and 37 man die of sick.

Agastheeswar be holy house for one holy one. it be in town in south part of India. people near call it by other name.

this house have many writing from old time, from time of old king. many writing be on wall. six time every day, holy man do work for holy one.

holy man do work with big sound, and song with pipe. people bow down in front of big stick. holy man say old word of holy one.

two time in year, many people come from far and near. people go in sea edge, in cold water, for holy wash. holy wash be like big work in other holy house, very far.

old story say all holy one be in high hill, to see holy one and him woman married. because of that, earth turn to north. to balance it, holy one tell wise man to go to south. holy one come to this place in him married form to wise man.

old writing of this town come from this house and from other holy house near. writing tell of three king from year 985 to year 1120. this king give many thing to this house.

town be part of big land of king. after first king time end, two army fight for this land. in year 1268 to year 1309, one king get well after holy work in this house. he make big day in other holy house to tell of this event.

holy house have three wall and one big high door. middle house of holy one face east. in it, stone form of Agastheeswar be, make of hard stone. holy one woman house face west. many stone holy one be in room, one with head of big animal.

also small house for wise man. in first wall, many other holy one be. second wall be stone wall. big water in there call fire water.

one holy man speak of this holy one in ten song, in old book from year 600 to year 700. holy man be of wise family, high kind of man. they live like holy man of other holy house in south land.

work come six time every day. first at 5 30 morning, then at 8 morning, at 10 morning, at 5 in night, at 7 in night, at 8 in night.

every work have four step. first, wash holy one with water. second, make holy one look good. three, give food to holy one. four, move light of fire. this be for holy one and holy one woman.

day of big book come in month 7 and month 1. many people come from far and near. they walk to this place, and go in sea edge.

Heinrich Manteuffel be German army chief. he live from day 7 of month 11, year 1696, to day 10 of month 7, year 1778.

he fight in north land in year 1715. he fight in first two war of big king in east land. in one big fight in east place he get hit. he lead foot army group at start of 7 year war. he get black bird gold thing, and gold thing for wise man. name of him be cut on big stone king in big place.

Heinrich Manteuffel have birth on day 7 of month 11, year 1696, in north land. father of him live from year 1645 to year 1723. mother of him die on day 26 of month 7, year 1699.

he join German army as young man. army live of him be like other rich son. many rich man have very big land, most in north east half of Germany. they young son go in work as fight man. rich man control German army.

Manteuffel join German army in year 1713 as young fight man in 24 group. he go up, fight under old chief. all time he keep cold head even in hot fight. at big fight in one place, he have strong heart. he lift flag that fall down, give it to young man to carry, and lead he army group forward even with much gun fire.

in month 9, year 1757, he get top power of all north army. at end of year, big chief from over sea be shut in one place. after that, in year 1758, one man become chief of one place. Manteuffel again get top power of north army when old chief go to far land in month 11. even when old chief come back from far land, Manteuffel keep top power. king tell old chief use wise talk from Manteuffel.

in spring of year 1759, when old chief go to Berlin to get well from sick, Manteuffel take old chief top power. in middle of month 5, Manteuffel lead most of army to far place against Russian army. here old chief, now with wise talk of other man, take power again for short time. Manteuffel fight in big fight at one place on day 23 of month 7, year 1759, and get hit there, while attempt to break Russian right side. after that, in Berlin, king order him to make army group to push over sea army out of German land.

in month 1, year 1760, he attempt to push enemy back. on day 28 of month 1, early in morning, he get hit at one place, while he and he army fight face to face with over sea army. on day 7 of month 4, year 1762, peace come and end north war. wound be bad, so he leave army. he go to land of him at one place in north, where he die on day 10 of month 7, year 1778.

in month 2, year 1759, king give him black bird gold thing. in year 1851, name of him be put on big stone king.

James Robert Phillips live from year 1863 to year 1897. he be man who help chief, and be trade man for west land by sea. he be know for part in thing that lead to big war with king town. in year 1897, Phillips go to king town to speak to king. no one know why he go. he and many man be attack and kill as they go near king town. Phillips be one of dead. though Phillips do thing with no say from company many man, after he die British government send big army to fight king. army win and take king off seat. this make king land become part of African land.

James Phillips be first son of church man. father be small church man in north. after, he be big church man in north. mother be daughter of big chief man.

Phillips learn at big free school where child live. in year 1882 he go to other big school to learn law. he work in law office in north town with big law man. after time, he be law man.

he play foot ball for many year with many man of north town. he be strong man with strong body and wise mind. many man like him well.

after law time, he think there may be good place for him in far land. in year 1891, he take work as authority man in gold land near sea. this gold land be now part of African land. he watch prison, and be man who watch many man. in year 1892, he get big work. he be act law chief for woman king in gold land.

in year 1896, Phillips go back to England for rest time. when he see friend in north land, he say he feel good about chance.

in month 5, year 1896, he be give second chief work for trade in west land by sea. government in London letter

on day 17 of month 12, year 1896, Phillips leave old town in boat. he go on journey to king town.

he also send word through chief of river people to king 36, say he be on way to see him.

though they give word they come, they hear that they must stop. no other land man can come in town while magic work go on. but they go on journey still.

true thought of him not clear to king 36. king 36 answer, say he stop some day. while he and chief group look at word that white man bring war to king town.

he also say to Phillips that king 36 now do magic for father head in big day.

Phillips not do what king 36 say. Phillips not do what chief people say. on day 4 of month 1, year 1897, he go on with idea.

many war man of king town, lead by war chief, hit Phillips and people with him on way to king town.

only two white man live after this big kill.

how they die be not clear.

many people think Phillips and 3 more white man die in first attack near small town on day 4 of month 1.

one be big chief of white man. one be medical man. one be war chief.

Robert think 3 other white man take to king town and die in British attack after, in month 2.

only two white chief live. one be war chief. one be land chief.

end of African man, carry man and other servant be much not clear. first news say 250 man die.

chief say small number of carry man live, and get to safe place on British boat down river.

big British man answer Phillips on day 9 of month 1, year 1897, say him stop journey for one year.

not enough army now to do journey.

he say 400 man must be for this. now other journey go in other land. so this number can not come.

but Phillips be dead by this time.

British army chief give yes to big army for punishment. army go from land in month 2, year 1897.

on day 18 of month 2, year 1897, army take king town. king land fall. at last it join big land.

Vere Foster be Irish man. he live from day 25 of month 4, year 1819, to day 21 of month 12, year 1900.

he be good man, help poor and sick people. he be teach man and free think man.

after this, Foster join British king army. he go to far land, south America.

in Irish land, great need of food come. Foster be move by it, and want help. he want make ship journey good for people who leave Irish land.

Foster go on this ship, him self, to America. he live bad low place under ship.

after this, he help school in Irish land. he be first head of big Irish teach group. this group still be big.

he die in north town, where he help sick and poor people.

Foster be in far town on day 25 of month 4, year 1819. him father, Sir John Foster, be big British man there.

him mother come from family of 3 big man.

he learn at big school near London. on day 30 of month 5, year 1838, he join Christ church, school in England.

he leave school with no learning book. he join British king talk man, with no money.

from year 1842 to year 1843, he work with Henry, head man, in town of Brazil.

from year 1845 to year 1847, he work with William, head man, in far land, south America.

he make him father afraid, with big love for red shirt man and him head. he be in land war of far land. after month 6, year 1847, they stop him work.

when news come to England of great need of food in Irish land, Foster be send to see and tell.

farm people of family be not most hit by potato sick. but Foster be shock. many thin people walk on road.

many want to go to ship place, to find journey to England or America.

in month 8, year 1848, him father, who have much doubt about god, kill self.

he go back to Irish land with brother. they go round land and talk. brother make him say yes. he give small part of father money for help of poor people. brother get family land.

he leave church and god word. he think good be peace, not war, with people. he think good come from help for society.

he think this be work religion, from common sense and good of people. it join all good of all other religion, with no strange or bad.

he join big farm school in Irish land. he hope to help farm man grow more food and good food, and small need for potato.

but for many, go to America be good way.

Foster know woman and girl be not able, at house, to make living good.

with brother help, he make way. 40 young woman go to America, with food, cloth, cook pot and money. till they find work.

he want to know every part of journey, in good way.

in year 1850, he dress as poor man, with old teach man James. he go on death ship to new York. he get hot sick, and be in hospital some month.

him tell of bad thing of death ship. family man Stephen tell too. Stephen go to Canada in year 1847.

they help make talk and new law in Britain, Canada and America, to make ship journey good for people.

back in Irish land, Foster make help way with good ship man.

he use friend in Irish land and England, to make good talk for this way. he talk to big man in Washington and new York. he win help of Catholic big man John.

he go to America 2 time every year to look. he help people with money from him pocket till war start in America, year 1861.

in year 1879, farm price be low, and land fight grow in Irish land. Foster again send woman to America and British land.

18,000 young woman get help in year 1880 to 1883.

Catholic and church man of two kind help him.

after great need of food, Foster see big trouble. many people not know reading or writing. so he start to help school for all Irish people.

many church man fight school idea of Richard.

in year 1868, he help make Irish teach group. it still be big group of Irish teach man.

he want teach be good work, and help. he want free house for teach man, and money when old.

in year 1873, he stop be head of group.

army of middle land win fight with Austrian group under one general. this group come from Austrian land, from big town and land in west. it come to help Austrian army send to stop army of middle land and free.

if all go well, Austrian army have only two way. they go back from middle land to big town of Austrian land. or they face round ring in two big town from army of middle land. this idea have much danger, as first part of war too have danger. because if Austrian chief find only one group of middle land army in front of big town, he can attack and kill that group. he can cut big army from road of word, and even take town of middle land government. or he can make round ring round three group go to help strong house.

when Austrian chief at last see what be true, he want strong attack on army of middle land in front of big town. this be on day 14 of month 4. then he want go across big river at river town and cut off army go to strong house. but two chief under him say no and not do what he say. so idea of him, which can cause hard time for army of middle land, never come true.

this loss make Austrian chief not go to big village where he want join Austrian many man, but go back to village far north. day 20 of month 4, one Austrian part go back from village, join that chief many man at big river, and become last part at back. on day 21 of month 4, that chief many man go over to right side of big river. two part take position at one village, one part at other village, one part at small village. two Austrian part keep left side of big river, to watch land near other river.

two day after war fight, on day 21 of month 4, army from east land come in town. this end stop by Austrian army on north side of strong place.

on day 24 chief of Austrian army tell other chief that east army make bridge good across big river. east army start go across river on bridge and on small boat. so chief question other chief bring army to field by morning of day 25. come to help him against east attack. on day 26, east army attack Austrian army from strong place. Austrian army go back to west. so big want of war be do. west part of land be free.

win of Nagysall make big change. it open way to strong place. win bring help in two day. at same time Austrian army have not enough army to cover big face of east win. so chief of Austrian army have to go back from town, because east army can hold him with two arm.

on morning of day 20, chief learn about lose. he tell chief of army that stop strong place, and tell great king of Austria. to keep big town of Austria safe, he have to go back from town and from strong place. he also say army heart be very low. army can not fight more war fight for while not with lose. so on day 21 he order army leave town. he leave big army in strong place to keep it safe against east attack. he order other chief be in town for while, then go back to east land, to small army of south land. this friend of Austrian army be in bad place after win of east army, lead by two chief.

Evelyn Gleeson live from day 15 of month 5, year 1855, to day 20 of month 2, year 1944. she be English person who make design for thread work, floor cloth and picture cloth. with two sister, she start one print place.

Evelyn come to live in north town, day 15 of month 5, year 1855. she be daughter of Irish medical man, her father Edward. her mother come from cotton town in north land. Edward have medical man work in north town. when he go to Ireland, he see much no work and poor live. so he start wool work house in year 1859. on word of he brother, cloth man in north land, he do this. in year 1863, family go to Irish town. Evelyn go to school in England, where she learn to teach. then she learn picture make in London, from year 1890 to year 1892.

from this, Evelyn learn design under Alexander. Alexander be man of art and make group, and go after of William. he see Evelyn have good hand for colour. at this time, big cloth company in Scotland get many of her design. Alexander be head of art there.

Evelyn care much for Irish thing. she join Irish group for book and talk. she know two sister and other Irish art man in London. she get idea from new Irish love of art and book. she join woman fight for right, and lead London woman group. in year 1900, she have chance to help Irish new live and woman right. on word of her friend, she leave London dirty air and go to Ireland, to make body good. she give 500 money to start her work place. she talk with two sister, Elizabeth and other one. they be good work woman with many rich friend, but can not give money. Evelyn also talk with book man, family man, and other Irish art man.

in summer of year 1902, Evelyn find good house near big Irish town. house have old name, old field, but new name be make to name after old woman with good hand for work. print machine be fixed in month 11, year 1902. 3 work place start quick. other sister run thread work room, because she learn from big woman of art. Elizabeth lead print room, use her knowledge from woman print group in London. Evelyn lead cloth make and picture cloth, and run money for all work room. one book man give help to group, and cause fight some time.

this work room take and teach near girl. they use high quality Irish material to make beautiful, rich, long last new thing. in year 1903, they say all thing, as far as can be, be Irish. design also be of Irish spirit and old way of land. by year 1905, work room have 30 woman and girl at work. much of they order be for Catholic church. one big church in west town order 24 thread work flag with Irish holy man, year 1902 to year 1903. other thing make be church cloth, dress, cover, and soft seat, with old Irish design. first book of group be from book man, year 1903. name be in 7 wood, cover in Irish cloth.

Evelyn many time judge at many work competition across Ireland. at Irish meeting in year 1904, she say good thing about work, but say no design teach. on this, she give talk and test to lift good name of work, from house work to big industry. fight go first grow high with two sister, who say she have bad mind and think she be too great. this may come from heavy money weight of house work. even with help money, she be afraid to give back money to friend. this fight lead two sister to no talk with her. they say no word of her in talk for book about house work. her teach, Alexander, say this leave out be like play with no king child. at last, house work be cut in two group in year 1904. Evelyn lead one group, two sister lead other group.

two group keep work, make see separate at Irish big meeting and other competition. Irish big house order one copy of old picture cloth, year 1907. copy make see at art and make group, year 1910. in year 1906, Evelyn group win silver thing at big world make see in Italy. by late 1900, two group no more work together, and fight grow. two sister leave, take print machine to house near town. Evelyn give up 185 money of sister, if they not use house name. they start new work house, with thread work room and print room.

place still grow, with Evelyn Gleeson work on design. her child of sister work too. other young woman, child of brother of old man, work with them.

in year 1910 Gleeson become one of first people of group of Irish art work. in year 1917 Gleeson become chief.

in year 1912 work place move from one town to other town.

Gleeson make design cloth, with idea from old Christian work. animal form be in many design. church still give most money to them.

Gleeson also have book work man, and other woman.

her sister, married man dead, live with her at place, with 3 child.

house be run by sister. 2 child work with mother sister from young time.

among Gleeson work, big one be flag for Irish woman group, year 1919. one more big work be cloth give to chief of church in year 1932, same year as big church meeting.

one child work with mother sister on other work for place. like year 1917 cloth for church in town, and year 1923 gold cloth for church in far town.

Gleeson die on day 20 of month 2, year 1944, at place. one child keep group work after her death.

last house of place be store on road in town. store shut in year 1964.
