Dixi Crosby live from day 8 of month 2, year 1800, to day 26 of month 9, year 1873. he be American cut man and teach at this medical school. he make new way for bone of hand to go back in place. he be first cut man to open bad sick thing at top of leg bone. Crosby be first cut man in America to go to law for bad medical work.

Crosby be come to birth day 8 of month 2, year 1800, in small town in America. Dr Crosby be father of him. mother of him be woman of family. before birth, father and mother have fear. father want boy. mother want girl. boy come. father, very happy, say Dixi in loud sound. Latin Dixi, i tell you so. Dixi become name of child.

he have normal learning of time, grow up in village where family live. it be not know if he go to any school. he go in work to make money when young, but not win, for no experience in business. he then take up father work of cut man.

Crosby be 20 when he start medical learning with father. he start cut work in one year, when learning be important. one good cut in first year be leg cut off to keep man alive. father and other cut many man say man can not live after such cut. but Crosby keep him alive.

Crosby learn at medical school and have degree from that school in year 1824. he do medical work for 14 year in many place near here, then go to other town. in year 1838, he be make chief of cut work at this school. he hold this place till year 1841. to this place be more birth work and other disease of woman and child. he teach in this field for 27 year. Crosby lead good push to start society of no drink at school in year 1844.

Crosby make new way for hand bone out of place. he be first cut man to open bad sick thing at top of leg bone.

Crosby be first cut man in America to go to law for bad medical work.

Crosby work for army by day in big war, and do medical work at night. school give him high degree of wise man in year 1867. he give medical talk in year 1868 to other man who help him. Crosby stop work in year 1870. school name him old teach man of cut work. he teach them from time to time when he want.

Crosby die in other town on day 26 of month 9, year 1873.

Crosby married Mary Jane of other town in year 1827. they have two son. first son be Albert Crosby, live from year 1828 to year 1886. he become medical man even though first learn as law man. other son live from year 1832 to year 1877. he become teach man of cut work at school.

Marianos Argyros die on day 16 of month 8, year 963. he be rich man of east land, of Argyros family. he be holy man before. in year 944, he help king of east land take all rule. he leave holy place and join king work. he hold many high army place. he fight south Italy people who fight king. he fight Africa people too. in north east land he fight north people. in year 963, he want stop army chief from take king seat. he take big east town and lock up he father, old man of army chief family. in fight, plate hit he head. day after, he die. day 16 of month 8.

Marianos be first son of Argyros army chief, who live in early part of year 900. he have brother who take young woman, daughter of king of east land, in year 921. so Argyros family be among strong help of that king line. king of east land come to power in year 919 as big help over young king. he give daughter to young king. by month 12 of year 920, he be put as high king. to keep power, he lift he first son to king in year 921. two young son become king in year 924. first son die in year 931. young king be out of work. two son get more power, but still come after brother in law. in year 943, old king make paper of will. will leave young king as high king after he death. this make two son very angry. they think to take power by secret fight. one son lead this secret fight. other son be friend with doubt.

in this time, Marianos Argyros first come to say in month 12 of year 944. he be holy man then, and near friend of Stephen. man of year 1100 say he be respect and think true by old king before. Marianos be one of secret many man. he help this work of two brother on day 20 of month 12. fight win and throw old king out. they send king to holy place on island. few week after, town people help young king win back rule. two brother lose and join father in far place. Marianos change side in time. he help hold two brother. as reward, young king lift him out of holy work. king make him high man and give him army work. he leave holy cloth, so people call him strange name. name be hard to know for me.

Marianos go from say for some time. then he lead army many man from two land part in journey to south Italy in year 955. army fight that grow in south Italy part of east land and town near sea. army circle and hit town. town give up. Marianos then rule east land part of Italy. in year 956, he be chief of south land and north land of Italy. so say one old holy place paper. at same time, Africa people attack one town in Spain. then war start between Africa people and Spain king. Africa many man say Spain king want east land for help. but Marianos stop fight that grow, not war with Africa people. east land send man to Africa king. they offer peace again and more time. but Africa king, want to see Spain king help enemy, say no.

Africa king send new army to island near Italy. two army chief lead it. in spring or summer of year 956, Africa boat fight and hit east boat in two fight in narrow sea. after, Africa many man attack south Italy edge. after this attack, Marianos go to Africa king seat. he want peace. he offer to give money again and let go man in prison from far east. Africa king say yes. but fight start again long after. east army chief attack Africa god place and attack one more town. so Marianos go back to Africa king seat in year 957. first he go through island and give money to Africa chief of island. in king room, Marianos give paper from king of east land. paper say same word as before. this time Africa king say no. because talk break, king of east land send big army to Italy. army chief lead it. Marianos lead land many man. Africa many man hit Marianos at first. but when east help come, Africa boat leave south Italy. on way back, Africa boat break in sea.

Marianos not say again in Italy after that. but he may lead one more journey to Africa king in month 9 of year 958. this journey lead to five year peace between two power.

in about year 960, Marianos stop attack by people from far land. he take many of them, put them in prison.

with this act, old book call him chief of north land and of west. this be same as high part of west, lead all army from Europe. it be not clear, but may be this be long time work, or short time work. second one be more like, as one man of old time be chief of west, but fight near east land at that time.

on day 15 of month 3, year 963, king die, and no one know why. he leave two young son as new king. strong big man, brother of one man, want take king seat for self. but Joseph, chief of king house, go against him. Joseph want help, offer Marianos high army in east, may be even king seat if he help him.

Marianos first say to win over son of brother of big man, John, who many like. he be chief of army in east. John not only say no, but take letter straight to father brother. father brother call army to town, have them say him king in early summer.

as big man army go across Asia to big town, Marianos make attempt to start fight in town with many man of army and many man in prison. many people in town go against this act. they fight in street.

many people become very angry when Marianos make attempt to take one old father out of holy house, where he keep safe, on day 15 of month 8. Marianos be hit on head by plate, throw by woman from near house roof. he be wound bad, die day after that.

friend of big man win after that. Joseph have to go to holy house, keep self safe. on day 16 of month 8, big man be make top king, to keep young son safe.

Dem Teodorescu live from day 25 of month 8, year 1849 to day 20 of month 8, year 1900. he be man from east land, after man of new land. he be old story man, book man and news make man.

he come from birth in big town. he be only son. father come from near big river, in west part of land. father have build business. mother be woman.

he go in first school in year 1855. after, he learn at high school, from year 1859 till year 1867.

while young, he start to get bit of old story he hear near him. with example from father and mother, from year 1865.

in year 1868, few month before he get high school paper, he get work for big government house. same time he work on two book of one man.

near end of year, he leave government. he get work at news paper. he be look man, news man, word change man till year 1870. then he be help man till year 1872, and paper man till year 1875.

he print many story, fight of word and writing about old story, book judge and history. first print writing of him about old story come out there, at end of year 1869 and start of year 1870. two writing tell root of holy day of birth in old big day of Rome. first book judge of him come out early in year 1870.

in month 5, year 1870, he start regular work with news paper of other name, paper that go against king house now. he make writing under pen name, not name of birth. he make some name for self with laugh song against king.

in first part of year 1871, he be paper man there. he also make other laugh paper ready, short time.

after, that year, he go as news man to far holy house in land under Austria rule. he mark 400 year from start of it.

in old thought writing of him, one man note good thing, from news writing of Teodorescu.

though free from army work, because only son of woman with no man, he join army group make by one general. he get to level of small chief.

in year 1872, he make writing for paper of knowledge and science. he make writing about old story. he make word change from French love song and other French song man. he make writing about live and writing of one French song man. he also make writing about start and grow of rich way of live in Rome.

in year 1874, he print first book about old story of east land people. before it, one man of big book make word start word. it get writing of him on this thing from year 1869 till year 1874.

in year 1868, he go in book and thought part of big school in town. same time, he take speak teaching at song school. he also hear teach on old word and book. he end them in year 1870.

one man teach history of Latin book, while other man teach old Greek. this teach take thought power of him and make Latin thought strong. he have idea for big writing for school, about Greek history before old Greek man of time.

he also hear teach from man of history of east land people and book of east land. he hear teach from man of French book history, from man of thought history and from man of world history.

in year 1874 till year 1875, two more man come to school. one man give free teach on old thing. other man give free teach on same word. Dem Teodorescu after find them big help in work of him on old story.

but, he not end book school. he go to France, with help money from government, give by one man. this man be chief of school in government. he leave while make word big writing. two man of group go with him.

learn at big school of Paris be from month 2, year 1875 till month 6, year 1877. at end, he get book paper. man who teach him be five man of France.

he come in touch with old story learn of west land. from it he get respect for writing. he know join between east land word and other old story. he go on to get story writing send by friend from near him. he send writing to big paper of one man, and to paper of book talk.

after he come back from France, he get work as help man who help teach at high school. this be word and Latin part of top group. work be free after death of one man.

he be also chief in town group. work keep order in town while regular army fight in war for free land. he keep this level till year 1879.

after, in year 1877, he print book about old word of east land, how to get and print them. it be judge writing. it tell way of look at word. it make him one of first east land man of book to know near join between word and old story.

he use what he learn in Paris. he use way of same, and work with word book by other land man, German man and British man, that have east land old word.

in early year 1878, he work at school. this work become full time. in year 1882, this work become always work.

after, in same year, he be give work to teach language and writing of east land in top part of school. he be at school till death. in year 1885, he become head of school.

in may, he go with group to Ottoman town as secretary to big man. this man talk with Ottoman people about people hold by army of east land.

in year 1879, he make book about old song of east land. book talk about winter song, and also old song and story. he say old song have Latin root and old god root. he see how song make see old way of people. song talk of old event, like man of trade from far land on black sea, and how king and people think.

in same year, he make first book about Latin verse in language of east land. in year 1880, part two, about measure, come out.

in month 8 of year 1883, while he be at water bath of salt lake, he see old man of 70 year. this old man be music man from east town. this man become chief way to get old song.

in month 3 of year 1884, he give talk before big learn group. he see this music man and big knowledge of old story. after, he make talk in small book. so he be second man of east land to make book about one music man. other learn man do it in 1866. he be first to make writing about music man.

at same time, he talk against big book of old song from other man. that man make song smooth and same, and change what man who sing say.

two see again in big town in month 5, year 1884. old man give more good song. in all, he give 137 song, over 15,000 verse, near one part of book of Teodorescu after.

one year after, Teodorescu become full part of learn group. from 1879 to 1899, he give many talk to group.

great book of Teodorescu come out in fall of year 1885. it be top work after 20 year of get old song.

in front word, he say writing be put in order by time of people who give them, and by time of old way.

two learn man make good talk. they say way of knowledge be good. they say song be true to old word. they keep different form, take care to tell who give song, where, and day of get. they say man who make book make note at end of page.

in year after, other man make good talk too. one man say big learn group must give Teodorescu big gold thing.

one learn man say no. he say Teodorescu get only 1000 money. he say big gold thing be for good learn work. money go to man who have only great keep and hand work.

in month 4, year 1888, by small yes, he come in first time to big house. he be for one part of land.

that summer, when group break in two, he go with George to new group.

by month 11, year 1895, he be in big group of land man. in 1896, he join small group that break from it.

in month 2, year 1891, when other man become head of land in hard time, he be give work as head of learn. he work in that work till he leave in month 7.

near end of work time, he be one of man who sign law. this law make learn place for king.

in same time, he make book about old song man, who work in first half of 1800 year. book tell of every man book in time order. it keep old record and man self note. it also give front word of most book.

in 1893, he make book of old wise thing. it tell of east land, Greek and Christian thing, from 600 year before Christ to 750 year after Christ.

in front word, he say why. to help learn of old wise thing. some man say learn dead language be waste of time. they say old book can be look at in other language, and have no use for new people.

book get big gold thing from learn group in 1894.

in 1893, he make first book of living of old music man. other learn man say good of it.

in 1894, in first number of learn paper, he make one story, only new story in he living. story be about girl and tree. he hear story from mother and make writing of it on journey to Turkish land in 1878.

in month 2, year 1895, he become first head of learn group. he may get work because he help make law and help get yes for it. work with him be first book man of group.

in early year 1897, he go in fight to become head teach of new school for old story of east land language in big town. at last he lose to other man in middle of year 1898.

in month 10, year 1898, king end head work of learn group. he give power of it to head of big town school.

this thing make paper make hard talk. paper see trick and want by learn head and land head against Teodorescu.

even so, Teodorescu have to give power to new head of school.

in year 1898, he make book. book name be moon story, wolf man, old story and old belief. book come from big talk about wolf man, he give ten year before.

he talk about many people, old people of east, Australian people, north people, south people, and Roman people. he see how small fear become strange belief, after become law. he also look at French copy of Edward book, from year 1871. same year, he make living story of late government man.

Teodorescu die of sick blood in house, in big town, in month 8, year 1900, few day before 51. he leave woman and two young child. king get word by far word. dead man go in earth at big place of dead. many people cry for him. government man of learning and friend of him come. he have many book not in print. in year 1901, group of man make money for metal picture of him. in year 1902, one man of stone and metal make it, and put it in garden of learning place. year 1902, friend make book of memory for him. book have story of living, list of book of him, and talk at time he die by many man. in year 1939, woman child of him give copy of metal picture to place of learning, where many people see it.

from year 1902 to year 1944, few man make talk about Teodorescu, few page in book of many man. at same time, book of people verse, book of people story, and school book, still copy word of him. in year 1944, one man give talk on far voice machine about living and work of Teodorescu. after this, he put it in king book. in year 1957, part of book of verse of him come out again as people verse. in year 1961, one man make most all learn book of Teodorescu up to now. in year 1968, 12 story he make in 1890 time, still not in print, come out as book. in year 1974, one man make learn book of people story of Roman land, and say many good word about Teodorescu.

on day 30 of month 4, year 1852, east iron road company get all right of branch, and take over work. that month 10, new man be take to take Webster place as chief. but Webster still be on board. on day 1 of month 2, year 1853, branch open for people. in year 1855, branch road company join with east iron road company.

by year 1858, Webster and woman live at tree place. on day 7 of month 1, year 1871, Webster die of sick chest in town of California, where he go see farm machine store, of which he be owner.

Sacred live from year 1809 to year 1836. she be woman of one people, on they land in America. she take long journey all over Europe. news of her journey be in French and American paper and small book of that time. after she come back to America, her face be paint and put up in Washington for people to see. this tell of her good heart and strong mind.

Sacred be come to birth in year 1809 near big river in west part of America. in her self language, her name be hard to say. as baby, Sacred and other baby of her people be put on board, on tree branch. they mother work in field, keep food and do other house work. by 12 year old, Sacred need to do her work. she know how to care for child, hunt, and keep meat and food. as people do, her father find married man for her near 14 year old.

in year 1827, Sacred be 18 year old. David, man from France who live in St Louis, take her to France with 11 other people from her group. he say he be man of American government and friend of two people who go to take her people to Washington. but he take them to Europe and use them for self pleasure and money.

David get 12 people, put they skin on boat, and start for St Louis. half way there, boat break and all skin be lose. half of people turn back to town here. other half, with Sacred, go on with journey. this group have five more people. one be small chief. one be woman of bird. one be black bird. one be man. one be big man of war. they join David in St Louis and get on steam boat. boat go down big river to sea town, then over sea to France.

Sacred and rest of group come to France on day 27 of month 7, year 1827. there they be say at house of king Charles ten. many French people come to see them, and give them many good thing. they call for food and drink, and get many kind of wine. at first, king say he like them be here. he tell how her people always be good friend to France, and he hope they be good friend to America too. Sacred be see as very beautiful by people of France, and they like her. only after all come and get say do they see big play be reason for they journey.

after people no more like them, David go break and be put in prison for not give money debt. he leave her people on self. at first, they say no to call for food, so they have no food to eat. in this time, Sacred be with two baby in her, and she hope go back to her house to care for them. on day 8 of month 2, year 1828, she give birth to two girl in one house in land north of France. two girl get old French name. Sacred let rich French woman take one girl, while she keep other. Sacred and other people of her group go past two year by self, go in France, Germany, Italy and more land. they go past time, call for food and place to sleep at night, but at last they have good help. news paper of one town tell about they hard time, and French king people come to help them. one big man of France send Sacred, her baby, and one more of her people, small chief, back to America on big boat. sad, one man get sick and die on journey back. but Sacred and her baby come safe to Virginia in year 1829. her married man and other come after few month.

when she come back to house, Sacred and her baby be love by many. Thomas, big man of trade, have Charles, man of paint, make picture of her and baby. it be put in big house of picture for 36 year, till fire break it. good thing, this picture can still be find in big book of story of people of north America, because copy of all picture be make before fire. in warm time of year 1830, Sacred go back to St Louis, where she and her child live till she die. people say Sacred die in year 1836, when she be 27 year old.

clean be act of take off near join place. air, water and any other thing that may burn or dirty join as join be make, and after join.

many steel and other metal be weak with air, water and other thing. this put together with hot metal as join be make.

such air may put together with metal and make bad thing. bad thing may make metal weak, and may cause crack or other damage.

clean be need for first run when two separate part join. this shut run be call root run when take more than one run to shut root from over.

after root run be do, clean can stop. but chief man may say clean must go on for second and three run. example, if root join become hot enough to burn in air that take place of clean air.

bad air be take off by wash with clean air. heavy air many time be use for this. light air be other selection if price and how much be have.

one kind of clean air have be use, but be bad for some steel.

most common way to take bad air out of join place be to wash it with clean air. join place can be shut so new air not come in. after small room be clean, shut it.

one more way of clean be to shut all join part in big box. take out all air, then put full with clean air before join.

when clean heavy air be use, it must go in very slow from under shut place. after low part be full, be it pipe or box, heavy air keep push old air up. old air go out of hole at top.

if watch be want, one small machine can be use near hole, to see join place be clean enough.

light air also be clean, but go in from top of shut place. it come over top, push old air down and out through hole, where air level can be measure till it be at right level.

slow go in, about 5 to 7 measure every minute, to not make rough wind. why slow go in be. keep rough wind far, or clean take long time.

most clean be do on join make by fire join way.

when bright light join way be use, join on hot metal must be do with clean air. in one other way, join be do in box with no air, so clean be take all air out.

for fire join way, top side and front side be safe by clean air go through fire hand. back side, which be under side of join, be where bad air must be take off.

when two part join with shut join, first hold them, by make short join at space. this change with size and weight of part. it be very important clean start for short join, so under side keep clean and bright, with no burn or colour change.

bad air be take off by wash with clean air. heavy air many time be use for this. light air be other selection if price and how much be have. one kind of clean air have be use, but be bad for some steel.

clean air must be of certain quality, so join be make right. because join in heavy air or light air with more than 0. 05, or 500 part of bad air, will burn and change colour. chief man will make word right air quality in guide for join.

if watch be want, one small machine can be use to see clean be right before join start.

some paper be there to make see colour change of some metal, cause by burn air, even at amount under 50 part. one instrument call air watch can watch air level.

many kind of this instrument be there, with change sense, fast answer and other thing of interest. 1 part sense be more than enough for almost all join purpose.

some of this instrument be hand, with power from power box, for use at building place where steel be join. other be power by wire from wall, because they need big power to run change, keep fact, and run pump to pull clean air over watch part.

to do clean, many part ready be there for all kind of join form.

bag pipe clean system be most common. two bag be join by one pipe, about 500 long, with one bag on every side of join.

space between bag be put full of clean air, which push old air out. left bad air be watch by machine till it be at right level for join to start.

in some box it be not possible to take back pipe clean machine, so thin skin that wash in water be good way. thin skin wall can be put on one side of join, and on other side. hold in place with strong sticky thing. thin wall be clear, so man can look at join from under side while it still go on.

after join make, skin wall come off only in water clean or water test of join.

thin metal join can be make on line join machine, where machine do clean by self.

where thin metal be make in vessel before join, in of vessel can be clean with air that go through, that do not change. but for big size, air price and time take much, so it be not good. in such box, join back thin band can be use. it be glass band in middle of wide bright metal skin, put on back of join.

join make on back thin band can go fast than normal. join top make flat on glass, and leave good form at end. this way may leave some colour to clean, but cut much burn and dirty that come on.

to make clean more good on front side of join, shield can be put on hand or machine that make join, and go after join while it be make. in this way, join keep under air shield for long time, so join be good and man can make join fast.

shield also come to hold on back side of join, flat or round, to keep join free from burn and dirty colour.

when join with hard metal like this, second air shield be necessary to keep join top and heat part safe while it become cold. cup stop burn by keep join out of air till it be cold enough.

when separate part need to join, put them in box full of clean air.

most box be make to order, but simple cheap cover also come, that let one or many small part join in one clean time.

this air be heavy, more than normal air. when use to clean, it need to go in slow at low part of space and let it push old air out of hole. this way stop old air and new air from be mixed, which make clean time much more.

this air be light, so it need to come in at top of space, with hole at low part. for good end, use machine to look at clean, not only think if it be good. one bad join that need to be cut out and make good again, always price more than such machine.

to make clean simple and join good, clean need to be think of as part of join make.

all top near join and in shut space to be clean need to be wash well with good clean liquid. dry and wash after in water with no salt.

man who make join and man who put pipe need to test to keep clean space free from oil, paper, wet, cloth, sponge. all such thing give off smoke all time in join make, and can make join dirty. join can be no good, or break in use.

clean thing for this work need to use good material, make to give not much smoke, so smoke not come out when join part start to be hot.

as join become hot in clean space, any material near heat will start to give off smoke.

normal, this more smoke need to be take out by clean air that keep move. but there be time when smoke and air come much, so air become bad and join become dirty.

this need to be see by man who make join, with clean machine he have.

some machine that look at air can make loud noise or shut down join make, when air go bad.

clean can keep go till air be low enough. join make can start again.

to stop such time, bad material need to be keep out of join part.

David Middleton die in year 1615. he be trade man and sea chief for English east India company. he make many journey by sea to far east.

he be young brother of John and of Sir chief. in year 1601 he and brother lead journey to west land over sea. in year 1604 he go to east land with brother, as second chief of red ship. he also talk with two king of island land. he come back with brother in month 5 of year 1606.

on day 12 of month 3, year 1607, he sail from harbour in England as chief of ship, one ship of group under William. he have John with him as head, man from town near river. ship see no more other ship in sea near England. no meeting place be give, so ship go on by self to Cape of good hope. she stop by table water on day 16 of month 7. many man of her be healthy.

Middleton go on, not with William. after touch at St land, he come to far town on day 14 of month 11. after get ship new thing, he sail for island of nut. he find Dutch man kind, but they have all trade of nut. not till month 3, year 1608 can he get any open say to trade. he get to do trade in secret, but when say be take back, few day after it be give, he go to other island. there king be kind to him, and he get full store of seed. by day 22 of month 5 he be back at far town, and he sail for England on day 15 of month 7.

journey, though not regular, be fast and good for money. Middleton be know as able and good chief. he be send out again on journey number 5 in big ship, from harbour on day 24 of month 4, year 1609. John be again head of ship. again he come to Cape of good hope. many man of him be healthy. after waiting of only eight day, he go on to far town, where he come on day 7 of month 12.

one month after he come to island town, where he give king food on ship. but no trade can be do, because fire burn all store. so he go on to other island.

Dutch man be full of drink and bad. he rule people of land, take tax for king of island land, keep much for self, and send on to king what he can give. Middleton, not able to trade there, want go to island of nut. bad wind force him to bear up for other island. but there Dutch chief tell him that to let him get one nut be more than head of him be value. he think they want take or burn ship. then he tell them he be ready to fight if attack.

at far island, after some talk, he get full store of nut and seed. on way back to west, he stop Dutch man from take him. after get ship new thing at far town, he sail on day 16 of month 11. he come to England in early summer of year 1611.

in month 5 of year 1614 he sail again for east land in new ship, with two small ship under him. he come to far town on day 14 of month 2, year 1615. full store be get. after send small ship to other town, Middleton sail in new ship for England on day 3 of month 4, year 1615. but ship break on edge of island in south. at first it be say that people and thing be safe, but loss seem all.

first word of Middleton death come to company on day 5 of month 9, year 1617. no true word ever come. but he be say dead, and will of him be make good on day 18 of month 4, year 1618. on day 6 of month 10, year 1624, group of chief think about letter for help of son. after much talk, group think that chief lose ship and thing to very great value. so they answer that no thing be for him.

in will of him, make on day 20 of month 4, year 1614, he name woman of him, two son, one be Henry and one be John, and daughter Elizabeth. he also say child not now come, and sister of woman, Jane. he name too brother, sister and her child, many friend. most thing of him go to son one.

in three week of word of loss of ship, woman of him be married to one man. on day 4 of month 12, year 1618, he be help of dead Middleton chief.

Leutogi be first daughter of king, then become god. long ago people call her god on many island in middle of south big sea.

chief have two woman. one woman come from far island. other woman come from sea land. Leutogi be this second woman. she be daughter of big man.

before she leave land, her brother tell her, if you come across trouble and need help, send sign back to this land, and i will see it.

after some time, other woman have child. Leutogi still have no child. other woman laugh at her about this. Leutogi become very angry. at last she make decision to kill that child.

one day, two go together to common bath place. when they come to it, other woman say, let me bath first, you hold small child of me. Leutogi do this, for she think time to get back have come.

after other woman go far, she take thin hard leaf stick and push it in head of small child. this stick come from nut tree leaf, use in group to clean. other woman hear loud cry of her child, come back, but child be dead. people think Leutogi kill child. she look for sign, find stick, and tell bad thing to chief. chief become so angry, he order Leutogi burn alive.

Leutogi know what her brother tell her. she go to sea, move water, and send angry wave to this land. when brother see angry wave, he know sister be in trouble. he send white fly animal to help Leutogi. before this, he call dead people to help white fly animal in long flight over sea, for journey be too big for animal self power. when white fly animal come to other land, dead people leave it to do what it come to do, so it have no way go back. white fly animal join many fly animal of that land to help Leutogi.

angry people pull this woman in forest, put her in fork of tree. after, much dry wood come round her. then people make fire in it, and not want hear loud cry of sad woman, so they go back to village.

but, big surprise, when fire start go up, 1000 fly animal come and put fire out with water. so good fly animal help Leutogi live.

when servant of king find woman still alive and fire out, they be big surprise. Leutogi then say to them, in friend way, we be under tree while still full of live.

all this be tell to king. then he make decision to put Leutogi on dry island with no man. bad ghost live on this island. king know this, and think bad ghost will kill woman. but bad ghost do not touch her, for he think she will die for want of food and water. so he only stop and watch woman.

great surprise come when day after, he see many fly animal, every one bring kind of food to Leutogi. this fly animal do this for many day, while bad ghost look on, more and more surprise about this big thing.

after some time, chief of far island come by this island in boat. Leutogi call him and say, take me with you. this he do, happy. as she be beautiful woman, he married her. in time she bear him son. they call him by name.

when boy grow up, she send him back to this land. before he leave, she give him 3 name to take to her family.

first name, stone, because she have to use stone to cover her cook fire, not leaf.

second name, decision, from, bring, fly animal.

Butternut be small river in land of new York. it go in more big river. this river be part of land where water run to big lake.

river be about long.

river start in wet land at station near big road 80, where many small water join. this small water run from three hill. river run north through cold low land to big water store. under big water store, small river join river. river run through village, by big play place, and under big road 481. river go across old big water road at wet place near town, where small river join too. river then run by train land and big road 90, turn east, and go in more big river near town.

land form of Butternut come from ice in last cold time. long ago, about 20,000 year ago, all land be cover by thick ice. when ice go back, about 12,000 year ago, big water lake form to west, in town land. at first, hill stop lake on east end, between this low land and other low land. when water make lake full, it run over hill, make low Butternut big river. at last, this river join big water road system. after all ice leave, water run north to great big water. it leave now dry cut between low land, and 180 foot high hill at play place, which one time be big water fall from ice.

near small village, Butternut land cut through hard rock hill, part of 55000000 year old rock, make high and narrow deep cut. big mine place be by river. it take out much rock from about land.

Butternut low land be in middle of old land of old tribe people.

after fight with French man in early year 1700, tribe go south to hill land by top Butternut river, before force go west to other river in year 1720.

Thomas Aldersey birth in year 1521 or 1522. death in month 12, year 1598.

Thomas be English trade man, cloth trade man, king meeting man, and kind to poor.

old writing say he be among wise and good trade man of London. he work hard to help new belief people of Germany, to make safe trade for them. he give money for free learning school in town of birth, in north land.

Thomas birth in small town of north land. father be John, big land man. he live year 1494 to 1554 in big house near small town. mother be Anne, daughter of trade man from near town. many of this family be big man in north town in year 1500. Thomas be second of many son in family. he learn in town of birth, may at big house of church.

in year 1541 Thomas work under London trade man. on day 13 of month 7, year 1548, he join cloth trade group. in London he hear two new belief man speak. this make him new belief man. Mary be woman king from year 1553. her rule make new belief bad for him. in year 1555 people say he do wrong, for look at writing of that man. he work every day to help new belief people leave England for town in Germany. he help them make trade. he get help of William and other big new belief man.

in rule of woman king after Mary, help of William and big London family help him get big place. he take woman from big London family in year 1554. he work in cloth trade with Germany, low land, Spain, and north sea land. he be big man in many London trade group. people know him for holy way, true word, and good trade work. friend say he be among wise and good trade man of London. in north town he not win big place. he attempt to get water side work in year 1595, but not win.

from year 1570 he hold many place in London. he be common town man for church of north side from year 1571. he be town watch man, year 1571 to 72. he be man who help town chief in year 1576. on day 7 of month 10, year 1579, after death of John, he become one of four London man of king meeting. he win again, two more, and work till year 1592. he make no big word in meeting, but be on many group about trade. king group get him in year 1574 to look at say against Spain. he look at trade thing for king group and sea group. this be bring thing in secret, bad sea take, price go up, and gold trade.

he have house in north side. he take woman from east land in year 1554. she live year 1526 to year 1589 or 95. her family be big in London. Martin be brother of this woman, and be chief of London in year 1589. they have no child. after elder brother John die year 1582, he help two of brother son. in late year, people say he be hard church man.

he do much good work in London and north land. he be chief of hospital in London for year 1574 to 79, of St Thomas hospital for year 1581 to 84, and of Christ hospital for year 1585 to 96. he also get money in year 1570 to 79 to help poor learn man at two big learning house. in north land he help build water pipe in north town in year 1582. after big fire in year 1583 in small north town, he help make help for people. he work as London man who help with other man, to get money for town build. he get over 2700 money.

in town of birth, he start free learning school in year 1575. on day 2 of month 1, year 1594, law give school name with Thomas Aldersey. now this school still be same school. on day 21 of month 10, year 1594, he give school, with much money, to cloth trade group. it be first school this group run. now group be most learn, help poor. same time he make one church man, who help in town of birth. he give church money and right to say who be church man to cloth trade group. this be first church thing run by group. one old man say this give join with late hard church of cloth trade group. town become early place for people not like king church.

he die in month 12, year 1598, at big house in small north town. he be put in earth at church of town of birth, by want of him, with no big sign. he be rich man at death. he leave almost 2000 money by will. he leave 100 money to Christ hospital. he leave money to help poor in London, near town, east land, north land, and town of birth. half of money go to school always. rest go to brother son John, man of small east town, who die year 1616.

baby fish have wide white line from nose to tail base. over and under this white line be dark brown and black line.

they live from India in west to sea far east, and south to north Australia. in Australia it live from west Australia east to water in east land. it may go south to north part of land. it also live on rock in sea. they live at deep sea. few see them under that. big fish live in rock in sea, in still water and on out side slope. they be in dirty water near land many time. baby fish live in back rock near land, where living thing grow on rock, over sand.

Bruchus make young in spring in field plant. it put egg on young plant. egg grow in seed. full grow insect live through winter in safe place, or be still as small thing in store seed.

full grow insect be still in winter in safe place. safe place be under tree, old tree, and in forest or leaf. early in spring, they eat flower near. some Bruchus can live through winter in seed. then they come out of seed after plant grow.

male be ready to make young when light grow more every day. when plant get leaf, male come to field. more special, 16 hour of light every day make insect stop still. good be 18 hour of light every day.

female still be in safe place when they come to field, when plant get flower and day get 20 degree hot. they be ready in few day, from more light every day and eat of flower.

full grow insect move very fast in day. at night and early morning they rest in flower and young leaf. they move from plant to plant where flower be. number in field can change. in France, about 20 insect for 100 plant at start, and 150 insect for 100 plant at top when high.

field near safe place of winter, like tree, and store place, have more danger of Bruchus. this be big danger in place with many insect last year.

when male and female two ready to make young, make young go on for few week. more than 25 degree be very good for insect move in field. cold, under 15 degree, and wet weather limit insect move.

after make young, female put egg on young plant. rain, wind and cold put put of egg on hold. egg be on low part of plant most. egg be small, 2 or under in wide. egg be white and yellow. at most 10 egg on one plant be see. female put 50 to 100 egg. rain can increase death of egg.

after 10 day or 1 to 3 week, young come out of egg. they go through wall of seed and grow in seed. so chemical control can not get them. young grow in seed 2 to 3 month. before they change, young cut circle cover. after about 10 day, full grow insect come out of seed. because make young and put egg go on for few week, insect can come out before or after plant be cut.

top limit of 3 part of 100 damage be put for seed in market for man to eat. damage seed from which full grow insect come out can grow low, 13 part of 100 low in test, but in field no change. amount from damage seed be 45 to 70 part of 100 low, than good one. also, damage seed have more trouble with root disease.

other way to sort seed be there. seed can be sort by heavy or light, because of baby or hole in seed. damage seed can be find by machine that make picture in seed.

that town first be sea people town. they call it by old name, long ago. after that Roman people take town. town have big wall, but very few part of wall live still.

wall of town build again many time. east Roman people build again, about year 700 after Christ. new god people build again, about year 1000 after Christ. king of south island build again, from year 1100 to year 1500. most strong part of wall come from man of order of St John, from year 1500 to year 1800.

after old Roman people lose, people build small wall in town. this make town small. this make town wall safe to hold. many town round middle sea do same in middle time. many say new god people build this wall. but some say east Roman people build it, about year 700, because attack from new god people grow strong.

in year 870, new god people take town, kill many man, and break old strong place. old man say this, and more. island be almost no people till year 1048 or 1049. then new god people and man who be not free come live there, and build new town. old find tell town be big and new god town by start of year 1000. so year 1048 or 1049 may be when town start and wall build. east Roman people attack town in year 1053 or 1054, but town people fight them off and win.

Jedediah Sanger have birth on day 28 of month 2, year 1751. Sanger die on day 6 of month 6, year 1829. Sanger make first new village in York, America. he come from small place near big sea town, in Massachusetts. he be child number 9 of ten child. he family be big and old, from Massachusetts land. in war for free land, he get level 1 in army. he fight in many fight near big sea town and in York.

after war, he live in north place. he farm, trade and run drink house. he help village people in many way. he get high level in north army. fire burn all he thing, so he have no money. he start over in far edge of York.

Sanger live in village then call white village. he get big land on two side of small river. he know big land trade with George Washington, for land that become new village in York. from 1789 to 1820, he run place to make paper, grain and wood. he also get land in some other place. Sanger put he name on one village and one club house. to help people go between village, Sanger help make two big road. now one road be number 12 road in York land. he be first man of new village. two stone mark say this.

among he many work, he farm and make thing. he be chief of village, judge of part of land, and law man. he help make church and school.

Jedediah Sanger have birth in small place near big sea town, day 28 of month 2, year 1751. he be child 9 of ten child. he father be iron man, who make thing with fire. like old many man of he family before him, he father work with iron. he father get big money from he father, year 1731. he father make more money by trade in big sea town, by land trade in north land, and by store and drink house in small place. family live in big house, one of big family of that place. house be on list of old place in America. it be make by he father.

Sanger learn in school near small place and work on farm. he may learn leather man trade and work with leather in small place. he first married, in year 1771.

Sanger fight in war for free land, from year 1775 to year 1781. in first 5 day of work, month 4, year 1775, he go up from low man to level 2 in army. he fight against British at first two fight near big sea town, month 4, year 1775. he fight at hill near big sea town, month 6, year 1775. he fight at long be still at big sea town, year 1776. he fight in York land, year 1776. in 1779, he get level 1 and work on small island land till month 3, day 18, year 1781.

Sanger go to north place after army. he may first work there as leather man. in 1777, he work on group of 5 many man to stop take of part of north place by near village. in 1782, he get farm in north place near big hill. by farm, he run drink house and small store on land. from 1783 till 1786, he be name to help make road of land part, keep record for village, and lead one meeting every year. in month 3, year 1785, he get high level in north army.

fire burn he thing on night of day 27 of month 2, year 1784. he have no money now. this be first death by fire in north place. fire kill one man from small place near big sea town, who work for old friend. Sanger want to leave and start over in far edge of middle York.

Sanger come to place then call white village. new village not come out of white village till year 1827. he come in month 3, year 1788, when 37 year old. there he get many hundred unit of land on two side of small river. he give big land part east of small river, one year after he get it, to one man. that man be second man to live in new village. Sanger move he family to white village in month 3, year 1789, and make wood cut place. year after, he make grain place. in 1805, he make cotton thing. he have paper place on small river. he get it round year 1810, and give it to one other man before 1820.

Sanger make new house in year 1810, with three floor. top floor be meeting place for secret club for more than 7 year. club be club number 23. he lead club there.

there be old story that Sanger get 1000 unit of land, some become new village. then he give half to one man for same money. first record, by one man in year 1851, say Sanger get land for 500 money. that be 50 small money for one unit of land. Sanger give part east of small river, think to be big, to one man in one year, for 500 money. that be one money for one unit of land. smart trade, give him land where most village business come, for no money. after look say land that man get be different from first think.

in year 1889, it be tell by paper of land record. other man get 492 land part from Sanger in month 12, year 1791. he give 1 money and 6 for every land. Sanger keep right to water power of river.

492 land part give by Sanger to other man. 183 land part be on west side of river. Sanger give that part in month 7, year 1790. one more part be on west side of river. Sanger get it from George Washington and other man. all this join to make most of first town of new town.

in year 1810, Sanger be one of many man who want law company to help. they want end fight over land line. fight come after land be leave out of year 1793 paper. paper give land to Philip. in year 1811, they want law company again. they want law limit to make line clear.

Sanger give land in new town to Richard. Richard be African American man. he make farm and build house there. after, owner of house be Richard family child. this child be man who fight hard for free. house be stop on secret road.

Sanger keep farm and grow many grain. at cow day in month 10, year 1819, Sanger winter grain be place 3. first be man from Paris. second be Benjamin from other town.

Sanger grass grain win first place. it make 84 measure for every land. for this, farm company give Sanger 15 money. this be by law from year 1819, to help farm and house work. in animal part, he win good animal house pig. he win top pig.

in year 1788, new York get land by big river from first man there. two year after, Sanger and two other man, Michael and John, get part of this land. they call this part number 20. they give 3 and 3 money for every land in year 1790 91 as money work.

Sanger do give or let land to new man. he build first wood cut machine there on small river in year 1793, in what come to be water town.

in year 1795, new York law company make new town. town be name for Sanger, to say good you. Sanger also say he give land to any church that build first god house. he give wood box of drink to first town meeting. he give drink and land to church company, first religion company in town. he give 25 land to church man who build first church. many first man not like town name. they want other name. after, they get other name for church.

Sanger keep farm in town name for him. William Sanger, same family, also farm there much late.

Sanger see good chance at end of big lake. he get many big land part there. he build wall on river about year 1796 or 97. he build first grain machine and wood cut machine there. he cut some land in small part. he give part as town small land on north end of lake. now this be in town. as big money man of road company, he have road build through town. it have first bridge over river, build in year 1800.

in year 1812, Sanger and other judge, also of new town, get land in other town from no money man. they build grain machine, wood cut machine and cloth machine by river. they give machine in year 1816. this be first trade work in this town.

Sanger get big land part from one man. this man get land from new York law for old war work. Sanger give small land part to new man. this land now have all town.

on day 7, month 4, year 1789, first town meeting of new town be in animal house of man who be town name. Sanger be make first town chief and first road man. he win again to be town chief in year 1790 and 1791.

Sanger be judge in first law place in other land, in month 1, year 1794. he be one of three side judge after land make in year 1791. in year 1798, new land part from old land. Sanger be name first judge of five land judge. first law be in month 5, year 1798, at school house near old wall, now Rome. Sanger be first judge there. he be make again many time till year 1810, when he be no more able, because he be 60 year old. law place be name for land law. judge be make by law company for five year time. Sanger be make more. in year 1801, 1804, 1805, 1808, and 1810.

Sanger first run for law seat in year 1792. he lose by 4. 502 man say yes to other man. 498 say yes to Sanger. he get 91 yes of 100 from new town. but other man, Michael, get most other yes from two other town in land place.

at same time as judge, Sanger also be man of new York law company, from two land part in year 1794 95, and do ten more time in law company. Sanger run with big group of man who want strong law of all land.

Sanger want good medical man to come to new land of new York. in all he time in law company, he bring many law paper. they say new York give help money for medical man who may make house in west.

in month 3, year 1794, land law man say make road. road go from old strong house on big river to small place on other big river. road must be straight as land let. this road be call great road. road go on old way of people to far place.

at end of ten year, many part of road still be bad. some part be not complete. law man give this work to road company. road company be make by group of money man, lead by Sanger. new road law come in month 4, day 1, year 1800. law say road go from river town west to far place. road be most long road in land at that time. road go same way as great road. Sanger make road turn from great road. road go west through hill town. this make hill town grow rich. road trade help, and water power make work. not till big water road come on big river, river town grow over hill town in trade.

in year 1801, he be one of first join man of new road group. law man say make road from far town to road come to house of Jedediah Sanger. this be way of now road, number 12.

Sanger, with two other man, make first paper print in land west of big town. first paper be print in hill town from year 1793. after Sanger have part, paper move to river town. after many join, paper become big paper name watch.

Sanger be one of big owner of Paris company, first make place in north low land. fire house and iron place start work in year 1801. they make iron thing, axe, plough, kettle, hollow thing and spade. they give for money all over land and to near land. he make man work for fire house after see man make hard walk over big river. thin ice cover river. money man offer 100 money to any man who can carry box to other side.

place of company and town up river from hill town be call Paris fire house. in year 1848, name change for respect of great man Henry. Sanger make company law group in year 1823. it work till year 1832 or 1833, many year after he die.

law man make part of land near salt water spring in year 1797 for salt make. salt make start about year 1789. salt make by hot salt water. in year 1798, Sanger and about six other money man make group call big company. this group make salt more. group build first strong house for salt make, new big well, and 32 kettle for salt work. this company be most big salt make at that time. Sanger give part to other man after two year.

he be name chief of money house in river town. money house open on day 8, month 12, year 1812.

people start to come to hill land in year 1787, when it be land with no people. town grow to about 3000 by year 1791. people want Christian house. on day 3, month 11, year 1791, Sanger and other people send letter to George Washington. they want give of 25 land for Christian man. letter say man of Christian house help people be good, work hard, and good. Washington say yes.

in year 1791, one Christian group start in meeting in Sanger house. Sanger be name one of first keep man. in year 1792, group say yes make Christian house on land give by Sanger. house be complete in year 1797. this house, after year 1801, be still big house in town.

in year 1820, Sanger give much help to make St Stephen Christian house in hill town. house have stone with word, he be dead, still speak. in year 1997, house be list on big list of old place. one say Sanger also give land for this Christian house and leave money in will.

Sanger be one of first join man of hill town group of good man, make in year 1792. in month 1, year 1799, he be name chief of big land group at first meeting in big town. at that meeting, big man be top man.

in year 1793, Samuel make school in river town to teach Indian people from five nation. Sanger make big give to school and be name keep man. when school become big school in year 1812, he be name keep man again.

Sanger be married to first woman from month 5, year 1771, till her death in month 9, year 1814. he be married to second woman from month 8, year 1815, till her death by sick head on day 22 of month 4, year 1825. on day 3 of month 10, year 1827, he be married to three woman from Washington. she live after him and die in year 1842.

Sanger have four child with first woman. first child come in year 1772. she die when 5 year old. second girl child, same as first girl, come in year 1778. he also have two son. one come in year 1781, one come in year 1783. two die in year 1802.

first girl child, only one of child live after him, be married to John. Sanger build them big house in new town. now it be call big house of John. she and James have 9 child, all come while Sanger live. she die in year 1861 at 83 year old in new town.

Sanger young brother come in year 1753. he get big house. big house be on land list of old place.

letter brother son, chief of army, come in year 1768 and die in year 1835. he be son of one more brother. he get all land in Sanger town, cold land in north. Sanger town change from old word to Sanger town when make town in year 1814.

one more brother son come early in new town. he be father of Henry, who come in new town. William, son of Henry, be one of big club of York land from year 1895 till 1897. he be second man of war for United land from year 1901 till 1903.

Sanger die on day 6 of month 6, year 1829, in house in new town. he be 79 year old. he first be put in new town dead place. then he move to family dead place on farm. at last he be put in tree hill dead place in big town, with second and three woman and some child. first stone, almost not able see word, get new stone in year 2007.

there be two York land sign about Sanger. one sign say Jedediah Sanger start new town in year 1788. he get 1000 land and live here with family. other sign say grain work building be build 350 foot east of here in year 1790 by Jedediah Sanger, first man live here and start new town.

Laval be French Catholic holy man. he live from year 1808 to year 1880. he be part of holy heart group. group be part of Roman Catholic church. Laval teach Christian on far island group.

Laval come in day 6 of month 1, year 1807, in small village of France. he join holy heart group on day 30 of month 12, year 1825. he take name brother. in year 1831 he become Catholic holy man in north town.

with two father and one brother, he go by carriage from Paris through town and town to big west town. there they get on ship that sail on day 1 of month 2, year 1834, for far south town in America. they come there on day 13 of month 5. then they take ship of chief from Boston. Laval and other father come on far island group on day 8 of month 8, year 1834.

from year 901 to year 1500, some thousand people live on far island group. they trade with other island group far far. but too much cut of tree make almost all tree on big island lose. this bad thing make pain island land and island money. old story of water land tell of fall in war and even eat man, when trade with other world break down. science make see this sad story be true.

when Laval and other father come, number of people on far island group be 800 to 1,000. one man say number be 2124 people.

far island group have few ship. one ship chief tell chief holy man of south island land, that ship come there only every 5 or 7 year, for fish. island have no other value. that holy man stop in far south town to keep word between island holy group and holy group in France. he die there in month 9, year 1839, from sick.

in month 8, year 1834, Laval and other father find house with French fish man. king of big island have brother, name father, who help them learn island talk. king he self change to Christian, wash in holy water, in month 8, year 1836. may he think brother want take power. king take new name for holy chief of Catholic church at that time. holy work grow strong. old holy place break down and new church build in that place. most people have no dress. they get dress and cloth. in month 12, year 1838, father come back from Europe with 2157 dress from woman of France. they give out dress.

British holy group of London have school on far island group for 30 year, but leave in early year 1835. big holy man, big man of Laval, come to far island group in month 5, year 1835, with two brother, one man of work, and two holy man who also know sick. when many sick come, father make hospital in old church in big island town.

two brother teach island people to build house. they learn how to build church and house. together they build big church in town. in year 1856 one brother and 60 man go to far east island to work on big church. ten year after, island man of big island build big light by sea in east island.

Laval and other father want work more in east island. they come there in month 2, year 1836. they find house to stop in, on land of American chief, man from Europe. British think he work for king of France. though holy man be good to woman chief of east island, she send them out, by word of British holy man. also send out be one French wood work man, who come with holy man from far island group. this send out be start of French fight in east island.

so in year 1838 France send sea chief to get back thing. in short time before sea chief come, woman of American chief be kill in crime take. French think British start this. when sea chief work end, he sail east to other island group and take it in year 1842.

then father and Laval go back to far island group. father go back to France in year 1837 to find more thing. big holy man leave for Europe in year 1841. in year 1843 big holy man come back, with 7 holy man, 7 brother and 10 holy people. they ship be lose at sea near cold island, and all die.

father become chief of holy work on far island group, and live there till year 1855.

in year 1848 big holy man send Laval to far island land, and he live there 3 year. he go back to far island group in year 1851.

king die in year 1857. woman of king become chief for her young son. son be ten year old.

from year 1862, many ship come. they take man to work by force. this be call black take. ship from far land look at small island for man to work, because far land have too few man.

one ship come near island on day 28 of month 10. say it be for knowledge journey. when one island trade man go on ship, he see iron door and secret knife on chief. he tell Laval that ship be take man ship. Laval tell woman chief.

when ship chief and two other man come see woman chief, she lock them up. Laval fear trouble from far land man. Laval let them go and tell them leave island group. ship chief say he want make big word against Laval and woman chief. still, many young man leave on ship. this make people few.

trade man also come to island for sea stone. by year 1838, trade man make bad talk. with church man here, they can no more give bad thing for sea stone. as church man make people know value of sea stone, island people watch work in water near.

more touch with far land bring sick. island people slow die from breath sick, skin sick and stomach sick. in year 1871, one medical man make writing. number of people be 936.

fight start between one sail man from far land and island judge. this man be Jean. he move to island to trade sea stone. brother son join him in year 1858. this son say no to sign paper of island law. judge say he do bad act and take thing from other. he get 15 month of prison. he be in prison 2 month and go back to far town.

he have much debt on far island. he have trouble with house owner. island judge say owner can throw him out. after take thing of him, owner can break down hut. Jean make big talk to chief man, who be chief from year 1864. this chief put 160,000 money on woman chief. he say she make Jean lose all, take house of him and break hut.

then chief send one man and 20 fight man to island group to get money. one man say this be fight between war way and church way. chief say to Laval, you people be too holy. you people be foolish.

this fight become reason for far land man to get more power in island group and make Laval and church small.

peace come back when church chief in far island offer to give money. one rule. fight man must go off. church chief talk about money with chief. chief say yes to take 4300 money. strange, this be same as money he have debt to two man.

in year 1842 Laval protest far land man take island. as woman chief one who help, he fight to keep island land free from far land man. in year 1870, island chief say to far land king to end that rule. that rule never get yes from far land, because of change.

far land man think Laval make chief say this. they think Laval be far from world 36 year, and he have too big holy idea. far land man want Laval go off.

after big fight man come see in year 1871 and big sea chief help, in month 3 of year 1871, church chief send Laval to town in far island. after, he make Laval chief help man.

about 1870, Laval work with one island man. this man be first island man to be church man. they make writing of old story of island. name be old time story of island people. this writing be keep in church house in far land.

Laval go back to island group in month 7 of year 1876, one last time, at big good day. go see of him make big sign of love from people. last year of him be sad. he can no more hear well. he say, i can no more say holy word, no more hear word of bad act, no more like talk with other.

Laval die on day 1 of month 11, year 1880. body of Laval rest in dead place near church house in far town.

Laval be not good at talk with man, like other church chief. one church man say Laval be too hot in mind, in far island in year 1836. other church man be sad that Laval seem too hard.

Laval be father to people of him. he be strong and hard with them. but he also work hard to keep them safe from trade man and sail man who come many time to place. they take from them, in money and body. one trade group can lose right to take sea stone if ship chief take woman off and not first make her married.

one man say Laval be guide, love by many holy people, hate by angry enemy of him.

town north live in island land for almost 40 year. he make big account of first people, with word book of island language. this writing come from year 1844 to year 1846. he also record land way to know sun turn.

many know Laval as wise man. he record old island people and what they do.

but at same time he record old way, church man change it much. church man not only bring new religion. they also bring European plant. they teach people new trade, such as wood work, stone work, and make cloth.

first use of this island name be in letter of father Laval, year 1863.

Laval live be make in story book in year 1948. this book tell story of magic woman.

book of Laval writing from year 1834 to year 1871.

this news go to other news. one news, on day 10 of month 5, year 1870, put it with name god rule in big sea.

school man 1915 be small gun with water cold, from Austrian land. it make in world war 1, in very small number.

little know about school man kind 1915. only one place tell about it. some picture in Austrian library have name machine gun of school man. picture time be month 10, year 1915. they see gun test at fire range. name and big box tell it be automatic gun. this gun make by man name man, from Austrian army of school. this army keep mountain land of west part of Austrian land safe, land near Italy, which not fight. it be most may first make, so it look rough, not end.

make of this gun come at same time as Italy come in world war, on side of other army. then Italy say war on Austrian land, old friend in three land agreement. this make Austrian land fight on three side. it may be this make come from fight place, may be from big chief. first make be in field work place or small store. or it come from back place by idea of some other man. school man not go through test, and no man know it more. may be only one gun make, then break or take down.

by army old way, most gun get name of man who make them. that man be Hellriegel, may be chief or man of low level. man in picture, who test gun, have level of field chief, level 1. this level for man who care for big gun or gun store.

it may be man in picture be Hellriegel self, but not so much. only one school man with name be Dr Richard man, medical chief of school group in mountain town. other man with name man fight in Austrian fight group, but no one of them can join to this gun.

may be this be first small gun of new kind to go through test. by this time, Italian have other small gun, but it fire from frame. man gun be first small gun make with gun back, so it fire from arm. war thought of this gun be like early light gun, like other gun of France and gun of America. light gun can be carry by man, use in foot army attack, and keep enemy down with fire.

man gun be all automatic gun. gun have water cold pipe. cold cover round pipe look like gun of Austrian make, with two hole, one to put water in and one to let out more steam. it be cover with leather so it can be use by hand even after long fire. bent pipe fixed under pipe, use as front hand grip. gun back look like other Austrian gun of 1895 kind, but change, with deep cut for thumb.

thing about how gun work not know. it look like push back work, by two spring that stick out at back of round part. iron eye fixed on top of gun, back eye can change for range. by rough idea, fire rate of gun can be about 550 to 650 round in one minute. but in true fight, long fire rate may be much low.

man gun may fire 9 by 23 round of Austrian make. it be round for small gun, use by most army part of Austrian land in world war 1. or it may be for 32 round, use in small gun of other land. but round in picture also look like 8 round of Austrian make, use in gun 1907.

man gun can take from round box, hold about 100 to 160 round. box not join to gun self, round go through soft pipe. many man think gun have join box, but it be not so. round not join to every other, and spring push them through box and pipe. design very like German 08 round box, use in German gun 08 and small gun 18. it may be gun can also use other box, hold about 20 to 30 round, very like box of American small gun.

as picture can see, gun work need two man, one fire man and one carry man.

carry man have back bag. bag can hold five round box, two small box and thing for clean gun.

fire man have arm band, which may carry small gun.

it can be that iron hook on band be use for walk fire, while fire from low side.

like thing be use late on other gun, basin that hold up base of gun when hold at low side.

Standsch Hellriegel not have two leg thing or any other help, which be bad for long fire.

may fire man must fire only from low side or from arm, which make gun not so true.

also, at end of pipe, no thing for stop fire light, which can make fire man see dark for short time while fire, make gun not so true.

but this bad thing may be not so bad by use of small fire bit.

other bad thing of gun be join of small gun and round box, through bent pipe.

as now picture can see, when fire from down, fire man must hold all weight of small gun.

small gun must be over round box, which must keep up.

not only be bad in make, but also may be that if fire man fire at other way fast, this can make gun stop, from strange bent pipe in gun.

not know if test of Standsch Hellriegel gun be good. but, from many strange thing and hard make, very may be that gun test be bad and end be not good.

other part of bad may be price of make, which come from thing like leather and hard make, be high.

also, army of that land at that time not have thing for such big and not know design.

all this make Standsch Hellriegel, year 1915, never go past first stage. become gun not know in history, with almost no writing left.

Manuchar of house Dadiani be chief of this land from year 1791 to year 1793. he fight against elder brother for chief seat. elder brother rule be bad. long fight go on in west part of land. king of near land want take all this land. people here want full free.

Manuchar be son of old chief Dadiani, by one woman Anna. in year 1791, king of near land want join all west land under chief power. he take chief seat from elder brother. he put Manuchar in that seat, because this man do what king say.

in year 1792, elder brother make attempt to come back, but not win. army from north run off. that new friend, who want king seat, lose big fight near big town. after that, elder brother find friend in hill land and fight well against king and Manuchar in strong house. Manuchar be push out of this land and run to north in year 1794. elder brother keep north man on side by give him strong house by sea. one more brother, young, also want chief seat in this land in this year.

two brother make peace in year 1799. elder brother become chief of this land. Manuchar get small land near sea.

in year 1802, king fight this land again. king make attempt to get Manuchar on side, but Manuchar help brother. elder brother die in month 10, year 1804, few month after he put this land under Russian power. that young son take chief seat. old woman, mother of that son, lead land for him till son grow. Manuchar see this as chance to take chief seat. he go to Russian big man and say to them to make him chief, or, at most, let him keep small land. that mother say same thing too. Russian big man say no. in year 1805, small land become land of chief of this land, and Manuchar lose much land.

old woman not keep word to make payment to Manuchar for that loss. Russian big chief Alexander make attempt to help end fight among Dadiani, but not win. Manuchar and young brother fight against woman rule of this land in month 1, year 1810. Manuchar run to king of near land. this king be on edge of war with Russian army. after king lose to Russian army, Manuchar live in this land. he not join king in new fight against Russian army in month 6, year 1810, but people think he hate Russian. after woman lose rule of this land in year 1811, Manuchar do no work in land big thing.

Manuchar be married to one woman, daughter of north big man. he have seven child. this child still live.

one child, birth year 1820.

they then go to sea town. they be afraid that man still come after them, so they change name. music man take new name, and so do he. he take name Domenico Lalli, which he keep for rest of living. this name make see in sea town book from second married.
