Szigetv and ship of her kind be first big war ship with gun all make in land of us. not like old Austrian ship, this kind have no heavy iron wall, but go fast.

early in her time, Szigetv go on big go over sea to America and north Europe, from month 10 of year 1901 to month 10 of year 1902. then she work with many ship near land of us. there she many time take part in big sea train every year. she also go to other land near, many time to Ottoman land and Greek land. in year 1905, she help many land stop trouble in Ottoman land. in year 1907 and 1912, she carry new man to ship far east. Szigetv be in Ottoman land when king man of Austrian land be kill. this make big war start, and she go back fast.

Szigetv be with big ship in big war most of time. she take part in big gun hit on small land near sea in first month of war. Italy come in war in month 5 of year 1915. Austrian sea war sail to hit place in Italy, and Szigetv keep ship safe, and hit Italian air ship. she help more air hit in Italy in month 12 of year 1915 and month 1 of year 1916. in month 6 of year 1917, she be make small to keep safe sea hole. in month 3 of year 1918 she go off from war. after war, she be give to Britain as war reward. she break in year 1920. before that, she be use as man house ship and place to hit for fire boat school.

in month 1 of year 1895, top man of Austrian sea war say must build two kind of new ship. one kind be big heavy ship with iron wall. other kind be small ship to keep big war ship safe, look for enemy ship, and keep them safe from fire boat. chief man who make first design, man name Joseph, make it from order of sea order. but by middle of year 1897, design grow big. last yes come after work on first ship have now start.

Szigetv be long at water line and long all over. she have wide part and deep part under water. ship be heavy, much more when full. man group of this kind number 308 man, chief man and other man. power of them be two big machine, every turn one big screw, push by hot water air make in eight coal fire pot. machine of them can make ship go fast. ship carry enough coal to go far. to help go far, ship carry sail on two tall stick.

ship have eight big quick gun make in land of us. one gun be on front top, six in side part, one gun on back top. they also have eight more gun and two small gun for fire boat. gun all be by self, four up, rest in side. ship also have two machine gun. they have two pipe to throw fire boat. three ship of this kind be first big Austrian war ship with gun all make in land of us.

ship floor have two level of steel at front and back. in middle, to keep machine safe, be two level. gun box have thick side. top house have two level of plate on side. every big gun have one shield, but too small to keep gun man safe well.

Szigetv be put down at work place on day 25 of month 5 of year 1899, last of her kind to start make. she go in water on day 29 of month 10 of year 1900, with no big eat. she get name from old fight in year 1500 time. work end by month 9 of year 1901. she start work on last day of month 9 at price of 4500000 money. sea order at one time say Szigetv must go on big go over sea to America and north Europe.

Szigetv leave Austrian harbour on day 4 of month 10. she steam through west part of Mediterranean sea. she stop at big rock on way. then she go to town in Africa, French land. after she go to town on Portuguese island.

she come to town on British island on day 1 of month 11. she stop there one week. then she start journey in hot sea with many island. this journey last rest of year.

on day 1 of month 1, year 1902, Szigetv leave big town on island. she go to harbour in north hot sea and Gulf. she stop at town on island, at town on island, at town in Mexico, at new town in American land, at town in American land, at small island in American land, at two town on island. she stop at all of this by day 15 of month 3.

Szigetv go north more. she stop in town in American land from day 7 to day 16 of month 3. then she steam to British island from day 19 to day 27 of month 3.

she go back to American water for after two month. she see many town of American land till early month 5. she see Canada for short time and stop in town in Canada. then she go back over Atlantic.

she come to French harbour on day 22 of month 5. she stop one week. then she go to two town in Dutch land. while she in Dutch town, she see new Dutch war boat come to water. Szigetv come to German harbour on day 15 of month 6. then she see German town on day 24 of month 6. from there she go to British harbour. big look for new king, Edward 7.

then vessel go back to German sea town for sail boat fight on water from day 2 to day 14 of month 7. German big king come see her there.

Szigetv then move to cold sea. she stop near German town, then near Russian town. Nicholas 2 of Russia, big king, come see her there.

then she see town in north Europe in month 8. after that month she see town in north Europe. then she go to town on north land, where king of north land see her from small boat of king.

then she go to town in north land. then she go over north sea to Scottish town. then she steam south to French harbour.

from there she go to Portuguese town, Spanish town, African land, and French town in Africa.

she come to Austrian town on day 25 of month 9. she stop there till end of month. then she go back to Austrian harbour on day 1 of month 10.

four day after, she stop work for make good. she get small new thing, put in talk machine.

Szigetv come back to work in year 1903. she lead group of small war boat. this boat go with chief group of boat in near water.

early that year, big Austrian man see her in Austrian town. she work with summer learning group of boat in two part. year learning time last from day 15 of month 6 to day 15 of month 9.

in this time she see Austrian town from day 19 to day 24 of month 7. then she see other Austrian sea town from day 14 to day 22 of month 8, with rest of group.

all boat come together in Austrian harbour from day 16 to day 19 of month 9. after fight test end, three Greek big boat come see them.

on day 30 of month 9, she see new big war boat come to water in Austrian sea town.

in month 11, one pull boat run in sand on small island. on day 16 of month 11, she and one small war boat pull that boat free.

Szigetv stop most of year 1904 in rest. in this time she get her talk machine make new again.

on day 5 of month 11 she go back to work. she take place of broken iron war boat in chief group of boat. she keep at work with chief group till day 15 of month 6, year 1905.

in this time she join group of boat for learning journey near east sea. boat leave Austrian harbour on day 1 of month 2 and stop at small island, Greek land. in this month she see many Greek harbour.

in month 4 she go to Ottoman land. she stop at town, town, town and town. then in late month 3 she go through narrow sea to big Ottoman town.

then she go back to Mediterranean. she see more Greek harbour till day 15 of month 4.

then she start journey back. she stop at Greek town, then at Ottoman town, then at town in after land. she come to Austrian harbour on day 22 of month 4.

on day 21 of month 5, Szigetv and rest of group go to Austrian sea town. new big war boat start to water there.

summer learning go on from day 15 of month 6 to day 15 of month 9. in this time she work with big war boat of first heavy group and fast iron war boat.

in month 11 she go to east sea. she leave Austrian harbour on day 19 and stop at Greek town on way on day 22 of month 11. there she join big group of boat from many land. they make to answer fight and trouble in Ottoman land, trouble for strange man in that land.

Szigetv go to Greek island town. she put many man on land on day 26 and day 27 of month 11. that man go to land to keep talk machine place safe in town.

that day after, she go back to Greek town. then she go back to near Greek island town to watch.

day after that, she steam to small island. she take broken French fast boat and pull it back to Greek town.

from day 5 to day 12 of month 12, she put her man on land on small island.

she go back to Greek town. then she work near that town till day 17.

big group of boat from many land end on day 18 of month 12. then Szigetv go through narrow water road. she see other iron war boat at Greek town. two fast iron war boat come back to Austrian harbour two day after.

in first half of year 1906, Szigetv be send to big ship army of fast boat. this army have many fast boat.

summer move time go from day 15 of month 6 to day 20 of month 9. Szigetv go on in her part as chief of fast boat.

in this time, from day 20 to day 23 of month 7, big ship army have big happy day. this day be for 40 year after big sea fight in year 1866. Austria win that fight over big Italian army, in war for free of Italy.

after day, ship run on sand near one big town by sea. ship damage one of her screw.

after this, she go back to army for train.

she take part in sea attack train in month 9, at one town. big man of Austria watch this. for him, army do big make see after train, near one island.

ship be move back to big army in early year 1907. before this, ship be give work to carry new group of man to east Asia. this be for one more ship.

to get ready for journey, Szigetv have her fire machine and big machine make good. her front fire pipe move back to make room. this space be make in room for ship man and sick house.

she leave one town on day 1 of month 3. she go through big water road. on day 12 of

at start of war, Szigetv join group 1 of war ship. group have other big ship, two other fast ship, and chief of sea ship.

day 31 of month 7, Szigetv watch near town by sea. day after, she go back to harbour.

day 8 of month 8, she go with other fast ship to fire at talk station in town.

day 24 of month 8, she again fire at enemy place.

day 9 of month 9, she go out with sea ship that keep land safe, and fast ship with under water gun. they fire at town near sea in black land.

day 16 of month 9, Szigetv again hit two place in black land.

day after, she and other ship go back to town near sea, with four fast ship and five under water gun boat. they also fire at talk station in other town.

ship see little fight for rest of year.

day 2 of month 4, year 1915, she leave harbour for other harbour. she come day after.

she stop in harbour from day 9 to day 16 of month 4 to make good.

she do short sea test day 22 of month 4.

group of three friend want Italy to join war against old friend. Italy say not in war at start. Italy long want take part of Austria where many Italian live.

group say give this place to Italy if they win war.

day 26 of month 4, Italy sign agreement in London. eight day after, Italy leave three friend group, and that say war near.

chief of Austria sea ship send out ship to watch for Italian sea ship.

day 23 of month 5, Italy join war against Austria. same day, all Austria sea ship go out to fire at many place on Italy edge. most fire at Italian town and iron road by sea edge.

first, Szigetv go with big sea group to other town. then she go off with three other fast ship and nine fast fight ship to watch for sea ship of Italy to come out. they not come.

at round 00 25 on day 24 of month 5, Szigetv fire at Italian air ship.

at 11 20, Szigetv come back to harbour with rest of big sea group.

day 12 of month 6, chief of land come to look at ship.

six day after, she go out with other big ship and eight under water gun boat for again attack on Italian town near sea. other big ship and four of boat break off to fire at road over water near town. while Szigetv and other four boat fire at town near sea, they make one carry ship go down.

then all group come together again near town, and make two sail boat with machine go down. ship come back to harbour day after.

Szigetv cover two air attack on town. first be day 9 of month 12. other be day 17 to 18 of month 1, year 1916.

day 21 of month 1, she join fire test, fire 12 over stone wall in water near harbour.

late in month 6, two under water gun of size 45 be put on top of ship, on turn part.

she stop in harbour again, day 9 to day 16 of month 5, year 1917, to make good.

day 23 of month 5, she go to harbour, where she take place of old fast ship which till day 15 of month 6 keep harbour safe.

ship come back to harbour day 15 of month 11, with three under water gun boat. she come two day after.

that night, she leave harbour for town with fast ship and under water gun boat. she get to town day after.

day 13 of month 3, Szigetv come back to harbour with her same kind ship.

day after, two ship stop be war ship, so people can go to other ship in black sea.

Szigetv have no gun now, become sleep ship and vessel that people fire at, for school of under water fight.

day 15 of month 3, she stop be war ship. she keep in harbour for rest of war, war end in month 11.

after war, she go to Britain as thing win in war. British give her to people who break ship in Italy in year 1920.

year 1851, James Worden become law man for say bad many man in 12 small land. year 1855, Joseph, chief of land, make James Worden judge of small land. after, he win six year time as judge in small land. he leave in year 1858, when he have big judge house office.

year 1857, one old judge say he go out. then big decision be make for new judge. other group man win this decision. but chief of land, from one group, say that old judge still be judge. so new man be no judge. new man go to big judge house. he say chief of land be wrong. big judge house have most many man from one group, same as chief of land. they help chief of land. then judge seat be give to James Worden, from one group.

in war time, James Worden and other judge many man have many trouble with army rule. army rule can stop free of man from prison. James Worden be judge for seven year. he leave in year 1865. he test again in year 1864, but he lose. other group win big give say, make one group leave judge house. judge seat go to new man, James. after he leave, town make him chief in year 1865. but he leave town chief after one year, to do more law work.

year 1871, James Worden come back to judge house. he win again in year 1876. in 1870, one group have long time of power in judge house. in this time, big fight come about one box, about selection. house say selection on 7 new big land law be wrong. many people say bad thing. they say judge decision come from one group. they say James Worden and he friend be wrong. Ernst August Hagen have birth in east town. at that time, it be chief town of east German land. for near 10 year after year 1806, when king run from Berlin, it be seat of king house. father of him be great chemical man, year 1749 to year 1829. he also be medical store man for king house.

family be full of learn and have many friend in high place. elder brother of him be teach man of law and money. he be high king man too, year 1785 to year 1856. he become early and loud speak for free trade after learn work of old money man. family child of him, year 1797 to year 1884, be great water work man. young sister of him, year 1800 to year 1838, be married to man of number and power science, year 1798 to year 1895. elder sister of him, year 1794 to year 1885, be married to star and power learn man, year 1784 to year 1846. so he also be brother in law to that man.

in year 1807 or 1808, when he be 11 year old, Ernst August and brother of him be teach by father of them in medical store. with them be young king child.

Hagen go past big school test at old school in town. in year 1816 it open way to learn of natural science and medical at town learn house. selection of learn respect father of him. after, but he change to other learn. he make journey in east German land with friend of him, young history man. he come to know old art thing from old time. learn of him turn to art and word and story. he get great learn card in year 1821. in year 1823 he get learn seat. he now, while still learn man, make word love verse in year 1820. great word man see it and say it be very good.

in year 1821 he start long journey. one book say it last 2 year. but time be not clear in place, so may be more than one journey, every one short. while winter of year 1821 or 1822, he be in big learn town. there he hear old word man teach. after, he go see great art place in Germany and Italy. he make friend with many high many man of art and learn. friend be work friend and self friend. in year 1824 he come back to east town. friend circle of him now have great many man of star, word and stone art. he now go first to teach of art and word.

friend circle have many many man. one be picture man, year 1783 to year 1876. one be high king man, year 1788 to year 1876. one be art store man, year 1826 to year 1872. one be old learn man of old art, year 1795 to year 1867. one be learn man of law, year 1800 to year 1876. one be art word man, year 1808 to year 1858. one be word man, year 1773 to year 1853. one be art learn man, year 1794 to year 1868. one be British man of art, year 1776 to year 1847. one be play man, year 1801 to year 1877. one be art learn man, year 1798 to year 1875. one be word man, year 1788 to year 1857.

Keith war take place on day 20 of month 3, year 1746, in town of Keith, north part of Scotland. war be part of big fight of year 1745, when man want Charles king.

in month 3, year 1746, chief Alexander come with about 70 man and 30 horse man of Britain. William, king son, come with them. they come to town of Keith. at that time, man who want Charles king be near big river. they hear word that king son army be on way. army want kill them all. chief John lead this man. he order horn to blow. they walk to take land for fight. about 500 man of other chief join them. in all, about 900 or 1000 man. at last night, small band of Britain horse come near hill of town but not see any of man of Charles. one chief order small band walk over hill, be still there for order from big chief who lead all. chief Robert not be there long when small band of French horse man come down street. they tell him that band of Britain horse man be in tree land near town. that they fire at one other for some time. and that they want band of man go in tree land and attack them. chief Robert say he can do this only with order of big chief. big chief come about 45 minute after with small band of man, about 16 French, about 20 or 30 horse. they go in tree land, but find no enemy. they then walk to town of Keith, come there about 12 hour at night.

watch of Britain stop them. say who come? they say they be friend of Britain man, and watch let them in. they then kill watch and come in town, where fight start. French start fight, with loud cry of god keep Charles. fight go on two side about half hour, with fire from Britain man very hard from hole of church. chief Robert be bad hit. ball go through two arm of him. big chief say chief Robert send small band of man to church, as he think enemy may win over him in street. chief Robert come down street now, and take all enemy and put in prison.

word be that William, king son, have 700 horse near, and may attack Charles man. so chief go at back of prison man, to stop them fall in enemy hand. they be carry over bridge to big river. in fight, 9 of king son William man be kill, good number be wound, about 80 man take prison. on Charles side, one French man be kill, but good many be wound, most of all among man of big chief who be in fire from church.

in month 9, year 1843, group of man come together to say who lead. middle group and free group join in one group. but middle group win more chief than free group, who also break in two, soft and fast. so free group have no one chief. big group of man say Isabella be old enough in month after this, when she be 13. in day 10 of month 11, year 1843, she say yes to keep law of year 1837. then, as old way say, government of chief end. work to make new government go to one free man, chief of soft free group. he be take by mother of king, because he make agreement with her when he come back from out land.

first bad thing for new government be that new chief for talk house of man lose to middle man. this middle man get help of one group and also of fast free group, lead then by two man. when second hard thing come, to push through town law, this man tell woman king to end group of man and call new time for all to say who lead. he want house full of man who help him, not one that stop him because he lose friend of group. then come bad event of this man. middle man say this man force woman king to sign paper that end group. this man say he do no wrong, but he have no other way, and he give up work. he call new time for all to say, in month 1, year 1844, with agreement of free man, even though new power only come. he bring back town law of year 1840, which start free fight of 1840 that end power of mother of king and come back of old chief.

about bad event of this man, new chief take work on day 1 of month 12. he want talk about it in house. in meeting, this man make clear that say against him be false. but middle man have many help, so they win. this man go out to other land over sea, not because he be send out, but from fear of death. bad thing in big town. in some land part, many man doubt new power. so some fight start. one man of fight take control of big sea town for more than 40 day. he hope to make he fight go to other town.

in year 1863, one side of forward people, free people and free people win. but one man come to power, with strong rule. this rule end in year 1868, when big fight break out against country rule and Isabella, woman king. people call it bright fight.

change one man be not simple. old side have many trouble and fight between people. middle people, through one war man, offer chance to make new rule.

forward people, lead by one man, think good to end one rule. in end, woman king give rule to one old man, with little help. he want bring forward people in rule, but they go far. this rule last only till month 1, year 1864.

seven other rule come after that, till big fight of 1868. one man come in land rule for first time, on day 1 of month 3, year 1864. other man come in money rule. for part of them, forward people think one man lose. one man with other man start new idea. they have no belief Isabella have power to end long trouble.

one man make rule on day 16 of month 9, year 1864. he want join force and make one spirit, so forward people can join in live rule. he fear question of rule go far. but forward people no join system they think bad and old. so this man go to strong rule, and many people leave rule.

bad name come to rule too. night of St Daniel, day 10 of month 4, year 1865. young learn people in big town protest against law of one man. this man want take out think spirit from school room, and keep old church teaching. they also protest against take far of one learn man from seat of him, for word in paper. this paper tell of bad trade of king land, with woman king take 25 of money. hard rule fight stop protest, and kill 13 young learn people.

trouble lead to new rule on day 21 of month 6, with one man and other people come back. new law be make. this law give say to 400000 people, almost two time old number. time of selection be fixed. before selection come, forward people say they keep out. one man fight in small town, want take power by force. but idea be bad and he lose. again, forward people make old man tired. he make rule more strong, so fight break out at army house on day 22 of month 6. again one man lead it, and again it lose. street full with blood, and more than 60 people get death.

old man go far, tired, from rule. on day 10 of month 7 other man take place of him. this man stop death of fight people, but keep hard rule. he make many learn people leave school work, and make paper and speak more hard. when this man die, one more strong man take rule on day 23 of month 4, year 1868. big fight be now make. on day 19 of month 9, big fight of old king end. people cry. down with old king family! long live Spain with good name! Isabella go to far land, and new free time start.

strong country rule be big good thing of middle people, most of all for long time. it last till new land rule come. this rule not part of law of 1845. it come from new law. one man bring it to Spain from far land, where strong one man rule be make. this rule put one top man at head. under him be people of every land part, with one man at head of every part. then come people of town, put in place by top man.

in one big Spain country, many town group have big political power. but with middle people, that power be small. they be only body to speak and give thought.

big support of every town chief be group of wise man, send from big town. this group act as law place for hard and fight thing. make peace between people and government.

in every town group, all man be by selection of people. they must have approval of town chief and big chief.

town chief must keep public order, and do what big government say. in some time, big government have right to make other chief for town, not town chief. because town chief come from selection of people, but other chief come from selection of big government.

Su Fengji die on day 2 of month 1, year 951. he be chief of one Chinese land, in time of five and ten king. many say he be cruel and want too much. he make self die when king of this land die in fight against army chief who turn bad.

it not know when Su Fengji come out. many say he come from big old town in north. Su father be say to be big chief of one old land in west. so not clear if Su Fengji come out there. mother of Su die early. for long time, Su father have no woman to help. Su like drink all day, but not much. he not happy with meal any man make for him. he only eat when Su Fengji make meal.

old story tell that mother of Su Fengji be woman of father. father have elder brother from other woman. he also have young brother, not know if same mother.

when young, Su Fengji learn writing well. some time he make writing for father.

one time, father help big army chief with writing. this chief like father well. he find chance to tell chief, i be old man with little good. son Fengji know little writing. he have respect and care. if you chief not mind weak dog, i want he help you.

chief call Su Fengji. chief see he be strong and good look. chief feel sad for him, and keep him as man to help. when big meeting come, chief make Su Fengji stop near him.

in year 940, chief become chief of army in north land. Su Fengji become second man of chief.

it be say chief be hard and bad, so people of chief not want to see him much. thing that need yes from him grow big. but Su come to him every day. Su carry paper with thing that need yes, and find time when chief be kind to talk. many time chief say yes to Su idea.

but many say Su be want too much, false, and cruel.

one time, on day of he come out, chief send Su to bad house to look at bad man there. chief say, make bad house quiet. Su go there, and make up mind to kill all man still in bad house, not care what crime. then Su go back and tell chief, bad house be quiet.

in year 947, land in north break old land near it. north king also say he be king of China.

chief first act like he help north king. but after, chief say he be king. land have no name at first, but after it get name.

he make Su Fengji and other man high chief. they get big name.

at that time new land start, with no old rule for use. so Su Fengji make up mind about many big thing, and he think this thing be work of he. but he not learn much, and he say thing as he like. so new land law not join together, and be cruel.

at same time, army chief go south to attack. at first north land stop him at one town. chief think call army chief back, and not go south at first. but Su Fengji and one more man to help say this be sign of weak. when army chief say yes, chief let army go on.

after, army chief make north town chief give up, then go to other big town.

after, chief go south and take big town and old land big town. now people see chief as king of middle land.

north land king take two old chief north. chief give big house of first man to other man to help, and big house of second man to Su Fengji.

all good thing that second man keep in big house be take by Su Fengji. land he have in big town also be take.

part of law that king make first, when he become king, be this. because many bad man take in land at that time, all bad man, how much they take, will be kill. many special man be send to run after bad man.

Su Fengji think that not enough. he make paper with king order. order say. not only bad man, but near man of bad man, will have family kill. other man of king say not. they say not even family of bad man must be kill, and near man not much more. but Su Fengji say very strong for it. at last, king make middle way order. near man will be kill, but family will not. not long after, this lead to big bad kill of 17 village man in one village near big town.

even so, Su Fengji and other Su man be like very much by king. no man can make king turn from them. king give them all work of king, and give military work to two other man. Su Fengji be say to want much money, and he not care that people see it. when other mother of father die, he not put on sad cloth, and this be against right family rule of learn man. when big brother, child of other woman of father, come to house of he, he first see son of he, not him. he become angry and make reason to say to king that this brother must be kill. learn man one speak against two Su chief many man for bad thing they do, but after he become friend of Su Fengji. they call every other old and young. at say of Su Fengji, king make learn man one chief too, and make other man chief also. in fall 947, king go to fight bad general with brother of he and other general.

at that time, Su Fengji get big name and take care of king paper of history. he like good cloth and good food. he eat only good food at house of he, and not eat food at king office. when woman of he die, he make big death thing for her, and make sad cloth for man under him to put on at that thing.

in spring 948, king become very sick. he give young son of him to Su Fengji and other man. he say. last breath come short, and i can not speak much. young son be young and weak, so what come after death must be give to you. he also say to watch bad general, who give up and live quiet in one place. same day king die, this man do not say king death. they kill bad general and son of him. young son become king after. when king death be say, young son be king.

early in young king time, high man work together, with different work. but one man, chief of help, control all king work. when learn man want give office to man, he say not, it be waste, and learn man become angry. in spring 948, learn man one send paper to young king say that this chief and one more chief man must go to military place far from big town, and Su Fengji must make big thing. when they hear this, they go to see king mother and say. people of you go after dead king in hard time. now young king hear other man and want send us out. there be bad thing west of hill, so how can we not care about country work? if we not be here, we hope to be here till dead king go in earth. king mother be angry, and she go to young king and say. this old and good man of country. why you hear other man and send them out? young king say bad of learn man in general. learn man one take bad word by self and lose chief place of he. after this, one man get more chief place, and one more man become second chief of work. so one man make big thing, and two Su chief many man have no more true power.

at same time, this man have big house. house now give to Su Fengji. this man come back from far land. now he have good thing, but little power. he know he have no friend in king house. so he be care in all he do.

but this man two young brother not so much care. they be small man for king, with Su Fengji son and brother. they always say bad thing when drink much. you take we house and money!

so Su start to hate they. then this man give house writing to Su. this make Su more angry, not happy.

in winter year 948, one brother find he servant take money from he. one brother want get money back from servant. servant join with Su servant. they make false word. one brother want fight king. when Su hear this, he push this word. then this man and all he house people be hold. after this, one brother feel great pain. he make word all he think, and say many thing. he say not only he, but this man and other young brother, also brother son and 20 servant, want fight king in big big town. they work with big army man who before turn against king in far land and in far north. when this writing come to Su, Su think 20 servant not enough for big fight. so Su take pen and change 20 to 50. then this man house people all kill.

in year 949, big army man stop big fight against king. this man not want good thing by self. so all high king man get good thing from king. for Su Fengji, king give big name. one of three top many man.

in summer year 950, bad thing come about. it make bad feeling between high king man. they talk, then say yes. he also keep old name of top army man.

this man want big army man keep old name, so he can tell army man what to do. Su Fengji say no. never before, army man keep top name when he go to new place. at last, top king man say yes to this man. then this man say bad thing to Su, angry about it. Su say, to let king house control far land people, be right. how can you now let far land control king house?

after day, big army man have meal before he go. meal at big house of one king man. this be where bad feeling in king house come to front.

at meal, this man lift glass for big army man. he speak in hard word. how can there be no yes? we talk this thing yesterday in king meeting. now, let we drink, young brother! Su and other man also lift glass. they say, this be important thing for king house. do not hold bad feeling! this man say again, in hard word. to make land quiet, need long spear and big sword. what use have ink pen? one king man, who keep money, say. no ink, where money come from? people say. from this time, bad feeling grow more between many army man and high king man.

after this, big army man go to see top king man before he go. top king man make see hard look, say good word to big army man. but bad feeling keep between king man.

not long after big army man go, one king man have meal for many high king man. one king man seat near this man. Su laugh and say, when you seat near this kind of man, you not need fear punishment. but this man take this bad. he think Su make laugh at he woman, old woman, who before work in drink house. this man say bad word to Su. Su not say back. this man get up, want hit Su. so Su go far. this man take sword, think go after Su. he say, Su be top king man. if you kill he, what place you put son of sky in? please think with care! this man then get on horse and go. other man go after he on horse too, not leave he till he come to house.

when top king man hear this, he send one king man to make quiet. but bad feeling still there. Su think want new work in far land. but then he think. if he go from king house, this man can kill he fast. so he not do. one king man want same work. but other man and this man say he not go from king house.

winter year 950, king get tired of control from old chief. even though, old man 1 lead, king country be think well run. old man 2 watch big town, make people safe. part of trouble come from near friend and family of king mother. they want power, but old man 1 and old man 2 stop they.

at that time, king mother young brother work as chief of many small thing in king house. he want high place. king and king mother like this, but old man 1 and old man 2 say no, he no old. so they stop he. more, three man. chief of horse house, chief of wine and drink, and man at office of army chief. king like all three, but long time no new high place for they, so they be angry. when king want make woman he like in big woman, old man 1 say too quick. time of morning king not end. when this woman die, old man 1 say no to king want put she in earth like big woman.

king then make bad think with king mother young brother, man 3, man 4, and man 5, to kill old man 1 and other man. king tell king mother he think. she say, how can such thing be simple think! you talk with chief more. but young brother say, king before dead say country thing not talk with learning man. they be afraid, make you lose. when king mother go talk again, king angry. country thing not make in woman house!

on day 24 of month 12, year 950, when chief come to king house for meeting, many army man come and kill old man 1, old man 2, and old man 3. after, king say they do bad act against king. king tell chief and other man, old man 1 and other man see us as small child. now we be you true king! do not be afraid! he send army man to hold and kill family and near friend of old man 1, 2, and 3. king make Su chief for now. Su be afraid, kill be too quick. Su be angry at old man 2 but do not think this will come. he tell near friend in private, this do too quick. if king tell me first, this not come.

more, king also kill family of man 4 and man 6. king send man who carry word to order kill of man 4 and man 6. but king mother young brother hold that man, give they to man 4. man 4 then fight against king and walk to big town. king, against king mother word, go out of big town to win army back. he put man 7 in lead of army. three chief go with king. Su, other Su, and man 8. after man 4 army win, man 7 run, army fall. king die in fight. Su, man 8, and man 9 kill self. man 4 put up they head, and man 10 head, on north door of big town. after, man 4 take king seat and make new country. he give Su son big house in west town.

Judith be woman of Sir Montefiore. she know many language. she make music. she make writing about far journey. she help poor people. she bear on day 20 of month 2, year 1784. she die on day 24 of month 9, year 1862. she make first Jewish cook book in English.

Judith be one of four girl of her father and mother. her father be German Jewish man, rich in money. she bear in London on day 20 of month 2, year 1784.

she get married to Sir Montefiore on day 10 of month 6, year 1812. old Portuguese Jewish church not like this join between two kind of Jewish people. but Sir Montefiore think this rule be bad for good of Jewish people, so he have desire to stop it. little doubt that this join do more than all other thing to make way for join of English Jewish people now.

they get married on day 10 of month 6, year 1812. they take house in new place near one rich money man, and live there 13 year. this man be probable first of rich money family in England. one of her sister get married to him in year 1806.

she like go far much. she see much pain and sad in Jewish town where she go. she be ever ready with idea to help.

her print book make see her be wise. she have strong belief in god, true to Jewish teaching. she be kind to people of other belief. she be quick to get angry if shame come to her god or her people.

her wise mind help all work of Sir Montefiore. when he stop business, she lead how money of him go to help poor people.

she go with him on all far journey up to year 1859. she help make big journey of him to holy land, to big town in Russia, and to Rome.

she know many language, so she help him with hard work.

in year 1846, on journey to Russia, she never stop to help pain and poor people. she work hard all near her.

woman and girl of Russian chief come see her. they make see great like for her among all people.

her heart grow wide from far journey. she print two book about this journey.

in this time also, Montefiore make and print first English language Jewish cook book.

for some year her body be so bad, they live much time in Europe, hope get good again. but she become too weak to go on journey, and last year of her living she live in London and town by sea.

only few month before she die, they make meeting for 50 year married. this time seem her body get bit good again.

on day 24 of month 9, year 1862, after she give good word to him, she die.

after she die, Sir Montefiore make school in her memory, in town by sea.

about year 1887, Collings and brother James join work with first man William. they run two London picture room at 69 and 92 big road. then they open three London room at 100 and room at 69 in sea town in year 1888. William do no good, and seem bad with money. in that year Collings end join work. Collings keep big room with brother James. from year 1890, name be Arthur Collings.

in year 1891 people list, Arthur Collings be call art man. he live with woman at 59 big road in sea town. son Arthur Collings come in year 1892. about year 1893, Collings move work room to 120 big road in sea town. he keep this name till world war 1.

by summer of year 1896, Collings live at 13 in sea town. he start make motion picture list. one picture have train come in station, like French brother picture of train in station. one picture have old time woman in her room. one be early love picture. one be broken song picture, with Dutch music man. on day 18 of month 9, Collings send camera to machine man Alfred to make good. Alfred may also give camera to Collings. Alfred after make self machine for motion picture. he help other first man George Albert Smith and James make machine work good. Collings picture run on big machine in far big town, for 8 week, start day 19 of month 10.

in year 1897, Collings make 3 picture from old song about wine store man, for Lewis to run with live sing man. second run of Collings picture start in year 1898, in far big town. after that, Collings end picture make to paint small people picture.

by year 1906, he leave picture business. he shut second room, open in year 1902 at 89 big road. he leave old army man Richard in care of work room at 120. Collings go back to London to work at paint. in month 7, year 1910, Collings business join with Albert, Henry and William, money man and picture man. in month 6, year 1913, they shut 69 room. room at 120 shut after year 1915.

on day 28 of month 3, year 1936, Collings die at house in south sea town.

Anne, woman of Collings, first help him make art desire grow. she work as picture and art woman in London room from year 1905 till death in year 1948.

Froberg fight be bad fight in British army. it be from day 4 to day 12 of month 4, year 1807. it be at big house on island. island be British land then. Froberg army do it.

Froberg army start in month 12, year 1803. French man who like king make it. he say he be big German man, Froberg. he get yes from secretary of war to make army for work on island. he make army in land east and Christian part of Ottoman land. army have many kind of man. some be German, some be Russian, some from cold north land and east land. Froberg way to get man be bad. one man say in book, most bad false say and trick be use to get man.

army have 513 man. they come to island in year 1806. army have chief man and second chief. second chief be man who make bad way to get man.

early after they come, some man in army start to say no. they get word they be high man with good money. they must work as low man for little money. when man be shut in house on island, they want go back to other island. they stop want after second chief say he stop eat for them. this make more man sad.

after man get out of house, army man go in big town. they fight with other man and man of this land. to stop bad fight, British chief William shut them in big house at door of big harbour. in month 11, year 1806, William make James chief of army. this only make many man more angry.

fight start on day 4 of month 4, year 1807, when James be in town. it have 200 man, Greek and man from east land, who kill second chief, one more chief, John, gun man, and many man. they also make pain first chief and three other chief. they take down British sign and put up Russian sign. they shut door of big house and lift bridge. they hold chief and woman and child of chief. they make about 20 British gun man point gun and big gun at town. fight have chief, man from Greek land.

some man get out of big house and tell British about fight. British army man come and stop near big house. two other big house point gun at this house. in one word, army man want go house, with money and be free from William. they say they kill man in town if no. William say no, and tell them give up.

on second day, more gun point at house. but no more do, because William want man run out of eat. one more word from fight man. they want eat, and say they kill town again. but William not care.

on day 3, fight man send one of hold man, chief, to British with word. William not care again. chief tell British chief how it be in house. he need go back, because woman of him still be hold. after while, fight man start fight with other man. one group ready to give up put up white sign, but other group take it down. William see fight man not say yes, so he send man to talk. but they still say no, not give up.

on day 5, day 8 of month 4, let go woman and child of chief who be hold, because fight man run out of eat. fight man send last word. break house if eat not come. when end come, they send new word. they say they kill all hold man left. at same time while fight man fight with other man. some German man and man from cold north land can open door of house. most fight man run far and give up, but 20 other man stop in house with door shut again.

on day 10 of month 4, last fight man fire at town, but do no make pain. then William tell army go in by force. 40 man under chief, who be part of Froberg army too, go up wall of house and take it. they lose no man. house fall, but six fight man run in room of fire power. they say they burst it. after two day, they burst room, 600 big bag of fire power, and kill three British man who watch. then six fight man can run far to country.

four of six fight man who run far after burst room get take after two day. they kill man now. William take chief of fight to judge. 24 or 25 man get say be bad, and get kill.

kill be do at open place in front of rest of Froberg band. band be now hold in stone house.

every band die by rope from hand of band after. last band not die by rope, but die by fire gun. rest of man in stone house also die by fire gun. some not die quick and want run out. most be take again and kill, but two run off and die after jump off stone wall.

at same time, chief of band and friend of him run out from stone house. they be take near sea on day 25 or 26 of month 4 by island army man. they die by rope on same day, and be put in hole under big stone wall.

board of man make to question question, from day 20 to 22 of month 4. they find bad way of take new man in army. they order band end in month 6, year 1807. about 350 man be let go and send back to east land. rest, who want keep in British army, be put in three other band. book name be what do at stone house from day 4 to 11 of month 4, year 1807. book probable make by Italian man.

he run out of town, know that way of take man be find. some man say band of east fight man take him in far town and cut him to small bit.

stone house self get big damage. store of fire powder also get damage, and most of half stone wall be break. half stone wall be never build again like first. but work on damage part of stone house take over 4523 money. stone house again get big damage in world war 2. now stone house be in bad way, and sea may eat it.

this food powder be make from root. people take skin off root, put it in water, crush it, let water go out. this take out poison in root. in market, sweet root come with one name. bitter root come with other name. this food powder also have other name in land near Brazil and in Portuguese land. many people eat it in Brazil and near land. French land too.

this living way come before grain in many place. but early food come quick about grain and root. root be food of Indian people in old time. Spanish people hate this food. keep it for African man, who must work for other man. they make it big food.

this root be big food in many country of Latin America. people live from far south up to Mexico, by sea. in French land, old thing say American people make high field for root. field be earth hill, put in line, see from sky. field be in place now use for grass or forest. this root have many name. part we eat be root, but leaf can eat too.

this food powder be more or little dry, rough thing. colour go from bright yellow to grey to white. it be make from bitter root kind, from old time.

old way of make not change over long time. root first take skin off, then crush with rub board. wood board with small hard stone in it, or flat metal with sharp bit. now, if can, machine crush it.

then put this wet thing in long snake, basket bag with round ring at every end. then stretch snake, push wet food, push out poison liquid. this liquid take back, cook long time, eat as soup.

this food powder come under in snake. if we let it rest few day, it take strong taste. then crush wet food, push through basket, take out wood thread and big bit. this food powder be good long time. insect not eat it, wet not make it bad.

if it rest some time, it take strong taste. dry food then crush, push through basket to take out thread and bit. this powder be burn on big steel plate over fire. while cook, move it always, stop it stick together. first, plate be make of earth. now this food take other name. it can eat by self, with green leaf, burn, or in hot cheese food. some people take it to market. many colour, from white to yellow, and many size.

this food take in wet, so people eat it like bread at every food time. it keep long time, simple. it give food power, dry by natural way. it good for people who live in forest. in year 1700, two man say this brown, smoke food be only food for people who go on boat in big river. and with ten weight, one man have enough food to live 15 day.

Richard Maynard live from year 1832 to 1907. he be camera man from Canada. he take many land picture in British land, by edge of sea, and on island of north sea.

he come in this world in small town, in south part of England, on day 22 of month 2, year 1832. when he be two year old, family of he move to near town. as boy he first go to sea, work in trade by edge of sea between England and Wales. Maynard also learn shoe make early on. so he make boot in winter, and work as sea man in summer. in year 1852 he come together woman, and they married. then they go to Canada. they live in small town, now part of Canada land. in month 6, year 1859, he leave to join gold run by river in British land. there he have some good chance at mine. between, woman of he learn rule of camera work. probable she get knowledge from near store of camera man. Maynard go back to small town. in year 1862 family with four child move always west to big town on island. after come, he leave for far land, to test again at gold mine. by year 1864 he be back in big town. through time he be far, woman start camera work store. when he come back, Richard put up boot make store.

probable Maynard learn camera rule from woman of he. he first light picture be big land picture of big town, in year 1864. in year 1868 he take first long walk, up road to gold mine town. with he go son, Albert, 11 year old, who be call general. he keep mine man happy with magic trick and jump. two year after, Maynard go only back to birth town. on way back, he stop to get camera thing in big town. in month 5 and month 6, year 1873, he get work from chief land. work be on war boat. boat go first to town, then up east edge of island, and on past big land, far north to town. on go journey be first chief over land many man of British land, one man. work of Maynard be to make light picture of land man living for true book. light picture of he be first view of tall stick, among land man at river. in harbour, he take six picture of village man, against back of big cloth. year after, Maynard be again camera man on same work, with same boat. this time go all round island. light picture be not good, because bad weather come all time. but most big picture be take at town by sea.

in year 1875, Richard and woman of he go to far south big town to get camera thing. while Richard do land picture, woman of he run good camera store in town. in month 6, year 1879, Richard make short walk to far north land. there he take light picture of near place, like chief house, and also make stop in town. two month after, Richard and woman of he go on happy boat walk all round island. they make many picture together. it be not always clear. by mark on picture, you not know which of they take any picture. some book man think out picture be Richard, and store work be woman of he. in year 1880 or year 1881, Richard get work from chief land, to make light picture of road build. road be between two town in British land. Richard and woman of he see two small town in year 1880. after, Richard make more walk by road, for five year more. he go back to far north land in year 1882, on boat. again he take light picture of two town. in second town, he take view from big old house. in water by land, Maynard put up camera on ice. but ice start to break, and he have to be help by small boat.

in 1884, Maynard go with American chief on journey to far island land. that land then have other name. he take about 200 picture on this journey. most of picture be of village, tall wood stick, and boat. but two picture let us see in of two house, first picture of this kind know. also, he make picture of small fish that come from sea, at end of big river, on land near by. some picture make from picture of him be put in writing of chief, in month 11, year 1884. on month 7, day 4, year 1886, he take picture of first big machine that carry people to west edge of land, in town. in month 4, year 1887, he take view of big town. this town almost all burn by fire year before. in after two month, Richard and woman of him walk on new road of iron for machine, as far as two town of north land. this be three go journey by self to cold land of north, in month 7, year 1887. he be ill for much of go journey, but he make few picture at three place. Richard and woman of him go on boat of fire in year 1888 to far island land. he make many picture of place there, and of British land near by, and of island. in year 1890, Maynard win first reward for good picture of water near Victoria. reward come from match for many man who make picture for money, in west land. in year 1892, he go on two month journey to St Paul island. this be part of island group in far north sea, where many nation fight over land. he go there to make picture of sea animal and where they live. Maynard take about 200 picture, and few of them go in writing of meeting of many nation, that say who have island. in year 1893, he make last go journey to lake land of British.

in late year 1890, Maynard stop work with picture. then he rest many year with people of house, and be good. he die on month 1, day 10, year 1907, in Victoria. woman of him keep work till she rest in year 1912, and she die in year 1918. many picture of Maynard, and some writing of him, be keep by Charles, man who learn about old people. first dark picture and that of woman of him be give or give for money by son Albert to British house of old writing. in year 2021, Daniel play him in big picture.

Job live from day 30 of month 3, year 1823, to day 7 of month 3, year 1906. Job be American, peace church man from new York. Job move to land part of Virginia. there he and elder brother John farm and run grain house with water wheel from year 1846.

in war time, two man who say no to south army run from Virginia for short time. they come back in year 1862 and lead town for many year.

Job run general store in town. Job be letter man for three ten year. Job also be one time man in Virginia big talk house. at some time, Job be book man of law, chief of town, and one of land part chief group.

John and Jane be married. they live in Virginia town after war.

Job come near long land by water in new York, day 30 of month 3, year 1823. father be man, live from year 1779 to year 1829. mother be woman of father. father be peace church man who go to many place, also to Virginia.

Job be child number four. elder brother John and Samuel and elder sister Anna come first. mother then have more child. one brother, one sister, and Elizabeth and Maria. small farm not support family. after father die, when Job be six, one brother of father take one brother.

Job be take and keep by father sister Anna and her sister. they live at old house of father of father, by sea side, in big neck land, new York. Job go to school run by James. then he go to big school where James teach.

Job married Maria on day 30 of month 3, year 1843. they have seven child before she die, quick after one girl die. child be. boy Edward, year 1844 to 1860. girl Anna Maria, year 1846 to 1946. boy George, year 1848 to 1932. girl, year 1850 to 1863. boy, year 1852 to 1863. girl Jane, year 1854, take by John and Jane. girl, year 1856 to 1883, take by Elizabeth.

Job married Margaret on day 16 of month 6, year 1860. she also come from new York. she have five more child, but only two live after she. boy, year 1862 to 1894. boy, year 1865 to 1906. boy Henry, year 1868 to 1947. boy, year 1872 to 1897. girl, year 1876 to 1878. girl, year 1878 to 1882. they also take girl, year 1880 to 1907.

when Job be 16, father sister Anna get farm in big neck land. Job be to run it. after four year, some wrong thing find in land paper. so she not end get farm.

they move to town in new York after Job married. there they work farm of one father brother for one year. Job know Maria about one year before. then Job be first man when father brother Charles married.

because Maria get farm part in land of new Jersey, after winter of year 1843 to 1844 at mother of Job house, where Maria have first child, they move to new Jersey in year 1844. they give that farm off about one year after, because elder brother John say many good thing be in Virginia.

in year 1846, month 2, Hawxhurst two brother move with family to land part of Virginia. there they farm 470 field. part be about 6 long walk north of house of law. they make old grain house work again. it turn grain in powder, with power from fast water. one brother of Maria also married and live in Virginia. they talk to god at church house on other side of land part. in war, when north army use that church house, they talk to god at house of friend.

but Maria die quick after one girl die. Job have seven young child to keep. also grain house burn down. sister Elizabeth come to Virginia to help family after Maria die. she take baby girl back to sea side place in long land. there she married, have three girl, then die in birth, like mother. John and Jane take some child in house, and take one girl.

two brother not like Virginia, leave south side after new chief come by say of many. they be strong north man in war, but south people, who be near, respect they for many kind act.

Job go to big town of America when war start, but he come back in spring of year 1862. north army take land town, near old house of law. army chief give Job right to run store. he do most with one, because John be send far in Virginia. Job keep not carry gun, though many say carry for safe. he run store there.

he many time go through south side and on road full of bad man. he say live come from this thing, also god power and good chance. by year 1865, north army take all land part. Job also become letter man, work he keep for more than three ten year, but not in two other chief time.

year 1869, many people of this place say yes to new law of Virginia. brother of him John help make that law.

they send Job Hawxhurst to speak for them in Virginia general meeting. Job be man of keep old way, not new. he speak for them only part of day.

he win over more strong man. many people like he speak against old war law. that law take right from man. many say yes to that law, though that part not win. like most other man in that meeting, that be first and only law work of him.

he also live when big house fall in month 4, year 1870. bad thing. too many people come to hear about who win town chief place in big town. so he be in money place, do work, and not in big house.

Job keep work in town law. many people send him to be writing man for big house. he be town chief too. he make first law against drink in year 1879, that let people of this place stop drink. many say yes to that law.

on day 18 of month 6, year 1867, he be first man of group, number 3, in this place. he be first big chief of big group against drink.

in year 1902, sick brain attack hit Job. body of him can not move, so he stop letter work. he get more sick and weak.

woman of him die in year 1904. he move to house of son George, town chief of place in Virginia. here Job die on day 7 of month 3, year 1906, leave three daughter and three son. he be put in earth, in place of dead, in this town.

library of this town have copy of writing of him, Anna, and Maria Hawxhurst. that be from year 1846, 1847, 1861 to 1866, 1897 to 1900.

other son of him be teach man and man of letter in Washington, big town. woman of son George be one of first woman in group for equal right of all to have say in law. she be chief of other group in other place.

Illinois group 126 be foot army in north army, in time of American war.

Illinois group 126 be make in late hot time of year 1862. chief of north army call for 300,000 free man to join army. all many man come from five land place of Illinois.

group start in one town of Illinois on day 2 of month 9, year 1862. group take man for three year work and join under control of chief. group take field on day 4 of month 9.

group go to field on day 20 of month 11, year 1862. group watch big wall by big river at town for one week. then group join army of chief at town, and join army 13.

group live through cold time to watch food road and iron road near two town. group keep back while big army go down big river and to town. at last group join long fight at town of big river on day 28 of month 5, year 1863.

group be there when south army give up on day 4 of month 7, year 1863. then group go to work in town.

from day 1 of month 8 to early day of month 9, year 1863, group join chief and that army against big town. there group see fight near small river. south army under chief lose, and north army take control of most of land.

after big walk to town, group keep at town till day 1 of month 8, year 1864. in this time group see little fight and live through many day of army live. one fight be small fight on day 25 to 26 of month 6, year 1864 at tiny place.

group live through rest of war near town in middle of land. after most of time in army, most in back place, group go back to land on day 12 of month 7, year 1865 at town.

group work at town till day 1 of month 1, year 1863. 6 company go to town on day 19 of month 12, year 1862. then they go to other town. fight at other town on day 21 of month 12.

4 company work at town and 6 company at other town, from month 1 to day 25 of month 3. then at town till day 25 of month 5, year 1863.

move to town in land of south on day 25 to 28 of month 5. long fight at town of big river on day 28 of month 5 to day 4 of month 7.

move to town on day 24 of month 7. walk against big town from day 1 of month 8 to day 10 of month 9. small river fight and take of big town on day 10 of month 9.

move to town on day 24 of month 10, and work there till day 19 of month 8, year 1864. fight at tiny place on day 25 to 26 of month 6.

move to town on day 19 of month 8, and work there till day 12 of month 2, year 1865. look from town to two town on day 26 to 31 of month 1. at mouth of big white river till day 12 of month 6, and at town till day 12 of month 7.

group lose 6 man kill or wound bad, 4 chief and 192 man die of sick. all 202 man die.

one chief go back to land with group on day 12 of month 7, year 1865.

Li be big woman of this land. while time of 3 land after old king, she be call great mother. she be mother of second king. she be married woman of man who start new land. after second king die, she rule for short time, in year 951, till new king come. she die in year 954.

no man know when Li come to birth. we know she come from big town in cold land. her father be man of farm. her future man be young army man in old land. one night, he be out with horse, let horse eat grass. he go in house, take her, and make her woman for him.

he have three son. we know second king come from her. we not know if other two son come from her. after he become big army chief, people give her high name. she have six brother. three brother be know in history. all be young than she. first brother be old. we not know if he be old or young than she.

in year 947, old land fall to cold people from cold land. they king say he be king of middle land too. this man, then army chief of east land, after some doubt, fight that king. he say he be king now. he first give land no name. after, people call it new land.

to get money for fight, he think to take money from people by force. he want give money to army as reward. Li say no. she say poor people have little, and they will be angry.

king take her word, stop idea. he give out money from big store. when news go out, people in cold land and other place think well of him. after, he make her high woman.

he join people who fight cold king under one rule. this land take over middle land, with big town in middle land. but he rule only one year before he die, in spring 848. first son die before him, so second son become new king. new king respect Li as great mother.

by old king order, rule of land be in hand of some man. 1 man, 2 man, 3 man, 4 man.

after, fight come up between 1 man and 2 man. 1 man be top office man. he put many man in office place that be open long time. 2 man be one of top chief. he think this place not need, waste of land money. so he say no to 1 man many time.

3 top office man send letter to new king. he say 2 man and other man must lose office and become chief of key town. chief work must go to 1 man and 5 man.

when 2 man and other man know letter, they go to Li and cry. they say, we be you man. we go after dead king from hard time. now new king hear other word and want send us out. with trouble far west, how can we, you man, not see land trouble? if we not be here, we hope we be here till dead king go in earth.

Li be angry. she go to king and say, this be old, good man of land. why you hear other man and send them out?

king say wrong be on top office man, in general. 3 man take wrong for self. he lose top office. after, 2 man get more top office. other man get chief work too. so 2 man be big one to rule. 1 man and 3 man lose true top power.

after, 3 chief come up and fight in west. 2 man go fight one of them. in year 849, 2 man win. that chief kill self. one more chief also kill self. last chief give up, but then think of fight again, and be kill.

with 3 chief dead, they say new king become foolish. he use much time with 2 man he like. Li tell him many time to make good. he not hear her.
