after print house not open here till after time, year 1850 and after.

in first part of year 1800, Turkish land have big wave of change. change want one rule for all government, like Europe.

Muslim big man of this land say no to change. they fight again and again against king of Turkish land.

Turkish army come in to this land in year 1831 and 1850. it crush big man of this land. then big change start to work here.

Christian people have few right in Turkish land. here it be even more bad than rest of land.

in year 1862, Christian people here get more right, two Catholic and other kind. they can open new church and run school.

this come after some fight by Christian people, most of all one kind. they have strong move for nation in this land.

one man and other Christian man of god request right to make print house in year 1847, 1850, 1853 and 1857. every time Turkish government say no.

change become strong in this land in year 1860. then Turkish chief of land be one man, though most change go slow.

by new Turkish law, every big land part have to have one print house and one news paper from government.

law for this land, make in year 1865, make this land big part of Turkish land. law 9 say there have to be print house in head town.

chief also have other reason to make print house.

at that time, news paper in near land, and in south part of Austrian land, say bad of Turkish rule here.

book bring in from near land for Christian school here also go wide nation feel, which chief see as bad for Turkish rule.

in mind of chief, move for nation of Christian people here be danger for Turkish rule.

to keep hold on this land, Turkish people want push idea of one nation for all this land. so they stop nation idea and political want of Christian people and Muslim people.

after new law come for this land, chief want rich print man come to big town. this print man be owner and manager of print house in town near big river. that town be part of Austrian land then. now that town be small part of other big town. he be German, have birth in year 1821 in new town by river.

chief give him money to make print house and keep it. print house be in one building on street, where land chief work. print man come to town with print machine and paper. one man from other big town lead old letter and Latin letter. this man have three young man from school to learn from him. chief want one more man, Turkish man, for letter of Turkish kind. head thing of print house be make news paper and school book for land. so people stop take school book from land near, like Austrian land.

print house be open by chief order. letter way in print house go with new rule from one wise man of land near. this new rule be new then, not all people like it still.

first news paper come out same day, one time every week, for political news and teach. this news paper be first news paper ever in this land. print man make agreement with chief. print this news paper, separate from chief news paper. when print man tell chief idea of he news paper, he say it be print in speak of that land near. chief not like it at all. chief take out one word, put other word in place. print man say yes to change, go with chief idea, make one people of this land. still, news paper stop strong near that people of other land. print man not think this be bad, he think people of this land and that people be same. in news paper, speak be call by two name, at some time. name of two people be put too.

first copy of chief news paper, name be land name, come out on day 13 of month 1, year 1283. news paper be in two speak. half of paper be Turkish speak with Turkish letter. other half be other speak with old letter. other speak be true copy of Turkish word. news paper be most about tell law, order and say. also give news about political thing, money, knowledge and living of people in land. it come out with no stop for more than 12 year, and for most of that time be only news paper in land.

over time 6 man put word in news paper. most of them be Muslim, but 1 be man of other belief and 1 be Turkish man. one man keep work all time. change Turkish word to other speak. that man know many speak, and in past he teach at little school in land near. also with that print man, that man put word in first news paper, with 2 other man. one of them lead school of one people and young man in town. other man work in big Muslim church. in month 8, year 1866, print house make first book. book teach on man and work of man, change from Greek speak by one man.

in month 10, year 1866, print man take money, give print house to chief of land. print house get new name. print house of land. from month 3, year 1867, name be print house of land again, same thing. print man keep owner work of first news paper and make 51 copy. after 1 year in this town, print man go back to old town. first chief of print house be one man of other belief from big town, give work by chief of land. that Muslim man, who put word in chief news paper from year 1868, make new news paper at end of that year. it be two speak news paper, one time every week, like chief news paper. it have word of now political thing and put about many thing of people living. most put word in it be by that man. he strong fight Turkish rule in this land. he fight with news paper from land near and Austrian land, that say bad thing of it. in month 5, year 1869, when chief of land stop be chief, man of other belief go back to big town. new chief put that Muslim man as chief of print house. that Muslim man die of sick breath in month 9, year 1872. last copy of new news paper come out two month before that.

death of one man mark end of rich time for print house. after chief be not able, and condition start become bad. year 1877, last Ottoman chief of this land put one man as chief of print house. this man make print house more good. Austrian army come in town on day 19 of month 8, year 1878. this start 40 year of Austrian hold land. four day after, Austrian army general give control of print house to one Austrian man of office. this be end of old print house. it get new name and keep work as chief print house of this land. last paper, number 636, come out near end of Ottoman rule over this land.

separate from three paper, print house put out about 50 book in land tongue, Ottoman Turkish and Hebrew. most of this book be about Ottoman law and rule. print house also put out some learn book. school book for small school of this land be make by one man, with book from near land. this with letter book, short Bible history, first reading book and first knowledge. this man letter book be first book of print house, and second letter book of near land with new letter. first idea be 15 learn book for school of near land, about word, number, land and god learn. only four print. even if book come from near land, chief of this land take out every word of near people and near tongue.

first year book of near people, for common year 1869, have 58 leaf. one man make it. in old way of near people, year book have more than day number, also be word book and learn book. this year book have more learn than word. it also have word for young man, say at time of group of cloth man in town, when young man become chief of work. this be only word like this know, with one writing of year 1841 for group of gold man.

Catholic school book in this land with land learn book, year 1869, by one man. also letter book with god learn for young Catholic people in land, year 1869. and one more land learn book, year 1871, by one god man. one Catholic chief of god man in town give money for print of Ottoman Turkish word book in year 1871. Hebrew book with two god list, one for rest day and one for big day. and one small god book. this be make about year 1875 by one Jewish chief of god man in town. print house also put out first print of this land writing, book with great rule of Muslim god. it be make by one Muslim chief of god man.

fight at Strasbourg bridge come in 30 year war. it be near free town of Strasbourg, in holy Roman land.

after north army lose big at town fight in month 9, army of top king, Spain and Catholic go over south land of Germany. so Louis, north chief, think go back over big river with army. he use Strasbourg bridge.

front of top king army, lead by Charles and chief of horse man, come to back of north army at small place. Louis almost take, but run out.

then top king army attack wall near Strasbourg bridge in small town, while north army be go over big river. fight last 3 hour and end with fight on bridge. at end, more than 300 north man, or may be 1500 or more, die or be take. Louis, with most man, be safe in Strasbourg.

small north army under Louis take almost all of high land from old king family, in month 3, year 1634. after win over Charles at small place.

after that, Louis take big town, and lock one more town. he leave small army to stop last old king wall town. big north chief tell Louis to watch new Spain army come, lead by one Spain chief. but Spain army go north, to join big top king army against north army. Louis keep at big river.

because small army of one town hold out till day 19 of month 8, Louis only slow go help north chief. he come too late for north town fight, and can only help bring back hit man.

after north army die in fight at north town, and north chief be take, king army go in two again. most of top king army go north, to big land where other German chief go back. at same time, Charles, now chief of German Catholic army, and horse chief of he go in rich land, where man can grow strong after fight.

on word of one big chief from south, top king send Charles to big river, to put out north army from last wall town.

Charles front army, with horse chief, win over back army of Louis at small place. they take six gun and four flag. Louis run to small place, where he join army again. horse chief join Charles, while Louis have help from king of rich land, who have to lift fight at small place.

after hear of come top king army, Louis go with army to Strasbourg bridge, to go back over big river. in all, he have 6000 or 7000 man, with rich land army and one big chief from small land. France chief come also, but come late, so not join fight. to stop north army go over big river, horse chief lead front army of 6 horse group, 2 more group and 300 gun man. in all about 3000 horse man and 1500 or 2000 walk man.

on 27 or 28 of month 9, horse chief come to back army of north at small place, between small place and big river, while most of north army be at small town for go over. as Louis go out with 15 friend to lead back army, he run in some horse man of Catholic army, who think he be Catholic chief. when he jump in small water with horse to get out, they see wrong think and fire on him. he only have light wound. small place be burn after fight.

Louis go back to small town, where army be in wall to cover go over. he send family first over to Strasbourg. when Louis come, Charles order attack on wall. top king army win after 3 hour fight. north army have more than 300 die in line of they, say by one old man of writing, and many die at bridge at end, when order go over turn in run. top king army say 1000 north man die in wall, and hundred more die in water of big river or burn in fire at house. they say up to 2000 north man not get out of fight. one old man of writing say north man lose 1500. Louis and most of army go over bridge to Strasbourg.

Charles send letter with request to town group in Strasbourg, to open door, but they say no. Louis, still at west side of big river, quick go back to small place. Catholic go to other small place.

north land and one group quick take off from town after fight.

by law of Paris, north people give France strong house and town. for stop big army from take control of land.

one chief talk with big king, but one more chief and one more still fight army against big king. they be in land near one big river town.

at same time, big king army be between two river. on day 27 of month 9, they take town. same day, fight at Strasbourg bridge.

after big fight, Catholic man push north man and German friend out of south land. two town still hold out, but by one chief of south land.

west land and most of middle land. one man, secretary to big chief, say north man out from root of high hill.

Hexagenia be one kind of water fly, in one family. it live in north America, in high part of big river land. some time many full fly come at one time, so many they cause trouble for man. young fly live in water and make hole in wet earth. full fly live little while.

when full fly be ready to come out, young fly move to top of water in night. young fly skin break open, and young wing fly come out in one minute, then fly to tree near them to rest. they be grey colour, with short rough leg, small hair on tail and cloud wing. after 8 to 18 hour, this change in full fly. this be more soft to look at than young fly. wing be clear, leg be long and thin, tail have no hair, eye be big and body be brown and white. female be much big than male.

Hexagenia live in high part of big river land. full fly come in summer and live near still and slow water. young fly make hole in wet earth and sand in low lake and slow river. this fly be more many than near kind, but that kind grow more from town near, north land up. when one water wall be free near town in month 7, year 1958, man find 344 young fly in wet earth.

in dark, male full fly come together in group. they live near tree or house, or if no wind, all round such thing. every male stop in one place, face wind, near other male, hold still with tail hair. male do not jump up and down like near kind. any female that come in group, many male come after her till they join in air. then male come back to group, all of them die before morning. female put two box, every one with many thousand egg, in water, where they fall down deep and stick to wet earth. she die after little time, and egg box still in her body may come out. every egg open few week after, and new young fly make hole in wet earth and make hollow. it make water move through hollow, give it air it want, and take food from wet earth. it live in this hollow till ready to come out in year after.

this fly may have short time to live than other kind in same family. in room, when keep warm, it grow from egg to full fly in 13 week. but in town near, one new line come every year. but in big lake, some full fly come out at 14 month, and other at 22 month.

some time many full fly come out at same time. on night before day 14 of month 7, year 1958, big paper say.

fish fly control bridge at town near for 40 minute, then give up with many die, under iron back attack by road machine.

tree at river side lose branch, house be cover, can not see, and many fly go many hundred far on boat on river. boat man call them that big, black thing.

on night of day 23 of month 7, year 2014, in town in north land, fly be up in air so many they see on weather machine. such big group look like big rain. they come to light, and many body come up in garden, on road and bridge. three machine bad thing hit two person in town near. some think wet green thing from crush dead body cause this.

this safe land keep thick forest, many field and wet river side. land be rich in many kind of living thing.

long ago, man take sticky milk from tree. now law say no cut tree for trade.

people here be poor in school and in healthy body. many be sick. they hunt, fish and farm for food. they get Brazil nut, fruit and heart of tree.

this land be cut between three town. about 44 of every 100 part be in first town. about 17 of every 100 part be in second town. about 39 of every 100 part be in last town.

it have big size.

Cajari river give name to this safe land. it take water from middle of land.

big river make south east edge of land. other river make north east edge.

road run through north part of land. road join town on river to west with head town to east.

other safe land and science place be few step north of this land.

in about year 1950, this land be use for sticky milk from tree.

man who take sticky milk come to this land. they learn take other natural thing from forest.

late, Daniel, rich American man, have this land. he want to get wood, farm and mine. this need cut down big land of forest and plant strange tree for paper.

fight come with old forest people. they make one club for work together. in year 1985, work man group join fight for make safe land for tree milk man. idea start to be take by big man.

law 99. 145 make this safe land on day 12 of month 3, year 1990.

law of day 30 of month 9, year 1997 say Brazil group can take some land from this safe land.

this land be group 6 of rule for safe land.

now, this land want keep natural thing safe, for old forest people to use.

Brazil group get control of this land.

now group of man take care of this land.

this land be part of big green road make in year

people here grow grain, rice, sweet fruit, root and sweet potato. this food come from land.

tree milk stop now. people take Brazil nut, heart and fruit from tree now.

people fish for food. people trade with boat for good thing.

Jhulan Purnima be also call by other name. it be happy time of hanging seat, for belief of many god. this be for love god and love woman, two god. many people in belief group keep this in month 7 to 8. this be in rain time. weather be hot, wet and little wind. here people see beautiful hanging seat, song and dance. it be happy time of love, and of love feel in rain time in India.

this word be old word of India, from old tongue, say hanging seat or hanging bed. this word be also name of special music song for hanging seat.

this way come from play of love god with cow woman in holy town. this play be in three old holy writing, one, two and three. word man and song man use hanging seat of rain time to tell about love feel in India.

one old holy book say this. people help god in hot time by put him on boat, take him out in walk, put wood on body of him, wave hair at him, put neck jewel on him. they offer him good food and bring him out for hanging seat in moon light.

of all place in India, 3 town be most big for this happy time. in 13 day of this time, from day 3 of bright half of month 7, to full moon night of month, call Purnima, many love god people walk from world to holy town. many go to holy town in north land and holy town in west part of India.

stone of two god be take out from high place. they be put on big hanging seat, which be make of gold and silver. big holy house in town 1, town 2 and town 3 be most great. here people see this happy time in great way. holy house of love god group in town 3 also be great place for this time.

in big holy house in town 4 and other holy place in east land, people put big god stone on hanging seat. they move it with sound of music and dance. this be in month 8 for 7 day, up to full moon, call Purnima.

many belief group, most of all love god group, keep Jhulan Purnima for 5 day. in town 3, big house of love god group, god stone of two god be beautiful and put on big hanging seat in open place of holy house. people hold flower rope and move seat, put flower leaf down, while they sing and dance. they sing big holy word of love god. special way of holy song be do after god stone be put on seat. people bring food for two god.

this man of love god group say this way to help love god on this time. in 5 day of this time, god stone cloth be change every day. good food be give out, and group song be do. big seat may be make, on which two god can be put, and move slow with music.

in one belief group, this time be keep for 15 day in rain time. big hanging seat be make and beautiful with different material for every day.

song for this happy time be sing in special music way, call hanging seat music. this music, sing by holy man like one holy man, be play with music thing in this time.

John Daniel Custance live from year 1842 to year 1923. he be science man of farm grow. he start big school in south part of Australia. but big man of law send him off. they not like one other.

Custance teach science of farm grow at big school in England. for some time he go to school in Japan.

south Australia have big law group. they fear, land no more make good food. grain grow in this land for not many year. early in year 1881 Sir Arthur look for good man. man teach farm grow at new big school. Arthur take Custance. in month 6 of year 1881 Custance get work. money be 800 every year.

they make one big farm and school together. Custance, Alfred, Samuel and Robert take land near town, by train station. but other man say land too good. they want land tired from grain grow. in year 1882 they get farm at flat place of jump animal, west of town. Custance come with no one, in late month 7, on big boat. boat leave Britain on day 1 of month 6.

he start test now. he go to many farm in many land of grain grow. but big school not start till year 1884. Custance get chief work with no money. but he have hard time in work, because law man not want give him more help.

Custance be good man to teach and learn, and good chief. but he be hard man, not soft. man say he be angry and hard. he not know how to win by smart way. before him, law man work well with him. Alfred and Thomas get on with him. but James be law man who want be top man. he not care work well with Custance.

day come when Custance want two test man. James send three. no one give up. Custance give up chief work with no money on day 8 of month 12, year 1886. then James say Custance have three month to end teach work.

James be angry. he not come to big day when learn man get mark.

Henry live from day 26 of month 9, year 1812, to day 25 of month 11, year 1887. he learn at big farm school. he come to be chief after in month 3 of year 1887. he come in month 6 but be too sick to work on day 1 of month 7. he give up and go back to England. there he die from sick in tongue and throat.

south Australia law group give money for journey of him, and big money more.

at this time James no more be law man. Custance can come back as chief with little loss of face. but that not be so. they put William as chief. other man act while William come from England.

about this time Custance go back to England with house people. he be in London early in year 1888. one son have birth in small town, far off. they go to island near England before go back to south Australia.

William work for 13 year, then leave in year 1903. he cry out that he get small money, not so high as Custance. after him come other man.

Custance and house people go back to south Australia on big boat, near day 27 of month 4, year 1906. many people give Custance good word for part he play in farm grow. he work for some time at big farm of one man, then at other farm near town.

after, at big day, man say many learn man of Custance do well in farm grow.

in year 1923 he make many word for news. one son die on dry road far off. and he die at house in dark forest, south Australia, at end of same year.

Mary, call Mrs king, be woman from far south land. she live from year 1831 to year 1911. she fight in England and America for end of bad rule about sick woman. she also want world peace, good house for many people, good dress, and help for farm people.

Mary be child 3 of Thomas. her father be learn man of law from England. her mother be Mary Anne. like her elder child William, who die young, Mary come from Germany. in 1852 family go over sea to far south land. they live in one town there.

Mary join William. William be chief of army, and new man in big meeting of rule. they have two daughter. one come in year 1859, one come in year 1855. in 1861 Mary father die. after one month William be kill in war, in attack by people of that land. town be under attack, so Mary, her child and rest of family go to safe island.

Mary not live long on island. in 1863 she and daughter go back to her town, where she make big book about fruit of garden. book say old holy book and what St Paul say be wrong. wise man John help her thought. book come out in 1864 in Australia and England. man George help put book before people. he not take god as true. on first page, her name be Mrs king, not her birth name. after some doubt, she say in first page that she be woman, and that wise man of America help her think.

in 1870 Mrs king come back to England with child. almost at one time she join one big woman to fight against bad rule about sick woman in town by sea. from 1870 to 1872 she help make street fight, speak to people, and be part of big group of woman that want end of that rule.

from 1872 to 1875, Mrs king be big name in England for talk about big thing. in 1872 she start small group for peace. she speak about woman and peace, about science of house work, and about good house for many people to live in together. she use work of one American woman. in 1873 she tell man Edward William to make picture of big house for 100 or more people.

this idea not work, no money come. but one speak in Ireland in 1878 about equal right for all people, Mrs king leave public live from 1875 to 1881. part of that time she live in Germany with child. there she make letter to one woman, to help her fight for dress change. in 1882 back in England, they make society for good dress, with that woman as chief and Mrs king as person help.

Mrs king speak again, make more book, and say society will put dress thing for people to see in 1883. because of fight in society, she make second group, dress group. it put dress thing for people to see in big house in London from day 18 of month 5 to day 12 of month 6, year 1883. Mrs king speak at open. then dress thing go to other town in country.

in 1884 Mrs king leave England with friend Elizabeth, who also have short name. they go to Canada and America and keep fight for dress change. in 1886 Mrs king and friend get orange tree land in Florida. there she help farm people fight. she make word for paper, be chief of paper, and speak to people for farm group. in 1890 they make club for woman to learn and talk, one of first in Florida. in 1907 she give last speak, about bad talk about people and what be right and wrong. after that year she go back to far south land to live with child. in 1911 she die near town where William live. she be put in rail place near big church of St Mary, with William and father Thomas.

Mrs king think man and woman be more same than different. she say what not same be make big by rule, church, house way, and bad thought of England and America, and that make bad to two sex. in her speak, book and fight for many people to live together and dress change, wise man of thought and society help her most.

Massachusetts be army wall house, build in flat land of south west. it be near west side of small water, at base of high hill. it be 8000 foot high, about 6 long walk north of now other wall house.

build in year 1852, leave in year 1858. Massachusetts be first wall house keep by army on land that become west part of America. but at time of build and use, land be part of new Mexico land, and flat land have very few man live there. wall house be make to keep control of flat land, and to keep man of land safe from one other. one other purpose be head house for Indian man who speak for band. it also make clear to Mexico that land now be America land, by agreement sign 5 year before wall house.

army of America order wall house in month 6, year 1852. chief George lead it, from first horse army. wall house be make most of wood, in square house form, with near wood. strong wood wall go about it. two army group live in wall house. one horse group, one foot group. in all, 93 man live in wall.

child and woman also live in wall house. they be family of army man and chief. woman do wash cloth work for army man.

Indian band keep attack and kill near house place, even with army there. wall house never attack. but it help stop one Indian band that kill many man near now town, on day 25 of month 12, year 1854. after news come to chief John, chief of army in new Mexico land, he want chief David to give 5 group of man on horse for 6 month. chief David say yes, and 500 man join army on day 31 of month 1, year 1855. this man join army at wall house. one of them be man know by many. he be from far land and know Indian well.

on day 18 of month 3, year 1855, look man find Indian fight group. chief of this group be man who kill many at now town. after look man come back, chief Thomas, lead of army send by chief John, order man to walk after them. Indian see too many army man. they go back. army walk after Indian across flat land for many day, till most of them be kill or run off.

after army run after Indian out of flat land, chief Thomas order army back to wall house, rest for 3 week. after 3 week, chief cut army in two. half go east over high hill. other half go north over high land. east group be lead by second chief, and guide by man know of far land.

army of chief Thomas find Indian band live near now town on river, on night of day 28 of month 4, year 1855. at morning, chief Thomas attack they place. in fight of 25 minute, 40 Indian be kill, and many more be wound. only 2 of chief Thomas man be wound in fight.

after loss in flat land and east land, Indian band and other Indian band want peace. Indian peace group come to chief David near town in new Mexico, on day 10 of month 9, year 1855. chief David and Indian group make agreement. Indian give up all land in flat land, but not land of 1000 square long walk, west of big river, north of small water. Indian also want America give 66000 money, and it be give. other Indian group come to chief David 2 day after, on day 12 of month 9, year 1855. they make same agreement. they give up all land but not land of 60000 square long walk. they want America give 36000 money. this end Indian fight of year 1855. it be only big fight wall house play part in.

even before wall house see fight, talk about move wall house, because house be in weak place for fight. chief Joseph, top look man of army of America, say this after look at wall house in year 1853. this be part of writing of him.

many wood be here. in hot month, grass be good for animal. but warm month be little. may grain not grow here.

near town be 30 distance to south, by river. about 25 family live there. they work in field, grow grain.

idea of this building be keep Indian people under control. it be for horse army and foot army.

building be good. many building be here, also. but they be put too near hill edge. not safe from strong enemy.

all food for this building come from town to south, far as low land. and big building be 165 distance.

in winter, snow fall here, four foot deep.

i think this building be more good on river. river be most north town in new Mexico. army can get help from people of low land. not danger from Indian.

Indian people live here, most in west, near big river. so this place be need here. this low land may before long be good road to country in hot month. it may be good road from new Mexico to great salt lake and north California.

building be in bad place. not good for army fight. and not safe for people of low land. building many time be under snow in winter. it be too near small river, so many time become wet place in warm month.

building first be put here because army man say this land be Indian hunt place. at first look, this place be on road people take in low land. but when building be make, people find road not hard. road not hard lead in low land.

in year 1856, make of new building start, 6 distance south of Massachusetts. new building have 22 small building make of earth. in year 1858, make end. new building get name for army chief John. Massachusetts be no more. it be on private land, not open to people. old thing place in town have full copy of Massachusetts. people see it.

Imamzadeh Yahya be most important Imamzadeh in this land. in last few year, this place be make new with many other town holy place. open space always use by people near as place for eat and play. some come see family who be dead and put in earth. it also be use as general event space. chief of this land want people know old history of this place. this please near people and far people. in year 2015, Imamzadeh be place for people walk on big holy walk day.

Kapi be king woman of island land. she be woman of king who rule from year 1874 till he die in year 1891. after that, she have name big king woman.

Kapi care very much for well and good of island people. she make house for girl, for education of daughter of people who live near sick place. Kapi also make house for mother and new baby, where mother can get care.

Kapi have birth on day 31 of month 12, year 1834, on big island. her father be high chief of big island town. her mother be high chief woman of far island. she be daughter of old king, last king of island land before big king take it. her two young sister have birth in year 1839 and year 1843. one be married to chief man, other be married to other chief man.

her full name be long. it say holy body of old woman. her name come from old woman of family, high chief woman Kapi. that woman take red berry and say no to fire god. she do this to tell new belief in Christian. Kapi be arch of sky. sky arch tell king power.

Kapi live in big island town till she be 8 year old. then she go to west side of island. Kapi come to big town on island at 16 year old. she come under care of old king.

Kapi learn to reading and put island word on paper. she learn few English word, but she never speak it well. like many island people, she need man who change word when she talk with English people. Kapi become part of Christian church after church come in year 1862.

on day 7 of month 3, year 1852, Kapi be married to high chief man of chief group in big town. she be almost 18 year old. he be 30 more year old than her. he be brother of father of king woman who be married to king. this make him family of king woman. Kapi be top woman for king woman.

they have no child. one baby in stomach die before birth. to get well, they go on church ship for many month among far island. but it do no good. he die on day 27 of month 12, year 1860, at big town.

Kapi and her chief man be care for child Albert, only child of king woman and king. Kapi be chief care woman for child. child die at 4 year old, on day 27 of month 8, year 1862, may from bad stomach sick. man of history say king woman say bad of Kapi after child die.

child be under Kapi care when king put cold water on him to make him quiet. old man say this make brain hot sick, which kill child. George say little to no knowledge of this bad feeling.

king woman put very kind word on paper for Kapi in month 3, year 1863. dear Kapi, friend in care of child. you be child who king woman love most, so heart of you must be full of pain. you be three friend of us.

English woman Jane and her young woman come to Kapi in month 6, year 1861. young woman say this on paper.

Kapi be married again on day 19 of month 12, year 1863, to David, in quiet event by Christian church man. many people say bad of it, because it come in time of pain for dead king.

David be chief man who want to be king. he be government man in chief group, in king group, and in many king house work. he work for king 4, king 5 and king before him.

but he not get king seat in year 1873. then he win over old king woman and become king on day 12 of month 2, year 1874. when David be king, Kapi be king woman of island land.

one of first thing they do be big journey round many island. from month 3 to month 5, year 1874, they go to five big island. people be very happy to see king and king woman.

they be married and have no child. sick man look at cause of death of king. some think king may have no baby, because Kapi lose baby before, with chief man. so Kapi and her sister take in three boy of sister. Kapi take in David and one more boy. her sister take in Edward.

in year 1883, David make three boy high chief of island land. he give them high name for day he become king. after death of sister in year 1884, king and Kapi take law care over all three boy.

king and Kapi get gold hat in big event, day 12 of month 2, year 1883. they not get this in year 1874, because big fight in land come. under Walter, man of money, law group give 10000 money for big event.

big event and happy thing last two week. special house with eight side and high seat build for day 12 of month 2, year 1883. many people come, over 5000, with seat on grass for more people.

two gold hat with good stone make in Britain. cloth of Kapi and other king woman come from far over sea.

king and Kapi come out of house on land, with all people. group of people sing first. news writing say king look sick, not happy.

Albert, chief of island law, say word of work to king. then hat go to king, and he put it on he head. king put small hat on Kapi and say, i put this hat on you head, to give you part of mine high seat.

after word say king have trouble to put hat on woman hair. her woman person help make attempt, but hat still not go in. king get angry and push hat on her head. she have bad pain.

event end with group sing, and one man say god word. big meal after event stop, not say before. now king house be place for island band music.

that night, king and Kapi have big meal for many man. every night on land of house, people dance. boat run, horse run, and many thing make full time.

because of weather, light of house and land come one week after day of hat. all people say want to come. fire light sky at house and big hole in land. big ball be on night of day 20 of month 2.

Kapi have same dream as married man king, make nation grow. Kapi care about bad sick of island people. Kapi make house for mother and new baby, where island mother and baby can get care.

Kapi go to hospital on island many time. hospital be place to take bad skin sick people from all island. Kapi make friend with mother and other sister of St Francis. sister say, king woman rest with sister, drink black drink, and attempt learn word of every other.

day 21 of month 7, year 1884, Kapi go to sick place on other island. with her go king sister, and her married man, John, and Dr man. Kapi come together man of god from Europe, man who care for sick people for last ten year. Kapi walk across land, with house of sick people. sick man bring one trouble to Kapi. trouble be small young come on island from two people with bad skin disease. Kapi say yes to make house for this young. after come to see, sick people living get much good.

day 9 of month 11, year 1885, Kapi house for girl at hospital on island make for school of daughter with sick skin. money come from Kapi help group. king and Kapi open house with Walter, who also be head of group for good body. in open, Kapi open door, give key to mother. same day, king give mother gold thing for her work with sick people.

month 4, year 1887, king send group to gold year of Victoria in London. group have Kapi, king sister, her married man John, man of king house, and man of army. king send group to be man of him in London.

group land in San Francisco, go across America, see Washington, Boston, and new York. then go on big ship to Britain. in Washington, chief of America and chief woman see them.

in London, Kapi and king sister see Victoria in big house of king. Victoria say good to see two with love and think of king go see of year 1881. they go to big church, and rest with other man of king. Kapi have on dress with big bird eye feather, make by man who help her, James.

after big event, they hear of trouble on island. under danger of death, king have to sign new law paper, which make king not so strong. this law give more power to man of Europe and America in government. king group stop walk in Europe and go back to island.

king be sick, so he go to California on war boat on day 25 of month 11, year 1890. on way, king get bad sick in big sea town. king go back to San Francisco fast. king die two day after, on day 20 of month 1.

news of king death not come to island land till day 29 of month 1, when war boat come back to big sea town with king body.

after king die, king sister take king seat. Kapi, old king woman, leave public place. she not go to big meeting many time.

king sister rule two year. then, on day 17 of month 1, year 1893, she fall from seat.

after short time, group of few rich man rule. then, on day 4 of month 7, year 1894, Republic of island land start. one chief man lead it. in this time, group of many American and European people want join island land to America. first people of island land not want this. they want keep free nation with king rule.

Kapi live rest of live in private house. house be near sea, where big sleep house be now.

before last sick, she give all big land, value over 250,000 money, to two young man of king family.

her body get bad two year before she die. in this time she have 3 sick attack.

in last day, she sleep, not awake. she die on day 24 of month 6, year 1899, at 64 year old.

island land join America on day 12 of month 8, year 1898. but new rule not start till day 30 of month 4, year 1900.

her body be in big church for people to see. English church chief Alfred do dead meeting at hour 14, on day 2 of month 7.

Republic chief man also come, with one chief man still call chief, and group of America army man and sea army man.

she be put in dead house with king, and rest of king family.

in year 1910, on day 24 of month 6, king sister do dead meeting. her body and body of king family move one more time to dark dead house under earth, after big house become small church.

her good work for sick people still live now as Kapi big sick house for woman and child.

Kapi garden near sea get name from king, her man.

also, many road, school and business in island town have Kapi name.

one of her good work for island music be love song she make for king, her man.

king die in San Francisco before he can hear song from Kapi, he woman.

picture of Kapi, paint in month 8, year 1884 by man Charles, be on wall in king house.

on day 15 of month 12, in same town on water, she make part of young man in play by man of music. that play, now go, be play of laugh with same word book as before. she make one more part for same man of music, in laugh play about married people in village. that play first open in town of Italy in year 1820 to year 1821. it be not big win. other man, who make word book, after say wrong Eckerlin in part for lose. he make that play not win from change of mind and bad will of some people who sing, most of all big woman.

one man who learn this think Eckerlin may be angry about law of her work book. by this time she now sing with some good at big house of song in north town. she make first open in play of bird. in year 1820 she make first part of one woman in play by other man of music.

in her work, she use many year at big house of play in town of Spain. there many people make good word about her. she take work in big house of play in Paris before she leave Spain.

she be very good at song of one man of music. while he lead big house of play in Paris, she sing there in many part. one part be part of one woman in play by him, first open in Paris, with one man and one woman who sing. in same house, in year 1832, she sing one man part in play. same year, other woman make first open in Paris, in big part.

her work take her to big house of play in north town, and to big house in south town. at north house she make big man part in play by other man of music, year 1823. she sing too in big town of Austria. in year 1822, with one company of play, she make part of woman in new play by man of music. for her, that man make new song and put it in second part of play. in year 1823 she sing woman part in play by other man, in south town. in middle of Italy, in year 1830, she make man part in play by other man of music. same year, in Rome, she sing young man part in play by other man. she sing too in big town of Spain, and in London. she stop work on stage in year 1840. she die two year after in town of her birth.

she have very big range of voice, and people know she sing very fast high song. people say she have sweet low voice. one man who make word in paper of north town, in year 1817, day 4 of month 2, say she have good way and taste in song, not like other. her young brother be low voice man, also Eckerlin.

Johann Christoph Schwab live from day 10 of month 12, year 1743, to day 15 of month 4, year 1821. he be wise man of thought from south land.

Johann Christoph Schwab have birth in small country town, in north of big town. father do account for public work.

Schwab go to school. he learn thought and knowledge of god. year 1764 he get degree. after that he work 11 year in land north of big lake, where French be speak. he take many teach work. by end of this time he know deep French book and French language.

year 1778 he become head teach man of thought at big school in south. one big young man learn there at same time.

Schwab not like new thought from east land. he not talk of it in teach. in many book and writing he say new thought be old thought with new face. every time he can say it be small and full of wrong.

new thought go wide more and more. it make people go to two side. as he grow old, Schwab move from quiet view to more spirit view for old thought of two wise man.

over year Schwab get many reward for writing. three reward come from big learn group in Berlin. in year 1788 he become out man of group. in year 1812 he get high place in group.

first reward, in year 1784, be most big one. he win it with other man from France. for writing he question why French become world speak language across Europe. how long this go on, and if it be right.

after first reward, king Frederick call him to Berlin. king Frederick love French way and French language. he offer him teach work at military school in Berlin, big government school.

in end, Schwab get more good offer at house. big man of south land give him government work as secretary in big town.

man die year 1793, and brother Louis take over. Louis know Schwab when they be young man in land north of lake, where French be speak.

Johann Christoph Schwab now get more high place, become one of wise man of king.

some people question if man of old thought be right for quick high place. in year 1798 one letter come out with no name, to help Schwab.

still, argument go on. war with France be more big fear for king in that time. Schwab keep many government work in this bad time.

in year 1816 new king William make him high school wise man. still, Schwab keep work as thought man till year 1813.

Schwab last book be on dark thought. it keep use old way of wise man, make it more good. he know well this leave him far from what be most common thought.

Johann Christoph Schwab die at big town of south on day 15 of month 4, year 1821.

Schwab get married to woman of old rich trade family of big town. she be daughter of brother of old stone art man.

Schwab and woman have child. one child be man of law, year 1781 to year 1847. other child be book and god man, year 1792 to year 1850.

Appomattox system let farm man take grain to machine on river. man go from far town, Virginia, carry bread all way to other town, from year 1745 to 1891. system have water road round fall, change on river, and turn basin in town. turn basin let man turn narrow long boat round, put down farm grain from up river, and carry make thing from town. in town, man put thing on big sea boat, and take far thing for farm and up river. boat go back up river with make thing. people who have money go boat on water road, fast and well. river carry thing and ship for over 100 year.

river change in year 1745 and more over many year. much of water road make by people with no free. free black man on hill work as boat man. water road take damage in war, and use till rail come fast.

Appomattox river clear for boat by year 1745. this boat same big as James boat, 60 foot long, six wide, two foot deep. boat be make to carry big thing through small part of river system. not like James boat, Appomattox boat go up and down river, so they not make to give for money as wood at end.

Virginia general meeting make law to keep water road safe on James river and Appomattox. by law, no wall in water can make if not it have lock for boat.

Virginia general meeting make high Appomattox group in 1795. Virginia get 125 part by 1801 to help growth of transport. in 1807, group can give for money card for one of four of price to make water road. 335 foot long wall in Appomattox turn water to water road. water road make by Africa man have by group.

Appomattox water road, make in year 1816, join 5 and half far from head of fall at fall line on river to turn basin in town, Virginia. make for 60000 money, water road be big for boat, six wide, three foot deep. with 10000 more money it can carry all river go. Africa man make river good from far town over 100 far, with many small wall to keep water high. river have four stone step lock. four machine on river have lock in wall. two of this machine have stone lock.

water road round fall have stone arch and stone pipe to carry boat over small water where water join, on way to basin. short far from basin, join by cart road, be deep water boat place that let thing go to and from big sea and more.

one of three of boat have by free people of colour. boat have by white people get white boat man and free man and no free man. one of four of all thing go from far town in boat on Appomattox river. one man on farm, Richard, get land from sad south man in year 1810. Richard let them free when he die in 1796. they make town on land, farm, build thing, and run many boat on Appomattox, carry thing for money. they still live there as free people till law make all people free.

in year 1829, Virginia general meeting give work public machine man to find if it can make and what price. join up Appomattox river to other river from Appomattox past far town by water road or rail. but that join never make.

high Appomattox water road in town be make again by John as lock and wall system, 17 lock and 8 far. still design for boat. money give by man who send to help keep lock and wall. in year 1831, boat man carry round 20000 box of bread and 20000 box of grain, 5000 box of smoke leaf, and some smoke wood. 500000 weight of make thing, box wood, cotton, grain, salt and iron. by 1836, town join to boat place at point by rail, not cart. town join to north by rail and to south by rail in year 1830 to 1839.

fall at big farm on Appomattox river be danger for boat, say Virginia general meeting. general meeting give money for damage to man who have big farm, but let group make wall and lock round fall in year 1819. man and child also let make machine on wall.

in year 1830 to 1839 big farm at fall on Appomattox river have 100 people with no free, store and boat place. near farm man can send farm food from boat place. big place to put thing in boat. when black rock first mine at hill, in 1837, it take by horse, after by rail, to boat place at fall. boat carry 7 heavy weight, go 4 day round to town for 2 money and 38 small money. this then change to rail on hill road.

water go under basin down in Appomattox make machine and work run. machine make cotton and wool, plant rope, plant linen and bread. bread send far to Brazil.

in war time, American war, be not enough army man to stop north army go forward in all place. south army make big wall across small river. wall be hard to go over. wall break. water take off water bridge of year 1826 and south iron road.

in year 1872, man, chief of Appomattox water road company, say company man come to same think. chief want change bad control. no meeting in long time, last in year 1866. this bad control give money out before make water road good. give money out, not see 70 company thing, out of almost 1100. so other man get more money. also, one company man break down water road thing, want take brick and get money. grain machine make with no company say, use water of road. one head let town take small stone from water road land, make road across water road land for head grain fast unit

Qianliyan be Chinese sea and door god. he come with friend. they keep house of sea woman god.

name Qianliyan think he of thousand far distance. also think sharp eye, far see, or all see. distance of 1000 measure think any great distance in Chinese. also come as other name. name of friend think sharp ear, or all hear.

in old time, Qianliyan have other name too.

first, Qianliyan be in book about journey west, from early year 1500. there he be man form of eye of high king. he also one of fight man of high king. but old picture of him be in cave in west part of China. cave day from old time. old story of ten brother be very old, before first book in old time. first two brother have power like him and friend.

after, Qianliyan be fight man of bright flower king in book about journey south. he also be man in book about how god come. he be mixed with other door god. little by little, he be mixed with old sea god, as people give more to sea woman god.

Qianliyan sharp eye help keep sea man safe at night, in mist and other bad weather. in some story, he can see all in world.

most time, Qianliyan be bad ghost. sea woman win him. then he become friend of her.

by one story, he and friend come to island in sea in big wind. they lose to her magic silk cloth. cloth blow sand in eye and ear of them.

after they give up, they say they be true friend. then she be kind, make them well from damage she do to them.

in other story, two be fight man of old time. two want her, and fight at mountain of red flower. two lose to her fight magic.

in other story, two be cruel fight man. when she be on journey near, they come and say, come fight her. one who lose do what one who win want. they want her married to two of them, but she win with magic. then they become her servant.

in other story, two be fight man of one king. in this story, they have magic power from start. they use it to stop first fight against king. wise man of old way use secret knowledge from high sky god to win over them. they magic stop when he cover them in blood of black dog. then one man be able to win at fight field, and at last become fight king.

most time, Qianliyan be door god at house of sea woman god, or he keep near her. he stop on yellow paper, too. some small town and sea man also keep him for help and safe from danger. in every year, for 8 day, man walk from one town to other town, carry picture of sea woman god. many man with cover face walk on tall stick, play Qianliyan and friend of him.

most time, Qianliyan be green ghost. hand on eye, from sun light.

not always, first. old picture in cave, and picture in house in east part of China, give him 3 eye, and no hand up to face.

Qianliyan also some time have 3 head and 6 arm. he stop at right side of friend.

some time he be red ghost. he have 2 sharp thing on head and yellow blue stone eye.

this watch house be important part of keep safe system in Ottoman time. name come from old word, say four arch. watch house be place to look and keep safe.

first one be make of four tree. after, many watch house be make in big or small way, by number of man who fight. watch house have high top and wood wall round base. watch house be place to see and fight. other wall, deep hole and earth wall be make near too, for more safe.

make of watch house take many week. in year 1706, in time of war, many detail be know about watch house in east land. for one small watch house for four man, make near town, three far step north, this be need. 20 work man from near village. 8 tree letter, every 18 foot long. 24 tree for wall seat and top. 18 tree for up and down floor. 25 stick, 75 wide board, 400 small nail, 1000 roof nail, 67 cart. for wood work man, 18 man work day. for young man who learn, 54 man work day. this small house have price of 28 gold money and 24 small money, and work of village man with no money. for 2 or 3 watch house, one man watch over, and man who work in every house. for build again of other watch house burn down to letter, price be think 30 gold money. some watch house also have small wall house, price think 40 gold money. for big watch house for 12 to 15 man, need 32 tree of build quality, 6 roof tree, 4 full tree for letter, 75 board and 1500 small nail.

Ottoman take this idea from people of near east land, who long be enemy. then Ottoman use idea against west enemy. so this watch house come to edge between two land, and enemy copy it.

first, Austrian man and man of this land build this house to keep safe from Ottoman. after, make strong to keep land safe from enemy people. watch house be put in line, so man can send fire sign, sound word and light sign. by land form, they be put 1 to 3 far step separate. for example, between one town and other town, 27 far step, 13 watch house be make. between one more town and other town, from one river to other river, 15 far step, 18 to 19 watch house be make. word about this house still live now. they also be put in long line of keep safe land in south and west Germany, where also call them watch house.

now very few watch house live. in many place, people build again many watch house copy. in year 1995, one watch house be build again on river, before edge between Austrian land and east land. other copy be find on old fight line.

history of Maya have three big time. first time, middle time and last time. before this be old time, when first town and farm come.

wise people now say this time be line of number, not sign of how Maya change or go down.

start and end of time can change by 100 year, for every person who make it. first time start about year 3000 before and end about year 250. then second time, from year 250 to about year 950. then last time, from year 950 to middle of year 1550. every time have small part.

Maya make first big people town in first time. wise people now talk about when this time start. old stone sign, from long ago, sign Maya live there about year 2600 before.

about year 1800 before, people make town on west side of land by big sea. they plant big food. grain, green food and hot red food. in this first part of first time, people live in one place. they make pot and small thing of soft stone and fire.

in middle time, small town grow to big town. by year 500 before, big town have big god house with god face make of soft stone.

one town, first big town see well, in low land of Maya, have big stone house from about year 750 before. this town also have big stone work, stone face of king and road of stone, like after big town in low land of Maya. by middle time, many people live in north part of this low land. about year 400 before, near end of middle time, first Maya king put up tall stone. stone sign what king do and king right to rule.

old paint on wall, come out of land in year 2005, sign Maya start writing many hundred year before than we think. by year 300 before, good writing now use at one town in low land. now it be clear Maya join wide writing of many people in America in first time.

in late part of first time, one big town of wet land grow to cover big land. it have flat road, big stone house in three part from about year 150 before, and tall stone and stone table put up in open place. this town be one of first head town of Maya. wet land near it may be big reason first people come here, as see by strange group of big town near it. one more big town, one of most important of second time, be big by about year 350 before, but not as big as first one. late in first time, Maya flower fall in year 1 to 100, and many great town be leave. cause of this fall no one know now.

in high land, one big town grow to big place in late first time. it join sea trade road on west side with road of river. it also sign more touch with other town on west sea side. this town be where many road come together, control trade road west to Gulf side, north in high land, and on west sea flat land to narrow land between sea and south land. this give it control over net of trade for important thing like green stone, black stone and red stone. in this trade road, two town be big place. this town and one town on west sea side. early Maya stone face go all over this trade net. two of most important town on west sea flat land in late first time be big too. one town in north part of low land also grow to be important in first time.

second time be know most as time when Maya in low land put up stone with year on it, and use long number of day. this time mark top of big building, big town, stone writing, big knowledge and art, most in south part of low land. Maya rule be like time of new light in Italy or like old Greek people, with many town king, fight and friend.

in second time, Maya get top. Maya make many farm and hard work, with many big town and high place. many town have one king, some under other one.

in early part of second time, many Maya town feel power of big town in low land of Mexico, far north. in year 378, big town from Mexico come hard in one big Maya town and other town near. it put out old king and put new king group in. this come lead by one man, name be fire, who come to town on day 31 of month 1, year 378. old king of this town die same day. this may be hard take over. year 379, same man put in new king. father of new king have name from middle of Mexico. he may be king of big Mexico town, or king of town in high land. this lead to time of power for this town, so this town become most strong in middle low land.

at top time, big town of Maya grow to have well over 100000 man. this town great enemy be other strong town in same land. two big town make many friend town and small town under them. small town that join this net get good name from big town. they keep peace with other town in net. two big town fight in long war for power. at some time, one town win big fight. then other town go down. this make time of good and time of bad.

in year 629, son of king of this town be send to build new town far west. he be only four year old at that time. new town take same mark as this town, to tell where it come from. then for 20 year more, he fight hard for brother, king of this town.

in year 648, king of enemy town attack new town, win, and take king of new town. at about same time, king of this town die. then king of enemy town put this king back on seat of new town, as servant. it be strange trick. this man say he be of king family of this town. then he be true friend to enemy town, enemy of this town.

in south east, big town be most important. king family of this big town start in year 426 with first king. this first king have strong join with middle land and far big town. may he come first from big town of Maya.

this town get to top of art and knowledge under king with long name, from year 695 to year 738. this king time end bad in month 4, year 738. servant king of other town take him. then he go back to other town. in early month 5, year 738, he die by cut of head in public thing. it be may that enemy town help, to make big friend of big town weak. two other big town in river land be most strong. in high land, one more big town be great by year 300. in north of Maya land, one town be most important.

head town of Maya land can be different in big. this change with how many small town be under it. king that have more small town under him can get more good thing and work from them. most important good thing in Maya picture on pot be brown seed, cloth and feather. base of Maya live be big net of political and money thing. it get to all Maya land and past in more land. strong big town be in middle low land. in this time, south high land and north low land be far from middle in art, money and political thing. town that be between middle and far land be place of trade and money.

most important thing be high house and house of king, that Maya build in middle of big town. at this time, Maya use old writing on stone thing. it become wide. it leave big knowledge of day of king, day

Maya have too many people for land. food from farm get little. many tree go down, cut by man. many big animal die from hunt. year 200 be long dry time. this dry time come at same time. Maya live under king with holy power. king not keep trade and food. this rule be weak, can not answer change. king can only do old thing. king make more build, more holy thing and more war. this do not help, make bad more bad.

from year 800 to 1000, rule of holy king fall down. in north part of Maya land, group of big man take rule. not one man. in south part and middle land, many king lose power. in west part and some other place, big change come. many town become dead. people leave. in few year, big part of middle Maya land become dead, almost all. fast fall also come to south part of Maya land, and one town in east. big town have 50,000 to 120,000 people. they join to small town near them. two big town and small town become dead in 50 to 100 year.

by year 780, big war come to one part of Maya land. two big town become dead. one by one, many old big town stop make stone with writing, and become dead. last stone with writing at three town come in year 795 to 810. after that, many more town fall, and no one know this town. last writing at one town come in year 909. no more stone make. poor people live in dead king building. trade change, go round this land.

by year 900, great big town become dead. this be big fall of Maya. still, many Maya live near water, which be always there. before, when man leave land, new man come fast. not now. many man go to north land and high land of Maya. many man may move from south land. many Maya group tell old word of move.

in year 700 to 800, one big town in north grow strong. this come at same time as south town become dead, so power and money cause fall. this town be most big and most strong of all Maya town, with mixed people. this town and near town fall very much in year 1000 to 1100. this may be last part of old fall of Maya. after this, no big power in Maya land. then in year 1100 to 1200, one big town grow up. new town grow near east sea and Gulf edge. new road for trade make.

in this time, Maya way change much from old time. one big old town in high land go dead, after 2000 year of people live there. this come with change all over high land and near Pacific edge. many town move to safe place, may be from much war. town now live on high hill, deep hole round, and wall. many north town have wall to keep safe. one big town of high land at this time be house of Maya king who like fight. Maya rule, from north to high land, be group rule. but one man in group can be top king. other man help him, as wise man.

in year 1448, one big town become dead. this be like old fall of south Maya. after this, much war in north land. war end before Spanish man come in year 1511. even with no big king town, Spanish man see rich sea town and big market.

in late time, flat land of Maya be cut in many free land. all of them have common way to live. but every one be different in how it rule. two most big free land be enemy to one other.

at time of Spanish come, many Maya town be in north part of flat land. some town be near sea. many small group live in south part, in wet low land. one group speak Maya, but not same as other.

at time of Spanish come, many strong Maya town rule hill land. in old time before Spanish come, one Maya group make small king land. it cover big part of west hill land and near sea. but in late time before year 1500, one Maya group fight against old friend. they make new king land to south east, with big town as head. before Spanish come, new land take much from old king land.

other hill group live near big lake. one group live in west hill. one group live in east hill. middle hill land be house of many Maya group, and one more group speak Maya too.

in year 1511, one Spanish boat break on rock in sea. near 12 man come to land at sea edge. one Maya chief take them. most be kill, but two run.

from year 1517 to year 1519, three Spanish group look at sea edge. many fight with Maya man.

after big town of middle land fall to Spanish in year 1521, Spanish chief send one Spanish man to hill land. he take 180 man on animal, 300 foot man, 4 big gun, and thousand friend from middle land. they come to sea town in year 1523.

Maya head town fall to him in year 1524. after little time, Maya chief say Spanish come as friend in big town. good thing not last, because Spanish want too much gold. town be leave in few month.

after that, Spanish take Maya town in west hill in year 1525.

one Spanish chief and he son start big fight in year 1527 against north Maya land. at last, in year 1546, war end in north part. only low wet land be free.

in year 1697, one Spanish man attack big Maya town. last free Maya town fall to Spanish.

Spanish win take most of old Maya way. many Maya town be far from Spanish rule, and for most part they keep same live.

Maya house and town keep old day way to live. food be grain and seed. farm use new steel, so farm make more food. Maya make cloth, pot, and basket. market and trade keep long after Spanish come.

at time, Spanish rule want pot or cotton cloth, but most in Spanish way. Maya belief and word keep strong, even with big work of Catholic man.

old number of 260 day still be use in Maya hill town. many people who speak Maya word live where old man live before.

from year 1500 on, Spanish fight man, Catholic man, and rule man know much of old Maya time and belief.

Catholic man tell many long story of Maya, to help Catholic work and make Maya part of Spanish king land. one big Catholic man tell much about Maya book. he burn many Maya book, so bad. he tell about Maya god, day number, sign writing and old story.

after that, many Spanish Catholic man and rule man tell about old stone house they see. this early people who come see know old stone house be near Maya man.

in year 1839 John, American man of writing, go to see old place. he go with Frederick, English man of building and picture. they see many old stone house. that writing and picture make many people care about Maya. that work bring Maya to eye of world.

late people say Maya come from old land under water. other man say old Maya be only stone house in big forest.

in year 1880 to 1899 new science of find start in Maya land. Alfred and one more man do care work. they clean and record many old place. some old town be clear and see.

by year 1900, big knowledge house send man to find in Maya land. old thing go out of land to that house.

in year 1900 to 1919, new knowledge come about Maya day number, god and sign. one man start to record all Maya stone and writing. some of this stone now broken. rich knowledge house send man to find at three old town. knowledge of Maya start then. from year 1930 on, find go fast, big find across all Maya land.

but in many place, big tree cover Maya stone. tree grow so thick, cover stone be ten step from eye. to find stone no one know, knowledge man use sky picture. they look at light eye can see and light eye not see. stone be of white rock. as stone break, earth chemical change. some wet plant be dead. other die or turn grey.

in year 1960, great Maya knowledge man say Maya town be only holy place. few people live in forest near. he say Maya be run by peace man of star and sky. this idea come from little knowledge of Maya writing then. Berlin, and two more knowledge man, tell this idea be wrong. in year 1950 on, writing be know more. writing tell Maya king fight much. so idea of peace Maya no more true. look at Maya town see many people. so idea of town with no people end.

in year 2018, knowledge man find 60,000 cover house in north of Maya land. they use new light machine. light machine see 2100 big step of land in green Maya land. before, people think few Maya live there. now knowledge man think 7000000 to 11000000 Maya live in north land in year 650 to 800. light machine take off tree. it give picture of old house, big house, high long land and wall for war. Maya town be much more big than think. Stephen say, this be one of big step forward in more than 150 year of Maya knowledge.

in year 2020, knowledge man find big old Maya town in Mexico. this be head town of old Maya king land. Charles and Andrew lead knowledge group. town be on land of farm man.

many house of people be for holy thing. big stone square where people come for holy day also find by group.

James be man of Virginia. he come on day 21 of month 3, year 1817. he die on day 8 of month 7, year 1867, in town in far west land. he be chief of south army in war of America.

James live young in west part of Virginia. he work on boat on river of Ohio. he also be chief of small army.

James be man of south church. he married woman in west part of Virginia. they have three daughter and six son. some of them fight with James in army after.

they move to far west land, first to town of Henry, then to town of west land. there James become big man. he keep writing of law for town and land.

in year 1857 James win work for law house. for while he move to big town of land.

with come of hot time, many man feel angry. hot time in west land.

other man win selection, with two more man.

other man help man who want land keep with America.

fight turn to gun fight, and that man die by gun.

James and William be take for kill of man. but only William be in trouble for kill.

at start of war, James join army of west land, on side of south. he become chief of 2 fast animal army of 8 group.

James join army with son William, James, and Charles. when army of west land end, after west join south, James then fight in other army. first he be one man.

5 army be make in town in south land, on day 1 of month 9, year 1862. it be part of 1 army of west.

James lead 5 group of west man. they be near half of new army. Robert be second chief under him.

5 army be in fight all time in war. James lead 5 army in fight near town, and at hill, and at big black river.

William build Clifford house. William married one woman, daughter of one man. she be sister of big man. William die in year 1071.

Avnillah and one more ship be one group of iron war ship. group make for Turkish sea army. two ship make in Britain, from year 1868 to 1870. they have four big gun in iron box in middle. so they be middle box ship.

in year 1877 to 1878, two ship fight Russian army in black sea. they help Turkish army on land. one ship also help watch harbour at big river edge. after war, two ship go in rest. not in use till year 1897. in year 1897, they get up and go to fight at start of war with Greek. like rest of Turkish sea army, two ship be in poor condition. they not able to attack.

after war end, two ship get new start. big idea make old Turkish sea army new. they come back to sea work as watch ship, with new group of four quick fire gun. in month 1, year 1912, Avnillah go down in sea fight near town in war with Italian and Turkish. that ship work on as learn ship from year 1913, sleep house ship from year 1920, and store ship for under sea boat from year 1928. she at last break for old iron in year 1932.

in year 1861, new king of Turkish start build more ship, to make sea army strong. army have big loss in war with Russian, year 1853 to 1856. Turkish sea army order some iron ship from company in Britain and France. but idea be little, because Turkish have little money.

Avnillah and other ship be long, with wide body and deep part under water. body make of iron, with two floor in part, and sharp front bow for hit. they have 15 chief and 130 man as first make.

ship of this kind move by one long engine, which turn one screw. steam come from four fire box, burn coal, send smoke out one high pipe. engine make top go fast. by year 1877, two ship be only slow. many year of poor care make ship slow by year 1892. they carry coal. they also have sail with two high stick.

ship have four gun put in from front, in middle iron box, two gun every side. gun can fire straight in front, back, or to any side. two ship have iron plate. iron band go round ship, thick part up over water, thin part down under water. band have thick iron wall at every end. box have heavy iron cover, gun part with 150 iron plate.

two ship get two new gun, put in from back, make in far company in year 1882. ship get new fire box from far company. stick sail take out, heavy fight stick put in place. Turkish idea put more gun and under sea fire pipe, but idea end with no thing.

in year 1903 to 1906, two ship get big new change. change put high box for watch on top. old front gun take out, new 40 long gun put in. new light group. six quick fire gun, ten more quick fire gun, and two more. ship get new fire box, but keep old engine. sail stick take out, heavy fight stick put in. many man on ship grow to 220.

two ship of this kind go to one island near Greek land after start work. they help quiet island after fight in land, year 1866 to 1869. still, Turkish sea army do little in this time.

in war with Russian, year 1877 to 1878, two ship fight Russian army in black sea again. they fire at Russian land near sea edge, to help Turkish army in cold high land. also help attack from sea at town by sea in month 5, year 1877. for rest of war, one ship stop at harbour at big river edge, and Avnillah help watch town at black sea edge in cold high land. after war, two ship rest in big town of Turkish. they get little make good in year 1882.

at start of war between Greek and Turkish, in month 2, year 1897, Ottoman look at all ship. almost all ship, and two Avnillah ship, be not good for fight against Greek sea ship.

after war with Greek end, government make decision. start big ship change work.

two ship be build again by big ship make man of Italy, from year 1903 to 1906. work be at Ottoman big place for make ship. half of that place be give to Italy ship make man.

after back to work, two ship become small watch ship in year 1910.

at start of war between Italian and Turkish, in month 9, year 1911, Avnillah be at harbour in Ottoman land. there, on day 24 of month 2, year 1912, two Italian big war ship attack harbour in big fight.

while fight, Italian hit Avnillah with many fire. after, they hit her under water. she fall down in harbour.

at same time, other ship be take gun off at harbour in Egypt, so gun can be use to make town strong.

in year 1913, she become under water fire teach ship. in year 1920, she change to sleep house ship. then in year 1928, she become hold ship for under water boat.
