Mary Fildes be head of female society in big town of north England, in year 1819. she also play big part at big meeting in that year. meeting end in big kill of many man and woman. she also be mother of son James. James be father of art man.

Mary have birth in Ireland, between year 1789 and year 1792. her family give for money food in big town of north England. her family come from Wales, not Ireland. so her father and mother may go to Ireland. Mary married William Fildes on day 18 of month 3, year 1808, in English town. William be man who make grass thing. they have 8 child. James have birth in year 1808. he be father of art man. Samuel have birth in year 1809. George have birth in year 1810. Robert have birth in year 1815. one girl have birth in year 1816. Thomas have birth in year 1818. Henry have birth in year 1819. John have birth in year 1821.

Mary name her young child after big political man of that day. they be John, Thomas and Henry.

in year 1819, on day 16 of month 8, many work man and work woman come to St Peter land, on edge of big town. some female woman come in with cart of talk man. Mary be at front of cart, wave flag. she go up to high land and be at front with her flag, with other female woman. Elizabeth and other woman be near in talk man cart. Richard, man of London, who see it, say she be strong woman. he give her big place in he picture of that day.

judge many man fear fight. they want take talk man from high land. they send for army help. army from near town come first. when talk man be take, they hit high land and man near. they take and break flag, and make big fear. big army come after, hit to clear land. many man be bad. in end, 18 be kill and near 700 man be bad. one child, William Fildes, 2 year old, be kill at edge of meeting. he be no family of Mary. Fildes be common name in that land. other female woman be hit and take. man think they be Fildes. they keep them many day, with no crime. Mary be push down to land by stick of one judge man, who take her flag. she near die from sword hit. she go and keep low for 14 day, may be with her family in north part of England. late, she know one woman who make word story. story say more of day. Mary be hanging by nail on cart, and her white dress stick on it. man of horse army cut her across body with sword.

Fildes give her self story on paper to big judge house in London, month 5, year 1821.

Mary be female woman who want change. she not want woman power, as some say. she not say so in open, but like most female woman of her time, she think woman must fight with man. they want power for all big man who have house. that power can be use for good of all family.

in year 1822, Richard and he group leave big group that talk man lead. Mary take side of talk man. she say Richard be afraid at meeting, and say bad thing.

in year 1823, Francis from London send her big paper on birth keep, to give to other man. he think she be woman who help birth, of family of her man. she make word to paper of news, as woman, married woman, and mother, to say bad of this bad paper.

she still be woman of change. in year 1833, she talk at meeting in town of north England, to start small part of female political society. in year 1843, she give talk on war at town near big town. two make see in paper of news.

Mary late year be good. her man die. in year 1846, she live in town of Scotland, may be with family of her man. in year 1849, she take four house from her mother in old town, old town on edge of Wales, where she go. no sign make see she run drink house. her house be list one time as place of strong drink, may be under room be give to man who make drink.

in year 1854, she go to big town of north, where son James be poor, with Irish married woman. she bring child of son, 11 year old, to live with her in old town. she can give money for boy to learn at art school. this make him one of big art man of Victoria time in England. she die of bad chest sick in big town of north, on day 3 of month 4, year 1876.

Jalouse be French war boat with 18 gun. one man make her design. she go in water in year 1794 at town near sea.

British take her in month 5, year 1797. they use her with same name. with British she work most near north sea. there she take three small French boat and many Dutch trade ship. she also join other British ship in two or three big attack. she be break up in year 1807.

from day 24 of month 3, year 1794 till day 25 of month 8, Jalouse be at two sea town, under one chief.

on day 5 of month 10, year 1795, new chief take Jalouse. at that time she have 12 gun and 150 man.

under him, Jalouse go to sea for 15 day in year 1795. she take seven ship and 52 man.

from day 7 of month 3, year 1797 till she be take, French record say Jalouse be under him. from there she go on north sea and come to cold town. she sail from cold town and take three ship. one big boat have 8 gun and 42 man. she also burn three ship under gun of wall at British town.

on day 27 of month 3 or day 7 of month 4, record not same, Jalouse find one small ship on north sea. after 11 hour, no side win.

after, he say he fight 38 gun big ship. French record say English chief say he fight 28 gun ship. many say, when French man take by him go back to Britain and say Jalouse be 12 gun boat, English chief get hit by judge and lose place. one English book say little about fight. it say no judge hit him. it say enemy be one other bad boat.

after fight, Jalouse go back to cold town. there she get more gun and fire thing. she take 20 Dutch man to make her many man again, then go to sea town. on way she take two more British ship.

English chief in war ship take Jalouse at about 5 hour in morning, on day 13 of month 5, year 1797, near sea town. after long run of nine hour and 84 hour of sail.

for 1 and half hour in run, Jalouse fire back with her two long 12 weight gun. English chief bring war ship after to her and fire three side fire before she give in. she have big damage to her wood and rope.

at time of take, Jalouse have 16 gun. she be make for 20 gun, and move some gun to open place. her arm be 12 very long gun of 12 weight and 4 gun of 6 weight. her chief have 153 man work on her. two man die, five man broken. English ship lose no man. English ship bring Jalouse to big river.

British take French man back to Britain. French chief get far and go back to France. after that judge hear about loss of Jalouse, and let him go free.

Jalouse get ready at town from day 24 of month 7 till day 16 of month 10, year 1797. new chief John take Jalouse in month 9, year 1797, go to north sea.

Jalouse first take one Dutch trade ship on day 7 of month 5, year 1798. after that, on day 25 of month 5, Jalouse take one more ship. judge say it go to king.

in month 6 and month 7 Jalouse take four more ship. one name Anna.

on day 22 of month 2, year 1799 Jalouse take one more ship. day after that Jalouse be at edge of land when she take French bad boat. it be from sea town, and have 14 gun and 52 man.

one chief of small war boat come to sea town on day 9 of month 3, with news from sand at mouth of river. he say he see 20 enemy ship be still in water all winter. he also say Jalouse be always at place, so chief John can well see enemy do. he also bring letter from John. it say man from one ship say 15000 man in France be go to low land to go on ship.

Jalouse be with two more small boat on day 10 of month 4. they take money from take of boat Maria. two day after that, Jalouse and that boat take one more ship. two day after that, they take back one ship.

Jalouse and one boat take back one boat on day 10 of month 5. on day 4 of month 6 they take back one more boat. they take back two boat at edge of cold land and send them to sea town. one boat go from far town to big town. other boat go from sea town to London.

in night of day 27 of month 6, chief John and one more chief from British boat offer to take out some Dutch boat. they be at back of island of small land. so one chief order Jalouse and two more ship to come join him, and stop near land as much as possible, to help them. when British boat come, they find thing they want be pull up on land where take out man can not get to them. British take out 12 trade ship, six with thing in them and six with no thing, and go back. no British man broken or die, even though Dutch land gun fire on them. after money paper name some Dutch ship, four fish boat and other people.

then on day 10 of month 7, Jalouse be part of small ship group. group have also 4 other ship, and one war boat, all under one chief on big ship. boat of group go for 15 or 16 hour in water at back of island. there they take 3 trade ship with sugar, wine and strong drink, and break one boat full of gun and store.

on day 24 of month 11, year 1799, big chief send Jalouse find bad man on sea that have be near edge of land. Jalouse find bad man on day 29, and she hit him after run of 5 hour. she be new boat with 14 gun and 60 man. he be able help 4 chief of ship and 35 sea man of 4 full coal boat that bad man take day before, near big land head. he then go across sea to town to take back trade ship, and on day 30 he take back one ship of town. she be make on day 17 of month 6, year 1793, at one town. other ship be make on day 12 of month 8, year 1793, at other town.

man get more power to be chief of ship on day 16 of month 11, year 1804. he take Jalouse, then with Mediterranean ship group, after that month.

ship group from town come to island on day 2 of month 1, year 1805, and ship group go to England on day 4 of month 1. Jalouse have help ship group from town, and she go on as help as far as west part of big island.

in month 6, year 1805, chief man put Jalouse in use at town.

in one paper on day 7 of month 10, year 1805, big chief say that Jalouse and two other ship be no good for work of this land. they go back to England with first ship group to be make good again.

two other ship go on to work for some more time. but Jalouse be stop in month 5, year 1806. she be then break up at town in month 3, year 1807.

Eknak be farm in south east part of Mexico, 48 far walk from big town. it stop between two small town. farm be one of many that grow up in year 1800 time, when rope plant grow big. Eknak be strange, because it build with idea to become holy place near church.

name Eknak be word from old language of this land. word say black house of snake.

take road 180 east to cut off road 18. go south to small town, then take road south east to Eknak. town and farm of same name be about 4 far walk before get to after town.

Eknak first be build as cow farm, then change to rope plant.

Richard get Eknak in year 1872. three year after, he start rope plant grow. he make more and more land for plant. in year 1901, Richard make farm big, by get other town. in year 1903 he get other farm, 20 far walk to south.

land change first come to Eknak in year 1919. but land go to near town only in year 1921 and 1922. at that time, 1500 land go to one small town. year 1923, Eknak lose 861. 94 more land to town near. though owner fight all way to top law place, law keep land give in year 1929. more part of land give to town near. even so, rope plant keep in private hand on Eknak till year 1935. year 1937, land change go on, and owner keep only 144 land.

from year 1950 to year 1960, farm change from rope plant to animal. most be bird, cow and pig. owner also do test on rope plant to find good way to grow.

now owner of Eknak be one man.

church in Eknak be old German building. now people think it be house of old thing.

church have many glass window, in old kind and round kind. they make light of many colour all over in church.

group sing place be hold up by white stone stick. big holy table, also with wood thing, get up by stone step. on one side be small holy house with cut table, hold picture of San Francisco and wood horse at foot.

there be big oil picture of holy woman in big cut wood frame. old bell, cup, water cup, box with holy cloth and three wood box also be here for people to see. people can see church all over land, and from near farm.

Eknak have two part. first part have wall, big house and other old building. second part, in big square, stop small holy house and power house, also small town for people who work on farm, on north side.

old building be in wall part, for cow farm. big house stop on high place. front and back side have arch. old way be here too, as be big step to door.

second part have building to make rope plant. there be cut machine, machine room, under room and box place.

water hole be on Eknak land, near some old stone. from door to cave, there be under cave about 50 long and 40 wide, with top about 20 high, which go down to clear water. there be big line of hanging stone and stone up. under water part of cave be about 380 long of know way, first look at in year 1982.

all rope plant farm stop be town by self in year 1937, when chief make land change law. law make farm in group land for all. only 150 land stop for old owner to use in private. before year 1937, many people live on farm. after year 1937, few people live in town, because left Eknak only have owner near family.

by group of year 2010, town have 698 people. 364 be man, and 334 be woman. after that, this people go to list of big town.

on day 11 of month 8, year 1835, many angry white man attack and break down eat house. black man have this eat house. white man be angry because free black man take work. this fight make many day of white man hit free black man, house and store. it stop only when chief Andrew say stop.

in year 1835, Washington be full of big fear. some man want end keep man as work thing. other man fight this idea. four year back, one black man lead bad fight in Virginia. that fight make big fear in many land. in year 1833, London say stop keep man as work thing in British land. many man send many paper to big house of law. so many that house of law make rule to stop them. but many white man be waiting for chance to hit back.

many thing make many man angry. first, Arthur, man with drink and axe, go in sleep room of Anna, woman who keep him. Arthur do not hit Anna. but man who want keep man as work thing be angry, because Arthur have chance to speak against keep. Arthur be take in and no one hit him. but angry man go after one man, they think he lead send of paper against keep man as work thing in Washington. among them be Francis, man of law who make song of America. he push to put that man in prison. man be find with no crime, and this make Francis look bad in public and end he political work.

then thing be first time man of government stop work for money. at boat house in Washington, man stop work on day 29 of month 7, year 1835. chief of boat house cut eat time for man, because man take thing. man want ten hour day and want chief to take back order. this stop grow to 175 white man and work man at one time. it make clear old fight between black and white man in boat house.

in book with no day mark, for month 8, year 1835, American black man Michael tell about fear from white work man. he tell that boat house chief be angry, and every one of them hit and say they not work any more. at same time they take one black man, chief of black boat man, and make all of them stop work. 15 or 20 black man be there, cut boat at that time. wood work man make all of them stop at 2.

many man of knowledge find strong join between boat house stop work and fight. year 1835 bring big trouble, and long fear and hate push white boat house man to lead fight.

white wood man and boat man stop work hear bad talk about black man of eat house. they hear this man say bad thing about woman and daughter of white man. eat house be know for rich food and sweet wine. on day 11 of month 8, year 1835, big fight group break up eat house and drink all wine. eat house man leave in fear, and white man not able to find him.

Michael tell about bad talk fly about black man of eat house, and what he say about woman of white man. he not know if that man say that thing or not. that night, white man break up eat house root and branch and go after that man. he run for safe. that night, after they break up eat house, they say they go to boat house to find chief of boat house. but they not come that night. after day, chief of boat house get order from big house of law to make boat house safe.

stop work quick change to bad fight against black man. white man stop work and work man take hate out on black man. many white man go and attack house of god, place of learning and work place run by free black man. big paper of America say reason for this attack be black man take work for low money.

one woman, daughter of paper man, put letter about stop work and bad fight. she put that black man of eat house will for certain be kill by white man if they take him. they now go after him. many hundred man of boat house be out of work, and they, with friend, make big fight group. she say it be first big fight group she see like this. it be very bad thing. she see that stop work give bad effect of skin hate on boat house many man. white man want say black man cause bad work and bad money. free and keep African Americans take that wrong.

after many day of bad fight, chief Andrew send army of America to make order.

after talk with help man, work stop at big ship work place. this be day 15 of month 8, year 1835.

work man can go back to work. they get little from it. after that, big fight leave deep, bad feel between white and black, that keep long.

black people of town, though, have most pain. white man break house and church of black people. black people get no money. they get no kind feel, no help.

also, town group make quick new law against black people. law say black people, not attack man, no meeting after sun go down.

for after 100 year, people not talk about work stop and big fight of black people. they keep it far from big ship work place record.

this man come from birth in Virginia, about year 1799. he have mixed mother and father. many paper call him half black, half white.

he come from birth not free, on farm of chief William. last will of chief William say give this man to chief girl. this man become free when 30 year old.

chief people let this man work small sea food house in town. he keep some money.

in this time, this man married young free woman.

this man become free in month 11, year 1829.

he and woman of him leave Virginia. Virginia have hard rule for free black people. he move in Washington, big town.

this man be not like most free black people. he learn much, have money, do well. some say he have bit big head.

he be one of many black man who self work place in middle of town. good work of him make see how strong free black people in Washington be.

in Washington, this man open food house many like. food house at end of street 6, near Pennsylvania. this be start of big fight, in year 1835.

good work of this man make white man hate him, want thing of him.

food house of him put much on good food for body. sign say healthy body come cheap.

in month 8, year 1835, big group of white work man run through town. they want break thing, make pain for free black people.

this group of work man from big ship work place hear talk that this man say bad thing about woman of them.

also, group not like good work of this man. many of this man come in food house of him, look for him, say break all of it.

they drink all of wine and strong drink. after this group cry, now for house of this man.

they break in. they look for writing that say free all man. find no. they break table and bed.

not able find this man, group attack black school and church. this fight become know as big fight. some call it big wind.

this man and woman of him run from fight man. they move to Canada, where he again open good food house.

first work of him be small drink house at end of church street.

he after open good food house. then he open bird drink house in year 1848. then money drink house in year 1856.

Hadda come from birth in small army town, year 1882, to Jewish father and mother. they have eat place and trade cloth machine in east land. wise medical man change Hadda much. he help Hadda father when father be sick. this make Hadda want be medical man.

in year 1901, Hadda start medical learning at big school in east town. Hadda teach man be child of wise medical man. many of them learn from same man.

in year 1906, head of cut part at Jewish hospital take Hadda. hospital open again in year 1903 and 1904, in new building. Jewish group help put back help in hole of Jewish help net. net be take far by rule of old king in year 1781. in he time of work, Hadda make more than 40 science paper. he see cut work that go down in history, like one cut work by one wise man. it be help for sick leg that no move, by cut of nerve root. he also work with many wise medical man.

in time of rest, Hadda see other medical place over sea, like Paris in year 1909 and London in year 1910. in year 1912 he see, among other, one wise cut man. this man make blood pipe cut work, and after win big gold reward. this be in America. he also be at big medical place.

after world war 1, he still work at Jewish hospital and become head of cut part. Hadda leave this place in year 1943, when it end, because of hard rule and hate of Jewish.

in time of world war 1, Hadda become head of two army hospital and get reward. he have to keep peace thought to self, so no man see him as strange. he tell of bad pain of sick people, like sick body from bad air, against which man feel no help. in early fall of year 1917, he see that people have no food. so they get sick more, like big sick of breath.

Hadda see this big turn point.

walk of hard chief in south big town, year 1933. this first look like bad copy of other chief walk in Rome.

surprise grow of hard group, now second strong group, in month 9 of year 1930.

3 chief do bad in hard time. then they give top chief idea. make hard chief big chief.

Hadda say about last point. black day of German land on day 30 of month 1, year 1933. we still have bad from it now. old man say yes to hard chief, make him big chief.

Hadda say about hard chief word that day. sad, i not see what this word do. i still think German people be good. i have birth and grow with them. i can not think, even now, how fast most German people fall under hard mind work of hard rule.

in year 1934, school group do what hard group say, fast. so Hadda daughter have to leave school. she can go to other school, but she have hard time there. so it be hard for her to end school. in year 1933, friend of Hadda son be kill, and kill man go out of prison after. not only this act make Hadda afraid, but also rule take far good thing of people and land, under hard new law.

Jewish hospital can do thing against this new bad. in year 1933 it take medical man who go out from other hospital. in year 1935 Hadda become head of cut part in normal way. out world be bad, but in world of family, group, friend, school and sick people keep Hadda safe. this safe must be very strong. even more than other man near him, Hadda say again and again. bad be over. it can not get more bad than this.

say one wise man in book. if not Siegmund Hadda be there, Jewish hospital, one of two most good thing of Jewish group, probable not be open as long as it be, till well in year 1943.

so not till year 1938 Hadda make attempt to get paper for he and married woman to see England. but from good heart, he change mind again.

many Jewish man be send to prison in year 1938, in month 6, in time when hard many man take many Jewish out. this take place before bad night of broken glass, day 8 to 10 of month 11, year 1938.

Dr Hadda work so hard help people with bad body, sick stomach or other damage. this after 4 week in prison. so he put off leave from land.

he say in writing, idea that such bad crime may come again and again still seem so not true to me.

still can for Hadda go to England that same year 1938. there he be able, as he say in writing, to get law paper to come in for young people, even though he not able for self. at very same time, family lose house by force.

it not till after all this event that bad Jewish night come. this bring new take of people to prison. one medical man friend be take too, Hadda see man take him. most Jewish medical man lose right to work on day 1 of month 10, year 1938. Hadda be one of few man not take. they paper for leave land be take from them start on day 26 of month 10.

Hadda go to Berlin few day after bad night. he not able even get paper to come in at America house or British house. he say no to money offer, because good man he be. he then want to get at small old law paper for young people. he get it, but with big stop.

push that two medical man, Hadda and other friend, have be so big. for friend, after prison time, he and woman of him no more doubt about leave land, even in most bad time. all chief medical man of Jewish sick house but not Hadda be let leave land at last minute.

sick house keep work under Hadda lead up to order to go out on day 31 of month 8, year 1939. at that time, bad picture no man can think of come to be. Hadda keep work hard, even with many bad stop and sick people take far. Hadda brother, build man, be kill. Hadda and woman be among last 18 Jewish people take from town in east to old strong place. this old strong place be stop place on way to kill Jewish people, but also for other people not still kill.

small hope come for him, and he be able work as medical man. only few medical man left get this. he even able go see Jewish church. he tell of trouble that people have in no food. bad food make sick bone, and sick people not able get up. picture of bone make see special part, name after one man in mountain land, year 1920. special sick word, milk man, tell of same sick on two side of body. special trade for box be make between king and big bad force. this box also hold food power, need fast.

when Hadda tell of bad of prison, he also tell of face big bad man one more time, as all medical man have to be before him in year 1944. chief cut man and i be last two medical man in line. in front of us one medical man after other be send to death place, by list that be in front of him. after answer, Hadda be say, go back to work and tell chief cut man he can also go back. number of prison man get small much in early year 1945.

then on month 2, day 3, year 1945, good thing seem to come. Hadda hear news that journey to mountain land be make by government of mountain land. fear be so big that offer of free be still one more bad act of big bad force, and train may go to death place. only 1650 of 6000 man sign up for train. after leave old strong place, carriage go by Germany and then come to mountain land. after Hadda find out that big man of Germany and government of mountain land say yes to make more journey from prison, but big bad chief put stop to idea.

after short time, he be able live with woman again and work as medical man. paper to work in Germany not good in mountain land, so he start again as young medical man. after one year in mountain land, Hadda and woman be able go to America by way of England. he get over many hard stop in new York and be able work as medical man there till 77 year old. he live more long than woman, who die in year 1970, and live to 95.

one medical man friend go back to Germany in year 1956. he not speak of time under big bad rule. up to now we only know he say in writing feeling and thought in song only. but they be very clear.

Hadda never go to Germany again. he say why, he not want be on Germany land. i think every man middle or old may be man who kill people i love.

he married in year 1914 and have 3 young, one son and two girl. in year 1977, he die in new York, where he work with sick people.

Foxhound first be French ship, make in year 1809. British man take it same year. British war man put her in use as 16 gun ship. she have short time in war. she take some trade ship. after year 1816, British man give her to other man for 800 money. from year 1817 to year 1848, she make 10 or 11 fish journey.

first ship be one kind of small ship. it may be other kind. from day 26 of month 3, year 1809, French chief man have her. her place be near Gulf, by France.

on day 11 of month 11, year 1809, big British ship, chief Sir William, find first ship. first ship be able push back attack from English boat. two day after, on day 13 of month 11, English ship take first ship. first ship have 16 gun and 112 man. she sail from France town to island over sea, with bread and other store.

first ship be on her first sea journey, with other ship of same kind. English take first ship, name now Foxhound. about one month after, English ship take other ship near island over sea. English put other ship in use with new name.

for almost one year, from day 28 of month 11, year 1809, to day 16 of month 10, year 1810, Foxhound be at sea town. she get good again there. one chief man take her in month 7, year 1810.

in year 1810, chief John take place of first chief. Foxhound work in sea near England. day 19 of month 12, John be chief when she take back one ship. French fight ship, 14 gun, 100 man, have take that ship on day 19, as it sail from London to Portuguese town. Foxhound send her to sea town. there she run on sand, with 2 foot of water in her.

one year after, Foxhound take back small ship, Samuel, on day 2 of month 12, year 1811. Samuel sail from Portuguese town to London. French fight ship take her on day 30 of month 11.

on day 11 of month 1, Foxhound bring fish ship to sea town. that ship have one chief man. that ship come back to London from far sea. Foxhound find her with no tall stick and in trouble near France.

on day 24 of month 12, year 1812, Foxhound take back one ship. on day 25, she take back Catherine. French fight ship take two ship. Catherine sail from hot land to London. first ship sail from cold island to sea town. two ship come to sea town on day 1 and day 2 of month 1, year 1813. that fight ship also take one more ship. that ship be take back by other ship.

Foxhound take two American ship. first, Foxhound take sail ship on day 8 of month 2. then, Foxhound take small ship on day 25 of month 3. that sail ship have 200 weight and 13 man. it sail from new York to France town, with cotton and stone. that ship come to sea town on day 12 of month 2. small ship come to sea town on day 1 of month 4.

on day 27 of month 11, Foxhound take German ship. it be from France town. Foxhound hold it. it come to sea town on day 6 of month 12.

near end of year, on day 18 of month 12, Foxhound take back one ship and all in it. that ship sail from Canada to big sea town, with wood. American fight ship take it. small ship come to sea town on day 1 of month 4.

on day 27 of month 5, year 1814, Foxhound, still with chief man John, take back Margaret. American fight ship have take Margaret. Margaret sail from Portuguese town to Britain.

in month 11, year 1814, chief man Thomas take place of John. Foxhound then carry half of 14 army man from sea town to town over sea. after big war fight of year 1815, Foxhound join other ship in month 6 and month 7, year 1815. they carry army ship between one sea town, other sea town, and town over sea, and back. they bring back 8000 French man, take in war. Foxhound then do secret work off sea town near France, and in other way.

on day 22 of month 8, Foxhound leave sea town for other sea town, to stop work. chief man Thomas give her man money and stop her in month 9.

on day 23 of month 11, year 1815, big English sea man offer Foxhound, small ship of 348 weight, false say at sea town. on day 15 of month 2, year 1816, English sea man give Foxhound to other man for 800 money.

Foxhound make 10 or 11 fish journey from year 1817 to year 1848. first 8 be for one company. last 2 or 3 be for other company.

1 fish journey, year 1817 to 1819. one chief man, name may be one or other, leave Britain on day 12 of month 6, year 1817. he go to Australia, for fish sea. Foxhound be see there on day 19 of month 10, year 1817. she come back to Britain on day 29 of month 10, year 1819, with 460 box of fish oil.

2 fish journey, year 1820 to 1822. one chief man leave Britain on day 18 of month 1, year 1820. he go to island far in sea. in month 12, year 1820, Foxhound be all well at island town. she come back to Britain on day 16 of month 6, year 1822, with 500 box of fish oil.

3 fish journey, year 1822 to 1824. one chief man leave Britain on day 7 of month 9, year 1822. he go to Japanese sea. at that time, Japan be shut to west man. Foxhound come back to Britain on day 12 of month 4, year 1824, with 480 box, and fish bone.

4 fish journey, year 1824 to 1827. Foxhound leave Britain on day 30 of month 7, year 1824. this time she go to Pacific sea. at first, one chief man be her chief. after, other man take place of him. she be at island near Africa on day 8 of month 8. on day 9 of month 1, year 1825, she be at island far in Pacific. on day 13 of month 6, year 1826, she be at island town far in sea, with 400 box. on day 7 of month 7, she be at other island. on day 24 of month 8, she be at island far in Pacific. on day 6 of month 11, she be at that island again. from there she go to sea off Japan. on day 29 of month 11, she be at island. between day 6 and day 8 of month 12, she be back at island far in Pacific. she come back to Britain on day 13 of month 4, year 1827, with 550 box.

5 fish journey, year 1827 to 1829. one chief man leave Britain for Pacific sea on day 17 of month 7, year 1827. Foxhound be at island in month 5, year 1828. on day 20 of month 11, year 1828, she be at island town far in sea, with 1900 box. again in month 5, year 1829, she be at island. she come back to Britain on day 18 of month 10, year 1829, with 1900 box, not all.

journey 6 hunt big fish, year 1831 to 1833. some man take Foxhound from Britain on day 5 of month 6, year 1830, go to Pacific sea.

journey 7 hunt big fish, year 1834 to 1837. one new chief take Foxhound from Britain on day 28 of month 5, year 1834, go to Japan sea. in month 4, year 1835, she be at far island, with 600 pot. on day 15 of month 8 she be at far island again, but with 1600 pot. she come back to Britain on day 24 of month 8, year 1837, with 1800 pot, full.

journey 8 hunt big fish, year 1838 to 1841. when she come back, money man take her. one man have big debt, so he give Foxhound and her ship thing for it. he not able to give money back.

journey 9 hunt big fish, year 1841 to 1844. Foxhound have new owner, some many man together. one chief take Foxhound from Britain on day 20 of month 5, year 1841, go to far island. she be see at far place on day 7 of month 8, year 1841, and at far sea place 3 week after. she be at far place again on day 31 of month 7, year 1842. she come back to Britain on day 1 of month 2, year 1844, with 440 pot and 4 pot.

in year 1844, Foxhound get big work to make her new.

journey 10 hunt big fish, year 1844 to 1847. one chief leave Britain on day 27 of month 4, year 1844. Foxhound be see at far island on day 15 of month 6, year 1845, with 400 pot. on day 26 of month 12 she be at far place, and not long after near far island. she come back to Britain on day 22 of month 9, year 1847.

journey 11 hunt big fish be make ready or start on day 1 of month 5, year 1849, with one chief, but no other thing know.

servant condition take place of old free village, where land be hold together, before king come.

servant can change land where they live. some give money to big man for this. but after many year, new rule come, make change hard.

one word for servant come from old Latin. in Moldavia, servant have other name, near man. in Wallachia they have other name. this name be first name of people of this land. one wise man say why. in old time, big man may be from other people, not this land.

first, people of this land live in free village. some land have one owner. other land be common for all, with open field.

with time, in year 1300 to year 1500, one owner get more land. this make people different, some rich, some poor.

some village be give by big chief to big man, army man and holy house. this take common land from people. put it in one man hand. other village be take by force by army chief. big chief not say yes.

in year 1400 to year 1500, in Moldavia, free village still be lead by one chief, with big man rule.

in year 1700 to year 1800, servant living get bad, slow. some servant be trade one by one by big man. this break them from land they work, even from child and mother. land man cry to big chief. they say, not servant now, more like animal.

some servant run from land to other land, far off. old big man not find them. always big man need more work people. so new big man take run servant. not question where they come from.

after war of Austrian, Russian and Turkish, in year 1735 to year 1739, bad living make many village become no people. servant run to other place, to mountain, even to far land over mountain.

big man see that with no work people, they lose all. so some let servant go. this let them work land as before, but as free man, for money every year. special agreement be use to bring run people back. and people from over mountain be call to live there.

one man, king of Wallachia and then of Moldavia, make end of servant condition. this man, after talk with big man meeting, make all land man same. this stop land man fight. end be make on day 5 of month 8, year 1746 in Wallachia, and day 6 of month 8, year 1749 in Moldavia.

after this end, Wallachia and Moldavia see many people come in. they come from far land over mountain, where servant still be.

fight at Lankaran take place from day 7 of month 1 to day 13 of month 1, year 1813. it be part of big war between Russian and south land, from year 1804 to year 1813.

before fight, Russian chief win big fight against south land king son at hill field. then chief offer 4000 man in town, and town chief, chance to give up. they say no. Russian chief start big fire on town. by day 13 of month 1, Russian man take town. most fight man die, and town chief die too. Russian chief get wound three time. chief of this land come back to town. so this old land go under Russian power again.

war end early after fight at Lankaran. south land must make peace, bad for them. Britain give money to south land for war. now Britain think war not good any more, and stop give money. on day 24 of month 10, year 1813, south land and Russian sign paper. in this paper, south land give up most land in east mountain land. north part of old land go to Russian.

Lankaran be town in north part of old land. after death of south land king in year 1747, Lankaran become big town of new land. like other land in mountain land, it still be part of south land. this be true even when south land king have no power here. from year 1760, Russian want more power in mountain land. war from year 1804 start when Russian take big town of other new land.

chief of this land keep change side between Russian and south land. south land king and king son get angry at him. after attempt that not work, they think to end power of him in Lankaran. big south land army from many place and way attack Lankaran in month 8, year 1812. army win over chief and Russian man who help him. chief be able to run to far place.

king son not hear to British man. British man say build watch at hill field, to stop Russian attack. king son not do it. so Russian chief win two big surprise attack against south land man. he take most of south land big gun. because king son go back to far town after fight at hill field, Russian chief have time to attack Lankaran.

on day 7 of month 1, Russian chief come round Lankaran. 4000 man hold town, lead by town chief. after day, Russian chief tell him give up town wall. he also say Russian hit king son at hill field, and south land king be weak, have no power to fight Russian. he call king by wrong name. town chief not give up, because king son tell him hold town till last man. so Russian chief order ship to throw big fire at town.

on day 10 of month 1, Russian chief talk to man in town again. he say they must give up to keep self, married woman, child and thing alive. he say again king son lose, and wall of far place break.

on day 12 of month 1, Russian chief give man in town three hour to give up quiet. after big fire run out, he order army to run at town. he put most man in three line. he put gun stop round by two company of man, so south land think big attack come there. first line lead by chief of Russian man, with six company. second line lead by chief, with 297 man from sea army and two company from far army. three line lead by chief with 350 man from far army and 17 army. 1661 man, 59 chief and 37 military band make all force.

at five in morning, line go up wall fast, quiet, and no fire. town man fire at Russian for three hour. many chief, first chief too, die. when Russian chief learn that army of first chief stop in hole round strong house after death of him, he take lead over them. but he get wound three time, one in face, and fall on top of dead man. chief from far army go up wall, so south land big gun turn to other place. town take after second and three line go up wall.

in long attack, 3737 south land man die, and town chief and ten other chief. on Russian side, 325 man and 16 chief die, while 584 man and 25 chief get wound. Russian chief find wound among dead body and get medical help. Russian take silver stick of town chief, two flag, eight big gun, big amount of food and fire thing.

peace chief come back to power after Russian take Lankaran. so that land be under Russian rule again.

war come to end after fight at Lankaran and at other small town.

but that land have to take bad peace. Britain think fight no more good.

on day 24 of month 10, year 1813, that land and Russian make peace. that land give most of land in east to Russian. also north part of that land.

king not think war end with Russian be end of fight with old chief.

now old chief be in land of Russian rule. king can not hit him with body, so king look for other way to do it.

Sir Thomas Offley live from about year 1500 to year 1582. he be law man of London and big man of London in time of woman king Mary 1 of England. he be long time town man of London. he be chief of wool trade three time. he also be one of first many man of Russia company.

Thomas Offley be elder of two big son of William Offley, cloth man of small town in north land. William Offley have first married woman. she may be of big family of that town. her sister be Thomas father sister, married to man of big family in town. William Offley be chief of town in year 1510 to 1511. after family go to big town in west, he be town man there. in year 1517 he be law man. William Offley married again to woman Elizabeth, who man be dead. she have child from first man too. William have 26 child in all. many come from second woman, and some make work in London.

when about 12, Thomas go to London to learn at St Paul school. there he learn Latin well. he also learn to sing with boy of St Paul. Thomas must work 13 year for John, wool man in over sea town. John be wool man too, and he know teach man well. John be married to daughter of big man Sir Stephen. Sir Stephen be chief in town in year 1508 to 1509. John be chief of wool trade in year 1522. in year 1525 he be town man of London, but he want to be let go from work, and he not come in.

Offley call many sister to London. one sister, Margaret, work in John house. when first woman of John die, John married her again. he give only girl to Thomas for married woman. Thomas be still in John work when he die in year 1530. he married girl at about time of her father death. Margaret married again to trade man Stephen, son of man call John. Stephen be young man who work with Sir Stephen, and be son of god. John Offley, full brother of Thomas, married woman who be step sister to him. he keep house for John at country house by big water near London. two rich many man, Nicholas and James, be in same group. one Offley sister, sister of John, Thomas and Margaret, get big money from first man. she then married James again in about year 1530.

Offley do well in trade. he have first son, Henry, come in about year 1536.

even if wool man put him out in may 1546 for bad trick with wool, Thomas go up slow in trade company. in 1547 he be head of company. in that year he get land of small town in north land from Sir Edward and from woman, daughter of big man. this be family country house for many year.

old house with many roof, now take down. Michael make picture of it as it look in year 1686, with garden and new east front. he get coat with sign on day 3 of month 5, year 1547.

Offley be town man for one town part in year 1549, and for other town part in year 1550. he be there till he die in year 1582. in year 1553 big man of north call him, with five other town many man, to sign king paper for change of king after death. in year 1553 to 1554, Offley be law man of London with cloth man William. Sir Thomas white be big man then. George name him on day 23 of month 7, year 1553, after king Edward die. then Jane be king woman for short time, till Mary 1 be king woman and big man of north be take.

Offley start year as law man with death say for young man. Thomas fight against Mary, because she married Spanish man. many other people die in London after that. church go back to old way. young man be give to Offley by high house man for head to be cut off on high hill. but it be say Offley keep many many man who must die for bad idea of Thomas. king woman Mary send him gold and good metal coat and 12 gold long spear from high house of London. late in year he see Philip of Spain come to London.

year after, two law many man be Offley family. one be William, from west town, who have daughter married to Richard Offley, half brother of Thomas. other one be David. Thomas take one as work boy, and Margaret take other one. first son, Robert, learn trade with rich woman, who man be dead, in big street. she married him in time. Offley give money to make Robert free man of wool trade. Robert do well in trade through over sea town and then through town in low land. William Offley and Thomas Offley young also become very rich in trade. he go in bad trick, but still make good work in London.

Thomas Offley be one of 24 help man for big head of trade. year 1555 make this trade company for new land.

name of William, Thomas and Thomas lead list of man make trade many man in Elizabeth paper of year 1561. from year 1559 Thomas, now very rich, but give to much help and simple in he taste, work as head of Christ hospital. this hospital be make in old place at big wall of town for poor man child learn. in year 1565 Thomas be among big give man for new building in town. in year 1568 and 1569 Thomas join with Sir and other man in make rule to hit back at Spanish trade man after Spanish king make attack.

Dambazawa be cow tribe. most of them live in north part of Africa.

them be among top make of holy fight. this fight come from year 1804 to year 1807, under chief who be holy man.

this tribe be top money man of fight, because them be very rich then.

other cow tribe join too, and big group of first people join with chief man. together them make strong fight, and throw down old family of king that rule for 158 year, from year 1781 to year 1806.

Dambazawa start be not clear, same as start of cow people. but people of tribe say them be of one cow group.

in time of old king, from year 1217 to year 1255, cow people go first use family name. that name say money group of person. in that time, group of person can be know by name, very simple. not clear how this come, but all cow people be part of one of four tribe. one group be fight man. second group be wise. three group be holy, keep holy place. last group be top of cow people.

Dambazawa tribe say them walk from west, from land near river, to east. them take with them chief, holy man, poor people, and many group of work people, like cloth man, iron man, gold man, pot man, leather man, wood man, sing man, and not free man. them walk through many land, from west to east. them move slow, stop in one place for many month or many year, then walk on. them keep cow, do money work, and teach holy knowledge where them live or go by.

for over two hundred year them keep walk, till them come to old big land and live there. by early year 1500, them leave that place and live for time in other place. then them walk to small place, then to east part of big place with wall. there them live for time. from there them walk west, go over big place with wall, and live north of wall. this place still have same name as tribe now.

after big place with wall fall to strong fight in year 1806, top chief, holy man and many of them walk in wall. there them take big hut north of big place, back of market. this hut still have name of tribe in wall. after tribe live there, some of them move to other place. where them live, them give place name Dambazawa hut.

Dambazawa have way of leave some of them and cow back when them move from one place. most time that place get name Dambazawa hut, which say hut of Dambazawa. Dambazawa think any place where them live, in Africa or far, be call hut of Dambazawa. now in one land only, many place have this name.

big place with wall be always most many people and most rich of old big place, and it top hut be almost certain most great big place in north land at end of year 1700. weather be good for cow. many cow people live there before holy fight, many year before. old word say first wave of cow people come in rule of 19 chief, from year 1452 to year 1463. cow people live in ring round big place with wall.

Dambazawa live north of wall. chief of them at end of year 1700 be holy man, big man of tribe.

cow people of big place know that holy man long before he fight with king of other land, from year 1802 to year 1808. chief of Dambazawa and two other big cow people, with holy man, learn under him. then they go with him in flight to other place, and after that he send them back to big place to call holy people. first thing chief do after come back be call people of tribe. then he join other cow chief to call holy people from cow people, first people and big place.

Dambazawa take full part in all big fight of holy war in this land. this holy war start in year 1804 and end in year 1807. Dambazawa help in every way, most of all with army food, move of army and knowledge of enemy.

all holy army live in north part of this land for almost one year before last attack on wall head town in year 1806. this part of land have much water. Dambazawa know it well, because Dambazawa have town there.

Dambazawa be very good group. they love chief very much. they go with him, do what he say and help him any place, any time. after holy war be win, group make power strong. they win over last army of old king in wall town in year 1807. for almost three year, from year 1806 to year 1809, this town have no king. many chief of holy war rule together. by late year 1808 or early year 1809, some people make mind go see holy man. they go to far town where holy man live. holy man can no make journey. so holy man son go in place of holy man. son of holy man, who after become big king, make one man from other group king of this town. group come back from long journey. for little time, all be quiet. but new king way do no be good with many chief of holy war. they say king act bad and break win of holy war. chief of Dambazawa lead this fight against king.

Plectorhinchus be kind of sea fish. it be sweet lip fish. it also have many other name. yellow band sweet lip, bent band sweet lip, gold sweet lip, fat lip, line sweet lip, many line sweet lip and yellow band sweet lip. it be one of two kind of sweet lip. it live in family of sound fish. it live in rock wall of west Pacific sea, at deep place.

Plectorhinchus have fat lip, which get some big with growth. it have 6 hole on chin, but have no middle hole. top back fish wing have 12 to 13 sharp bone and 18 to 19 ray. under back fish wing have 3 sharp bone and 7 to 8 ray. all colour be light grey, which get white on stomach. it have big yellow lip. top part of body have many black break line, bent. swim wing be yellow. tail, under back and top swim wing have black mark. stomach swim wing have red mark at base. young have few flat to bit bent dark brown band. they break as fish grow till colour of body look dark brown on top, break up by net of thin white line run over back. with growth big brown band on under side break up in mark, which get small more as fish grow. this fish get most long.

Plectorhinchus live in east Indian sea and west Pacific sea. it live from far west land to east sea, north to island land and south to far land. in Australia it live at rock wall in far north sea and with big rock wall as far south as far island land, and gold land edge in north Australia.

it live in deep water, in two in rock wall and out rock wall. here it may be find one or in group with rock slope in clear water. young be by self, find on low safe rock wall. they eat small sea thing from open sand and sea grass bed in night. in day they rest. this fish make two by two to make egg off far west island near new moon. in day they can find rest near tall rock, which be out when sea low.

in year 1758, old man first tell about this fish in book 10 of big know book. he give it name, line sweet lip. it name line think line. may this be about many dark band on body, flat on young, bent on old.

man take it with hand line and spear. take trade it as new, but small part keep with salt.

Li Daliang live from year 586 to day 4 of month 1, year 645. he be big army chief and rule man in early king house of east land. people know him for good heart and good work.

Li Daliang come from town near old king town. this old town become new king town after year 618.

great father of he be rule man of money in north king house. father of he be chief of army in small place. Li Daliang be good at book and fight from young time.

in year 617, he be in army under chief near east big town. he lose fight and be take by bad man. other 100 more man all die. but Li Daliang be let live by bad chief who make friend with he.

in year 618, Li Daliang join man who make new king house. he be make town chief of small place. place have bad time with no food, and many bad man. he give horse for money to help poor and need man. he teach farm and lead man to kill bad man. when son of that king go by place, he see and hear much. so son give Li Daliang horse and cloth.

one time, he know he can not stop attack by big north tribe army of more than 1000 man. he go by self on horse to enemy place. he talk long about danger and good thing, and make north tribe man give up. he kill horse, eat with tribe man, and walk back to small place on foot. king be very happy by this work. king make Li Daliang second chief of army in big town near river.

in year 620, Li Daliang join fight against bad chief of war. he lead army to town on river, hold by son of brother of bad chief. he take over 10 town and kill one chief of bad army. for good work, king make Li Daliang town chief of small place.

in year 623, king make Li Daliang peace chief. he send with army to south town to make peace. on way, he be in town on big river when bad chief make war against king. Li Daliang lead man fast to high land, hold by one chief. with two army on far side of big river, Li Daliang talk to that chief and make him give up. chief say man make he go to war, and he not know if king kill him if he give up. Li Daliang say, chief, if you want give up, then we be family. he go over river on horse, he only. he take hand of chief and make chief have belief in he. chief say yes to give up, and go to Li Daliang place with more than 10 horse man. Li Daliang say horse man stop out while he take chief in. after talk long, Li Daliang order man to hold chief. horse man out there run.

after time, chief man come and say Li Daliang must give back chief of they. Li Daliang make man tell them chief not want go back, because he be serious about give up. chief man think Li Daliang be bad to they, so they all run. Li Daliang lead man to take many of them. chief be send to big town and at last die.

in month 2 of year 624, Li Daliang lead man to town where bad chief hold town and stop food. he hit bad chief to let town live. after bad chief die, king give Li Daliang hundred of girl. but Li Daliang let them all go free, say.

when king hear this, he feel good, but give Li Daliang 20 more girl. after that, Li Daliang be chief of big town.

son become king in year 626. in year 627, Li Daliang be send to hot south land. when he leave place, he leave hundred of book he make writing, so man after can use them. after, he go back to big town to be money chief of king house. then he be send to west land as top chief.

in year 629, man who bring word from king come and see big bird with Li. to please Li, he say Li must give bird to king as present. Li Daliang then make secret writing to king. he say,

king say good of Li Daliang for good heart and true word. king make writing back, what have i to fear if i have man like you? king also give Li Daliang one far pot, and old book of old time, make writing by man from long ago.

in year 630, north tribe king be take when tribe man run in high land. king make Li Daliang peace chief of west north land to make north tribe chief give up. king want to win chief by give them food, cloth, and high name, with idea to move them to south of big yellow river. Li Daliang say no to this idea, and make writing with word, he say,

king hear word of he and leave north tribe man out past edge of land.

in year 634, Li Daliang be send to south west land as look chief. he fight bad thing and make good rule, so people say yes to him.

after this year, chief send big army against west enemy land. Daliang be make chief of east part, under general.

army lead by general, Daliang, go north west. after year, army win over enemy big army. Daliang take more than 20 big man and more than 50,000 animal in fight near big hill. enemy chief leave, and die while run. son give up. chief make son chief after him. chief take big army out of land. but Daliang keep few thousand man with son, because people not like son, till son be kill, few month after. for good work in this fight, Daliang get big present, with 150 servant from chief. but he give all to family.

at some time Daliang be make chief general of right watch in head town. in winter 641, north people under one chief be attack by other people under other chief. chief send Daliang and other general to help first chief. one big general lead all army. few month after, we army hit enemy army hard. enemy go back to land of enemy.

in may 643, chief make son big man after him. Daliang be make right watch chief for son, and keep old watch too. in month 643, Daliang be also make chief of work. with three work at one time, Daliang work even hard to watch two chief and son house. many time Daliang sleep stop all night when fight man be on watch. chief say, when you on watch, i can sleep well all night. one head man also say good of Daliang very much, even say he be like two good old man of far past.

at this time, Daliang see old general again by chance on road. this general keep Daliang alive in old time. with wet eye, Daliang hold general hand and give all money. general say no. then Daliang tell chief how big debt be to general. chief make general chief of east land, as end. Daliang be say good for think memory good and give back good he get.

in cold month 644, chief get ready to lead big army against enemy land, and go to east town. chief make Daliang second man of head town, under head man who say good of him. Daliang fall ill. when chief hear, chief make good medical thing and send it by fast horse. but Daliang sick not get well. on last day he live, Daliang make writing for chief. writing say stop big army against enemy land, and keep head town good. in year 645, first fight against enemy land be bad for chief.

when word of death come to chief, chief cry hard. stop work for 3 day. Daliang get good name, and many more good name. Daliang live simple, so when he die, no good stone or white stone be in house, to put in box with him, as be old way. in place, he be put in land with only rice and cloth. in fact, Daliang use much money to give good put in land for family with no child. he also help care for many child with no father. 15 people, not he self child, cry for him like father at time of put in land. Daliang be put in big hill place, where chief also be put after.

he care about sick and healthy trouble. town have no drain for dirty water. many dead animal and dirty thing go in road and river. many want rule for distance between well and dirty house. many animal walk through west town road.

not till big water in year 1878 make many sick people, town start to build drain.

after war end, Bancroft go to medical talk at school in Pennsylvania till middle of year 1866. then he go to west town.

Bancroft start medical work in small town of Pennsylvania for seven month. then he get early work as army medical man with Pennsylvania army in month 11, year 1861. he be medical man for north army in war, and chief of sick house in Pennsylvania.

Bancroft have many work from spring of year 1862, when army leave place, till year after spring. then he make sick house at big place for south many man in hold. he become chief medical man at big place in Virginia from month 6, year 1863 to month 12, year 1865. he help chief of south land, till south chief learn he come from north land. after that, south chief get other medical man, one who like south.

Bancroft be call one of most big medical man in west land by news paper of death from San Francisco. for many year, he be medical man for town. from year 1866 to 1869, he be medical man for land part near town. he be medical man in west town from year 1872 to 1878. in that year, dry weather and many people get needle against sick, so bad skin sick get little. child go to school when sick, so bad hot sick, cough and red sick come. he be one of two medical man at sick house, which become St Joseph in year 1876. from year 1872 to 1876, he be chief of east town learn board. Bancroft help start one sick house in town, and be in medical group till few year before he die.

Bancroft private work be for many rail group, like Pacific and Gulf rail, and west town rail. also for stage company.

he become number two chief of rail medical group.

in late year 1870 to 1879, he and west town medical group make public way to keep people healthy.

big sick danger be bad sick of sex, how it go from one to other.

Chloe Cooley be young black woman. she be hold as property in late year 1700, in north land near big river. many people from America come live here.

this thing be see by many people. they tell chief group in north land. price be stop against owner of Cooley. but many think this thing make act of king, year 1793, in north land. act stop trade of property people in land. act give free slow, over long time, for that hold there.

in year 1793, Cooley be hold by white farm man. this man be old chief of fight group, be from new York. he come in north land after war of America. few month before, he trade for her from other man. other man live near, in place now near big water.

king let people bring property people in, by act of king, year 1790. they bring 2000 man in north land after war of America. 500 or 700 man come in north land. this make number grow big. king want people live in north land and east land after war. king give land for property lose in new America. king want build this place with English people.

many talk grow. government may give free for property people. some black people, property of America, be free by British after leave owner and join fight. they also live in north land, but most move in east land. property people in new land seem wrong with other right keep for most people.

this man and other owner fear lose property. by law, they be only property. they go first trade property people off. this man fear he must make Cooley free. so he make trade with American on day 14 of month 3, year 1793. he move her over big river while she cry. black man from fight group see this thing. he bring white man who also see this thing, for tell chief group of north land. other people see thing but do no thing. what come about with Cooley after she go over big river, no one know.

chief group of north land bring price against this man for trouble of peace. but this man want price stop. at last, price stop, because Chloe Cooley be think property.

but big chief of government be angry by this thing. he make decision for act, stop trade of property people. 12 man or more of government, of 25 man, hold property people or be from family who hold. they fight little against act. this thing about Cooley be think big start of first act of north land for stop property people. act have long name, think stop more property people come in, and short hold time for old property people. big chief sign it on day 9 of month 7, year 1793.

act stop bring property people in north land. it let trade property people in land, and over edge in America. last trade of property people be in year 1824. act have three kind of people. first kind, hold as property till die. owner let go if free. second kind, child of property woman, get free at 25 year old, because then they can make food for self. owner may work them, up to nine year, can be make again. last kind, child of free black people, be free from start.

in year 1799, new York make law like this. slow stop property people, no more trade in land. last property people in new York be free in year 1827. other north land, like Massachusetts, stop this thing before.

old sign be put by group for know Cooley, near place by big water.

Cooley story be in short picture, year 2016, make by one man. this picture be send in for short thing. in year 2022, one short thing about her story be put out.

Muzaffar be first king of new family in India, long ago. at first, he have other name. Muzaffar rule big land of west from year 1391 till 1403, and again from 1404 till 1411.

king of north village put Muzaffar to rule west land. after, while north village be in big trouble, strong man from far east make attack. Muzaffar make west land free. he become king of it.

then Muzaffar lose king place to son who want power. but he win place back after little while, when he die.

Muzaffar father and brother be strong chief of farm people. they can call many thousand fight man.

old book say father have long list of old man. this list go back to god of sun king line. many old writing do not make see this say of king and sun line.

some say he be man of fight people from south part of five river land. one book man say father be farm man of south part of five river land. new book man say father be probable fight man from north farm village.

one book man call after king of this family man who change from fight people to Muslim. as man who rule for king, he make west land free in year 1411. other book man say father be farm man who change to Muslim. American book man say Muzaffar be son of farm man who change to Muslim.

Muzaffar come alive on day 25 of month 1, year 743, that be day 30 of month 6, year 1342.

Muzaffar be son of strong farm chief. old story say holy man give west land to Muzaffar, because he give food to holy poor man at house. he give Muzaffar little of sweet fruit and say, you grain like this will rule west land. old writing say grain be 11 to 13, not all same.

old king of north village go to help war, but die on side of big river in year 1351. he die from hot sick cause by too much fish. he have no son, so man of same family take king place.

old king put one strong man to rule west land in year 1377. in year 1387, other man come to take that place. but strong man kill him. old king die in year 1388. son of son take king place, but rule only five month. then other son of son take place. after nine month, son of old king put him out. that son rule three year, from year 1389 till 1392.

in year 1391, king make Muzaffar man to rule west land. on way, Muzaffar come to man from sea village. they say wrong of cruel rule of strong man. Muzaffar give them hope. then he go to old village, place of rule, and go against strong man. army come near small village, part of old village. strong man die, and army of strong man lose. to make see win, Muzaffar build small village on fight field and name it win village. then he go to sea village and make wrong right. it be say strong man want free rule in west land.

in year 1392, strong man lose fight near old village. he die. Muzaffar take old village and build win village on that place. when old king die in year 1392, son take place, but die after 45 day. then brother take place, but man of same family also want same place in north village.

Muzaffar first fight be against chief of small village. in year 1393, chief say no to give old money. Muzaffar make chief small. old writing say before man get money from most chief of west land, but not chief of far south village and king of hill land, who keep free. Muzaffar now want fight against great holy house by sea. but hear that man of far village attack two village by river. he move army that way, and man go back to far village.

in year 1394, he go against chief of hill village and take money. after, he go to great holy house, break it, build big holy house, make people Muslim, and leave Muslim man of law. he make small place of rule in old village at sea. he hear people of other holy way in hill village be cruel to Muslim. he go there and stop at strong house one year, but no take it. so he take reason from king and go. from hill village he go on holy walk to far north village. then he fight two chief, and win. he go back to old village in year 1396.

about this time, son of Muzaffar leave thing in north strong house, and want to attack king village. but man of north take strong house, take thing, and make son go back to west land. in year 1397, Muzaffar go to take small village. he go to strong house of small village and break land near it.

in bad time, king of east come attack India and go to north big town in year 1398.

in early year 1399, he win over king, break many house and take much of big town.

king run off. after many walk, he come to town of west.

he want friend of chief there to go to big town, but chief say no.

he go to land of middle west, where chief of land say no again.

at same time, man who help him push out other chief from town, so king come back to big town. but king no more have enough power over land part. every chief rule by self.

before this chief take stone building, he get news that king of east take big town. chief make peace with king of stone building, and come back to town of west.

in year 1398, chief hear that people of holy place say they be free. chief lead army against them, hit them, and make god word strong in land.

in year 1403, chief son push father to go to big town, but father say no. so son put father in prison at town of hill. son say he be king with name Shah.

he hit chief of hill land. he go to big town, but on way, brother of father poison him at town on north side of big river. some people say he die from weather or from much drink.

after death of Shah, father come out of prison in year 1404. father want young brother keep land, but he say no. father send brother to far town in place of that town chief. father take control over government.

in year 1407, he say he be king, name Muzaffar Shah. at small town in hill, he take sign of king and make money with name of him.

at this time, people say son of big chief of west poison father of him and take king seat with new name. on hear this, Muzaffar Shah go against him and be still near him in strong town.

he win strong town, which come under control of him.

Muzaffar give son of big chief to care of brother of him, and give brother new name. son of big chief stop one year in prison, and one of relation of him take power by force.

on hear this, son of big chief make request to be free, and Muzaffar say yes. Muzaffar send son of son of him, king after with name Shah, with army to put him back.

this army walk win. strong town of hill be take, and force man run. son of son come back to land of self in year 1409 to 1410.

at same time, Muzaffar go to big town to help king of north. he stop attack on that town by king of far east.

he stop people fight against him, or send army to small town of west, but army no win.

old book say he leave king seat for son of son in year 1410, because he be sick. he die after 5 month and 13 day.

wise people of law answer yes, and he get answer in writing. he come back to town of self and make father of father drink poison, and it kill him. he be put in earth in town of self.

new king, name Shah, take seat at 19 year old, in year 1411.

Anisakis be kind of worm. it live in body of sea animal, such as fish. it be common in cold sea, such as Pacific and Atlantic.

this worm start as egg in waste of animal. egg come out as second stage young worm in sea. young worm live few day in sea.

then small animal eat young worm. in this small animal, worm grow to three stage.

fish then eat this small animal. fish carry worm, but worm not grow there.

at last big sea animal eat that fish, and worm come to end of it living. in stomach of this last animal, worm grow full. worm make egg. egg come out of body of this last animal.

Anisakis have eat part and out part, such as mouth and pipe. but it form change from one stage to other stage.

when it be full, it have clear lip, regular skin, and full sex part.

people who eat fish not cook well be in danger. this worm can cause bad sick.

worm can make stomach or pipe sick. it stick to wall of that part, and make strong liquid to break through skin. some time it break all way through wall, and move in body.

bad sign come few hour after eat. such as pain in stomach, feel sick and loose waste. sick can be long if no care.

care for this be take worm out, by look in body or by cut.

knowledge man put Anisakis in group of worm. it have normal mark of this group. body be long and round, with no part. body some time get full of liquid, and let it swim free.

like other worm, Anisakis talk by sense part that feel chemical and move.

worm of this kind have tendency to sick and live in body of other animal. that animal be place for worm.

Anisakis also be part of group of worm. this kind can move sick from one animal to other. it start with fish, then at last to man.

egg of Anisakis be first find in dust of last carry animal. egg not grow still. egg can see through, round, with smooth top. when out of body, small animal grow in egg. grow till 2 stage young animal. egg then break open, and 2 stage young animal come out in sea. it have thin cover. heat of water change fast of break open of egg. in warm, egg take between 4 and 8 day to break open, but in very cold, under 5 degree, it may take till 82 day. when they break open, they can live up to 1 month in warm, and can last long in cold under 10 degree. but egg let out from last carry animal not change by weather or heat, so sick rate be same all year.

when egg break open, 2 stage young animal be eat by middle carry animal. this carry animal be most common small sea animal, or other kind of hard cover sea animal. when eat, young animal take off thin cover, then come free in body of carry animal, and live there. this change from open sea to body of carry animal make young animal grow to 3 stage.

small sea animal with 3 stage young animal be eat by common hunter. fish be one kind of this hunter, and they be carry animal too. they be call carry animal, because 3 stage young animal not grow more in them. at this stage, young animal not move free in stomach of carry animal, but be in stomach wall, and at last be deep in body muscle. some fish kind be trade and eat by man, such as red fish, white fish, small fish and long fish.

Anisakis get to end of live when carry animal be eat by last carry animal. last carry animal be most many time big sea animal, such as big grey animal and big brown animal. here, 3 stage young animal make way in middle of body of last carry animal, and take off skin two, then full grow. they then stick in wet stomach wall, and make strong thing to eat it. at this stage, small animal can make more small animal. female call male by let out chemical sign, and male then stick to female to make more small animal.

Anisakis live in body of other sea animal, because most of live be in carry animal. it second place be sea where this carry animal live. this have Pacific sea, Atlantic sea, cold sea of north, and other cold sea. it be find with edge of land and in deep part of this sea.

where this kind live be know by rate of sick in man, in many place. first sick man be find in low land by sea in year 1960. after this, sick man be find in more place of Europe, such as Germany, Spain, Italy and United land. it also be find in Egypt, east land, and part of America, such as island in sea, cold land in north, and south of America. but it be most common find in Japan.

great thing that change where this kind live be salt in sea, and heat of sea top. when heat be high,

Anisakis in stomach can be find about one week after eat. like first form, end of stomach have hole where worm go in deep. stomach skin become sick and grow three time thick, big mass be here, and hole become small.

worm go through stomach skin all way, and go to near part in middle of body. worm may even go back up to throat, where worm can come out of mouth.

Anisakis cause bad body reaction. reaction can come with stomach sick, or by self. first mark come in one hour after eat, but how bad it be change for every one. some people have small red skin mark, while other people have big trouble. trouble with breath can come, and stop heart, stomach and other body part from work. Anisakis cause most of bad body reaction in big people who now eat sea food.

medical man find bad body reaction from Anisakis by three thing. one, old bad reaction to sea food. two, test find right body attack thing in blood or live body. three, fish part do no work.

most sick come where people eat not cook or little cook fish. for example, many eat not cook fish food in south part of America, small fish smoke in land of Dutch, and salt fish in Spain make high danger of sick in land like this. now many eat not cook fish food like rice fish all over world, but Japan still have most sick. 95 of 100 sick come from Japan.

many time worm take out by look in stomach with light. this make sick go far in few hour. but cut out bad part need do when worm be deep now in middle of body.

bad reaction from Anisakis can go far with medical help, or other help that be common use.

no eat not cook or half cook sea food be most good way to stop sick. by rule from America, sea food need cook hot at 63 degree or more. and fish need keep cold, 20 degree cold for 7 day, or 35 degree cold for 15 hour, for safe eat. but bad thing in Anisakis can not be take out by hot or cold process.
