after year 1840, he go to America. he work as news man in big river town. he have big place in Republic group.

Bernays be come to birth in old town of Germany. he be one of eight child of trade man and woman. family be Jewish, but they change to Christian when he still small child. they give him new church name.

they move to small town, where he go to Catholic school. after, he go to church school in other town. then he go to school in far town. he start learn law at big school. then he move to other big school. in some school time, he lose one eye in fight with sword. he get top learn paper in year 1844 from school of old town.

Bernays become news man for paper call German French book. it be make in Paris by two big man. when it stop, he become chief of paper that come after. it be call forward.

in year 1844, French government stop paper, and he go to prison for two month. after he come out, he stop with friend Henry and other news man. Henry have young girl child. after, Bernays be married to her.

after big fight of year 1848, French Republic come. Bernays become government man. he go to town in Austria as part of group send by government.

but when Henry want go to America in year 1849, Bernays also want go. he take ship to big river town with family. he change name to Charles Louis Bernays. big sick run through town, so he live in small town in middle land. there he get short work as trade man and make drink from grain. he make big drink place there.

after Henry come to big river town and take news paper of German people, Bernays move back there. he work as chief of news for paper. he also make word for English news paper of Republic group.

in year 1860, when people make big chief of America, Bernays be secretary for Republic group. he make friend with big chief of America. in year 1861, chief send him to mountain land and then to far north land, to work for America. Bernays not like this work. many people protest because he be Jewish. he go back to America to work as news man again. in America fight, he be give money man for army, with level of army chief, level 6.

about year 1870, he go off from public live and start make book about him and he time. because of sick, he leave this book not end. he die in big river town in year 1876.

Banda District be important for knowledge of trade. trade change live of people in west Africa.

Banda District be in middle west part of land, only south of big black river, in wood and open land.

this land have many connection to trade with north big sand land, and Atlantic trade, and British rule and money want.

old thing from earth let we see this connection. strange thing come in, and material go out. people make pot and metal. live and food way change.

first learning about old earth thing here be do by one woman.

trade with north sand land start in year 1300, and last to year 1700.

many first small town in this place be change by trade net from sand land.

Banda people have trade with west Africa, where wood and open land give gold, big nut, and white bone. people give gold, big nut, and white bone. for this they get copper, salt, and cloth from north.

some not know if people of Banda get this thing straight, or through big town near.

European want for west Africa thing grow strong from year 1400 to year 1650.

one big reason be story of king of gold land. this king walk to holy place, all in gold.

Portuguese be very strong with gold edge of land. Portuguese make strong house at one place, and fast look at land near.

pot in this place look very like pot from far town. all pot be well make and same. this say many man do one work well.

before this, there be first time pot with red paint in form line. this have no true sign of north connection.

test of broken pot bit from one place say earth be same too. this support idea that pot be make here.

much earth come from east of Banda hill. man who make pot use same earth for every form.

bottle be in two big group. one group have top edge wide out from narrow part. second group be more round in form.

much mark be on top edge of pot. pot get mark with cord or cloth mark. then line and form be on top.

many thing put together in earth too. some pot even have metal bit in earth.

this part of Africa be know for much metal in earth, most iron and gold.

much sign of metal work in Banda. pot, knife, gun, and ring say it. iron bit left from work too.

also be burn basin and hard iron thing at many level, say work be do many time in year.

much more be make than people here need. more keep for trade.

among metal thing find, be many ring of iron, knife and blade, and one long bent spear.

cloth make be common in far town near here.

there be no true sign still that cloth work be do in Banda. in one place, only one broken thread turn find. but no sign not always think it not do.

some metal work place, like one near far town, have sign of holy act.

at this hill, three clear level be find.

low level of hill many time have holy act sign and dead people put in earth. on top, metal work be do.

dead people be from baby to old man. some put in different way.

middle level have holy house group, may use for see future.

holy house can be see in work place. it may help work well, keep safe, and help with trouble.

one holy house have iron ring, first one find in Banda land.

also one stone, two iron blade, one bone bit, and one small brass man, two in one.

this small man be strange. it be use for see future and have magic power.

in one more place, we find earth pot with small sea thing from far edge of land.

this find say trade connection of that time. it also support idea that see future be use, because small sea thing be magic.

in time of trade across dry land, people have plant food and animal food. many sign of new world grain come here. small grain and red grain also come here. they live well in dry time. some say people of north carry new world grain to west Africa. they use it as war food. so far, new world grain be first food of Atlantic trade in Banda District. this time, more value be on grain that help keep food from run out. people help all to have food, even in dry time. this way make food safe for Banda District people for many year.

big number of animal bone, most from big animal, be sign that people still need hunt for food and skin. many animal bone come from hard to hunt kind. hunt need much knowledge of this animal and of land where they live. also people find bone of big cat, big water animal and tooth pig. still, little sign that people need keep animal. also at this place, there be sign of fish and other water food. most of it come from big river, over 20 measure far. because of this far, Banda District people get water food from trade. small amount of sea animal be sign of trade with sea edge too. some house animal like sheep, goat, cow and horse be here. most common be house dog. people kill dog and leave dog bone in many place, for spirit reason. sign of house animal may change by break and keep of animal bone.

village be build so many house be near together in big group. many pot and metal waste be here. build again and make good of house, with big waste, be sign people live in one place long time.

at one place, people live in village from year 1300 to year 1700. sign of this can be find. at this time, village be about two to three land measure in size. village have sign of many kind of work, iron make, and farm of food like small grain and red grain. still, hunt, plant food and animal be important part of food.

this place have sign of many old time, only north of other place in Banda District. this place be about 2. 8 land measure big, with hill of many old time and big size. here people find high number of animal bone, pot and iron waste. pot in this place be 5400 for one measure. this be sign that more people live here than in new place of this place.

at this place, be sign of trade in Africa and across dry land. trade of gold, sea animal, glass and copper be here. this place be important for join trade between wood land in south and dry land in north. here also be where house be in big group, with many pot and iron waste from work. pot look here be very like pot from other place of same time. this be sign that people in this place join.

this place be one more big stop in trade road join dry land and wood edge. it be trade place till Atlantic trade take over in west Africa. group of people look at over 1500 hill here. group use test for old time to see when most people live here. most big time be between year 1400 and year 1800. this place have copper, glass and white stone. it also have sign of one kind of work, big brass house with fire.

this place one time be cut in four part that match many group of people at that time. still, pot look and design be same over all of this place.

Atlantic trade road be more use at end of year 1700, and dry land road go down. in this time, more care be on gold and metal and stone, and at last on people trade from Atlantic. this time also have war and fight with strong group of people from other land. they have big power on day to day safe and work of people living in Banda District.

early time have much war and trade of man. strong people from south forest land have much power on Banda in this time. this people come together in year 1600. they take control of land to north from year 1700. this be part of Banda land, where many place be left when war come. people come back when trouble stop. army take two town. many time people from south forest land make Banda many man fight in war with other people. by year 1800, people from south forest land take control of much north trade across hot sand. this make little far trade thing in Banda, but more trade in land near. also, few kind of make thing may make Banda lose money to people from south forest land.

not like before, on place iron work not big in early time. little bit of iron rock be find at place. this make sense. work be far off, or people use more metal thing from trade with other land.

also, no pot make at place in this time. much design from before time be lose. people seem to like pot with small line for design. many pot have edge bent out. pot come in many kind and size. one big change from before be earth for pot. not only more kind of earth come from many place. earth for big pot come from west of hill. earth for small pot come from east. this make strong trade with people east and west in early time. pipe also be much more common. this make see more people smoke in land.

in this time, more round stone for thread be see in old place. this make see people now make cloth in hut, not big work with many man.

early time town have square house. house have many room join together. wall make from earth, put up in many level. some place have three level, to make old part strong and hold up fall wall. one find cook room with two fire place. this make see people know wet and dry time of year.

people in this time live by mixed hunt, take food from land and keep animal. change from hunt of big bad animal like lion. more eat of small animal like snake and rat. animal keep be fowl, dog, sheep, goat and cow. plant food be grain, many kind, that grow together in this land for long time. this plant be good food when other food be short.

late time be when British man of war come to Banda land, from year 1890 to year 1920. also, people move from big house with many room to small house, stop by self. small house simple to take down and move. this make sense of British in land. in this time, more near hunt, take food from land, and more European thing come with trade. even though people come back to town left in war, house be not strong, pot simple and same. trade with other land be little. trade in near land be small. near people go east of Banda hill, not east and west like early time. this make sense of war in this time.

to west of Banda be big town, head of land. chief of that land take army to win much land across Africa, so Banda people go east to stop far from them. in this time, more fight between European and African man. for example, British and people from south forest land fight on sea for land and thing. at last British take head town of south forest land. in year 1894, Banda make agreement with British man who walk far. this end control of south forest land people over Banda land.

in late time, Banda people change from make here to machine make thing. this change be attempt by British want to grow trade in more European market. first thing to go be pipe make. metal work and pot make go after. though make slow down for trade purpose, make here pot still use in house. stone test sign earth come from east of hill, for more than half of pot. same earth use for cup and pot, not like early time. pot have paint and mark like see in this land now. in this time, there be no sign of big metal work on this place. all find be probable get by trade, then change for self use. only make that still be here from early time be cloth make. house make of cloth still fixed, though more want for machine make thing in trade.

in this time, Banda still eat animal, most big animal. bone from this place sign many kind of animal, like old time before. plant like grain, nut, root and smoke plant sign more and more. even sign make see smoke plant grow in Banda District be trade in near town.

house in late time be very small, quite simple, make of two room. most be stick and earth house, can be build quick. they also have only one floor, no wall near them.

in high time of chain man trade, Banda District be place to keep, hold and trade war man. chief people of north send Banda war man from war to Atlantic trade as chain man. in year 1800 time, want for chain man grow big. not only for Atlantic trade, but in land trade too. most of this want come from use as give money and work man to get plant and gold. with British power, change in money way also can be see. group here move from old way of all together, to one man way, make special thing for trade.

this place sign two time of live here, one big time in late year 1700 and early year 1800, and one short time from late year 1800 till year 1920. early town be about 18 big land, last long time, then quick leave. late live here leave only little old thing from far land, like one money thing, glass bottle and pipe.

British come to Banda District in late year 1800. British fight many fight for land and other thing here, with army of one chief and other group. one such group be lead by one chief man. chief man lead army on horse, win land all way from west to east. British help stop chief man from take Banda, from fear that it can break trade in this land.

though British put rule in Banda, British at first be not near to people day live. they want in Banda be most about money thing, not about rule of land. after, Banda make thing change to match want of European market. thing like sweet nut and chain man quick become big thing to send out. British also put one money way. tax and other give money all must be give in this way, not old sea thing money way that Banda people use before.

Harriet Forten Purvis live from year 1810 to year 1875. she be black woman, first in fight against chain. with her mother and sister, she make first group of black and white woman against chain. she have meeting against chain in her house. with her man Robert Purvis, she run secret road station for people run from chain. Robert and Harriet also make new school. she fight against keep separate people by colour, and for black people to say who run land after war.

Harriet come to world in year 1810, in big town. she be one of 8 child of James Forten and her mother. James Forten be rich man, make new invention, and be free man from birth. in big war, he be powder boy and be take to prison ship. white boat man Robert give James start in business. Harriet get name from one daughter of that man. Forten family, most know black family in big town, be know for good way and kind house. one writing man say family have few who be more good in heart and mind. in year 2002, one wise man say her father be one of 100 great black people.

James and her mother help make and give money to 6 group against chain. many people who want end chain come to Forten house and sleep here. first black and white group against chain in this land be make by her mother, her sister, and one more woman. Forten woman be in group, do work, and have top place.

her father start one private school with one man. Harriet and her sister go there and learn other tongue and music from private teach man. 2 young sister come to world in year 1814 and year 1815. Harriet brother be James, William, Robert, and Thomas. girl be grow to be good woman. one man who make verse, say he like her good way.

Harriet reading many book. story, religion, writing for argument, writing against chain, and writing of old man. she do argument and like reading out loud with clear voice. she look for people with same interest in music, art, and writing. she be in 3 group of writing and music.

she married in family house on day 13 of month 9, year 1831, to mixed blood man Robert Purvis from Carolina. like her father, Purvis be rich man with family from Africa and England. they married by church man in good meeting. some people talk about how skin be different colour. Purvis, man who speak against chain, be very open about where he come from. Harriet and Robert work together on same interest, fight, and change.

Harriet and Robert be equal, married, and work as one group. this be one new thing. few such people be then. this married make clear one man want same right for all, free to say. also, it make clear one woman can go past old rule to join in man work, and in house, in private and public.

they have servant, one teach woman from England, so Harriet can work hard for thing she care about. her house and land, call holy man rest, give rest to people who come. it be place where bad people stop trouble, and tired people be at rest. she have many fight people come to see her. they have deep and long friend with big black and white man. they think all people be one kind.

other people in town fight against black people and people who help people run from chain. 44 church and house of black people burn in year 1834.

her sister married Joseph Purvis, Robert brother. she make verse for paper under other name. one black band chief make music for her verse, call death of chain man, and play it at many fight event. they live near Robert and Harriet in small town.

about year 1840, her brother Robert lose him married woman, and him daughter live with Purvis. she learn from private teach man. because of keep separate, Robert no think she get good learning in big town. she get comfort and good mind from Harriet. then, in year 1853, she live in small town with one more rich black family.

Harriet have 8 child, 1 to 18 year old in year 1850. Charles be first black man to run big hospital. he go to school in one town and to other school. in big war, he be man who make sick body well and help sick for north army.

early in married time, Harriet have first child. Robert talk against hold people as property across land.

Harriet be part of big town group of many woman against hold people as property. while child in body, she go to big meeting of woman against this in York. this be in year 1837. two sister go with her.

year 1838, big meeting be in big town, at new big house. this house make by land group against hold people as property. Robert Purvis help woman out of cart. angry people who look on think they be mixed two people. many people want people join as one kind. big house burn when fire come. many people who hold people as property make fire. meeting then go to school of teaching woman. black and white woman join as same in group. this not common in that time. this also make angry people. many people fear mixed people. many people fear woman go in public thing.

not stop by fight of year before, Harriet come to meeting two year after. she be representative at year 1838 and year 1839 meeting. not able to get big house in big town in year 1839. meeting go to horse house. Harriet help lead many market of woman group against hold people as property. from year 1840 to year 1861 they get 32000 money. year 1841, group speak against keep black school out at school market every year, at big square. year after, this be black and white event.

after law 13 come, Purvis keep work for right of African Americans. group of woman against hold people keep come together. in month 9 of year 1866, they talk about how thing be in south land.

Robert and Harriet join group for equal right. they also join American group for equal right. they work on committee. she talk for right to say who lead for woman and black. she talk against keep people different.

Harriet, Robert and other man work to end keep people different on big cart on iron road in big town. this be do with group for equal right. year 1867, law of land come. all people can go in same cart.

Harriet join group of free food. group man get food from near. they not get food grow or cut by hold people as property. Harriet many time come to meeting of free food. she be part of black free food group. Harriet only get food and thing not make or grow by hold people as property. she do this many year, even after some man talk this be not work well. Purvis, and two woman keep true to idea of free food as right thing. book man say they think false idea cause pain to big work of group.

Harriet and Robert, call father of secret road by many, start secret help in house. this be at street 9 and other street in big town. big town become not safe. family move to farm in quiet land in year 1843 or 1844. they help 9000 run from hold people as property on way to Canada. hold people keep secret from man of law in house, through hole in floor that Robert make. Harriet have meeting of people against hold people in her house. she lead woman group who give food and cloth to people on way.

she see need for law against hold people as property. as mother, she see clear that black school not as good as white school. her child will face fear for skin, even though family live with much money.

near house, big house of quiet people be across street. Purvis child go to school there. also near be big house of book and talk, and Purvis big house. Robert Purvis make big house in year 1846. many people come together there about against hold people as property and other thing. year 1853, Robert not give school money because child of Robert not get school. child learn from teaching man and quiet school. Harriet and Robert start new house of learning.

Harriet be part of big woman group for right to say who lead. she be friend of two woman who also work for right to say who lead for black and woman, against hold people as property, and safe way out for run people. Harriet and sister Forten lead big meeting in big town, year 1854. Harriet daughter become first African American woman who help lead group. other sister also early in right to say who lead. many black woman work for woman right to say who lead. other woman too, like one woman who say true.

year 1873, Robert and Harriet move to new place in big hill town. they go with young daughter, still at house. they keep old house, harmony house, and give house to other family for money.

family get many sick. three son die. one sick in head. two sick in body. Harriet die on day 11 of month 6, year 1875. she die in Washington. Robert work as man who lead money house for free man. she put in earth at quiet people place of dead in street 9.

two year after her death, girl die. man move to house in big town. he married white woman from small town, about year 1878. she be church word man.

one man say, this small woman be not same as all of you. big thing be in store for her in time to come. i feel sad, think i not live to see what i say of her come true, but all will come true!

book man say this Blavatsky man be ready to say yes to end of married. he fight to get end by law on reason that he married never be more than form, and she go off. but Russian law at that time be not good for end, so attempt come to no.

this book tell of big sea way in year 1695, 1696 and 1697. way go to Africa edge, Brazil, warm land across sea, and many island. ship of French army go under chief of sea man. this man make book in French and English, in year 1698. book tell of three year sail of this young French man. he be learn man of map and sea. he be 19 year old when he leave.

this young man always have big want to go sail. he learn picture, number and story of old sail. then ship of French army take him on sea. he use what he learn there. he make note for self learn. when he come back to France, no other man tell of sail. so he make book, to say what he see. he want help France, so he make word simple and right story, with no need of more say.

this sail have money reason first. when ship come to narrow sea, this man stop story and tell start of sail. about year 1686, sea man from hot land in west want make money in north sea. then they want go to south sea, Pacific, where they know they find more gold. they have two way, go across land, or go through narrow sea. fear of Indian and not know find good ship after go over sea make them take second way. after go through narrow sea, they take many ship and say give money for food. then they live on island for while to eat food, before go back to edge of land to take other ship. this man say after seven year of this living, some man want go back to Atlantic and land of birth. they put thing on ship, and lose it in narrow sea. so they use 10 month to make new ship, and at last come to hot land. some live there with what they still have, but four or five want second sail, so they come back to France to tell about this sail. one of them talk to chief man, who go to Paris and make this idea strong at king house. king take idea and give ship. so this sail be for bring back much money from west edge of America.

other reason for this sail be power. in year 1695 and 1697, France and Spain be at war. this man say Spanish make war on French with much money they find in new Spain and in far land. if French have this money, they can fight Spanish more well, and then bring back peace.

in month 6 of year 1695, six ship leave one town in France. one be English bird. one be sun of Africa. one be angry. one be small ship. one be eat ship. one be fruit ship.

at start of month 7, they stop near island by big sea edge, where this man tell how black people live and make map of island. they come to big river in Africa at end of month. before sail on, they break English war house. at end of month 8, this man tell of more sick people on ship, and need to stop on island near Cape, where air be good. in early month 10, they go to Brazil and come to big town on day 28 of month 11, year 1695. this man make map of Brazil edge and picture of how they come to big town. it have other old word at that time. this man also tell and picture new fruit he find.

in month 1, year 1696, ship group sail to narrow sea. on way, they see big foot people, and this man make word how they live and what they do. this man make some map of sea edge and land point they go through, and they come to narrow sea at end of month 2, year 1696. ship group make many time to go through in month 3 and month 4, but wind be against them. with little food and no hope, they want go back to Brazil to find much money in other land. in early month 6, they come to island of Anne, but Portuguese fear stop them from be at big town. in month 7, they come to sea edge near big town in Brazil.

in month 9, they stop in hot land. then they want go to other hot land to get more, but Dutch ship stop them. so they take sail in warm sea. in month 11, year 1696, they come to island, where they put down thing and clean ship. in month 12, they go to other island, then to other island, and at last come back to first island in month 1, year 1697. they live there one month to get thing, then go to other island in early month 2. at last they go through small island in month 3, and go back to France on day 21 of month 4, year 1697.

Marie Couvent be African woman. she give big help to church in new town. other name be Maria. most people know her for land that be use to build school. she live from year 1757 to day 28 of month 6, year 1837.

Marie Couvent come from west part of Africa. in this time, many people use that name for west side. in her will, Couvent say she be ship to French island land as no free man. she be about seven year old. because of this, she have no memory of father or mother. she get no school. all her live, she can no know letter or writing.

Couvent still get free and after live in new town. but not know how this change come, or what day. it may be she go far in time of war on black island. in new town, she married free black man, work with wood. together, they live on road in low part of town. they get land and other thing.

Couvent family have many not free people all they live. but they want town government make three of them free. in year 1821, Marie and her married man want government make one woman free. in year 1829, her married man want two other woman free. but he die on day 22 of month 5, before they get free. in year 1831, Marie want same thing again. she say they help her well and care for her when she be sick.

when she be 70 year old, Couvent tell church man at St Louis church. she want build school for black child with no father or mother. Couvent be strong Catholic. she think this church man be her wise guide. in year 1832, she make last will. it say in part

i give mine land at angle of two road. it be use for all time for free school for black child with no father or mother. this church man and other church man get control of this will and it purpose. Henry be friend of her married man. he have work to do this will.

Marie Couvent die on day 28 of month 6, year 1837, at about 80 year old.

this school not get build for almost ten year after she die. Henry want make it, but town man say no.

then church man want build school. he get help from man. this man help start group for teach poor child. this group get money and go to law for land of Marie Couvent. they win in year 1846. school open in year 1848, 11 year after Marie Couvent die.

Peter Pennavaire come in year 1678 or 1680. he be son of French law man in big town. this man run from France in year 1685. Peter work in army of north land. he become lead of horse man. he get black bird reward and big gold reward. at 80 year old, he lead horse man in attack in big fight on Austrian land. he die from wound of that fight.

Pennavaire family come from south part of France. father of Peter be law man. after year 1685, new law make many people leave France. father run with four son to safe place, that big town. father die in year 1711 in that big town.

Peter come in year 1680, may be in big town or south land, on day 6 of month 8. he join with girl from old trade family. they have many child. one son die in war of Austrian land. this girl live from day 21 of month 7, year 1730, to day 2 of month 2, year 1795. in year 1747, this girl join with big army chief. this big army chief live from day 23 of month 7, year 1723, to year 1787. he be son of lead of army.

elder brother of Peter live from day 21 of month 1, year 1678, to day 5 of month 2, year 1750. he also work in north army, first in horse group. son of that brother fight in war of Austrian land, may be in horse group of old brother. he die as chief of horse in year 1741. elder brother leave army as full lead on day 4 of month 2, year 1741, after lead of big horse group.

Peter join army of north land in year 1694 as big gun man. he fight in war of Spanish land. he fight in big fight of that war. in month 12, year 1712, he become chief of horse watch. in north land, he fight in war of north from year 1715 to 1716. on day 21 of month 12, he become chief of horse. in year 1733, he become chief of big group. in year 1741, he become chief of big group. in year 1744, he become chief of many horse man. in middle of 1730, he build big house in that big town. after, son of king live in that house.

in month 6, year 1747, he get big gold reward. after second part of war of Austrian land, on day 14 of month 7, year 1748, he become big general. on day 14 of month 11, year 1751, he become chief of iron horse group number 11, also call king horse group. he take place of old chief before him.

in month 9, year 1756, he join war of seven year as big general. he lead line of north army. he lead five horse group from two big horse group. by early month 10, year 1756, at that town near Austrian land, this horse group grow. one more horse group of 178 man join him. now he have near 2000 man. at hour 11, field still have mist. horse man of he go to look at Austrian line. help come from other horse man. quick, this look turn in fight. fire from Austrian side hit right side of this iron horse man. Austrian man in that town fire at them. some Austrian horse group attack too. other man help front man. after, king pull horse man out of fight. still, this help king know where enemy be strong. fight last seven more hour. he and this man only watch. at first, this man hit two Austrian horse group. they take three flag and take Austrian war chief.

in month 2, year 1757, he get black bird reward. on day 18 of month 6, year 1757, he become big general. in big fight at that town, king idea go wrong. he attack front, not wing. he lead horse man in middle of north line, with 10 iron horse group. king order many horse attack to help fight. he get 10 more horse group. he get order to attack hill place, with help from other horse man and foot man. other horse man have trouble. foot man now in fight. this man go back. one man of history say horse man do bad at that fight. people call him iron stone because he lose so many fight.

at big fight in Austrian land, man at 80 year old lead this man in attack on Austrian man across river. many gun ball and small ball hit them. he get bad wound. he get well, but he not work again.

he die in that big town in night of day 18 to day 19 of month 1, year 1759, from chest sick. one more man take he place as chief of that group. he put in that big town in place where war man sleep. son of elder brother get land. Peter give for money power place give by king to other man, in year 1749. last of family, old Pennavaire, die in year 1824. in year 1806, he work in north land foot group at strong place of stone wall.

for work, Pennavaire name live on from year 1851 on one plate on big horse stone of king.

Theophile Allain live from day 1 of month 10, year 1846 to day 2 of month 2, year 1917.

he be man in law house of this land from year 1870 to year 1880.

he work on political thing, for education and growth.

he help change river wall, in year 1880 to 1890.

after this, he move to big town in north.

he still work for right of black people.

for time, he be most rich black person of this land.

Theophile Allain have birth as servant, on day 1 of month 10, year 1846.

he grow up on big farm, in west part of this land.

father be rich farm owner. father self Theophile and mother.

Allain be servant to father, near him.

father love young Theophile. he let Theophile eat at table with him, and take Theophile to Europe.

when Allain be 10, he go to Paris with father. there he go to school.

at time, Allain have other name, not Theophile.

in year 1850 to 1860, Allain go to France to see father.

many people come to sea town to see him. they think he be big chief of island land.

in year 1859, back in this land, he go to school again.

and in year 1868, he go to private school in far north town.

in year 1869, he make food store business in west part, till year 1873.

he after put money in sugar and rice farm, and become owner of father farm.

he also do well in ship industry, most with sugar, sweet thing and rice.

with friend, Allain go in political work in year 1872.

people give Allain seat in law house from year 1872 to 1874, and from year 1879 to 1886.

he be in high law house from year 1875 to 1878.

as law man, he speak for part 14 of land.

in year 1879, he be in big meeting for new law.

as political man of group, he speak for farm work, most black work.

he say work and money need one other.

he also push to build river wall on big river, to keep work people safe. this help land grow rich.

he work much with learning and school, and with black chief.

in year 1886, he get 14000 money from law for big school in south.

with 2 other man, he help make that school.

he be first person after America war to make mixed public school in this town.

in year 1880, Allain and other law man lead fight against new paper.

paper want to change law number 527 of this land.

this law need all judge man to say same thing.

new paper want only 9 people to say yes.

this make law many man win more. more black man go to prison.

other law man lead this new paper too.

some who fight it think it want to make black people servant again, like before.

but paper go through law house in month 2, and high law house in month 4.

in year 1887, people say Allain do bad thing with money.

he lose high place in group, and seat in law house.

in year 1890, farm of him come to bad end.

at last, he give farm to other man, and move to big north town near year 1893.

he have some little public work.

he keep work for black right in town and land group.

in year 1900, he be part of big meeting of black group in other town.

he be married to one woman, and have 6 child.

he be part of Catholic church.

he die in north town, day 2 of month 2, year 1917.

at last meeting for him, at St Catholic church, many people come.

Smythe money run short, and he come back to America, leave hope for act work. Smythe take hand work, and on word of one man, he start teach at school in town of Pennsylvania.

in year 1869, Smythe join law school in big town, Washington. as learn man, he be give work by one chief man as keep man of paper in house for free black people on day 12 of month 1, year 1870. on day 15 of month 8 of that year, he leave to be keep man of paper in America people number house. in town of north Carolina, Smythe do political work. he be one of man in big meeting of land law in year 1875, and he support Republic group. he help two man run for chief of America. he come to know one man, who through big man of America law house, tell chief man of America government in year 1878 about Smythe. two black man of big name also support Smythe. he take this work on day 23 of month 5, year 1878. he be call back by chief of America, and one more chief of America give him work again on day 12 of month 4, year 1882. in he time, he also have price of German house in town of Africa land for 6 month, and for short time one house of other land. he also speak for king of two north land, on word of man from that land in America. in Africa, he give work to people of this land for chief work in many town, and make good word between Africa and America. he get good name from school board in Africa land. he be make big man of good order by chief of Africa land on day 28 of month 12, year 1885. this meeting have many fight. law man say no to some of woman king many man of rule, and push them out. law man talk and fight about law on money chance and poison. law man attempt to change old law paper for new law paper. in this meeting, Pua be one of law man who give big paper from people, question for new law paper.

in year 1895, son Samuel be take and put in prison for wrong against land. this after fight to get king land back, not win.

Shishmano family be great family of land near Ottoman, Russian and Austrian. people of family say they come from old king house in middle time.

people of family say connection between old time and new time be strong. but wise man have more doubt.

new line of Shishmano family start near year 1590, with strong forest fight man. people tell great story of him.

after long time of more than 100 year, old big land fall. Turkish people rule then.

many people of that time take old king name, say they come from great old house.

first man of family come from small place on island on big water. wise man say, Turkish name of first man be fat man.

he come near year 1530. in early year he learn in holy house.

then he start as fight man at early time, after Turkish people put him in prison and hit him.

that make him leave birth place and go to far forest, where he quick learn use of gun and military thing from old fight chief.

he make band of fight people. then he start violent fight against Turkish people.

strong self of him and military knowledge make many people come with him. band of him become strong force.

he join army of Michael in west land with 2000 fight people, to make land free. he become chief of that group.

in year 1601 enemy of Michael take him, say he must die, and kill him.

after death of him people still sing of him as great fight man in old song of many land.

old story say he have two son. they also fight with Turkish people.

after that, big man of family be son of second son. he say true big name, king son of old town, and lead strong fight there.

in year 1686 he go to Russia, want get help for fight.

at big town of Russia he see Russian holy chief and say to him, please help.

when war of Russian and Turkish people start, from year 1686 to 1700, fight break out early in old town.

he go back to Turkish land, but Turkish army have much more people, and fight stop.

after many hard time he go back to big town of Russia. there he last join with daughter of brother of holy chief, and give base to new Russian family.

in year 1592 first son live in old town, where in middle time old king house live.

child of him and after child do cloth work. one girl of them join with strong Turkish army man. this make family grow, strange thing for many people.

in year 1794 son of son of him become chief of old town land, and fight against Turkish rule.

when he run, he give money work to other family man of him, who get great money.

this man make money house, put four son of him in big money place in Turkish and Austrian land.

not like old Christian money many man, who help Turkish big house but many time lose money in fight or take, this family system be safe from attack of near people.

money of them be in thing that move all over world, like debt and more money.

knowledge of this man let them keep money safe from near fight.

they keep big right after death of that man of old town, and even get big name.

in year 1850, but son of that man lead big fight in old town. they want free land back and be king of that land. then punishment come, they go out of town, and money house of them break.

after free of land from Turkish rule, family go in big political live of land.

Alexander, son of that man, be make chief of that town by people. other people of family also go in rule and talk with other land.

he become learn chief at big learn house in year 1894.

from year 1903 to 1907 he be chief of learn for land.

work of him have writing on connection of land with Russia and near land, and many talk on writing of west European land in year 1700.

son of this wise man also go in rule and become chief of other land talk, in time of second big war.

as chief he help land join big agreement of three. after war, red people kill him.

Han Yanhui live from year 882 to year 959. he have other name, light and wise. north people give him name, one who come back. he get big chief name of land. he be Han people, and help north people family as chief help man. he help first four north king.

Han Yanhui come to world in year 882, when old king of middle land rule. family come from small town in north land. not clear he come to world there. father of Han be chief of three town, one after other. this town be in north land, near big river. so Han may come to world in small town, or big north town.

when young, he make army chief of north land like him. chief make him teach man for land, and look man at town near sea. but he stop at chief place, work with big help man of middle land, who come after. at last he become help man to army chief in big town.

in year 907, army chief son make father lose and take north land. when king seat of middle land be take by strong army chief from middle land, old family end, new family start in middle land. at first army chief son be small help man of this new family, but in year 911 he say he be king of new north land. this bring attack by west land big man, with two other army chief of near land. while they fight, army chief send Han to north place for help. north king be angry, because Han not bow to him. so he hold Han and make him care for horse. first north king married woman say to king, Han keep strong heart and not give in. this be sign he be good man. why shame him by make him care for horse? you must respect and use him. after this, first north king call Han back to place. after talk with him, and see he be wise, keep him as chief think man.

it be say that, as chief think man, Han help north people win over two small tribe. he also teach north people how to build chief place, big town wall, and market, so Han people want live in north land. he also make Han people married, and give them land to plough and grow plant, so Han people no more want leave north land. it be say, from this, north people grow more and more strong.

in year 916 or before, Han run from north place and go to west land big town. west land big man want Han in help group. but one chief of writing not like Han. Han not feel safe, so he say he want go back east to north land, to see mother. when he stop in one town, he stop with friend, who be son of big man from other family. when friend say, what you do now? he answer that all land north of big yellow river now be west land. i come back to north people. friend say, you run from north people, so come back be death. he answer, to run from them be like lose hand and eye. when i come back, they get hand and eye again. they will not kill me. he go see mother, then come back to north place. north king be happy see him come back. king touch back of Han and say, why you leave? he answer, i think of mother and want come back, but i be afraid you not let me, so i leave not say yes. second king do more well for him after that. second king also give him north name, one who come back. he make Han chief of word for king, and big learn man of writing house. Han think much of rule, in near land and far land.

in year 925, Han go after second king in fight against east land, which king give in then turn against them again. for Han help in this fight, he get place of big help man. he then take big town of east land with one army chief.

in year 926, first king die. son of first king come to seat, as second king. Han keep work as chief think man, and get big chief name of land. after that, he go to west land, to carry word for north king. when he come back, he be take from chief think work and make head of three money house. tax, gold, salt and iron, at south big town, which west land give to north people.

in year 947, old king die. brother child of old king become king after him.

in time of this new king, Han Yanhui become head of south rule in that land. old king make this rule to rule new land take in war. new king make it big. north rule keep old land, from before.

when new king make head work place of south rule in year 950, Han be one who make most of form of it. he put many man to work in it.

in year 951, king of north land want new king make him king too. new king tell Han to make big work. Han copy most of old big work. that old big work make one man king of late gold land.

in year 951, new king be kill. brother child of old king become king after him.

in time of this king, Han Yanhui stop work. at that time son of Han keep east town. king say son can go back to see father one time every year.

Han Yanhui die in year 959. after death, king give him big good thing. they put body in earth in far town.

old man Warner be chief in army of America. he be man who make map of land.

in year 1849, he lead army of many man north from big town. they go through land no man know. they go in south middle part of west land.

Warner be kill by red man in north east of west land. this be near south edge of other land.

in year 1850, two army place in south west land take Warner name. now, big hill, low land and many other place have Warner name.

Warner come to world on day 8 of month 5, year 1812, in east land of America. he go to big army school. he go in school in month 7, year 1831. he end school on day 1 of month 7, year 1836.

Warner end school, place ten in group of 49 young man. after school, he become second chief. he join army gun group 1.

as second chief, Warner fight in war with red man from year 1836 to year 1838. then he help move many man of land to west.

on day 7 of month 7, year 1838, Warner join map man group. he keep level of second chief. as map man, he lead work to make harbour good in east town. he lead it till year 1839.

then he look at sea harbour of other town in east land. after that year, Warner go back to south land to help army fight red man. then in year 1840, Warner look at big river in north middle land. he end that work in year 1841.

on day 1 of month 9, year 1841, he become first chief in map man group. after this, Warner go to look at land near big sea town in south west. he end that work in year 1842.

then he look at big lake in north middle land. he say how to make harbour good round lake. that work last till year 1843.

Warner then look at big river near steel town in east. after end this work in year 1845, Warner go look at line between America and British land of Canada.

Warner work hard in war between America and Mexico. he go to west land with big chief of army. on day 6 of month 12, year 1846, Warner fight in big fight near town of south west. he get wound there.

after big fight, he get good word for fight in field. he get high level.

from year 1847 to year 1849, Warner do map work in west land. in month 5, year 1847, he look at island in west sea. Warner work be first full look at island.

in month 5, year 1848, Warner start look at army land in San Francisco. after this, in year 1848, Warner look at town place of big river town with help of other chief.

in month 10, year 1848, Warner join chief Richard and two other man to make trade company. every one of four man give 500 money. idea of group be to open store in mine town and trade food to man who work in hole.

after company form, business go to other man to run, with help of writing man who work for Warner before.

in month 1, year 1849, Warner join first law fight in west land, under America law. store man Charles kill other store man. Warner be in big meeting where judge and man of law be name.

few day after when law fight come, Warner be name for group of judge man. law fight end with no answer from judge group. Charles go free on money.

in early year 1849, chief Richard tell Warner to lead look group up big river from town. they look at high land in north east of west land. this reason be look for way through hill for big iron road from east to west.

Warner also look for good place to make army place in north east land. Warner second chief be Robert. he also learn map make in west school.

Warner and group start late in summer, leave town in month 8, year 1849. this walk go slow by hard land.

when walk get to low land by big lake, Warner want to cut group in two part. Warner tell Robert to be at low land by big lake. Warner take small group of man to look north and east of low land.

Warner first go north to water lake. then he go after way of chief John east in low land. he come in low land near one big lake, then go south by west side of land.

Warner and man leave low land at south end. they go to north west land edge, only short way off. on day 26 of month 9, year 1849, Warner group be attack by red man, only south of land edge. man who live say Warner die first, get hit by many arrow.

guide man also die, and two other man get wound.

true place of attack be not clear. but Robert map put attack only south of land edge, near small water. in year 1850, army group with big chief go out to get Warner body. they not find it.

in summer of year 1864, Charles be chief of army. he be order to lead big group east from army house. group go to see south east land.

group come to big lake land, go over what be now Warner mountain. when he come to other land, he give it name Warner land. name be for Warner, chief who he think be kill there.

in year 1860 to year 1869, there be two army house in south middle land. two be call Warner house. old Warner house be on east side of high mountain. after hard winter, army move house to new place near sweet water. place be on west side of Warner land. this house become know as Warner house. army leave Warner house in month 9 of year 1874. from year 1889 till year 1924, there be also letter house near small town. town have name of Warner.

now there be many place with name of William Warner. most big of this place be Warner mountain. mountain range be on line between two land. south Warner land be name for this mountain. other place in south middle land have name of Warner. they be Warner land, Warner lake, Warner deep cut, Warner edge, and Warner high top. Warner top be most high place of high mountain.

in year 1923, big boat for carry thing on lake get name William Warner. boat be put in water.

Cudamani Warmadewa be king of sea land, in year 988 to 1004. Chinese writing have other name for him.

he be able and smart king. he talk well with other chief and make good thought. time of him as king be big name, because in that time sea land face bad trouble. big fire island army come by sea to attack. king of big fire island be enemy of him.

in year 990, king of big fire island send army by sea to attack land of sea people. he make attempt to take big town of sea land. news of this attack be in Chinese writing.

in year 988, man from sea land be send to big town of China. after two year in China, this man learn land of sea people be attack by big fire island. so he be not able to come back to house.

in year 992, man from big fire island come to Chinese king. he say land of big fire island have long fight with sea land.

in year 999, man of sea land take boat from China to other land, want come back to house. he hear no news of land of sea people. man then take boat back to China. he call Chinese king for help. he want China keep sea people safe against big fire island army.

attack from big fire island make Cudamani Warmadewa want help from China. in bad trouble from attack, he take help from Chinese king. he make Chinese king happy.

in year 1003, Chinese writing say man from sea land be send by king Cudamani Warmadewa. this man say to Chinese king. in land of sea people, people make house for god. house be for Chinese king live long. he question king to give name and bell for this house. house be make with respect for Chinese king.

Chinese king be happy. he give long name to house, 10000 year of good thing from god. bell be make at one time and send to sea land to be put in house.

king Cudamani die near year 1004, may be in long fight with big fire island many man. after him, son be after king of sea land.

Dora Colebrook be medical man and learn about small living thing. her work find out if light help sick people. she also learn why woman get sick after birth. she make first true knowledge about this thing.

Colebrook be last daughter of her father and her mother Mary Colebrook. she have three brother and sister. seven half brother and sister come from her father first married. family live in south town till father die in year 1896. then they move to sea town.

Colebrook learn at big hospital in London. she get medical card in year 1915. then she get more big knowledge in year 1919 from London school. she also get card about small living thing.

she work first at old hospital in north town. now that hospital be no more. then she move to old school town, to do general medical work. then she move to baby help place in north London. her work then turn to find out about thing.

she get work as secretary of medical group about light. her brother, man of small living thing, speak for her. at that time, more and more people use light for many sick thing. her work look at two place where light seem to help. first be bad leg wound. second be weak child.

she test 85 sick man with bad leg wound. light help be put after to normal help, wet cloth cover. normal help give far more good end. second test, on 287 school child, still see no good from light. test have some trouble, though. she look at three thing. light, light under glass cover, and group with no light. in test after that on coal man, office man and work building man, she still see no clear good from light.

her first find about light bring fight, because many medical man in year 1920 think light help well. she still be in fight about light help till late year 1940.

Colebrook work with brother on sick after birth. they do this at woman birth house in London, where she have money from big group to learn. she look for where bad small living thing come from, in house. after take bit of small living thing from sick woman, family and work man in house, she use body fight to find every kind. this make clear that bad kind be no different. they be same kind in town that make throat sick. they come to woman after birth, not before. together, they see small living thing come from work man more than from woman.

Hampton Gleeson live from day 31 of month 8, year 1834, to day 10 of month 4, year 1907.

he be sheep and cow man and law man in young land in south part of Australia.

after, he be in drink business in land near, with big money.

Hampton be first son of John Hampton Gleeson.

John Hampton Gleeson and brother Edward Gleeson come with family to south Australia. they come on big boat from India, in month 7, year 1838.

Australian many man make this journey.

also on boat be two Gleeson family, few other man, judge James and servant.

boat carry many Indian work man, much Indian thing and horse.

one fast male horse, from far land, be bring by Edward Gleeson for make more horse.

some trouble be with boat and boat chief. no one know what trouble be.

other boat of Australian group break in sea by big river of India, in year 1840. no more boat be send.

Gleeson family make farm in north part of land. Edward Gleeson build small town there and give it new name.

John Hampton Gleeson die in year 1840, when son be six year old.

Hampton learn good, and get sharp mind for business. he learn much at farm of father brother, near town.

in year 1860 he make business go journey to India. he bring back many small animal that kill snake, as strange thing.

he give some to man of house where he live, and to big plant garden.

he get agreement to send horse to India. in same year he join with one more man as station man, with work house in town.

in year 1861 he start new mine group. in year 1862 he start other mine group.

in year 1868 he be chief of mine group. in year 1864 he get print from government to do trade.

in year 1869 government make him judge of peace.

he get place in law house for north hill land, from month 4, year 1870, to month 12, year 1871. Alfred be other man from that place.

he move to land in east.

in year 1874 he be first with two more man to start drink house in east town.

after, this house get new name, with Gleeson.

in year 1876 this house take over other drink house. same year big water break much of house.

for short time other drink house make drink for them, and give that house toe hold in land, and they never leave.

Gleeson also join with other drink house.

he die in house, number 44, on road.

he be in group of many man in east town. in last year he live, he keep group money.

John Hampton Gleeson and woman of him have family. some child be.

Publius Valerius Poplicola die year 460 before. he be chief of Roman Republic in year 475 before and year 460 before. he also be chief for short time in year 462 before.

before he be chief, he be one of two rich old man. group of Rome send them to far south island. there they get grain to keep safe Rome. in year 492 before, Rome have bad time with no food. they come back one year after and do well.

in first time he be chief, Valerius get work for war against hill man and near town. Roman army get more man from Latin friend and other hill man.

hill man army be at place out of near town wall. Valerius attack hill man wall. hill man come out from place of they, but Roman man win fight, and take door of hill man place. near town man attack from town then, but in some bad mixed fight. Roman horse man run at near town man and make them run, so Rome win all of fight.

Valerius get big reward for this win. he do big thing on day 1 of month 5.

after big sick time in Rome in year 463 before, many die. two chief die too, among other. Valerius get work to hold give say for year 462 before.

in second time as chief, hate between rich man and poor man go on from year before. one poor man chief say one rich man make bad secret against Rome. this rich man be make go from Rome year before. he say this bad secret must be look at. then it can be stop, before rich man hard rule take Roman right.

other chief, friend of Valerius, say talk of bad secret be not true. he say poor man chief make up talk as cause to make rich man go. rich man who stop against poor man want.

then come fast news of down man fight on hill of Rome. fight be lead by one rich hill man. he want break Rome power or get king power. in dark, this man take hill of Rome with near 4500 down man and out man. he kill all who fight him, and call all down man he find on hill to be free.

in morning, when people know how bad it be, poor man say no help fight. they help only if rich man give them long want change. rich man say it be more good to fight this man with no poor man, even with far help, than give poor man change.

in this fight, with part of Rome take by enemy, Valerius make long talk. he say poor man must help rich man fight this enemy. he say house of god be hold by enemy man. he also say he will work for change they want, if they give help. he talk make poor man quiet, and most say yes to fight enemy fast.

chance be pull, and Valerius get work to fight this man on hill of Rome. with help of one chief from near town, Valerius win and kill rich hill man. but in fight he too be kill.

he be say to be son of Publius Valerius Poplicola, chief of year 509 before. but other talk say that son fall in fight at lake in year 496 before. chief of year 475 before may be son of son.

Ollivier come to world in year 1799. he die year 1884. he be French man of business and rule.

he be strong man of people, and want land be Republic, not king. he be against old king family, and against king Louis. in year 1830 he have Italian friend. after year 1848, people give him big meeting place. in year 1851 he fight Louis, so he go far from land.

Ollivier come to world in town by sea, in south land, on day 25 of month 2, year 1799.

he go in business when young. he lead house of trade in south town, with cloth.

Ollivier have view of people rule. he be against king family of year 1814 to 1830.

in year 1822 Ollivier do bad thing against king. man of king take him, put him in prison for 6 month, and take money from him.

Ollivier join woman Marie. they have son. son come to world in south town by sea, on day 8 of month 7, year 1825.

Ollivier be against king Louis, from year 1830 to 1848.

Italian friend live with Ollivier family in early year 1830.

in month 8, year 1832, Italian friend woman have child. almost certain child be son of Italian friend. they name child after Ollivier family.

Ollivier family take care of child in month 6, year 1833, when woman and Italian friend go to land of mountain. child die in month 2, year 1835.

Ollivier become man of town rule in year 1836.

business of him run in trouble, and money come to end. this break rule work of him.

but with hard work he can make thing right, and get back good name.

he leave south town and go to big town, Paris. there he live quiet and bring up big family.

after year 1848 fight, Ollivier make son of him, 23 year old, big man of Republic in south town.

Ollivier be man of south land in big meeting of rule on day 23 of month 4, year 1848.

in first meeting on day 4 of month 5, year 1848, he want all man say word of Republic one by one at high place.

when they say no, he want book of meeting record that we call for Republic be one call from all.

all man get up to say yes to this idea.

Ollivier become part of trade committee.

he side with most strong part of Republic people.

Ollivier be against law fight with Louis and with other man after big fight in month 6.

he be against put man back in prison. he be for end of law that kill man.

he want right to work, and be against order of day to good word for general.

he be for free all man in prison, against stop on club, against money for army go to Rome, and for end of tax on drink.

he be against Louis. he be one of man who sign paper to put big man of rule and help man of big man out of rule, because of thing in Rome. Ollivier be not take again for big meeting, but keep fight for Republic and new idea in south land.

Ollivier say no strong to sudden take power by force, on day 2 of month 12, year 1851. man take him and send him far from France.

he go first to small land in north, then to Italy. this be in time of French rule, year 1852 to 1870.

he live in town by sea, then in town of art.

son join woman, daughter of music man and Marie, on day 22 of month 10, year 1857.

in year 1859 Ollivier be in fight about money not give. Marie say she give money at join, but not give it to new join two.

Ollivier come back to France in year 1860.

he die in town by sea, south land, on day 22 of month 4, year 1884.

Qilinyu be kind of hard plate fish. it be dead now. it live in late time, about 423 big year old. it be from China.

it have one kind only, with long nose. it live with bone fish in old rock place.

with same time fish, Qilinyu be strange hard plate fish. it have some sign more like bone fish, such as skin mouth bone and flat arm.

it can be know for live on sea floor. mouth and nose hole be under head, like other hard plate fish. it be not same kind.

head look be like smart sea animal. round top slope to short point nose.

many good stone bone of it be find in China. good one be most complete. it have body and head hard plate join together. only low chin bone be not there.

all be from same old rock place, where many fish dead be. many find walk from year 1999 to year 2016. they now be at Institute, in China. they have many old fish, like same kind fish find in year 2013.

stone learning tell this be late time, near end of old time. in number, this kind be about 423 big year old.

Qilinyu take name from place, which take name from strange animal of old China story. this mixed animal have two kind of sign, hard plate and bone fish, like Qilinyu. name of kind, long nose, be for nose point.

this old head and body hard plate be 12. 6 long, 5. 0 wide. like other hard plate fish, hard plate be part. head plate be head bone. body plate be full ring after head. plate have round high part.

head look be like smart sea animal. top be round, slope to short point nose. nose point out front. mouth and nose hole be under head, like flat fish or big fish. eye hole be small, far separate, and move front to base of nose. small ring of three bone go round every eye hole.

like same time fish, Qilinyu be hard plate fish with mouth bone. this tell it have three small bone on every side of mouth. front, side and low. this be not same as most other hard plate fish. they have blade bone in, not out mouth bone. so Qilinyu look more like bone fish and four foot animal in mouth look. no sign tell more in mouth bone.

other way Qilinyu be not like bone fish. three out mouth bone of Qilinyu be all no tooth. they have narrow up face. wide flat side be bent in at mouth edge. all three bone have this look in Qilinyu.

Qilinyu also have no bone at low edge of chin, and no throat plate. this tell low mouth bone be only low mouth part. only small hole at chin.

top of nose be cover by one nose plate. then flat plate between two eye. then two middle plate. last narrow back plate have point back end. under nose be cover by big flat plate and small plate at every nose hole side. wide cut go from every nose hole to nose end.

after eye, side of head have two big bone. front plate be small, with thin line of bone over eye. back plate be much big, make most of side. two plate have deep hole between. hole may be for breath hole. most big bone in head be back head plate. every one form back edge of head plate, between nose plate and back plate.

three small round bone go back in line over back plate.

only head look, head plate be not same as same time fish. Qilinyu have two middle plate, not one. it have two eye plate on every side of head, not one. eye ring be not join to head.

Qilinyu be not same as near kind fish. it have long nose. it have no small tooth on chin. it have no side line branch on back plate. it have no front eye plate on every side of nose plate.

small town, other fish, and bone fish all have three different bone near high mouth. this be. eye water bone, face bone, and breath cover.

in Qilinyu, eye water bone cover under front face. it be between air hole and mouth bone. air hole cover too.

face bone can see on side of head, right over mouth bone, back of eye. breath cover be thin, join straight to back of face bone, not soft middle part. it also have bent plate in, like mouth bone. in two way, breath cover be most like old fish kind.

big line cut go from back of eye, straight back over edge plate. at front end, it turn sharp down as under eye line cut. it go past back of eye, with face bone. one more side line cut come in from front edge plate to middle plate.

like other hard skin fish, Qilinyu have big body plate. it be near head, but not join. front edge of body plate go near to back edge of head, with many cut and high line. no big hole be here. three middle back plate be in line over high body. second plate be long, six side, and most like big middle back plate of other high fish. it be smooth and round, but body plate have no sharp high line or top. three plate be strange thing. it can be first big body skin, like one other fish. first plate also be strange. few other hard skin fish have first middle back plate small than second. it may be same as big first back plate of old fish kind. it be like one loose neck plate in other fish. only two other hard skin fish have middle back plate like Qilinyu.

four plate can see on side of body. top front, low front, top back, low back. of four, top front plate be most big, not like other hard skin fish. low front plate be strange form and go out front. it be base for big sharp blade plate, which stick out from side of body. side line go on from head to top side plate. under body have two small five side middle bone. four big square bone be near them, two at front, two at back. two square bone make small part of side of body, with bent edge. back two be much big than front two.

Qilinyu have one kind of neck join, never see before in hard skin fish. front edge of top front plate have one round cut. two sharp high line be on edge of cut. back edge of head back plate go in this cut. this join be like that of old fish kind, where it be call back turn join. not like old fish kind, under of back neck plate also have small hole, with one high line. this let low high line of body plate go in head, like neck join of some other fish. two join kind may also be in two other hard skin fish, base on body plate and head.

Qilinyu be first hard skin fish with mouth bone find with keep front swim part and back swim part. front swim part go in one big hole, between low front plate and front square bone. back swim part join one small plate at back of body. base of swim part be soft part with small skin. but back edge be big and no skin.

Qilinyu and other fish give more sign that new mouth bone fish come from hard skin fish.

in year 2016, wise group test Qilinyu first. they say Qilinyu be near one group, with other fish and all new bone fish.

in year 2019, wise group test other hard skin fish again. they find Qilinyu and that fish be same family, but other end be same as before.

in year 2021, wise group test one more mouth bone hard skin fish. it be also like Qilinyu. it be in group with Qilinyu, that other fish, and high new kind.

Norman be chief of one boat. one rich man have that boat for 9 year. from year 1848, he be chief of one boat for 4 year. in year 1851, he join one big sea work group. he make ready one new boat and take it to Australia. he come back to England, and group give him one boat. he take that boat to Australia.

one of people on that boat be Sir Charles. he come to Victoria to be chief there. he be sea man too. Sir Charles like Norman and want him for new land of Victoria. Britain be at war with Russia. Sir Charles say Victoria need one strong steam boat to keep safe from Russian attack. when Norman come back to Britain on that boat, he leave group. he start work for land of Victoria.

Norman first work be make new boat, Victoria. then sail it to big water near land near Victoria.

that boat then do many work under Norman. work with sail to far place to help gold man of Victoria. they leave Victoria for new gold land and be bad off. land of Victoria give free way back to Victoria, where man be need.

in year 1860, land chief of Victoria send boat Victoria to new Zealand, to help British man fight in first war. against people of that land. on day 19 of month 4, year 1860, Victoria sail to one town by sea. it take 134 fight man from 40 army group and carry them to new Zealand. before boat leave, land chief go past one law to give boat law right. but Britain stop that law. Britain think it be make one sea army not under king.

after boat put fight man on land, Victoria fire at sea edge and watch edge of land. Victoria keep food way open between two town.

in month 7, Victoria come to one big town and take chief Thomas and man with him to new Zealand. Victoria be use to take woman and child from one town, after people attack wall of that town. in month 10, boat be fixed in one town and then help British fight man. as Victoria land chief need boat for work, chief say boat come back at end of year. Victoria come to one big town in month 3, year 1861.

this be first time one Australian boat help in far war.

law trouble for boat far from land of Victoria be fixed. so king say all Australian fight boat in far sea must join king sea army.

12 month in new Zealand bring Norman good say from big chief of new Zealand, Thomas.

when Norman come back to Victoria, few month after, news come. two man walk far from south to north land. they be in big water near land with no food. second chief, John, lead group of ship man and ship people to get help from light house on island. but light house have not enough food for all this live people.

then John go on horse 26 unit far to town. from there he tell big town of Victoria by fast word on day 21 of month 7.

Victoria government quick send Norman to weight food, cloth and medical thing on ship Victoria. then go fast to island to help live people. John, who go by train from town, join ship to help find people. other ship also go from town to help live people.

on day 23 of month 7, Norman find break place of other ship. after talk with other ship chief, Norman take 230 people on board Victoria. as many as be possible, Norman leave food for people on island. then other ship come and take 60 live people near break place. other 117 people have left break place and go to light house.

after take people to big town of Victoria, Victoria and other ship go back to light house on island. they help rest of people and give light house new boat.

people go by train and then by carriage. carriage man do this for free. they go to big building in town. this be not same as building of now. little of people bag come back. most people be in sad say after bad time. Norman do one more work, take fish egg to small south island on Victoria, to bring fish to that island.

about year 1858, British government give Victoria government big iron ship. Norman be send to England to watch ship get ready, then bring ship back to Victoria.

on go back to England to make ship ready, Norman get more sick. on day 12 of month 12, year 1869, Norman die in town of England from sick of heart and breath, then water sick. Jane, he sister, help him when he be sick. he woman and child be in town of Victoria.

big river and town in north part of Australia take name after him.

this man have good eye for see trouble and find new answer, also at that hole. two thing help people at Parc most. first be change in way of work. long before, stone come out by four man together. two rock man work under land, take big stone from one room. two top man work on top, make big stone to roof stone. when work go on under, top man have no thing to do. and when rock come out, under man many time can not work as fast as they want, because too many big stone be there for top man.

plane three be foot join, which go across plane of cut.
