Polanco man live about year 1635 to year 1714. he be chief of 50 horse man group from north part of island. he carry long spear and lead win fight in English attack of year 1655. he also lead win big fight in year 1691. with other chief, Polanco be part of rule group of horse man town and north sea land.

he also be head of horse man town. he be rich, with many cow and sugar house. he be only son. father live about year 1620 to year 1656. father also be chief of north horse group. father keep safe north sea land and town from bad sea many man from far island. mother be woman of other house.

father of father of he be Polanco man, live about year 1585 to year 1679. he be head of town in year 1623. he married woman of other house. father of father of father be Polanco man, about year 1535. he and woman of he come from high people and first new land people. they live in horse man town, town of green, and one more town. three of old European town in new land. Polanco man also be head of town near year 1575.

Polanco man, come from Spain about year 1480, be one of first people who come to new land. he come with big sea chief in boat. in this journey, they attempt go round world, first time. this be year 1502, on 4 journey.

other of this house, Polanco man, be head of town in year 1638. other Polanco man be chief of church in year 1660, under holy man Francisco.

Polanco man married woman of other house. she be daughter of man of big book of king. her mother be woman of other house, sister of man who lead big fight at far island in year 1654. they take big rock house there.

daughter of they, Maria, live about year 1660 to year 1744. she married Campuzano man. Campuzano man, about year 1648, come from Spain to island in year 1680. he be help man of land chief Francisco. he also be head of horse man town. he make book of memory, of living and work of north island at that time. they have five son and three daughter. they use name Campuzano Polanco as sign of high people. all child keep this name.

this man give living to church. in year 1720 he become chief of holy group in far land. he rule holy house in island land and far land, from island to far land. in year 1721 he get big book of holy knowledge in Rome.

chief of king army from year 1708 to year 1719. in year 1719 he be chief of town and land near town of green. he send off enemy from sea land. with brother, he give money for many sea journey, in early year 1700. he help stop fight of chief many man in horse man town. he help take in house and people of broken boat in year 1724. after he be head of island town, from year 1752 to 1754. son of he, Campuzano Polanco, become chief of church of big church of new land.

this man may be most good sea hunter from island town in first half of year 1700. he have paper from king to take boat. he be one of most strong sea man in island land. he fight bad trade with land not Spain. he take more than 50 boat of other land with he first boat, second boat, and Maria.

he be know for deep knowledge of sea. king give him paper to sail in many place, Florida, and other. in idea, this journey stop bad trade. in true, it be big work for island town, because it bring food and thing to people.

this Campuzano Polanco man also be one of sea chief who, with other man, keep safe big sea town for Spain in year 1741. chief of sea, call half man, lead this fight. this be most important fight of war of ear. this man make book of this fight. man man be rich man. he be owner of land and farm in north west part of island. he send animal and smoke leaf over sea.

he married woman. her father be sea chief from far island town. he have 5 child.

one child be church chief. one child be Maria. one child be Dr man. one child be man.

young son be army chief. from year 1770 to year 1840 he live. in year 1808, he fight in big fight at hard hill. he also be chief of big meeting. this meeting send island land back to king of Spanish land from France.

one army man move to far land over sea. there he married woman. he start sweet brown nut farm to send over sea.

he become second chief of town. in year 1715 he become chief of town. he work for king money house. child of him have army work and farm work.

one child of him be Francisco, chief of town, also. one child move back to island town.

he come back to island town. he run sugar house on far farm. this farm be family thing. in year 1758 he become first chief of Santa band, when this name first make on island.

this man also call Dr man. he get top law learn from big school in year 1751. in year 1752 Francisco, chief of land, name him chief of island town. from year 1751 to year 1759 he rule land.

he married woman. they have one child, son. they have three daughter. first daughter be Maria. she married man of other family. second daughter married rich farm man. daughter 3 married man, great son of old chief of land.

he become head of big school in Spanish land from year 1798 to 1800. he learn there before. he be one of few American man to do this.

he be part of big top meeting. he be top army chief of far land from year 1808 to year 1810. he be king man in island, in care of put land back in order. this be start of second Spanish land, after big fight in year 1808.

he be chief of meeting for America from year 1813 to 1814, and in year 1821. he be top man for king from year 1815 to 1817, and year 1834. he be part of king house from year 1833 to 1836. in year 1834, woman king name him. he also help with will of old king.

with time, work of first teach man bear fruit. school grow big. learn man get big name for wise and knowledge. some learn man become teach man in school. every one get name holy man of law and start teach one small school of learn man.

far walk man Benjamin 2 go to big place in year 1848. he tell what he see of Midrash like this.

rich man die on day 14 of month 10, year 1851. he leave two son only as kind, same as he. son keep father money for learn man. they also make new money for learn man who not get money before. they put to base money of Midrash so learn man can learn with full heart.

learn man come from far north land, far east land, India, and middle of Asia. they come to big place to learn at Midrash. head teach man work to answer many question of law. question come from far place. many question about married man and woman, and about break up of two married. many letter be in Hebrew. some be in other east word. school need big group of writing man who know many language of east. so Jewish people of that land get this word. people say many time, law will come out of big place, and word of god from this school!

one holy book roll from first house keep alive. it be from early year 1600. it go to house of holy word in town near sea, in holy land.

Toledo be Roman town, then land of old king, then Muslim fight place. then Christian king land. from year 1500 to year 1600, Toledo be short time seat of big power under Charles 5. many art and building come from three big religion, Jewish, Christian and Muslim.

Roman history man talk of Toledo, from year 59 before to year 17 after. he say it be small town, but strong by place.

Roman chief fight near Toledo in year 193 before. many tribe from many land come to fight Roman army. Roman chief win and take tribe king.

at that time, Toledo be town of one tribe, part of big land. old town

old king die in year 672 at he house in far land. then man who come after he be take as king at that place. then he go to Toledo. there head of church make he king, as old church law say before.

in year 673 king win against bad man Paul. then king have big walk in Toledo. walk have shame and skin cut from Paul, man who lose.

king do work on wall and door of Toledo in year 674 and 675. writing on top of door be lose, but man note it in year 700 and more.

church meeting number 11 be hold in year 675 under king. king make power of head of church of Toledo small. he make new church head place out of Toledo, at church of Peter and Paul. this be one of big church of Toledo. this be church where king be make king, and church from where old king go to war after holy work with small part of wood from Christ. by make new place, king take power over who be king after old king from head of Toledo, and give it to new head.

church meeting number 12 be hold in year 681 after king lose he place. king think he be die, so he take pain before god. old church law say this make he no more king. church meeting number 12, lead by new head of Toledo who come from other god, say king lose place be right. say other king after he be right too. church meeting number 12 make end of new church place. it give power of who be king after old king back to head of Toledo.

church meeting number 12 make 28 law against people of other god. head of church of Toledo, though he come from other god, be strong against them in he writing and work. top people of other god come together in church of Mary, day 27 of month 1, year 681. there law be say to them.

church meeting number 13, 14 and 15 be hold in year 683, 684 and 688. number 13 give back land and law right to they who fight king in year 673. number 13 also make law to keep king family safe after king die. in year 687 that king take pain before die, and man after he come to be king in Toledo on day 24 of month 11, year 687. in year 688 church meeting 15 lift stop on take land from family of old king. so king can take land of that king family.

in late year 600, Toledo become big place of learning and writing in Spain. Toledo growth as place of learning be help by wise man of writing from far town, who come to many church meeting in Toledo. king have big book house in Toledo. one high man have book house. before year 651, king send head of church from far town to Rome to take book not in Toledo. he take some part of book by old man of Rome. book house also have copy of six day book by old man of writing. king like it so much that he want man of writing to make new part with addition about seven day of make world. in year 654, king who come after put law together in one law book. book be change two time, many copy be make, and it be big thing for law of Spain after.

three head of church of Toledo do big writing. they be copy in many land of west Europe, and some part still be this day. wise people of church in Spain have no equal in brain before wise man of Britain come.

in year 693, church meeting 16 say bad of head of church of Toledo, who take place of head before. he fight new king with help of woman of other old king. one bad king take power in Toledo for short time about this time. no one know if this be one fight or two. bad king be know only from money make in Toledo, in time when other king must be king. church meeting 17 be hold in year 694. church meeting 18, last one, take place after king die, about year 702 or 703.

by end of year 600, head of church of Toledo lead all church head of Spain. this be not common in Europe. head of church of Toledo have power and top place by last part of year 600, power no other in west Europe have. not even head of Rome can have such help from near head of church. Toledo be match by no other town in west Europe out of Italy as big place of power and king land. Toledo come from not much to be always big place of rule for king land of old people. true head town, only one like it in west Europe be far town of Italy.

when old king die about year 710, one man become king in Toledo. but land be cut. other king rule north and east part.

at same time, sand man and hill man under one chief take two sea town between year 705 and 710. in year 711 they attack land of Toledo.

one man lead army to go against attack. he be kill in fight. it may be big man turn against him, because they want new king. they do not think sand man be big danger.

chief of attack be hill man, who one time be man of owner and work for chief. other king may rule Toledo between death of first king and loss of Toledo. chief of attack take chance from death of king and fight with big man. in year 711 or 712 he take Toledo.

chief come over sea to south town. then chief go to Toledo and kill many big man. this break much of king power. one man say king people love Toledo as heart of king holy work. this become weak thing. king be put in place in Toledo by man there. king must be make with oil by holy man of Toledo, in church of Toledo. when chief take Toledo and kill big man and king, king people have no way to put true new king in place.

after short time, chief and attack chief go back to far land. sand man seat of rule be first in south town, then move to other south town. with most of rest of Spain, Toledo rule from other south town by sand man chief. this chief be under one big sand king far off. sand man do again and again put new town in place of old big town, to make clear new power. they do so here. there be sign that Toledo keep much power as heart of book and church in middle 700. book make in year 754 tell this. one church man make story of holy man from Toledo, about year 737 or before. this story tell two big thing. in first thing, cover of holy woman box lift up while holy man say mass, with king there. in second thing, holy woman Mary come to holy man and king. people say two thing come from holy man love for holy woman, holy one of Toledo. one man say this story help holy man keep name big, and help church of Toledo keep power over other church in Spain.

this fight hold Toledo against first man. one of other man family hold Toledo. other man attempt walk on town, but he lose. he attempt go to family man in Toledo. he die on way, or he get to Toledo and hold out for two or three year. then people of that man turn him over and kill him.

one of other man family keep fight. first man have son kill, and throw head over wall in Toledo. in year 764, first man attack Toledo. he win only when some people of other man family turn him over to first man and free man of first man.

near end of first man rule, chief of Toledo attack hard in north king land. north book not make this.

Shi be one of many important man that first king of that land put in control of land while king child be young. but that child, when grow up, become sick of man in control and have Shi kill, with two other man.

no man know day of Shi birth, but man know he come from town in middle of land. he father be farm man. when young, Shi use day walk round near land, attempt to be strong, not do trade. he become good at fight with hand. he walk fast, cover 200 distance in one day.

near end of that time, army call every seven house to give one army man. Shi be take for army at that time. after, he be put in one army group of that town. after that, he be make man of king watch army. at one time after, he work under general Shi, and general Shi keep him near as watch man. after general Shi become king of land that come after, Shi Hongzhao become man of office in king watch army, one of two big group. in year 941, big general of north army become king of north land. he want Shi Hongzhao to come to him, and he make Shi man of office of house watch. after, he make two new army group, and make Shi chief of two. Shi also get good name, king of town by sea.

in year 947, land of after time fall to army from east. that army win, and that far king say he also be king of all Chinese land. at first, big general say he will say yes to that king, but he get ready to fight. he say to army man that he will send army to help last king of that land, who be take by that far army. he have Shi Hongzhao bring them together and tell them this. army man want him to take king seat now, but he say no at that time.

after that, he make self king. at first, he not give land any name, but after, people call it by other name. he send Shi to attack north town, in north part of land. Shi take it fast, kill king that far king give to town. after that, he give many new work to man of office. Shi become king of middle army and chief of foot army. after that, one man of far king go to big town, with help of other man. that town still hold by man of last king. he send Shi with 10000 man to help town. Shi army go first, to be front of army. Shi get to town before that man can, so that man go back. Shi send one man after that man, attack him, win over that army. then that man and other general of far king go back to south town, in south part of land.

then he send army to where Shi be, to join him. before he come, Shi attack high town, but at first he not able to take it, because man of far king hold it strong. he fear Shi army too few in number, so he think of call Shi back. some man say no. he send man to talk with Shi. Shi say go back be sign of weak. then he let Shi keep fight at high town. after that, Shi send one man to make king of town say yes. that king say yes, so Shi leave one man in control of town, and go on forward.

Shi come near river town. king there all ready say yes to join king, but three man of far king fight him there. when them man hear Shi come, they stop fight and go back to south town. Shi join with that king. after that, he be able to go in big town and then king seat, with little trouble.

one man, one more man, Shi, and army man. he say to them, breath near end, can not talk much. son be young and feeble, so what come after death of me must be give to you.

after old king death, Shi mother die. but Shi not take long time to cry. he go back to work in few day. son then call him back to government and give him high name.

at that time, law of land be very strong, and Shi be know as very cruel in make pain. he think true one money man, who be very good at make pain for man in army prison, so prison man always say crime be true after make pain. Shi also have care of town watch, part of work over king man. by order of him, if army man take man they think bad, they kill most, not care if crime big or small. no man can speak for self. man who not die lose mouth, tongue cut, foot break. so crime go down, but many good man die.

Shi not like man of pen. he say many time, that people not care much, and call man like us only army man. he give tax work of one part of land to near help man. this help man use power bad, so all land fear him as much as Shi, even Shi second army chief. he give too much money to Shi, so people have much pain.

son of Shi, one man, be wise, and many time not like Shi way. one time, when man from test cause noise out of test room, one high help man order man take and give to Shi head town, hope Shi hit him and mark him. son of Shi say to Shi, when test man be bad, man of pen have way to make pain. this be not army thing. this be how man of pen want tell you bad, father. in 949, after army man win over big army chief who fight against king, army man say no to big thing for self. so other high man and land chief all get big thing. as part of big thing, Shi get high name, big help of king.

in summer 950, bad thing come to make bad for good work between high man. they talk and say that, because north people many time attack and land part not work together to watch land, army man must go to one town in north, to watch it and be army chief of near land. Shi say army man must keep high name, chief of writing, to give order to army chief. one more high help say no, no time before have army chief keep high name. at end, king say yes to Shi. when Shi speak against that help, help answer, let head town rule far land be right. how can you let far land rule head town now?

it be at send off eat for army man, one day after, at house of one high man, that fight among high man come out. at eat, Shi, when lift cup for army man, speak in hard voice, how can there be no yes when we talk that yesterday at king meeting? now, let us drink, young brother! other high man also lift cup and say, this be big thing for land. do not hold bad heart! king make serious face and say good word to other man. but many man of land rule still fight. after that, other man go off. while big eat go on, there be drink play that Shi not know. one man seat near Shi, and say law of drink play again and again. other man say thing for laugh. when you seat near that man, you need not fear be hit. but Shi take this word bad. he think other man say bad thing about woman of him, who before work in drink house. he say bad word to other man. when other man not answer, he get up and want hit other man. other man go off, and he take sword and think of go after other man. one man cry and say please stop. this other man be chief of land rule. if you kill him, what kind of place you put son of sky in? please think well! after that Shi get on horse and go off. one man also go with him on horse, not leave him till he come to house of him. when king hear this, he send one man of king house to make peace, but he can not make them good again. other man want new work far off in army land. but if he go off from king town, Shi can kill him, so he not do this. but other man want this work too, but one man and Shi say please not go off from king town.

in winter year 950, king be tired of control of old man of land rule. even though one man lead well, king land rule be good, and Shi keep big town safe for people. part of fight come from how near man of king and family of old woman, mother of king, want get power, but one man and Shi stop them. at that time, young brother of old woman work in king house as small man of many thing. he want big high place of land rule. king and old woman same think this want, but one man and Shi think not right. he not have long time in land rule, so they stop new work of him. more, three man. one care for king horse, one care for drink leaf and wine, one talk for army house. king like all three, but they long not get big place, so they be angry. when king want make woman he like most be top woman of king house, one man think this too fast after time of sad for death of old king, so he say no. when that woman die, one man say no when king want her put in earth like top woman of king house. one day, when one man and Shi talk about big work of land with king, king say, think well! not let other man get chance to say bad about you! one man say, king, you must only be quiet. people of you still be here. this make king angry at them. after that, near man of king say false thing about one man and other man, say they make secret thing against king. other man angry at Shi, he also make young brother of old woman and other man go against them.

after that, king make secret thing with young brother and three man to kill one man and other man. king say about secret thing to old woman, mother of king, who say, how can such thing be think of so fast? you must talk with chief of land rule more. but young brother then say, old king before say big work of land not talk with wise man. they fear, so they will break you. when old woman want talk again, king say angry, big work of land can not be make in house of woman!

on day 24 of month 12, year 950, when man of land rule come to king house for big meeting, many army man come and kill one man, Shi, and other man. after that, king say they make big bad thing against king. king say to chief and other man of land rule, one man and other man see us as young child. now we at last be true king for you. you must not fear! he send army man to kill family and near man of one man, Shi, and other man. after that, other man take king from high place and make new land. after death, he make Shi big man of land.

William Dubois live from year 1841 to day 29 of month 4, year 1910. he be American servant of land. he work as chief of big white house in Washington. he work there from month 6, year 1896 to month 1, year 1901. he be first man to get name chief of house. before, many people say chief in talk and paper, but not as name of work.

no one know right day he come alive. stone of dead man say year 1831. but paper of death say he be about 70 year old. so he come alive near year 1840 or 1841. little know about early live of William Dubois. only he have one brother and one sister, Mary. he be foot man in army of north, in big fight of America. no one know which unit, group or army he be in.

after big fight, William Dubois come live in Washington. he join town watch. he be keep man at big white house in year 1880. in year 1881, man take him to law for take other man, no paper. paper tell many people. law say he be right.

in year 1881, day 29 of month 4, he join big white house as help person, but still keep watch. he leave watch work in year 1892. paper say he get high level. on day 3 of month 6, year 1896, he become chief of big white house. he take place of army man who be chief from month 3, year 1893 to month 12, year 1895. from month 8, year 1887, paper use word chief for one help person, to tell he be top man over other people. name of chief come only in year 1897. he be first man use name, but name healthy only last four year of five year in work.

he watch over 10 help people. he have control over watch people in big white house, but not out on land there. as chief, he also control who can come in big white house. more than 500 people come through house every day, for look and work. he watch over many thing people lose, and find in house.

he be sick many time, and it lead him to leave work. he get bad sick for two week in month 11, year 1892. he get ill again in month 9, year 1899. by month 11 many people fear he die. but he live, and come back to work on day 20 of month 12, year 1899.

he body still weak, so on day 2 of month 1, year 1902, he say please to chief of land for simple work at other place. chief of land say yes. he go work at money place for old man.

no one know how long he work at money place. he have woman, Mary. she die about day 7 or 8 of month 12, year 1907.

he go far from Washington in year 1909, but after eight month he come back to live in town in year 1910. he die in house on day 29 of month 4, year 1910. no one know why. he be in holy group in town, but he be put in sleep place of land.

Philo Belden live from year 1815 to year 1889. he be first man of north land. he help make new small town on river. he live in big house of land and in big house of north.

Belden be come to birth in old town of east land. he be one of six child of father and mother. he go out of east land in year 1835. he get land in new west land. but in year 1836 he go to land part in west. after that, he want give he new west land and get land in town on river, in year 1838.

in month 10, year 1839, Belden and Martin and three other first man make map of all town land west of big river. they also make map of land east of big river, south of big road.

Belden make many good thing for town. he build wood cut house in year 1840. in year 1842 he build wall for water power on big river. also in year 1842 he make first bread grain house in town. he run it as only man till year 1846. he also run iron house, which make iron thing for grain house and wood cut house. he also build first brick smoke pipe in town. he bring brick from mouth of root river.

in year 1855, Belden make company for iron road. it test to build iron road from town far south to big town on lake. road go through three small town. he get many rich man in big town on lake. he change company to new name, iron road of north land. Belden be head of company. company almost end make hole road but never put iron. Belden lose much money when company end bad.

Belden get first seat in year 1839. he give work as judge of peace in land part. king of west land, Henry, give him this seat. in year 1842, other king give him same seat again. he go on town board. he work five time on land part board. he be head of land part board in year 1854.

in year 1852 Belden go to big house of land as man of one group. he speak against keep man as thing and for no drink.

he go back to big house in year 1864 and in year 1866 as man of Republic group. in year 1870 he get seat for land part in big house of north. he go as man of Republic group.

in year 1882, king of north land give Belden open judge seat in land part. he get full time that same year. he leave this seat in year 1889, one week before he die. one son of son, one young man, get seat to end judge time. after that, he go to high house.

Philo Belden die on day 9 of month 9, year 1889, in small town. one come together for dead man on day 11 of month 9, year 1889, in church of big town on lake. he be put in earth in dead place.

on day 6 of month 6, year 1839, he married Mary Francis Belden. she come from far town, daughter of man Henry. they have four son. first three son fight in American war. they fight in army of north.

Henry Belden join 24 north land group. after that, he become chief of ship of 37 north land group. he married woman from small town on river. he move to big town on lake. then he live in south land. they have five child. one son be judge. more be Louis, Robert, Charles, and one girl.

Edward Belden join 1 north land big gun group. he live in Washington. he married one woman. after war he move to west land, then far west land.

Albert Belden, only 15 year old, join when big chief call for 60 day man. he work as low man in 39 north land group. he married woman from north town. he live in small town on river. they have one son call Philo.

one more son married one woman, then end that married. then he married second woman and live in town. he have one son with first woman, call Louis.

Antonio Nardi be writing man from Italian land. he live from year 1598 to year 1648? he be know for number work with star man and two young man. he also make big book, of many page. this book talk about wise thought, natural thing, good way to live, writing and number.

very little be know of early time of Nardi. true, till not long ago, day and place of holy water be not certain. day 8 of month 11, year 1598, he get holy water in small church in small town. father and mother of him be small rich people from big town. he get degree in law, in year 1621, at big school. there he may come to know one teach man, who hold seat of number at school. this man be long friend and help of star man.

in year 1630, Nardi join group of young man, who learn from teach man, in Rome. group also have two other man. after book of star man come out in year 1632, Nardi and two man send many letter to star man. letter say good thing about big book of two big world. letter also say bad thing about man who fight it. star man see love of them and call them three strong man in Rome.

in year 1635, brother of father of Nardi get him work in house of church chief in Rome. house have many wise man, like head of book. Nardi be there till church chief die in year 1641.

round this time, Nardi send letter again to star man. this time he send some of he number work. this be from big book of Nardi, about old wise number man. this book have new, good way to make see old idea. it use new way of small part, from one man of Italian land. letter back from star man be not here. but after letter of Nardi make see star man like he work, and Nardi even think of print of it. this idea fall through, but, when star man die in year 1642, early after death of other church chief.

no thing be know of when and where Nardi die. after two wise man die of bad sick in year 1647, no mark of him be in letter of star man friend. it be probable he too be kill by bad sick.

almost 1400 page long, book 130 be top of work of Nardi, put together number work with many kind of learning, from god knowledge to old language. book be make word in clean, good Italian language. all of it make see high wise level. but Nardi say he not make big new thing in any one field.

what be strange of this work, but, be that it seem to not enough any kind of order. it jump, not with care, from wise thought of old Greek man to talk about writing of man of France.

certain i put them in place where they seem to me not all with no order.

big book have never come out in print, and this may be why Nardi be little know now. but in he time, this be not so. two young man and one man of France see some part of work of Nardi and think high of it. true, young man work near with Nardi on big book, give some of him number work. he after print that work in year 1666. that also have writing about body of man, from one young man who learn from him.

Theodore Daphnopates be big man of Roman land. he be chief secretary. he work for three king, king 1, king 7 and king 2. he become high man and chief of town. big work of him end when new king come, year 963. then he go to rest. he also make many talk and book for church. few still live. he be know most for letter. some wise man say he make last part of old story book of Roman king.

Daphnopates have birth between year 890 and 900. he come from mountain land in east. he speak that land language. he put letter of church man from that language to Greek. mother of him come by ship to town on east side of small sea, may be about year 920. on way back, big wind come on ship. Daphnopates almost die in water. only with big work and good chance ship get to land near hard point.

Daphnopates first be see in old writing in middle of year 920. he go in king house short time before. in year 924 and 925, he make three letter answer to king 1, to letter of north king. in this letter, king 1 say north king want take all and like war. king 1 want make peace. this end long war between Roman land and north land. ten more letter to king and church man of north and east land, make for king 1 from year 925 to 933, still live. this be sign Daphnopates may be chief of king writing house. some new wise man think Daphnopates make talk for peace in year 927, when north king son take woman, king 1 child child. one Greek wise man say no.

Daphnopates keep in king writing house under king 7 after year 945. in late year 945 and 946 he make sign letter from king to holy man of Greek land. about same time he also make letter to king about good talk about new dead man, some wise man think he be king 1 of Roman land. this man die on day 15 of month 6, year 948. king send man from king house with rich give. after work of Daphnopates under king 7 be hard to know. but he come back under king 2, who come after king 7, year 959 to 963, same work. three letter, 13, 14, 16, still live to king. one letter, 15, from king 2 to Daphnopates. king 2 make him go up to high place, chief of town. letter 15 say near to king. king want he tell what dream be. in dream, king want bring back one high man, may be old chief of town, or church chief of Greek land. bad to him by this, or not like to bring back this man, Daphnopates make soft answer.

after king 2 die, day 15 of month 3, year 963, Daphnopates may make talk for dead man. short time after, new king come up, and Daphnopates go to rest. most probable reason be he be old. new king not bad to him. Daphnopates keep talk with high man, two new chief, and help old friend. two more letter give hope to man who fall from high place, may be from same time.

with king work and letter, Daphnopates work hard as man of writing. most of work of him not still live. he make many talk and holy story book, one for holy man George, and one for holy church man from long ago. some say Michael make one of this group. he also make small book of John, gold mouth, from many old wise many man. Alexander say this kind of work be common in year 900 time. John say Daphnopates make old book, and John use that book. John also use part of old book for early time. so some new wise man think Daphnopates make last part of that book, to year 963. other wise man, French and Greek, say no.

James Preston Poindexter live from year 1819 to year 1907. he be man who speak against owner keep people as property. he want right for black people. he be church teach man in big town of Ohio.

he start live in big town of Virginia, on day 26 of month 10, year 1819. mother of him be black and red skin people. father of him be white man. father of him may be brother of George, second chief of south land. father of him be man of writing of news for big paper in Virginia. mother of him die when he be four year old.

as child he go to school. at ten year old he learn hair cut work. he work in rich man store. he know many chief of big town in Virginia. after he move to Ohio and live in big town there at 12 year old. he keep go to school, now private, and cut hair. this give him many good friend. in year 1840 time he be married. in month 5, year 1887, he give church talk to wise young people at school. school give him great name, Dr of god word.

he be wash in church in big town of Ohio, in year 1840, first warm time of year. in year 1849 he be make church chief. from year 1862 to year 1893 he lead second church. he be part of group of church lead. after he be chief of that group.

he speak many time against owner keep people. many church man do not answer, they say god word let it. he answer them with god word. about year 1857 he be chief of secret group for help. he keep that place for 30 year. this group help black people run to free land. other black man fight against owner in big town too. many white man help them.

in month 12, year 1848, he help bring Frederick to big town to speak at meeting of free land man.

after war of year 1861 to 1865, he be chief to help black child learn at school. in year 1872 he be send to big meeting in big town far north. he go to land meeting many time. in year 1873 he be first black man in Ohio put forward to run for seat in house of wise many man. but big group of other man win in that place.

from year 1880 he work two time, four year, in town wise group. he be second chief in that group. he be put in hollow place in school board. after he win that place, from year 1884 to year 1893. he be put forward for four year work at Institute for no see people, by chief Charles. he be put forward to help big school in Ohio by chief George. but group of wise man say no in year 1885, for political reason. in year 1887 he be put forward for six year work with forest office of Ohio. he be put forward two more time.

in month 9, year 1888, he lead big happy meeting for 100 year of free land. in year 1898 chief of Ohio put him forward for wise school work. he be first black chief of judge group in Ohio. he many time do writing for many paper. he work near with big chief of land, and with William, Ohio chief.

in year 1898 he leave lead of second church, but he keep speak god word. he die in big town in Ohio, day 7 of month 2, year 1907, of chest sick. he leave two child of child. first house for poor people in big town of Ohio be call Poindexter village, name for him.

Jeremiah Yates act for political right of poor people. he go to prison for one year, for bring work people out. this be in year 1842, when pot work fight in England.

Jeremiah Yates come in year 1810, in pot town of England. when he married Smith woman in year 1837, he move to new place. he be pot man by trade. he keep drink house and rest house with woman, in house of same place.

in late 1830, Jeremiah Yates act with political right group. this group start in year 1836. it want power and right for work people. at that time, after 1832 law not work, only 18 of 100 old people can say who rule land. there be also big poor and no work. 1834 law take out help for poor. poor have to live in house for poor, where family not live together. this wrong thing help this group grow big, most in north of England.

Jeremiah Yates become strong help of this group. he go to meeting and offer many paper of group from drink house of him. one paper come from friend Thomas, chief of group, who be also wise word man. in year 1843, he name first son with long name, after old big many man of this group. this thing keep on till now in family.

in year 1839, this group give British house of common big paper with six big want. one want be say in rule for all man over 21. other want be secret say by paper, and no money need to become rule man. money for rule man. same size part for say. say every year for house of rule. but 1250000 people sign it, house say no, 235 to 46. second paper, also want free from rule about god, be talk on day 5 of month 5, year 1842. paper have over 3300000 sign. house say no again, 287 to 49.

when house say no in may 1842, many poor people with no work stop work. this become big stop work in north of England. first, black rock man stop work in early month 6, year 1842. by end of month 7, stop work be all over north part. many pot man and work people join. money cut make it bad.

group want all work to stop across pot town. on day 15 of month 8, group call meeting at big place of talk. people say yes or no to stop all work till people paper be law of land. about 8000 to 10000 people be there. after strong talk by Thomas, decision go through. then group of man, with Jeremiah Yates, leave to make other people stop work.

one man who see it at law talk say this. on morning of day 15 of month 8, Jeremiah Yates lead big group of 200, most black rock man, to work place of two man. they go in, stop all man from work, and take them out.

Jeremiah be take at work 6 day after, on day 21 of month 8. in month 10, year 1842, he be find wrong for fight and fear make. he get one year prison punishment, and be in prison in London.

Jeremiah punishment be small. other man do bad. break, fire and kill. by day 16 of month 8, trouble get big. war man come in to make order. they be tell to fire at group of man who stop work in big square. one man die, many more get sick. group hit back. they break house of rich black rock man, god man, law man, and rule house. in special law talk after, 274 people be bring to law. 146 go to prison. 54 be send out for up to 21 year to Australia.

when Jeremiah be free from prison in month 10, year 1843, he can not get work at pot place again. punishment and strong hate of rich man against group stop him. still, Jeremiah be in group. he hold meeting at drink house. he fight for free of group man in prison. he lead talk at big place against two paper law about work and Irish name. in 1845 he be name man to speak for group at land meeting. in 1848 he speak at land company meeting in far place. in 1845, he get work as help for road man of this town.

after short sick, Jeremiah die, say man of knowledge, from sick fall. this be on day 11 of month 10, year 1852, when he be 42 year old. he be put in earth at god house of St Mary. news paper of day 23 of month 10, year 1852 say this. body of him go to earth place with many friend, walk in line. road from big place to god house be full of people. big group of people be round earth place.

Giuseppe Sterzi live from year 1876 to year 1919. he be Italian man who learn about body, brain and medical history.

though he learn for no more than 15 year, many thing he learn be important to brain body and history of body.

Sterzi learn about brain body and birth of baby. many people then say he be right. many of what he find be put in body book.

Sterzi win many reward. among them be one from Institute, in year 1909, and one from Institute of France in Paris, year 1912.

Sterzi come from rich family in small village in Italy. father of him be machine man. when young he fight in fight against Austrian rule. mother be Carolina.

in year 1893 he go to big school, and join medical school. chief of school say him come to body room. in year 1899 he get medical card. few month after he become teach man in body room of big school, then lead by man of great name.

in year 1906 he become teach man of body form, with one year work. in year 1910 many man take him, and he become full teach man and chief of body room in big school in south island.

in summer of 1915, Sterzi go to Italian army. there he work as medical man. after end of big fight, Sterzi have high place in army and can leave, but he stop. he stop as chief of medical house in small village while Spanish sick time. in winter of 1919 he get hot sick and die when he live 43 year. he leave woman, and four son, one of them after become medical man and teach man of skin body.

Sterzi make two book. first be about brain nerve of animal with back bone, 1907 to 1912. second be about brain nerve body of man, 1914 to 1915. John, one of many American man of same time, say in look again, year 1908, that Sterzi work say will do to be most big work in any language about brain nerve of animal with back bone.

Sterzi make book of seven paper from 1899 to 1902. paper be about skin round brain and back bone. Sterzi make see how skin look in animal, from small sea animal to man. not like before say, skin round back bone in low animal and young stage of high animal be very simple. after, that skin break in two, one in side and one out side, call hard skin. in high animal, in side skin break again in two more skin. in same animal, Sterzi make see that in back bone hard skin keep form, but in head bone it join bone skin, year 1902. he also make see all skin join with nerve cover and with thin cord at end.

second group of learn, about blood line in back bone and brain stem, start with talk give by young Sterzi at 14 meeting of German body man in year 1900. it with paper of 370 page make in German, year 1904, about body and birth of this blood line from round mouth fish to man. Sterzi make see that in round mouth fish and young stage of high animal, back bone get blood from skin blood line. it be only after that blood line go in back bone in many way. he also make see that low animal have part of back bone get blood from blood line, and other part from blood pipe. after, blood come same way, to make long line in first body. in year 1913, Sterzi make learn of development of blood pipe in high animal, in back bone, back brain and bridge. he see this blood pipe keep same form in bridge, but in low part, because of middle crack, they make one middle line.

in paper about small small body part under brain, year 1904, Sterzi learn about round mouth fish. not like before man say, he make see no small body part of that kind be in this fish. he also learn about this small body part in all animal with back bone.

in paper about top of brain in low animal, year 1905, Sterzi make see that some body part be one, and some body part be two. but two kind, in grow round mouth fish, become not even and be in middle under top of head, which have crack. they have look of kind of eye.

Sterzi make group of writing about brain body, from year 1912 till year 1914.

first writing, in year 1912, be about how big brain crack grow. Sterzi tell that, not like old word, long crack not from push of hard band in head, but from fast grow of big brain from side part of front brain bag. he also say three hole have not only back part, but also small front part from front brain start.

in second writing, year 1914, Sterzi say old thought be wrong. other medical man, year 1911, say man brain be two part. new top brain, and old other brain. Sterzi tell that even in part that other medical man call old brain, there be new brain part also. Sterzi tell that not all brain part grow from low animal to man, because in long growth, some part grow and other part go back.

in year 1909, Sterzi make writing about form and early grow of small ear bag. in man this bag be in head bone, but in low back bone animal, it be between hard band and head bone. it be not in sea fish, and may be in round mouth fish.

in writing of year 1910, Sterzi look at under skin substance with care, in it general kind. growth, time order, sex, and food condition. also it be tell in many part of man body. under skin substance be in two part. top and deep. in head, neck, body and near arm and leg, they be separate by middle part like muscle in other milk animal. this middle part in man make skin muscle of head and neck, and some under skin muscle of back hole ring. in other part it make top cover, which be not in far arm and leg.

by look in old book house of Italy town, Sterzi come to know that old medical man give in will to government of Republic big book of body picture, that many think be lose for 200 year. Sterzi find them, with three other book of old medical man, in book house of sea town. of 300 table old medical man say, there be only 167, join in eight book. seven about man, and one about other animal body. also be most important body book of 16 hundred year and 17 hundred year. big picture table, big page, make first colour body book, paint by hand, in all time. in writing of year 1909, Sterzi can find that old medical man put in this picture what two old cut many man of he learn.

in writing of year 1910, Sterzi tell live story and work of this cut medical man, and how body learn teach go in medical school in that town. work of this man be book about voice and ear, book of five feel, and picture body book. this man start as house servant of old medical man, then become cut man, and at last first to teach cut work in that town. writing tell in detail, and also long fight that come after between him and he old chief.

Sterzi make writing in year 1910 about time when medical man Joseph from cold east land teach in that town, from year 1510 till year 1568.

writing of year 1910 be small tell of brain learn, from straight reading of old writing. of idea that Sterzi tell, one be from old Greek man, who say man have three spirit with different work. this idea be like new thought of three part brain, year 1970. he also tell about brain learn growth from big change time of Europe till 19 hundred year. he push big value of body learn and early grow in other animal, start by old man and after bring back by two other man.

after that, in same year, Sterzi make other writing, where he tell that one old man, not other man as many think, be first to find small hole in heart.

two man of Blumwes be German. they be strong man, and chief of work place in Bydgoszcz. this be from year 1850 to year 1899. house of them and make thing still be in town now.

one of Blumwes come in world on day 20 of month 10, year 1827, in small town. when young, he go to far town and learn iron work. he come to Bydgoszcz as head of man on steam rail, about year 1850. he live at house on street 42.

in year 1865, he open work place of him for work and make farm machine, under name of Blumwes. in year 1869 it move to land on street 94. it be small iron place, good at make cart and wood machine. in year 1878 he get small iron place on street from man, make it big, and put in steam engine. in year 1878 company take name of Blumwes and son, because son of him take over chief work in early year 1880. in year 1884 name change to Blumwes and son, iron place for cart and wood machine. this be base of now wood machine place.

now, place make only cut machine, wood machine and steam engine. because of good work and good thing, company get big name. in year 1886, it have more than 100 man.

one of Blumwes die on day 11 of month 3, year 1887, in Bydgoszcz. burn bone of him be put on top of son big house in middle of town. he be married to woman, and have many child.

second son of Blumwes come in world on day 11 of month 8, year 1853, in far town. in Bydgoszcz, he go to school in year 1850 and end it in year 1871. he then learn machine work, first in Germany, then in England, and in north land over sea. he come back to Bydgoszcz in year 1878, to take chief work of father company.

after father die in year 1887, he make work place big, and put in light and electric move thing. in year 1896, he build new iron place, good for this time. in year 1897, company change to company with money man. he be big money man and chief. at end of year 1800, company have branch in Berlin, and in two more big town in land. they send make thing all over Europe, even to China, to America and Africa. in year 1899, work place have 22 chief and 250 man who work. at big time, company also have more land on north side of street, in front of work place, use for keep thing.

on top of work, he help people very much. in year 1889, man who work more than 10 year at place get money to keep, 50 mark. he also make insurance for sick man and for death of man. in year 1900, he make house for child of man who work near by, in house on street 47 now.

he be part of group of rich man who think like new law, but not take big part in law fight. for many year, he work in near trade group, and become part of board in year 1897. he also take part in work of history group of land, and German group for art and knowledge. in two group, he be board man.

Basimba be African people. they speak old talk. other name for they be big lion. they live in east part of Africa.

name Basimba be old. it come before year 1200. name Basimba use for people, or for place where they come from. early people use name for all group of big cat family, in north land and east land.

before king land come, this place have old name. with help of 13 family, one chief make king land. it be in year 1300. Basimba and big cat family be part of 13 family. first king of that land be top chief.

big cat family have hard time many year, because they help make king land strong. under one king, 400 man of this family be kill from year 1674 to 1680, in middle place of king land. so they keep secret who they be. same hard time against family be record under other king too.

Basimba be call family that rule, like other king family. other king family move from far west king land to river land, in north land.

many king group be know in Basimba, also big cat family. Basimba king group get attack many time, because of king family. one branch of big cat family be able to take king seat. king of king land take this branch and kill most man, so king have few chance to lose power.

after king of king land die, he woman of big cat family rule as king. this be for 18 month, year 1554 to 1556. after this, new name join big cat family. name tell other family in king land that woman of big cat family have power one time. name say i eat it, so family take king power one time.

though little old writing be about Basimba big lion people, we must talk about them, because they be near other Basimba, all big cat family. most Basimba people say they come from far west land, from people of king land. little be know about come people, but mark of they history be in old story of one first father.

one first father live on east side of big water. he face hard time from north people and south people. he and friend go over big water. they move to west side after bad idea against he come to near big water. then they go over one river, and come to river side of big river, in year 1550 to 1600. son of he, and friend, go on up river, while other go other place.

one group name say they go by way by water. other group name say they go by way on land while move. other group move to east side of big river and other river, with Basimba people and other tribe.

first group move to land of cow people, and east. they go by big river east. they friend go by big river to back of wet lake place. about year 1600, people come slow to mountain from flat land, and name mountain. at last, one man and he father go far over river to current place near river. they live in south part of big water land. other big cat family join they there. they not fight with other people who move to high land.

Basimba seem to come in many group, under many chief. when they come to river land in north land, and to middle place of king land, they make up mind to live. chief become head of family. after many year, first chief become big story to he family.

Basimba people be know as first people, because they be first to come in north land and east land. old story of people here say first people be big cat family name Basimba, who live on island in south east end of big water. no one know what talk they speak, and no child of they live now. old story say no thing of fight between Basimba and people they find in east land and at middle place of king land. Basimba of big cat family win against other people in north land.

old land of Basimba people be not know. many story and old talk tell of this. they seem to lose touch with old father in far west land, among other people. some Basimba move north from big water and river land. some go to west part of east land, and live among other people there. other Basimba live at middle place of king land, at other place near big hill, and in east part of Africa. other Basimba live in north land, which one time be part of far south land.

Basimba do sing and dance for spirit. this be like holy dance of island people. Basimba people of island land be take far over sea as servant.

Basimba people of Africa keep spirit stone. this stone speak of spirit, and spirit be king power. no stone make no political power. African belief say spirit be same as king. spirit be keep in special basket, cover with cloth. basket be put in holy house for spirit.

Basimba people work with holy man of king. holy man keep holy water. every year king send young woman, two cow and one white sheep to holy man. young woman be give as married woman to one Basimba man, servant of holy man.

Basimba think dead go to other world, in new form. Basimba respect dead like living father and mother. Basimba do song and dance to talk with dead. this be like holy art of island people. island be make free land by big war chief in year 1804. this dance last all night, and be do many time.

Basimba dance be hunt dance. people of big island do this dance.

Basimba family group name in Africa come from first father.

now, 40 to 50 of 100 Basimba be Christian. 50 of 100 be Muslim. also, old belief be very wide among them. big thing be respect of first father, and sign animal. some man say this word be wrong.

Basimba of big town kill Dr. Paul, man of Christ house. this be in year 1964 to 1965, in big war. Basimba of this group join big fight, after, they lose.

Basimba sign animal be use from first time of Basimba people. sign animal cut family group among Basimba. this group make old king family. seven different sign animal be know among Basimba people in Africa, like Basimba of other tribe in east land.

people of same family group use same sign animal. sign animal be animal or bird.

some animal sign be big cat, small cat, lion, dog and bird. people of same sign come from one first father, so they must not be married. sign animal go over land, so it be wall between group.

Basimba chief must know history of family group from first father. only then can he make chief.

sign animal system be big trouble for many child with no mother or father. Basimba woman be married to man of other family. they be most sad. Basimba people be afraid of ghost. ghost hit them if they break law of sign animal of child they find. so hard to find new father and mother for child like this. if child grow up, they have trouble to be married. at death, they not put in old earth of Basimba.

sign animal be very important when person die. person with other sign can not start to put dead in earth. only person with same sign, even from other tribe, can start this work. for example, African man with big cat sign can start work for Basimba man with same sign. this be good in Basimba way. but Basimba man of other sign can not do this.

if person start to put dead of other sign in earth, he be in danger to give money to dead family. old way be cow or goat. now people want much money. if they put family of dead in earth, they must come back to make clean stone of dead.

Basimba people be servant of one big king spirit. they live in small village of 50 to 100 people. in year 2016, they be 100,000. there be seven Basimba big lion people. family group name come from animal.

some Basimba move north from river land after old king land break. other Basimba live in north land, now call Basimba of big cat sign family. this Basimba family be king family among other tribe.

Basimba people live in many land of Africa. one land have old name, north land. one land be island. more land be near big lake, and more land be east of Africa. word Basimba have many sense. Basimba can think people with Basimba root, all where they live. they live in town or in old Basimba land. old Basimba land be in small village, near big lake, in north land. more land be near Africa, among other tribe, in big wood. first language of Basimba people be not know.

Basimba people live in north part of land, among other tribe. they speak language most near to other tribe language. this language many people speak in east part of land. most people in country speak this language, but not always as first language.

history of Basimba people, big lion people, be hard to know. wise man fight about it. some say. Basimba of animal group come with king in year 1300, or come from far land or big river?

some wise man, story man and knowledge man have book about Basimba people. but they not say name of old Basimba man who leave big group in far land and go to many land. some history man of Africa use old paper with not clear word. take such think with care.

group of knowledge man in London have not still make book about physical and living way of Basimba people. because name Basimba sound like other name, other people who go from east Africa and live on big island be family of Basimba.

history leave few mark of woman. but if woman part in society help peace process, as Benjamin think it do, then Sarah can get credit for help peace law in year 1783. when Mr Jay come back to new York, he get work for far land people. he come from family of horse man. Candidus start in army. at last he be food chief in second journey of old king against German man, in year 178 or 179. then in time of young king, he be lift to high place by word of king, and make one of big man in Rome.

work go on in east part of land. Candidus help Roman chief in Asia. after that, he take care of two big town in east. he may be in east, or he may be chief of one army in west land. then one man, chief in west land, say he be king. this be in year 193, after king of Rome kill.

for big journey to east land, one man make special army from good people of west army. he put Candidus in top place. while king be in one town, Candidus take people across sea. he find black man army and win fight near sea town. after fight, one chief of black man army be take and bring to Candidus. Candidus kill him.

black man come to lead people at one town. at fight there, he fight against army of Candidus. Candidus be lose fight at first, but he call people together and win again. black man run off and go to one big town in east.

one man say this time black people change from kind people to angry owner of they land, against white man who come near them. order to take him start in year 1846.

year 1840 to 1841. big push of white man want land to keep sheep. north land be open for white man to live on.

year 1841, month 9. black many man kill sheep and take animal. this be small answer to white man take black land.

year 1842, month 1. big kill of 30 to 60 black people near station of white man, with food that have poison in it.

year 1842, month 6. Dundalli come together John, Irish man who run out from prison in far town.

group have eat for 18 day, and talk wire, so they can talk all time as they go 146 long part across dry sand land.

chief and group start walk at 5 30 on day 29 of month 7. they walk only at night, so man who watch not see them. there be no road or way. land be broken rock and low sand, very hard to find way in dark. chief push group fast, to get to enemy before help come. group walk till middle of night, 16 long measure. sleep in day not possible, because of hot heat. only when they find shade in dry land can tired man rest.

walk go on like this till small village, day 4 of month 8. one man fire gun at group, and tell chief that enemy know he come. chief know more enemy help will go to Abu Hamed. chief make group go more fast, even with 3 man die. 58 man fall back on road. group join with 150 more man on day 5 of month 8. night of day 6 of month 8, group walk 16 more long measure over hard land to small town near Abu Hamed. here half of group be back to keep cart of food and gun safe. after 2 hour rest, chief tell man to get ready, and start last attack.

Abu Hamed be small town of many house and small road, on side of big river. 3 side of town be high flat land. 3 stone watch be near. from this watch, man see group come from north. help from far town not come in time. but chief of town not go. enemy man go fast to hold wall of town. enemy man with gun be in hole in front of town. other man with stick be in house and street. small group of man on horse be near, ready to act. all tell, 400 to 1000 man hold town.

chief group go to town in half round form. from left, group 10 and group 9. then weak group 3 from Egypt and group 11. big gun be with weak group 3 from Egypt. group come to high flat land over town, about 300 measure far, at time 6 15. chief see enemy ready in hole. he tell big gun to start at time 6 30. but gun not hit in narrow hole or break wall where enemy man hold. chief stop gun. he tell man to go forward in order. tell man to make sharp stick ready. man go across 300 measure, that be between them and enemy.

but enemy man with gun be safe in hole. every group must fire gun with no order. gun fire of group be little strong against enemy, who still not fire back. when man be half way across, fire line join, so group 10 on left must stop. stop to not be hit by fire of group 11 on right.

enemy be in hole with old gun and bad fire. they be in hole till man be in range. they hold on with much fire till way get short, 100 measure. then enemy line open fire all at one time. hit man, most of all group 10 be still. British chief Henry and British man Edward die. 3 man from Egypt die, and 12 more man die in fire. over 50 man get wound. after this, group not keep order. they run at hole with sharp stick. big fight come. man of group go in hole and through town, fight hand to hand with enemy, in narrow house and small road of Abu Hamed. in some part, big gun be use to push out strong man. while man on horse see chief group go through town, turn and go south to far town.

by 7 30, town be strong in hand of general chief army.

almost all of enemy army, but not horse man, be kill in bad fight all over town.

now machine use good solid acid. it last long, many hour. when change to very mixed form, this go up by much. in year 2005, people see this work well at 250 degree, in wet air. machine need wet air. if no wet air, this acid break to stone and water.

air go to first side. there it break in small thing. small thing go through solid acid to other side. other small thing go by long way, make power. on other side, small thing join with air and make water. water go out.

this machine work at warm, so it can use normal metal and soft thing that break at hot. also, this make machine not sick from dust in air, like bad air or bad thing. machine can use air from oil, milk, and other thing.

other machine that work at very hot, this one work good at low warm. at hot, thing break. at low warm, thing be still. this machine work at warm, not hot, so it not break. also, low warm can use cheap thing. this make machine cheap.
