Edwards come to live in day 27 of month 7, year 1857, in north part of America. he be son of William Edwards, man who build road, and of mother, woman call Jane.

as young man, he test hand at few different work before he join rod company in year 1882 as one of first learn. he leave that north land to go after that man to new place. there he learn rod make. other great rod make man work there too. Thomas be one. George be other. two more be many man with same name. with they, that man make new machine for cut rod.

in year 1889, Edwards, with Thomas and two man, leave that store to start new work together. with Edwards know light wood plant well, two man know machine, and Thomas know how to lead, this hard quick start with name of big play house. they make very good rod. they start make high mark for new fly rod.

after start, one of two man leave. other man come in place of he.

this rod make see at big play place in year 1893, and win big gold thing. in year 1894, in time of bad money, play house give part of this to big net house. this rod now be well know, though time of make be small.

Thomas go back to north land. two man start make rod by self. Edwards leave for far place in west. he may have family there. people think he learn short time with man who make picture with camera, in one of two place. then he come back to east and England land after about one year.

at 58 year old, after 15 year rest from rod make, Edwards start make rod again. he test new thing with light wood plant in secret. when he start make rod again, they have new good thing in them.

he find way to heat light wood plant with open fire. it get more strong, come back quick, and have small weight. new heat light wood let Edwards make rod short. it do good work with no need of full long long, as normal then for fly fish. of him rod of seven and half foot, and short rod too, be big thing. this be new thing, and make Edwards rod important in make of new dry fly rod.

between year 1914 and year 1919, Edwards make rod in north town with two son. this rod have new mark of Edwards rod, like name in white on wood near hand. they make rod with name of other big play house. in year 1919, big gun house get Edwards rod company.

Edwards be keep to watch work in east town. while there, Edwards make two kind of light wood rod. one be low good, and he only watch it. other kind be special, and make by hand of Edwards. this last kind be very high good, and have few seven foot rod. after 5 year, Edwards leave big gun house in year 1924, though he keep build rod at he house. big gun house keep make all Edwards rod till year 1930.

Edwards move to house 40 in town, while still at gun house. he get house in year 1922. he live there for rest of time. of him last woman keep live at house 40 after he die, and one son too. he work from house 40 till year 1927, when he move work to big house in near town. Edwards make four kind of rod. he have six man to work, with two son too. one big rod man also work there when he be child. in year 1927, name of company change to Edwards and son. company make rod for many store, and for Paul too, and for more. in year 1931, Edwards and son give company to big make house.

Edwards come to live in year 1857, in north part of America. of him old father make word for news paper in town, and self part of it. of him great old father be big man in army.

through live, Edwards test many work. as young man, he start small work with fruit and sweet food. he keep book for money, and work with hand, before he learn rod make. he make picture with camera for work.

in year 1886, Edwards take married woman, one woman. they have son, William, in year 1887. in year 1895, Edwards and family leave for far place in west. Edwards go back to east land and make picture with camera. in year 1896, he go to north town and start make fly rod with Thomas. then he go back to camera picture, and still work for Thomas part time. in year 1915, Edwards start make rod with name of he.

Edwards get new married woman in year 1900. in year 1902, they have son too.

after become sick in year 1931, Edwards make agreement to trade fly rod company. trade become hard because of great bad time. Edwards die at small place, on last day of that year. he put in earth at place for dead, same rest place as other two man.

John Arneaux be man of play. he be news man in York and in Paris, France.

from year 1884 to 1886, he be chief and owner of big news paper. this news paper have more people look at it than any other black news paper. as news man and fight for right, many people like him. he be also play man and head of black play group. together with friend Benjamin, he be great black play man of that time.

say of book from year 1887 by William, John or Jean Arneaux birth in town in Georgia, year 1855. part book on Arneaux say he father come from Paris, France, and he mother, who die when he be 12 year old, be African. but, no man can say this thing be true. he seem to get most of detail about Arneaux from Arneaux self. new wise man have doubt Arneaux when he speak of he past.

many thing about he learn be say, though many be not true. Arneaux go to school from year 1865. for four year he learn at sand sea school in town. then he move to York, where he learn German and Latin. then he be in town north, where he learn French at language school. no record say he can speak French. he then say he go to Paris and learn two thing, one at great knowledge place. but that place never be place of teach. it be group of wise people who make writing. he also say he go in music school in York and end there. this school be true before. but Arneaux seem only say he want go there. he never do it.

Arneaux start in play. in year 1876, he first big stage play be there. he play rich south land man in play by John. he do not at one time go in play work. for time, he work as food man and hair man. in year 1883, he make song about big animal king. in year 1884, play chief tell he to take bad army chief part in play. play be at big house in town. for this, many people say good. this play be make by Benjamin, who have big win in year 1878 as chief of all black play. in this play, Benjamin be army chief, one woman be he woman, and one girl be too. this group then make what may be first play group of black man. this group be call big play group of black man. Arneaux be chief of this group, and group play in all York. in month 11, year 1884, at big music house, group play by John. Arneaux play one friend, and Benjamin play other friend. one woman and one girl be in play too.

in year 1885, Arneaux take big part in play about king 3. play be put in new play competition, judge by news chief from that paper and from other paper. for he work, Arneaux get gold thing. group take play to town north and then back to many new York stage. play go round after year. in month 10, year 1886, one news man say of Arneaux, we see him in hard part of big man. we see other man in same part too. we say Mr Arneaux be very good. about same time, new York news paper give him name, black play man, like well know play man. other play man in that play be Benjamin, who play army chief and king 6, and one woman, who play woman Anne. in month 11, group play again at big music house. same many man play same part, but one woman play girl. one woman sing before play in town north, and all play get good talk from white and black news paper.

in 1886, Arneaux play young man with one woman as girl in play at big house. after that year, Arneaux play king 3 again with John as king Henry and one woman as woman Anne, at big play house. in month 1, year 1887, play be put on at big music house in town. in 1887, Arneaux say he want leave stage for 2 year to make he voice and play good able more good. in this time, he still give some play. he play part of play about one king who kill, with one woman in play, and Thomas as man in play and as man three. this be in month 4, year 1887, at big house. in 1888, Arneaux play part of army chief play and part of king play, with other man and one woman, at big house in town.

John Arneaux make play of Richard 3 like play of other play man. many people say he good at this. he also know for long hair on face, have for that part.

because of big part in that play, many say he go after black play man before him. that man be know in all world for that part, from year 1820 to year 1860. Arneaux be in line of black man who do that part. first be that old play man, then Arneaux, then two more black man.

Arneaux also work in group of many York news paper. first he work one year at big news paper, in year 1883. then he go to other paper, then to paper of sun.

in year 1884 he leave work at paper of sun. he become help chief of new paper, then chief of paper. three man make this paper in year 1883, for club of book people. then he have paper and change name to new York paper. in paper he go against word colour, and say black American be more good. he also want good work school, and make club of Africa history.

in year 1886, many people say this paper be big of all black news paper. people call it most good of black paper. office burn down on day 14 of month 12, year 1886. may by chance. paper stop.

Arneaux be part of big group of black news man then. this man speak well at year 1886 meeting in Atlantic. he also make letter to and be friend of black woman who make news.

in year 1887, Arneaux go back to paper of sun, then to York news paper of world. in month 8, Arneaux again speak at big black news meeting, in river town far south. Arneaux be one of few black man who make word for paper of white man, like paper of sun, paper of world, and York news paper.

late in year 1887, Arneaux go to hill land with idea to move to Paris and act on stage there. news man want know if he will open paper again. but he say chief of black paper lose money on paper. after fire, he not know if paper get help. he want to go back to news work some day after.

before day 14 of month 4, year 1888, Arneaux go to Canada, and after that year to Paris. he have head sick and want change of weather. he live in Europe for ten year. little be know of work after that.

he leave Paris for London in year 1890, then go to Germany. one play make for him in Europe. he say he come back to America in month 10, year 1891, for play. but no go journey ever take place. in year 1900, one news paper say Arneaux be still live in Paris, but not clear if he be there. no other word make see he be there.

he be man of Republic, and open against division of people, black and white, and bad law. he be very strong in way he act. with William, Arneaux fight in public with old black chief man in month 12, year 1884, over that man not do work. he also print many word song, and work in secret society.

Tara house be old house in small town, in land of Canada. old house build by rich trade man and letter chief, from 1837 to month 11 of 1839. man name house Tara house, after old Irish story. story tell of big eat room where people eat, at hill of Tara. this house be good example of old house from time of king George. it have old way of United people, only in this land. it be on list of old house of this land. land law keep it safe. people say it be great work in that day.

Tara house be make of brick, put five deep in beautiful old way. brick come over lake in boat, as weight, when boat go back after carry food to America. house edge have big cut stone. front of house have wide window, with stone top over. stone line cut floor from floor. in time before year 1870, long walk with roof run by all house. only picture and mark of support be left.

few arch roof be over big door room. good old wall top, with form only for every room, be in all house. house have seven fire place, with five smoke pipe. on low floor, east side have long room, which fold in two room, talk room and morning room, with three door, 10 foot tall. morning room open to green house or fruit house, may be late put in, after take off. west side have big eat room, and back of that, learn room. eat room and talk room open on long front walk with roof, by two door with side window. top floor, come up by bent step, have walk go from east to west, to north and south of low floor. across from top of step be new old way door to big dance room of Tara house. off walk be big man room and four more bed room, and servant way to girl room, and step down to cook room at back. one floor tail house winter cook room, and past this summer cook room and small cart house, though fire take this, all lose. under winter cook room be root and wine dark room. in separate build, far back on man 38 land, big cart house and horse house one time be, use together with St Rome Catholic church. over winter cook room be room for two servant. two more house build near land, to house more work man and they family, on road by town line, now road 2. right across from Tara house be first iron work house of man, build before house.

people say secret way under earth go from Tara house to St Rome Catholic church, 160 far, to north. way may be use to take people who run from America. with many boat place and many boat from America, secret way be much use in this land. church part in Tara house, and place right across from big boat place of town, make it good for this use. but secret make it hard to find true writing. other story say secret way come from fight in year 1866.

as big house in town, Tara house be great for big eat day, which last many day.

in year 1844, man give Tara house to Catholic church for 1000 money. church use it as Catholic school for after 12 year, when church not give money for debt, so man take back house in year 1856. man live at Tara house to death in month 1 of year 1864.

in late year 1800, Tara house have secret club meeting, with big day to mark first stone of new town club house in year 1889.

through year 1900 and in year 2000, Tara house be well keep and care. house be still all in every part, as good big house it be in year 1830.

Thomas Williams live from about year 1794 till day 2 of month 12, year 1881. he be man of government in south part of Australia. he work in meeting of government, not as chief, from month 6, year 1843 till month 9, year 1843.

Williams be son of Robert Williams. Robert die in year 1803. mother be Jane. he married her in year 1794. Williams be from old family of land in south place. they have interest in money house.

Williams be one time chief of law in one land. he be join in money house with Williams and company.

he put big money in south Australian company. he work near with John, with George, and with other big man of company.

Williams, Catherine, and much of family go over sea on big ship. they come to south Australia in month 2, year 1839. for time they live in old wood house on one road. this house be make in year 1837. may be first true house in new town. before, other people live in it. one woman, Stephen, and Alfred. house burn in fire in month 5, year 1857.

after prison he have three child. year 1844, 1846, 1848. then he go back to England. he live in old house near London.

Corymbia be one kind of tree. people call this tree by two other name. tree live only in north land. it have smooth skin, green grey to white. skin be rough at base of old tree. leaf be egg form, heart form or sharp form. flower come in group of three or seven. flower be white. fruit be pot form or round form.

Corymbia grow tall. it make round root ball under land. young tree and new grow again have heart form or egg form leaf. this leaf be bright green on top, light under. old leaf come one after other on stem. they be light under side, egg form to heart form or sharp form. many small oil thing can see with eye.

young flower grow on end of small branch. small branch have three or seven young flower. young flower be egg form with round top. flower come from month 8 to month 11. flower be white. fruit be hard pot form or round form, with seed in it.

Corymbia first be name in year 1877 by one German man. he put it in book. first seed be take near sea by one man. in year 1995, two man change name of this tree to Corymbia. they put it in book again. name of this tree be for one Italian man. this man say use tree that like water to dry wet land. this stop sick from insect bite.

tree grow in wet forest, near edge of rain forest. it also grow tall over rain forest. in world it live from one town near north sea to other town. it go far in land to flat land. man use it as fast grow tree. people use it to make land look good. now it grow past first place.

tree now live free in south east land and middle land. many man think it bad plant in south east land. it grow on road edge, near water, in dirty place and waste land. it thick leaf over land many time stop small plant from grow. this change kind of plant in forest of warm land. stick thing from fruit of this tree be take by small bee. bee use it to stop up honey house. some time it stop hole where bee go in. this kill many bee in house.

this tree be put in group of small danger. law of year 1992 say this.

this tree grow fast. people use it on road and near house, far south of first place. it grow in many town in middle land, far in land. it have thick leaf of big size, can make dark place under. many time black sick thing grow on tree. it can make thing under it dirty. big branch can some time break off. this tree cause serious trouble for living thing near sea. more good tree be brush box, other Corymbia tree, and one more tree.

Owain day be hold on day 16 of month 9, in Wales. day be for Owain, last king of Wales, big chief who make first meeting of Wales man.

every year, on day 16 of month 9, many man in Wales make happy day for Owain, who fight against rule of England.

Owain be chief of Wales. he lead long war to make Wales free from England. this war be in old time. he make first Wales meeting of man. he be last man of Wales by birth to hold name king of Wales.

Owain come from king family of one land, from father. from mother, he come from king family of other land, too. this king family come from great king of old time.

on day 16 of month 9, year 1400, Owain say he be king of Wales. he start 15 year war against rule of king Henry 4 of England. man of him win many fight against England man. they take many stone house in Wales, and fast get control of most of land. Owain get help from Scotland and from far land over sea, and get help of king Charles 6 of France.

in year 1403, army of Wales and some France man fight big England army. Owain lead this army, with top chief and other chief from low land. people say king Henry 4 lead England army, in person. fight be in big field in south of Wales. this army win.

by year 1404, England army come 4 time, and lose every time. Owain make control of Wales strong. he hold big meeting in one town, and say big idea of him for free Wales. idea of him be. make 2 big school of knowledge, use old law of Wales again, and make free church of Wales. man come to meeting from France, Scotland, and one king land in Spain.

at first, Owain win much. but in year 1407, England get strong and win back. by year 1409, England army take most of Wales back. Owain be stop in stone house, and England army stop round it. but he get out, by make self look like old man, and slip past enemy at night. he run to far land with small band of man who keep good to him. he keep war with small fight, keep low and hit, in all of Wales and edge of England. last time man see him. year 1412, he hit king man in one town in south, and take one big man of king Henry. Owain say no to 2 offer from new king Henry 5 of England. many gold reward be offer for take him, but he never be give up. death of him be record by old servant, year 1415, at near 56 year old.

after death of him, Owain be like great god in old story, with other old king man of Wales. people look for day he come back and make them free.

Owain be call last king of Wales, many time.

in year 2000, 600 year after Owain war, many make big day all over Wales. one town, where war against England start in year 1400, also have big day. Wales flag fly from many house on day, too. one book man print small paper for this day, as protest against king thing, which not make paper for day. stone house of Owain in small town be open to people for 2 day.

many school and group make this day big. street walk, like fire light, be hold to make day happy.

for near 20 year, man of one town in Wales make happy day for Owain. town man come every year to big horse stone picture of Owain in town square, on day he say he be king, year 1400. day walk take place, and they put flower by stone. after that, church meeting.

day be make happy also in one town, where walk take place every year.

happy day also take place in one town, where Owain hold big meeting for all Wales, before he be king and go to fight England to keep Wales free. many child from 2 school also make talk, before one band walk to stone picture of Owain. walk start at house of Owain. one house in town also have night of music.

one big house of man in control fly Wales flag for happy day of Owain, and also for day of St David.

in year 1999, group in Wales start small fight to make day one day off for all of Wales.

in year 2000, one group call for day to be big day for Wales. they want it for 600 year after war, in year 2001.

in year 2012, one company in one town give work man one way. take day off on Owain day, or on king day of England. they say, so all can join, we give all work man one way of when they like to take this more day off.

in year 2021, one man of big meeting in Wales, David, call for Owain day. he say, any new day off in Wales must have day 16 of month 9 as Owain day.

in year 2021, one woman of Owain day group say. yes, Owain day must be day off so all can make happy.

most of all, big walk and flower ring put at small town stop. but people who make event keep church meeting, talk and town meal as before.

group that keep old stone place say event at small town go forward. but event at old stone house stop. this make many people talk on machine.

he have birth in north land of Spain, to father Jose and mother Maria.

he married Maria on day 25 of month 1, year 1825, and have ten child.

Jose Miguel father and brother of father be horse man with spear, in fast group of San town. they go from town near north land to town of San. work be to keep out Americans from north land, and stop bad take of cow and sheep.

this group be only safe for north land. Americans say edge go far to Gulf of Mexico, and take sea town from Spain. king of Spain say no. king send old, strong horse man to keep north land safe, not take.

this horse group also stop Indian fight that come in middle land of Mexico. horse man also start town, and become man who trade, farm man and cow man. army house be in break, so horse man live in old place with family.

Jose Miguel be only 9 year old when he go to live in old place. he live in old place till he be 17 year old, when father stop work after 32 year of work for Spain. in year 1811, father get land in middle of San town. name of old place change, because of old group name.

Jose Miguel be horse man of family line, number 3. son of him also become horse man, make 4. Jose Miguel be horse man from year 1810 to year 1836. this group break up in year 1836, after new land start.

in year of this time, Jose Miguel be news man for Spain and head man of small group to find new land. by year 1819, still French man live in north land with American man. Jose Miguel know many word. he be secret man for Spain, find news of enemy, France and Americans. he must speak Spanish, English and French well. he also speak many talk of Indian.

this man make agreement with Spain to live in south east land, but he die before he start. after him, son of him come to north land at end of war of Mexico. son be sad to find father paper no good, after Spain no more have power over new Spain, now Mexico. son keep go on with Mexico, and make new agreement that last almost 2 year to make town of 300 old family in south east land in year 1823.

Jose Miguel fight in war of Mexico with father and brother of father. people of north land, Mexico, have to build new land. north land and land of Mexico join as one. north land be rough, hard edge land. after many year of war, fight and Indian attack, land need people in all place.

people of north land have no money to make new land. Indian attack make it hard to make town in land. Jose Miguel get work from government of Mexico to talk peace with bad Indian, so all can live together.

on day 21 of month 10, year 1822, Jose be political chief for north land. he be war head man for Mexico to be free from Spain. he open first money house west of big river. town man Jose Miguel, other town man, head man of town, and he sign money so it can be money for all.

Jose Miguel start work as government and political head man for Mexico from this time. Jose Miguel father die in year 1822 from bad tooth sick. Jose Miguel get land of father in down town of San.

in year 1823, Jose Miguel be law man for north land. he work with this man, also call old man of land. this man be dear friend, other law man, and man who live by him. this man help make north land what it be now. he speak for this son to Spain government, to say yes to paper. when first man die, this man keep help son. he work short time as land man for son and law man for north land, till he die in town, on day 23 of month 2, year 1827. Jose Miguel work for law from year 1828, and again in year 1829, with other law man.

in 1826 Arciniega be order to make peace talk with chief Richard of Indian. he then go to lake land to keep peace talk with 4 Indian group. it take Miguel from day 21 of month 1 to day 15 of month 6, year 1826, to complete this work.

in year 1830, Jose Miguel become land chief. government of Mexico give this work to him. Jose Miguel have power from government of Mexico, by law of day 24 of month 3, year 1825. with rule 11 and rule 34 he make new town. town be seat for this land.

in year 1832, Jose Miguel Arciniega make town. he give name to town to keep memory of old friend, big man in government. Samuel be secretary of this man. Samuel put name of town on land paper, as Samuel do with all land paper. Samuel make them for Jose Miguel to make true.

other man measure town of four land. Jose Miguel be public money man, chief of rule, judge, chief of army, general man of arm, and big man of San in year 1830 and year 1833. he help this man talk to chief of San. chief want side with this man in meeting of year 1833 to separate this land from other land.

in this year Jose Miguel send letter to representative man. he want this man to present idea of Jose Miguel with help of man, man, Jose and Jose Maria. idea. make three tax house, one at harbour by sea, one at harbour of island, and one stop point at edge with north land. many people live here. tax house and stop point stop bad man from sea and bad thing come in. this make trade grow in few year.

from year 1832 to year 1835, Jose Miguel get approval from government of Mexico to have 11 measure of land. this be 48703 measure of land in middle edge between north part of this land and America. this land break in four part. three in north of this land, one in America. he keep goat and many forest by big hole, near big river, red river, and south of lake.

on day 11 of month 12, year 1835, general Martin make Jose Miguel talk man for him for agreement with general Edward. this come after big fight in town, win by people of this land and people who help. Jose Miguel keep work in army for Republic, with son of him Jose Miguel. son of him Jose Miguel work under army of man in year 1839.

Jose Miguel be very much work in Republic time. he work as judge, judge of land, chief of land part, town man, and make edge safe at big river under order of chief David. he be know man of trade always, trade in sugar, potato and grain. he make and trade cart for horse.

in year 1846, in war with Mexico, when Republic join America, Arciniega make edge safe at big river for America, as chief.

on day 13 of month 5, year 1849, Arciniega die young, at 56 year old, near house of him in town of San. no man know true place of rest of him. he be near old holy land, now under green land and sick house of Santa, in town of San.

there be one water house on west side of green land, not all make. in year 1990 time, town of San make it. face of water house have short story of history and long list of old people of San who be put to rest long ago in place that be old. now they still be under green land and sick house of Santa. Jose Miguel, Maria, and other Arciniega, with hundred more name, can be see at green land in San.

child of him and child of them, from group of Jose Miguel, name first house of him Arciniega house on day of birth, day 22 of month 9, year 2013. house still be on edge of Arciniega road and south road, in green land of big house. he and father of him build small house in year 1811. group put up big sign of history on day 15 of month 5, year 2015, in front of house of him for true love of him for this land.

picture of Arciniega paint by art man always, David, from big town.

Cyanea be ghost jelly fish. it live in north part of Pacific, near land edge of China and Japan. with other big jelly fish, it sign more tendency to come in many number and cause burst.

swim stage of Cyanea have flat top bell. this bell can grow to big wide. bell be most time light yellow or white in colour, with dark middle and clear edge. it have eight big edge part and eight group of thread like small arm. there may be hundred or more arm in every group, which be clear or red, and can stretch far. under middle of bell be mouth stick. mouth be round by mixed mass of brown or orange arm.

Cyanea live on land edge of China and Japan. from start of this hundred year time, Cyanea have become more common, with big group come together. in year 2004 this come in part of sea near north east China. people see that money from one kind of food jelly fish get bad hit.

in year 2011, big group of jelly fish come near one town in China. wise man of Japan say this be no jelly fish year. this jelly fish be most of three kind, one of them Cyanea. science place of China be learn how this burst grow and effect on people and living thing.

in year 2014, wise people find this burst may be sign of sea get more sick. this burst join with change of sea heat, more bad dust in water near land, too much fish take by China, net pull on sea floor, and little air in water, cause by water plant burst. this thing help baby jelly live, so more jelly fish come.

many kind of young fish live with this jelly, safe from bite arm of it. two kind of fish live with it. big number of tiny fish come together near and among thin arm. every fish keep off from arm, or bite not do bad to it much. if net take jelly, small fish live with it and may get more bite, so die. as they get more big, fish leave jelly and live by self.

one more small sea thing live with jelly. it stick to edge of bell. it be clear and white like jelly, so hard to see. it always live with jelly, and eat much food in top water where jelly go.

Rajamudy be small town in south hill land. it be in high range, near west hill.

Rajamudy be one of small town in south hill land.

Rajamudy be in high range of this land. it be small part under big town group, at high place. it be at 9. 897032 north and 77. 180953 east. it touch other town in west south. town in north east be 1. 5 far. town in east be 3 to 5 far.

not much sharp hill be here, though high range be near. after flat town, flat land go down to north west, to low land of other town. small river cut Rajamudy and other town. river go on, make Rajamudy good for grow farm. land go more under high place to east. so Rajamudy be beautiful, high land with much food grow. it be safe, free from bad weather and bad thing.

this land get all kind of weather in year. rain and winter bring much water and cold, from high range, hill and forest. but Rajamudy have good, warm weather.

not like other town in this land, people of Rajamudy have self strong way of live, make by people self. way of join, no cut by hate, belief or bad rule. this way of live of Rajamudy be mixed one. this old harmony go back to day of people come, from long time ago. many family and people of different belief, colour, from old day to now day. though big belief of this small town be Christianity, there be no any power over other. no fight, no cut, no bad thing from any chief, from head of belief, in Rajamudy till now. big Christ eat and walk, all people call other people to come, eat, walk and play. in month 12, Christ group go to every house, give food and sweet. same way of live, same join of people.

big language of land be speak by people of Rajamudy. though there be no one who not learn in small town, most people use only this big language. some young people use far language, too. in old day, some people speak self tongue, see among other group. now young people of that group speak and use big language of land.

Rajamudy be all farm. almost all family, 95. 9 of 100, be farm family only. so farm be big way to get money for Rajamudy. few family live by farm work too. few family build house or work in rock hole. no family here have no land or house. big food grow here be black seed, brown seed, and big tree food like elastic tree and big nut tree. sweet dust, hot dust, hot root and yellow root grow here. few family grow food plant too. many fruit tree and food plant can be see here.

from old time, young people of Rajamudy always play. Rajamudy be big in name for ball play. ball field be make in front of Christ house. for more than 20 year, this be good place for all people to come at night hour, play and watch young people play. Rajamudy make many near, part of land and big land fight in ball play. two cup always go round for first and second place win, get gold thing. this tell how much Rajamudy love play.

after year 1991, one of big want of young people come true. big play place be build and open at Rajamudy with help of Thomas and other man of town. place be part of Thomas, two other man and other Christ house. it be also common place for all people to come together and give part. this big use go more. in this place, one only small child house work with good care.

one more play big in name in Rajamudy be pull rope play, old play of this land. Rajamudy always have good group for this play. group go to many part of land and big land fight, win gold thing and good word.

Rajamudy be in one part of big say land. 956 people in this small town have say in big chief. they like all big group of land, big and small.

Rajamudy have two school and one small child house.

old school be run by church, on church land. church start it in year 1983. school be in quiet place, under big tree, good for learn. this be first of two school.

second school be new school, on road to town. it be in big new building, with all new thing. school have big land with three long side. this make school happy, quiet and good place for learn.

near school be old government school, in after town. it start in year 1968, now it be high school. most Rajamudy child get learning up to level 10. before this school, child go to other town for learn.

now Rajamudy have big school of art and science. this be what old family from far land want for long.

church people of one kind, who live at Rajamudy till year 1970, go to St Joseph church, St Mary church and holy family church. church man from this church come to Rajamudy when necessary, for talk to god.

among family who come from far, and other people, few man lead. they take first step to make church for people at Rajamudy.

first church man lead this church.

with chief, few family start work on land, to help church with money. great thing be this, family work and take no money. they never want money back. all work be for church.

one family grow nut tree, other tree and black plant. people always know this work.

so after then church grow big, from small start. church be call king of Rajamudy. now church have more than 280 family and 1000 people. it have many building and thing for people of town. it be only church of this kind at Rajamudy.

church start by early family of Christian kind, from one low group. it start in late year 1960 by few family in house of them, as house meeting. after, with land, this meeting become church in year 1978.

lead family of early people help make church. there be 27 family in this church, about 150 people.

this church be not as old as other two big church. but meeting and talk to god start in early year 1970.

Anguanax be one kind of sea animal, all dead now. it live in late time of old sea, about 160 000 000 year ago. it be find in north part of Italy, in old rock level.

Anguanax be know only from one big bone group. it keep now in old house in big town. bone group still stick in some stone. it have part head with low chin. it have 32 tooth. it have neck, back and tail bone. it have right arm frame, part left arm bone, one more left arm bone, three left hand bone. it have part low bone, leg bone, two more leg bone, and foot and toe bone. man take all this bone in year 1980, from stone hole in north part of Italy.

stone hole be first talk about by one old man in year 1883. this man take many back bone and more from near stone hole. other bone be say all sea animal at first. but after, some bone be from other kind of land animal with mouth. not all bone be know in family level. after that, first sea animal bone be take and name from high stone level. this sea animal have long mouth, and many of this kind be take.

even with find in year 1980, this bone group be only first well tell about by two man in year 2014. it be first all bone frame of Italy sea animal. it have big head, big more than rest of body. it have hill on top front of eye hole, so man know it be one kind of big head sea animal. in year 2015 two man give it name. first name be Anguanax. second name be for old man who first find sea animal bone from this stone. first part of name come from old story of north east Italy, about animal with fish and snake way. second part come from Greek, word for big man of power and chief of army.

Anguanax be middle size meat eat, with long body and heavy frame. it be like one old kind well keep in stone. it eat soft or small animal in top water part of sea. wide eye hole to side tell this. long low chin tell this. small thin curve tooth with tiny edge tell this.

Anguanax have two thing not in other sea animal. first thing be hill on top front of eye hole, at middle high place. second thing be low bone at back of arm frame, flat and wide, with straight edge point back and to side. more thing be not common in big head sea animal, so mixed group of thing make it different. narrow back bone point be one. back point bone on back be one. hill in low chin hole be one. step at back of eye hole be one. chest bone mark on tail bone be one. front neck bone with low wide middle hill under be one.

in year 2015 two man do test to find where it be among other big head sea animal. they use big list from one man, year 2014, with most know sea animal. they find it be big head sea animal, but not in one big group. many big head kind come in big mixed group if small part not take out or time be think. map under be simple from this test. it tell only join in big head group.

Ma Xiguang die on day 25 of month 1, year 951. he be four chief of one land, in time of five house and ten land.

no one know when Ma Xiguang be birth. he be 35 son of first chief, he father. he be full young brother of four son, who be brother of he. two be birth from one woman of house. when he father die in year 930, he order son take power by time. so four son take power in year 932, after old brother die. in four son rule, Ma Xiguang be full of care and hear well. four son love him very much.

in year 947, Ma Xiguang hold many high place. he be second army chief of peace land, at head town. four son let him look after army house. when four son die quick in year 947, no one say who be chief after. man of army talk about who can be call to take power. two chief say old son of first chief can be call. this son rule army in other land and be old live son. some chief want help Ma Xiguang. one old man say, old son be strong and will not work for you. if we help you, we must make full care idea to control him. or land will be in danger. other old man say, you rule army house, but old son be more old. you can send man to offer to give up. or fight will certain come. but other chief say, now rule be in hand of you. if you not take what sky give you, where will we be in future? Ma Xiguang be weak and not certain what to do. he let them say it be four son will that he take power. old man see danger come. he say sick and go off from army house.

in fall 947, king of late house of north, who take middle land now, give Ma Xiguang many name. he give army chief, rule of south land, and king son of one land.

at same time, young brother of other woman send secret letter to old son. he push old son to fight, say other man go against first chief will. when old son come near head town to cry for four son, Ma Xiguang send chief watch with boat group to stop him. watch take off old son sword and gun. he put old son in one house. old son cry there, not go to Ma Xiguang house. chief watch say kill old son. but Ma Xiguang say, how can i have heart to kill old brother? i want more cut land in two part and rule them. he give old son many thing and let him go back. still, young brother of other woman keep watch on Ma Xiguang. he push old son to turn against and say he can help him.

in fall 948, king of south land send one man to this land. he say two land make family join by married. before, father of south king take sister of Ma Xiguang as woman of house. Ma Xiguang say no. this make south king angry. he say to man, can Ma fight south? man answer, Ma brother fight one other all time. how can they damage us? south king be happy and say, true. Ma Xiguang be afraid and hold tight to money, and army not think of war long time. this be time to go forward. late in year, south king send army chief to attack this land. he take two town far south.

at same time, Ma big brother send word to north king, son of old north king. he want send thing by self, not with Xiguang. he want land cut in two. one land for Xiguang, one for big brother.

Xiguang hear this. on word of watch man, he give many thing to high man of north king house, want them say no to big brother.

north king say to two brother, brother must have harmony. what big brother want send, send under Xiguang. big brother not happy.

in year 949, big brother fight Xiguang in open. he call man of brother land, make 700 boat, want attack Xiguang land. though woman of big brother say no, he not stop.

when Xiguang hear this, he first want give up. he say, big brother be old brother. i not fight him. i give king land to him. two wise man say no to this. then he send one man, big man of town, to lead army against big brother. wise man go with army to watch.

that man win, take 300 boat of big brother. that man run after big brother, come near to take him. but Xiguang call army back, say to him, do not kill brother.

when big brother run back to brother land, woman of him say bad thing come, i not want see it. she jump in well and die. but that not stop bad think of big brother.

early after, north king general stop fight of other general. north king reward many man, give big name. Xiguang get big name, high chief of king.

same time, young brother of Xiguang, army man of quiet river land, send word to big brother and Xiguang, want stop fight. no one hear him. he fear this bring destruction to Ma family. he get sick on back and die.

big brother, after first lose, make word to chief of three tribe of hill land. he want them join attack on Xiguang land.

tribe chief long hear of Xiguang rich town, want it. so they join big brother, attack river town.

when Xiguang send one man to stop them, that man lose and die. after, two more man also die by join army. this make big fear in Xiguang people. Xiguang then send man to watch town by river, ready for attack.

same time, big brother not give up on north king house side with him. he send man to north king house, want new house for word at big north town. north king say no, land now have house for word.

big brother think north king want keep Xiguang safe, so he think bow to south king in place. he want south king help against Xiguang.

south king say yes, make him high man, give him one year of money from river town. south king also send general with army to help big brother.

Xiguang send word to north king house, want help. he want north king send army to stop at town on river, to cut help from south king to big brother.

in winter 950, that wise man want Xiguang let him lead army to attack brother land. he say he can win and take big brother. Xiguang say yes.

when man lead army to brother land, first no fight. but early fall in bad place of big brother and tribe many man, so army lose all.

Xiguang fear, open big box of thing, give much thing to man of army. he test keep man with him.

same time, word come that young brother talk to big brother. man say kill young brother. but Xiguang say no. he say, if i kill young brother, how i see dead king in dark land?

early after, big brother send general to attack river town. one man of Xiguang leave river town, run back to Xiguang land, so town fall. that general say to big brother, attack Xiguang land again. big brother say yes, go to Xiguang land, leave son of him at brother land, take name of king of sky land.

with big brother come, Xiguang put big army under general to stop attack. he do this because this general be son of old general of dead king. he make young brother watch over this army. one man with horse and one man on foot stop other way.

after short time, brother come with front army of him. army live with mixed 7000 people, some not of same kind. they live west of big river, across from town.

one chief, not of same kind, have long time good feeling for Ma Xiguang. he say he will die for him. this chief want take some people, circle other army, and attack from back. other chief attack from front. he say, if front army lose, brother will stop war.

Ma Xiguang ready to go after this chief. but other chief talk in secret with brother before, and offer part of land for two. he say no to chief. he say to Ma Xiguang, this chief be same kind as hill people of other land. why you hold good feeling for him? i and house be big army chief for many year. i will not be bad to you. brother can do no thing.

after short time, brother come with boat army. boat of brother and other chief be across river, face to face. other chief see brother in secret, not tell army, and say yes to brother rule. one chief see this, go to Ma Xiguang and say, other chief will do bad thing. please kill him now to stop this. Ma Xiguang not think it true. he say, he be son of old chief. how this come? chief leave and cry, but can do no more. at same time, big snow and wind come. no army can fight.

Ma Xiguang look to wise man and holy man. he make stone thing of big animal with hand up, hope this will stop other army. he also have many holy man sing holy word. he put on holy man cloth, hope to get good chance.

early morning on day 21 of month 1, year 951, one chief of brother see flag of other army not in order. he think this be sign that army not in order, so he attack. other army lose. chief die from wound. then brother army use chance to attack big town hard.

two other chief fight hard against attack from early morning to middle day. but one army be tired. no help come from other chief or other man. brother people put fire on east wall. town people question chief come help. chief give up to brother, and then town fall.

one chief go back to help town, but not able. he and other man take son of other Ma people and run to land south. brother take two chief, but see they be strong and true to Ma Xiguang. he let two live.

at same time, as town fall, Ma Xiguang, woman of him and some son live secret in big house. brother people take thing from town. they tell him take big seat.

on day 22 of month 1, year 951, brother come in to town and take over. he shut door and take Ma Xiguang and other people. brother say to Ma Xiguang, be there no order between old and young when come to get work of father and brother? Ma Xiguang answer, it be because of help of chief and big man, and order from king. brother hold him.

on day 24 of month 1, year 951, brother take name of king of south land. he have other people put to death, and army eat body of them. one more also die.

on day 25 of month 1, year 951, brother say to chief and big man in public, Ma Xiguang only weak man, control by friend. may i let him live? no one speak. but one chief, who before hit Ma Xiguang, speak up. he say, you use three year in war to get big town. one land not able have two king. if you let him live, you will regret it.

same day, brother order Ma Xiguang to kill self. Ma Xiguang, near death, sing holy word. one chief make hole and put him in earth, out of town.

he go to big school and learn many thing. then he work in machine company of Sir Joseph. sick in body, he go in month 9, year 1846 to island land, to take good from air. he be help manager of plant company in hill town. he live with company till year 1854, then start new business, dark drink plant trade.

he open office in big sea town. business grow big, and he come to power. he be first English man to lead plant man group, in year 1856 to year 1857. he come back as chief nine time.

from year 1858 he be in law group, as no rule man. he help fight against rice tax. on day 15 of month 11, year 1864, he and five other man leave law group. they think government money way be not good, and not respect law group rule.

he go back to England in year 1859 and live four year in big town in north of England. there he work with old chief as owner too, in machine company. he win money by make small gun. he come back to island land, then lead island trade group in year 1866. he join star knowledge group in London in month 2, year 1872, and plant knowledge group in London too. in month 8, year 1879, business of him stop work after big bad sick in dark drink plant. other company take it.

with business, he love plant and star. he love green plant with feather leaf most. he make big store of dry plant from island land. some of this store be at big learning house in England. in year 1889 he become head word man of island land news paper, for six year. in year 1892 he get big gold thing from club of rich man, for work to end grain tax. after sick in year 1894 he come back to England for help of body man in big sick house, where he die in month 12 of that year. he be married two time, and have 13 child. one son teach plant knowledge in far land, Zealand. other son also become plant knowledge man. daughter of him married big man in year 1881. he die day 18 of month 12, year 1894.

road in north part of island land take name for George. big water stone with wave be at road meeting in town of island land, to make people know George.

Charles Strauss be American man of business and political man. move to dry land in west, for sick body. he make work as chief of public teaching. he also be chief of west town. he also help start big school of learning.

he live from day 15 of month 4, year 1840, in big east town. father and mother be old people from far land. when he be little, family move to Boston, Massachusetts. young man learn in public school, with self learning and Hebrew school. he end school of word in year 1856, and become store man.

in year 1860, he move to big town in south. he work at store of dry thing. after, he grow business in south and in Ohio. in year 1868, he fight against big general, who want be chief of America. in year 1862, general give order to send Jewish people out of south land. people say Jewish people do bad trade. he be married to woman in year 1868. they have five child, four girl and one boy. first child of Strauss die of throat sick in year 1875.

in year 1870, he move family to small town in Massachusetts. there he join secret group of many man. Strauss also join political group. he be part of committee in Massachusetts. in year 1878, group put him forward as chief of record in Massachusetts.

want good weather, Strauss move family to dry hot land in west, in year 1880. there he be manager of store of other man from month 3, year 1880, till year 1883. after, he join town group. he work on school group and new fire group.

Strauss become first Jewish chief of town in year 1883. in time as chief, Strauss watch build of town house and book house. also fire house, money help group, sick house and good road. in Strauss time, general lead army to Mexico to hunt chief of west fight many man. on day 19 of month 6, year 1883, fight chief of west say will do to give up. Strauss make big happy day for general. near end of time as chief, Strauss have trouble with law. on day 6 of month 6, year 1884, Strauss and some many man of town group get crime word for bad act in office. they say they give 5000 money paper with no right power. Strauss and other man of crime get free. in month 10, judge see chief have right power. so judge tell group to say no crime. Strauss leave office on day 8 of month 8, year 1884, right after town group turn over chief say no.

chief of land put Strauss as man of big school of learning. after some many man lose right, for not give money paper. he join group of school many man in month 11, year 1886, and group put him as book man. he work with other many man to start school before law group meeting in month 1, year 1887, can end school right. this work also be work with other man, to trade money paper for build of school.

in year 1886, Strauss win chief of public teaching, after run as man of political group. after he win, law group change this office. now chief put man in it, not by people. in month 1, year 1887, chief of land put Strauss in office. Strauss get put in office again on day 12 of month 3, year 1889, but high group of law say no.

in year 1891, in 16 law group of west land, Strauss be chief book man for meeting. by that time, he have bad sick in chest. Strauss die in town of west, day 13 of month 3, year 1892. first he be put in earth in old town place of dead. after, body move to green place of dead.

Darius 1, king of big land, lead this war in year 513 before. army of Darius go to Scythian land in Europe. Scythian be people from far east. they break trade between two big river and edge of black sea. they also turn against Darius in middle land. this war be in south part of Europe, also in Russia.

Scythian not fight Darius army in straight fight. Scythian live on move, with no town, but one. Darius army lose many man, because Scythian burn land first. but Darius take much land and damage friend of Scythian, force Scythian to respect Darius army. Darius end walk to hold win land, and build long wall.

almost all we know of this war come from old history book. no writing from Darius people, and no writing from Scythian. so it be hard to know how much of old history be true.

Darius go over black sea at narrow water, with bridge of boat. Darius take big part of east Europe, even go over big river to fight Scythian. Darius go to Scythian land with chief of army. Scythian run from Darius army, use trick, run east, burn land. they put dust in well, take food transport, kill grass. many small fight come again and again. Darius army want fight Scythian. Darius army go after Scythian army deep in Scythian land, most in land now. no town to take, no food to find. Darius be angry, so he send letter to Scythian king. he say give up or fight. king answer he not stop and fight Darius, if not Darius army find and break dead place of old man of Scythian. till then, they keep this way. they have no town or land to lose. even so, Darius war be good for now. old writing say Scythian lose good land and damage friend. now fact be Darius have power. as he move east in Scythian land, he keep food by ship and live off land.

while move east in Scythian land, he take big town with wall, one friend of Scythian, and burn it.

Darius stop at river edge. he build eight big wall, some eight far from every other. no doubt to keep edge safe. this be as far east as Darius want go, for now. after month of hunt, Darius army lose many man by tired, no food and sick. old writing say wall still be here now. afraid to lose more man, Darius stop walk at big river edge, then go to west. he not fight Scythian in straight fight, so he have no reason to hold land. power still be with him. Scythian keep run and burn, they lose much. Darius lose too. he take enough Scythian land to force Scythian to respect Darius army.

all land from middle land to Georgia, and from north part of black sea to Mediterranean, form one land with same trade between Scythian, Greek and Darius people. Darius must see Scythian people come from north land to far east land. long line of bad run man. also, no one have black sea. control of black sea have no land line. Darius people and Greek too want control place of Scythian gold, grain, skin and hair. many Greek live in Darius land, and some live in Greek town in south east land.

as old writing say, Greek man of knowledge at king house, near year 400 before, say that before Darius walk, one Darius man sail black sea to north. he take Scythian land with 30 ship. he come back with Scythian man, female, and brother of Scythian king.

some think Darius only want break Scythian land, but bridge over narrow water say no. Darius have big ship, and carry army over sea. Scythian have no ship at all.

though old writing not say part of year, we can think it. if Darius walk from big town in east in spring of year 513 before, he get to west town in month 5. he make army on west side in month 6. so he may start go past river in late month 8.

Darius do much damage to Scythian and friend of them. he make king of Scythian group weak.

but he can no bring Scythian to fight, so he take no land. he no even end building of house at edge of land.

this go journey be little more than big waste. no one win.

winter come now, so Darius no go to attack. he go to west, to safe land of Darius.

some king power may keep here after Darius go. Scythian across sea be say in stone writing of king. king win them in far land, one of many people. one old wise man have belief that king army win Scythian land. he say Scythian free self only in year 496. then king house lose all land in west. this be cause of big fight.

friend group of Scythian be many people. some be from north, some from east. many chief from sea land be in this too, from town near sea. one chief have big ship.

this fight be big win for Scythian. king people stop to win Scythian.

one old Greek wise man have right belief. he say Scythian get free because they can go fast. they have no big house in one place. they have good many man on horse with bow.

Coartaci be system of self payment for free. it be in Latin America from year 1500 to year 1900. in society of servant, servant make first payment and make price for free. this give servant new name, Coartaci, with more right and more good.

word first come from Spanish word for cut off or limit. first use be to limit how servant make price, cut it off from trade price up, so owner can not get more. but by year 1700, word change to say limit on power of owner.

servant in Spanish America be base on law book of year 1348. this law book make clear all law in world must lead to free. but it not speak of how servant get free. Roman law, which change European law of servant, let servant give money self free with self money. this be few.

law book give servant right to get self money.

before island grow big farm of servant, servant do big work in trade, as man of work and art. through speak with other man, this servant learn of Spanish law. law let servant tell authority bad thing by owner. so servant make connection with judge.

number of man from town in Spain have some man as cut. in year 1729, Spanish word book say cut self be process. by this process servant talk with owner and limit price of free.

also, in year 1766 Spain make paper law, tax on trade must be take in some example of Coartaci. Coartaci not put in island law till year 1842.

before law rule of year 1842, owner work to end this way of Coartaci. they see it as bad thing for servant living. but British many man of change grow strong power. chief make this law against owner. owner keep say no to this law. they say it cause bad secret.

law house work to look again at some part of this law. most of all, part let servant change owner as they want. at last, in year 1862, law house make decision to keep all part of law. in year 1871, chief make true country servant not change owner as they want. but by this time, east part of island have big war against rule. this make fear for all servant system.

servant first make price of self free with owner in front of judge. servant then give money big part of price. then paper make servant new name, Coartaci. but this way can be hard, as many man who see value give very other price.

servant with name Coartaci then give money little by little over many day, till get full price for free. price fixed be most big thing in this way. if other owner get servant with Coartaci name, value be same. take off what servant give back.

man who want servant can give more than price now. this be few, because it make man bad with money. when servant with Coartaci name give full price, they get paper of free. but man of history think other paper of trade also be paper of free, get from Coartaci. because say man who get this paper give very low price, down from trade price. this servant may give part to owner, out of judge.

servant can get some amount of money and land. in town, servant can do other work and make money. in country part, servant can have small farm. they can grow small amount of grain and keep some animal.

some owner think small farm be need to keep peace and make true servant system keep. servant can also get money for Coartaci from help of other man.

with word of free, half free servant get some right over normal servant. one time servant be make half free, owner can not put him back to servant. one time he become half free, he keep that till he make full payment for free. some half free man not make full payment. they make small payment many time, to get more good and safe living. because half free servant still be servant in law, owner must keep help him. this may have come from good work money. if half free servant work for other man, he get part of money. idea be that half free man have part of property that be work for other man. half free man also have more right to change owner. before, servant can call for change of owner if owner be very bad to him. half free man can change owner with no cause. this right be very weak, because owner win in law house many time.

half free way never seem to be as big in Latin America as in first island, land of Spanish. some man learn in Mexico, west land, south land, Spanish land and Brazil. only in gold mine land and south town be half free big way to get free. many black man from black island, French land, come to Spanish land because of this.

in Brazil, half free way be not same as in first island. most important, we see no sign that Brazil half free man get any special right before they make full payment for free. they can not change owner with no cause, or take part of money when they work for other man. this be very bad for Brazil half free man, because many servant in Brazil do many kind of work and get small money. this be big way for Brazil servant to get money to make self free. other change be how it start. in Brazil, owner put man to be half free. in first island, servant start it.

even if they be, chance to get free in other Europe land be small, after to Spanish and Portuguese land. black law and other law like it put many limit for free. self payment never become way for servant to get free, because servant not have enough chance to get money. in American south, land owner not want servant to use law for self good. servant not able to go to law house for self or other man. what servant say in law house be no good, till hard pain make them say it. by rule, law house almost never use for free. different in way to free for island and south servant also come from kind of work. south servant work on farm most part, with market go up and down. island servant also do good work in other place.

more man servant be there than woman servant, but woman make 55 and 67 out of 100 of all free in Latin America. there be many cause for this. first, woman servant be value not so much as man servant. they can work in other place as cook, or give milk to

one wise man say Coartaci be big thing for man under owner. let them go to law house and make living.

other wise man say only small part of man under owner come free from Coartaci in Latin America. big thing of Coartaci be this. it turn normal thing of Spanish land round. man under owner can put thing on owner.

many say Coartaci be road of control for owner. owner give man under owner reason, not fight.

so many free people of colour live in Spanish America. by year 1800, free people of colour be more than man under owner in Mexico and two other big place of Spanish America.

in big place near sea in Brazil, 30 of 100 people be free colour. in other place, 20 of 100 be free colour.

in general, this not break big system of man under owner. and some free man, who be under owner before, even have man under owner. this be not common, because most free people of colour be poor.

Harriet Patience Dame live from day 5 of number 1, year 1815, to day 24 of number 4, year 1900. Dame be strong help for sick man in American war of big fight. picture of Dame hold in house of government in north land.

Dame be come to birth in small town of north land, to father and mother, day 5 of number 1, year 1815. Dame be last of five child. in year 1843, Dame move to town of north land, where she live till war come. Dame do many work. by year 1861, she keep house for school child. she have no learning in help for sick man.

when war come, Dame, 46 year old, go to place where new army man learn fight, in town of north land. she offer help to chief there. because place have no house for sick, Dame be put as help for sick man.

Dame join group number 2 of new man as chief help for sick man, from number 6 of year 1861 to day 25 of number 12, year 1865. she work with no rest through two long year. her give money as help be six money every moon till year 1863. then give money go up to ten money every moon.

group be man from town of north land and small town near. group be lead by chief of army. Dame go and sleep with man, many day, as only woman among thousand man.

in number 9 of year 1864, Dame be make chief of sick house for army group 18. her work be watch other help, and cook food for sick man, many in thousand. i see her face big gun with no fear. while man go back her for safe from fly fire. she be always here when most need.

she see fight at four big fight, first, second, and more. Dame help man more than sick help. other time she look at clean and sick of other group. Dame be at this sick house till end of war fight. then she go back to group number 2. on day 25 of number 12, year 1865, group leave army, end Dame work.

she be take by enemy in two big fight. enemy let her go. at second big fight, Dame be take by enemy, but let go, because she help man of one side and other side all same. on one day, big chief of enemy let her go back to her side.

after short time after war, William give Dame work in government house in Washington. she work there for 28 year, till year 1895. she do not go back to house land till year 1900. in year 1884, government give her money for old work, but Dame always give money to man in need.

Dame be three chief of big group of army help for American war. first chief die. Dr leave.

Dame be never married. she die in town of north land. she be put in earth at hill of flower.

sign of army group 18, sign of army group 3, sign of army group 12, and gold sign from group 2.

after short time after war, government give Dame 500 money for great help of people. she give most money to group 2, for build of house for old army man.

when she die in year 1900, chief of land and army man join her last walk.

in year 1901, government of north land say her picture be paint and hold in government house. it be first picture of woman in that house.

Harriet Dame school in town of north land have her name.

in year 2002, Dame be more to big house of great people by American group of help for sick man.
