Roebuck be war ship of England. she have 44 gun. she carry 20 long gun to fight. she be put in sea on day 21 of month 12, year 1743. she first go to sea between England and France. this be in war with Austrian people. England join that war in month 3, year 1744.

in year 1744, Roebuck be part of big sea army under big chief John. Roebuck walk with many ship to town in west land. but Roebuck go after enemy ship. so she lose group. she come to big river near town after group. she see that John ship go back before. French sea army stop her there till day 9 of month 9. help come then. after that, she go to Mediterranean. she join big chief William and that sea army. they fight near big town in Italy.

in year 1756, war start. Roebuck go to far west land. there she fight in attack on island. in month 1, year 1759, she fight in attack on island. in month 4, she help take big island.

Roebuck leave for last time in month 8, year 1759. she be use for short time as private ship. in year 1764, she come back to England. people look at her at town near sea. on day 3 of month 7, year 1764, people send her off for money.

Roebuck be one of group of ship of year 1741. ship have 2 floor. king sea army order them. first order be day 1 of month 12, year 1742, as 40 gun ship. but she be complete with 44 gun. she have 20 gun on under floor. she have 20 gun on high floor. she have 4 gun on back floor. build start on day 2 of month 1, year 1743. when build, Roebuck be long. she be big across and deep. she have 708 weight.

king sea army give 7266 money for her. Roebuck go in sea on day 21 of month 12, year 1743. first, man Thomas lead her. then she go to town near sea. there she be complete. she take 4251 more money. after complete, Roebuck join sea army under big chief John.

John army leave sea town early on day 7 of month 3, year 1744. they hear 15 French ship be out of far place. wind and water go wrong way. so British stop near enemy. at hour 11, Roebuck come to them from town near sea. at hour 1 after morning, big wind come up. it last most of day. it break rope and make ship go many way. Roebuck stop still but lose one small boat. wind stop that night, but French go before. France and Britain be at peace on paper. but war may come any time. big army of French ship at town near sea may come. so John stop from go after them.

John want keep enough ship to attack French at town near sea, if chance come. but ship be need to walk with 6000 Dutch man from town. in addition, big chief Thomas army in Mediterranean be very short of food. food ship at town near sea can not move while French be still free. John must break army in two. he want keep sea army from get weak. so he take eight of strong ship under chief Charles. they walk with food group only as far as far place. two ship, Roebuck and other one, take food group rest of way. order change after. Roebuck and other ship take ship only as far as big river. Thomas be left to do rest of way.

group will sail on day 5 of month 4. but bad weather make them stop till day 10 of month 4. motion be slow for no wind. so sea army stop again. when wind come back, it blow wrong way. on day 13 of month 4, chief Charles get news no one can say be true. French ship at far place put to sea. one light group go to big town in west land now be weak to attack. on day 23 of month 4, king sea army send new order. chief Charles must send one ship first to look at far place. if talk be true, all group walk with food group to town in west land. if false, he need only go past bad place with food group. then he leave Roebuck and other ship to go with it rest of way. first one be true. so on day 4 of month 5, year 1744, Roebuck and other ship walk with food group up sea. some big ship walk with them.

Roebuck leave group when she go after and take Spanish ship. it have 18 gun. this be west of far point. she come to town in west land on day 17 of month 5 with what she take. group be there, three day before. chief Charles ship go back to sea town. after that, group and five other ship send by Thomas stop. French sea army stop them. on day 9 of month 9, help come. 25 British and Dutch ship under Sir John come to them. French go to far place and stop. they be stop there too.

Roebuck join big chief William and sea army in Mediterranean. on day 31 of month 10, year 1744, she go with 3 other ship. they go to watch Spanish at far place. rest of ship look after big group of trade ship. in month 9, year 1745, she be join small group. group have 5 level ship and 2 fire ship. group have 2 other small ship. they watch big town on sea. they walk side of land near big town in Italy. they stop food move between far town and sea near Italy. Roebuck be some time at stop in town near sea in Italy. big ship hit big town in Italy with gun. she leave on day 12 of month 10 to join William again.

in month 12, year 1746, Roebuck come under chief John. Roebuck bring gun to Austrian army. Austrian army stop at town on sea, make long attack. Roebuck stop with group of boat under chief Henry. on day 1 of month 2, Austrian army go back. they fear strong army of French chief. Austrian chief also think attack not work. he say town get meal when bad weather push boat off from place. Henry group not need now. group go to Spanish town. Roebuck and small boat stop to keep safe two island. British friend hold this island. on day 18 of month 2, many small boat come near town edge. chief send one big boat and two small boat to burn them. French man come together on edge to keep boat safe. British take six and burn many more. no British man die. four day after, one more big army come to edge with gun. they want attack stone house on island. chief order new attack. many gun on edge fire hard at small group of chief. Roebuck quick stop gun there and make enemy go back. big boat have to go back, in danger of go down in sea. Roebuck keep fire till it be too dark. in this, Roebuck get 30 ball in her side and much do bad to her tall stick and rope. six of her man die and 14 get wound. to stop more attack, chief George go to watch more island.

when war end in month 10, year 1748, Roebuck get money, then leave. she go back to England, where she get look over in month 11. work start in month 4, year 1750 at sea town near river. it take five year and need money 3128, 19 bit, 9 bit. when boat get new work at second place, money go up to 8189, 5, 2. Roebuck come back to work in month 7, year 1755 under new chief.

in month 12, year 1756, Roebuck be on island group of big sea under chief John. chief John after take her to other island group. in year 1757, Roebuck carry chief George to England. she come to sea place on day 17 of month 7. chief John give up control to chief Thomas. chief Thomas take boat back to island in month 12.

Roebuck be there for fight on big island in year 1759. to help fight on French land in sea, group join with eight big boat and boat carry 4400 man under army chief. more man come to island from England in month 1. sea chief keep control of sea fight. group go out to sea on day 13 of month 1, come two day after to big water near land. at 8 hour on day 16 of month 1, Roebuck with other boat fire on gun in water near land. gun there be to stop man come on land. at same time, other boat attack far stone house. gun in water near land go quiet when store blow up. but Roebuck and other boat keep fire at edge so enemy can not form up and stop man land. group keep fire for much of day after and cover man when they land at 16 hour. with no water to drink and 10000 French man and army, British be force to go back.

British group come near town at middle day on day 22 of month 1. they start attack day after. sea chief take eight big boat near to fire on gun and top house of town. when one big boat stick on sand, Roebuck and other boat need go in and help her. by 17 hour, French gun be quiet. at 22 hour, four small fire boat start to fire on town. fire go on all night, make big fire that burn house and stone house. on day 24 of month 1, man land and fast take town. but they can not get town chief, who run to mountain. by day 30 of month 1, 1500 of army man have die from sick. on day 13 of month 2, sea chief send Roebuck with other boat and two fire boat to attack stone house on other side of island. after six hour of fire, Scottish man and sea man land and take town and house.

on day 11 of month 3, sea chief get news of French group with eight big boat and three big boat. Roebuck stop to keep boat safe, while sea chief come together boat and go out to far water near land. there he can get water and see what enemy do.

after three month of hard fight, on day 22 of month 4, town chief of French island offer to give up. army chief die from sick at end of month 2, so other army chief John take it. agreement be make on day 25 of month 4.

Roebuck get money and leave for last time in month 8, year 1759. from month 6, year 1762 till month 1, year 1764, she be give out to other land for fight, with private control. when she come back, she get look over and then trade at sea town for money 560, 0, 0 on day 3 of month 7.

Kutlugh Turkan be king of one land from year 1257 till year 1282. Kutlugh Turkan birth near year 1208 or 1213, death year 1283.

different story tell about her early living. one book by man no name say she may be birth in far land between year 1208 and year 1213. then she trade to one man of trade from big town. that man take her as child, grow her with good teaching. other book say she be woman of one son of big king in far land. then she be woman of other man. but one woman say she be daughter of that man.

she make married her man on day 5 of month 9, year 1235. her man be son of brother of old king, and be new king after him. but they go to big house of far king. this be when other son of old king be new king of that land. they come back to that land when great king make her man king, in month 12 of year 1252. but in month 9 of year 1257 her man die. her son be still small child then.

in year 1257, big man of that land and one great king say she be new king of that land. one book say she only have say in law. man of her daughter lead army, by order of great king. this change early, when she speak to great king. she make him change he say. she make good connection with great king, by send her son to he army.

in year 1264, great king say yes, she be king again. holy word say her new name too. one woman book say Kutlugh be one of Muslim woman king who have right to rule. in year 1265 she go to see new king. he give one town to her daughter. they be married in year 1272.

after this, her rule be trouble by her two son. they fight her right to be king, and one even think kill her. but she go to that one town, where her daughter be king. one son be bad king. he have to go to far land after year. other son, son of other woman, come to that land in month 9, day 19, year 1280. he make her give him king place with her till day 19 of month 10. he name say in holy word too. she go to her daughter. her daughter give one paper from great king. paper say no to that son. he no touch thing of that land.

last time of her rule be time of gold, good for that land. she give food store for people in year 1263 or 1264. people say good of her. she help make many thing. strong house in year 1279, house of learning, house for sick, holy house, water road under land, and 16 or more group that give help.

but in year 1282, new great king make other son king of that land, by help of her mother. Kutlugh Turkan go to great king in one far town. she say no, but she no win. she die in summer, year 1283, in one place near that far town. she be put in dead house in that land.

she be married to her man on day 5 of month 9, year 1235. she have 3 or more child with him.

first child be girl. she be married to new king, then to other king.

second child be girl, Turkan. she be married to one big man, then to other man.
